papers.title: A Systematic Survey of Decompilation: Mapping Classical and Machine-Learning Approaches
papers.abstract: Context: Decompilers reconstruct source-level code from compiled binaries, and analysts rely on them whenever source code is unavailable. Many recent studies apply machine learning (ML), including large language models, to parts of this task. From the primary literature alone, it is unclear where these methods sit in the classical decompilation pipeline and how well their claims are supported. Objectives: We map decompilation research onto a pipeline-centered taxonomy and ask two questions: where classical, ML-trained, and ML-prompted approaches are positioned (RQ1), and how ML-based studies vary in technical design and evaluation evidence (RQ2). Methods: We surveyed 405 decompilation studies from 1973 to 2026, collected through database search and citation tracing. We classified 394 primary studies into eight pipeline stages and two complementary categories. For the 116 ML-based studies that propose or modify decompilation methods, we extracted the model-use strategy, reusable backbones, target platform, and the evidence behind each evaluation. Results: Classical techniques still dominate front-end recovery, IR lifting, and control-flow structuring (277 of 394 primary studies are classical). ML-based work (117 studies) clusters instead around symbol and name recovery, output refinement, and end-to-end translation. Type recovery is the clearest mixed region. Most ML-based studies target native binaries (97 of 116), and most evidence is item-level matching against references (89 of 116); execution-based tests, human or LLM judgment, and downstream-task evidence are much rarer. Conclusion: ML has not displaced the classical pipeline. It has been taken up where a recovered artifact can be posed as a prediction, translation, or refinement problem, and reported gains only make sense when read against the pipeline position and the evidence used to support them.

translation.title: 反编译系统性综述：梳理经典方法与机器学习方法
translation.abstract: 背景：反编译器从编译后的二进制文件中重建源码级代码，当源代码不可用时分析师依赖它们。近期许多研究将机器学习（ML），包括大语言模型，应用于该任务的部分环节。仅从一手文献来看，尚不清楚这些方法在经典反编译流水线中的位置，以及其论断得到多大程度的支持。目标：我们将反编译研究映射到一个以流水线为中心的分类体系中，并提出两个问题：经典方法、ML训练方法和ML提示方法分别处于什么位置（RQ1），以及基于ML的研究在技术设计和评估证据上有何差异（RQ2）。方法：我们调研了1973年至2026年的405项反编译研究，通过数据库检索和引文追踪收集。我们将394项一手研究分为八个流水线阶段和两个互补类别。对于提出或修改反编译方法的116项基于ML的研究，我们提取了模型使用策略、可复用的骨干模型、目标平台以及每项评估背后的证据。结果：经典技术仍然主导前端恢复、IR提升和控制流结构化（394项一手研究中有277项是经典方法）。基于ML的工作（117项研究）则集中在符号和名称恢复、输出精炼以及端到端翻译上。类型恢复是最明显的混合区域。大多数基于ML的研究面向原生二进制（116项中有97项），大多数证据是针对参照项的条目级匹配（116项中有89项）；基于执行的测试、人工或LLM评判以及下游任务证据则要稀少得多。结论：ML尚未取代经典流水线。它被应用于可将恢复产物表述为预测、翻译或精炼问题的环节，而所报告的收益只有在结合其流水线位置和支持它们的证据来解读时才有意义。
translation.brief: 该综述将405项反编译研究映射到流水线分类体系中，用以定位经典与机器学习方法各自所处的环节并评估其证据支撑。

papers.title: Does Your Agent Need to Know Its Budget? A Placebo-Controlled Experiment on LLM Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Organizations deploying autonomous coding agents impose token budgets, yet the causal effects of a budget, and of telling the agent about it, are unmeasured. We conduct a placebo-controlled factorial experiment under a frozen, timestamped protocol, crossing budget enforcement with budget disclosure on two executable program-repair benchmarks (5,835 runs, two open models, three cap levels). Enforcing a calibrated cap reduced task resolution by 20.0 percentage points while reducing tokens per resolved task roughly twelvefold. Disclosing the enforced budget never helped: the placebo-controlled risk difference was -2.8 pp (95% CI [-6.2, +0.7]) at the medium cap and -4.2 pp ([-8.1, -0.2], nominally significant, unadjusted) at the tight cap, with every prompt wording and per-turn feedback variant far below the 10-point effect size of interest. Observed run-to-run outcome variance was roughly 1.5x the uncapped level under caps, though part of this reflects resolution rates moving nearer one half. These results make budget governance for coding agents an enforcement-design problem: no communication variant produced an effect beyond that of an unrelated sentence, which itself raised resolution by 7.2 pp (95% CI [+4.0, +10.5]) over silent enforcement, a sentence effect that only a placebo control removes.

translation.title: 你的Agent需要知道自己的预算吗？一项针对LLM编程Agent的安慰剂对照实验
translation.abstract: 部署自主编程Agent的组织会施加token预算，然而预算本身以及告知Agent预算的因果效应从未被测量过。我们在一个冻结的、带时间戳的协议下进行安慰剂对照析因实验，将预算强制执行与预算披露交叉组合，在两个可执行的程序修复基准上进行（5,835次运行，两个开源模型，三个上限档位）。执行一个经过校准的预算上限使任务解决率降低了20.0个百分点，同时使每个已解决任务的token消耗降低约十二倍。披露已执行的预算从未带来帮助：安慰剂对照的风险差在中等上限下为-2.8个百分点（95% CI [-6.2, +0.7]），在严格上限下为-4.2个百分点（[-8.1, -0.2]，名义上显著、未校正），且每一种提示措辞和逐轮反馈变体都远低于10个百分点的目标效应量。在上限约束下观察到的运行间结果方差约为无上限水平的1.5倍，尽管其中部分反映了解决率移向一半附近。这些结果表明，编程Agent的预算治理是一个强制执行设计问题：没有任何沟通变体产生了超出无关句子所能产生的效应，而该无关句子本身相对沉默执行使解决率提高了7.2个百分点（95% CI [+4.0, +10.5]），这种句子效应只有通过安慰剂对照才能剔除。
translation.brief: 该研究通过安慰剂对照析因实验测量token预算的强制执行与告知对LLM编程Agent的因果影响，发现执行预算会大幅降低解决率而披露预算无益。

papers.title: Revision-Consistent Code Context for Agents That Edit Their Environment
papers.abstract: Editing agents query repositories while simultaneously changing them. Source content, symbols, graph relations, and retrieval state may be maintained by different stores and refreshed at different times. During an update, a successful query can therefore combine facts that never belonged to the same repository state. We call this condition mixed-revision code context. This paper proposes an Agent-visible complete-revision publication contract for composite code-intelligence queries. Before a query-visible publication point, a service must wait, report unavailability, or serve a complete old revision; after that point, it serves the complete new revision. The contract requires a shared version identity and publication boundary across every view returned in one response. We instantiate the method in Codetrip, whose brief operation joins source, symbol, and graph facts. In a controlled comparison on frozen Gin v1.12.0, live-source composition produced two unsafe responses in 150 update trials, whereas complete-revision publication produced none under the same five edit scenarios. We further implement journaled, idempotent publication and terminate the real MCP process at five durable boundaries. All 300 evaluable recovery trials on frozen Gin and Cobra returned complete-new context equivalent to a clean full rebuild, with median restart-to-context latency of 77--131 ms. In a separate rename probe, mixed context occurred in 0/30 Codetrip trials and 30/30 trials for both CodeGraph and codebase-memory-mcp before clean-full-equivalent convergence. The contribution is an Agent-facing safety contract, implementation pattern, and measurement protocol for joining live repository bytes with asynchronously derived facts. Every successful composite response consequently has a testable repository-state meaning, including after interruption.

translation.title: 面向编辑环境的Agent的修订一致性代码上下文
translation.abstract: 编辑型Agent在查询代码库的同时也在修改它。源内容、符号、图关系和检索状态可能由不同的存储维护并在不同时间刷新。在更新过程中，一次成功的查询因此可能组合出从未属于同一代码库状态的事实。我们将这种状况称为混合修订代码上下文。本文为复合代码智能查询提出一个Agent可见的完整修订发布契约。在查询可见的发布点之前，服务必须等待、报告不可用，或提供完整的旧修订；在该点之后，则提供完整的新修订。该契约要求在同一次响应返回的所有视图上共享版本标识和发布边界。我们在Codetrip中实例化该方法，其简短操作会连接源码、符号和图事实。在冻结的Gin v1.12.0上的受控比较中，实时源码组合在150次更新试验中产生了两次不安全响应，而完整修订发布在相同的五种编辑场景下均未产生。我们进一步实现了带日志的幂等发布，并在五个持久边界处终止真实的MCP进程。在冻结的Gin和Cobra上所有300次可评估的恢复试验均返回了等同于干净全量重建的完整新上下文，重启到可用上下文的中位延迟为77–131毫秒。在一个单独的重命名探针中，Codetrip在30次试验中0次出现混合上下文，而CodeGraph和codebase-memory-mcp在达到干净全量等效收敛前均为30/30次。贡献是一个面向Agent的安全契约、实现模式和测量协议，用于将实时代码库字节与异步派生的事实进行连接。由此，每个成功的复合响应都具有可测试的代码库状态含义，包括在中断之后。
translation.brief: 该论文提出完整修订发布契约，解决编辑型Agent在查询与修改代码库时可能读到混合修订上下文的问题。

papers.title: A Chain-of-Thought Prompt Engineering Framework for Automated Technical Specification Generation in Enterprise Integration: A Real-World Case Study
papers.abstract: Technical Specification Documents (TSDs) translate functional requirements into implementable designs and are mandatory artifacts in governed Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) programs, yet their production remains a manual, expertise-intensive bottleneck. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been studied extensively for code generation, but long-form, template-governed engineering documents remain comparatively unexplored. This paper reports an industrial case study, conducted during a migration of more than 250 enterprise integrations to Microsoft Azure Integration Services at a large Australian wholesale distributor, that introduces a chain-of-thought prompt-engineering framework for automated TSD generation using GitHub Copilot. The framework combines a two-phase generation architecture that grounds the model in the functional specification, organizational standards, and the approved template; a six-stage prompting pipeline with human validation checkpoints; and Prompt-as-a-Code, under which prompts are version-controlled and reviewed as engineering artifacts. Applied to a stratified sample of fifteen production interfaces, the framework reduced TSD authoring effort from 793 to 300 person-hours, a 62.2% pooled reduction and a 64.0% mean per-document reduction (Wilcoxon signed-rank, n = 15, p < 0.001), at 74.3% reviewer-assessed accuracy and 3.7/5 developer satisfaction. Benefits degrade monotonically with interface complexity: between the simplest and most complex bands, effort reduction falls from 70.6% to 58.9% and accuracy from 91% to 62.5%, and the residual human effort concentrates in diagrams, sequence flows, and cross-system integration content. We additionally report comparative observations of GPT-4.1/5 and Claude Sonnet 4, as well as Copilot's Ask and Agent interaction modes, offering reusable, practice-grounded guidance for enterprise settings.

translation.title: 面向企业集成中自动生成技术规格的思维链提示工程框架：一个真实案例研究
translation.abstract: 技术规格文档（TSD）将功能需求转化为可实施的设计，是受治理的企业应用集成（EAI）项目中的强制性产物，但其生产仍然是手动且依赖专业知识的瓶颈。大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面已被广泛研究，但长篇、模板约束的工程文档相对未被探索。本文报告了一项工业案例研究，该研究在一家澳大利亚大型批发分销商将250多个企业集成迁移到Microsoft Azure Integration Services的过程中进行，提出了一个基于GitHub Copilot、用于自动生成TSD的思维链提示工程框架。该框架结合了两阶段生成架构（将模型锚定在功能规格、组织标准和已批准模板上）、带人工验证检查点的六阶段提示流水线，以及Prompt-as-a-Code（将提示作为工程产物进行版本控制和评审）。应用于15个生产接口的分层样本，该框架将TSD编写工作量从793人时降至300人时，总体降低62.2%，单篇文档平均降低64.0%（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，n=15，p<0.001），评审员评估的准确率为74.3%，开发者满意度为3.7/5。收益随接口复杂度单调下降：在最简单与最复杂区间之间，工作量降低从70.6%降至58.9%，准确率从91%降至62.5%，剩余的人工工作集中在图表、时序流程和跨系统集成内容上。我们还报告了对GPT-4.1/5和Claude Sonnet 4以及Copilot的Ask和Agent交互模式的对比观察，为企业环境提供了可复用的、基于实践的指导。
translation.brief: 该研究提出一个基于思维链和Copilot的提示工程框架，用于自动化企业集成中技术规格文档的生成以减少人工编写工作量。

papers.title: The Defense Rests: A Courtroom-Inspired Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Safety Case Generation
papers.abstract: Safety cases are widely used to demonstrate that mission-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and unmanned aerial systems, can operate safely after deployment. However, manually constructing safety cases is complex, time-consuming, and labor-intensive, which calls for the proposal of automated approaches to support their creation. Inspired by the legal nature of safety case construction, we formalize the safety case creation problem through a courtroom analogy, where stakeholders collaboratively propose, examine, criticize, review, improve and validate safety claims and their supporting evidence. In this analogy, the safety analyst acts as a prosecutor by identifying hazards and safety concerns, while the assurance case developer serves as a defense attorney by constructing and substantiating safety arguments. An orchestrator acts as a judge by coordinating stakeholder interactions, and a review board serves as a jury by assessing argument completeness and persuasiveness. Based on this formalization, we propose eTrustWare, a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for automated safety case generation and review. Our experiments on several safety cases of ML-enabled autonomous driving systems demonstrate the feasibility of coordinated LLM-based agents for generating safety cases.

translation.title: 辩方休庭：一个法庭启发的多Agent LLM框架，用于自动化安全论证生成
translation.abstract: 安全论证被广泛用于证明任务关键系统（如自动驾驶车辆和无人飞行系统）在部署后可以安全运行。然而，手动构建安全论证复杂、耗时且劳动密集，这呼唤提出自动化方法来支持其创建。受安全论证构建的法律本质启发，我们通过法庭类比形式化安全论证创建问题，其中利益相关者协作地提出、审查、批评、评审、改进和验证安全主张及其支撑证据。在这个类比中，安全分析师充当控方检察官，负责识别危害和安全关注点；保证论证开发者充当辩护律师，负责构建和充实安全论据；一个编排者充当法官，协调利益相关者的交互；一个评审委员会充当陪审团，评估论证的完整性和说服力。基于这一形式化，我们提出了eTrustWare，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多Agent框架，用于自动化安全论证的生成与评审。我们在若干ML赋能的自动驾驶系统的安全论证上的实验证明了协同的LLM Agent生成安全论证的可行性。
translation.brief: 该研究以法庭类比形式化安全论证构建问题，并提出基于LLM的多Agent框架eTrustWare来自动化生成和评审安全论证。

papers.title: From AIOps Pipelines to Agentic Service Operations: A Survey of Capability, Authority, and Evidence
papers.abstract: Modern service systems combine rapidly changing dependencies, heterogeneous telemetry, and operational actions whose side effects may amplify an incident. Conventional AIOps research has produced effective detectors, localizers, and diagnostic models, yet surveys typically organize them by task, telemetry modality, or learning technique. Such taxonomies describe what a method predicts, but not which decisions it may make or which evidence justifies that authority. We survey the transition from AIOps pipelines to agentic service operations through three coupled lenses: capability, operational authority, and evaluation evidence. We first relate SOA, microservices, Kubernetes, service meshes, and serverless platforms to the incident lifecycle. We then review conventional AIOps methods and audit 22 language-model-enabled systems according to their evaluated behavior rather than their intended autonomy. The audit shows that most systems remain copilots or read-only investigators. Only two exercise write authority; both use constrained action envelopes, and neither carries controlled production-outcome evidence. Building on these findings, we synthesize a four-plane reference architecture, evidence grades, an evaluation ladder, and a controlled adoption path. Together, these artifacts clarify which claims current evaluations support and what evidence is still required for dependable agentic service operations.

translation.title: 从AIOps流水线到智能体化服务运维：能力、权限与证据综述
translation.abstract: 现代服务系统具有快速变化的依赖关系、异构的遥测数据，以及副作用可能放大故障的运维操作。传统AIOps研究已产出有效的检测、定位与诊断模型，但已有综述通常按任务、遥测模态或学习技术来组织它们。这类分类法描述了方法预测什么，却未说明它可以做出哪些决策、何种证据支撑这种权限。本文通过三个相互关联的视角——能力、运维权限和评估证据——综述从AIOps流水线到智能体化服务运维的转变。我们首先将SOA、微服务、Kubernetes、服务网格和Serverless平台与故障生命周期关联起来，随后综述传统AIOps方法，并依据22个语言模型驱动系统的实际评估行为而非其宣称的自主性对其进行审计。审计显示，大多数系统仍处于副驾驶或只读调查者角色；只有两个系统拥有写操作权限，且均使用受限的操作边界，也没有任何一个具备受控的生产结果证据。基于这些发现，我们综合出四平面参考架构、证据分级、评估阶梯和受控的采纳路径。这些成果共同澄清了当前评估能够支持哪些声明，以及可靠的智能体化服务运维还需要何种证据。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体化服务运维缺乏系统化分类与评估证据的问题，采用能力、权限、证据三视角审计22个LLM系统并提出四平面参考架构与证据分级体系。

papers.title: CrisisBench: an evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI
papers.abstract: Background: Crisis helplines are essential to mental health systems but are often understaffed and underfunded. LLMs could support counselors, but existing benchmarks do not capture the escalation, risk assessment, and de-escalation central to crisis conversations, while privacy restrictions limit use of real transcripts. Methods: We present CrisisBench, a privacy-preserving suite for single- and multi-turn crisis counseling evaluation. It includes 1,085 single-turn tasks from 200 de-identified conversations and 1,185 patient LLMs derived from hotline metadata. Patient models and a 23-item LLM judge were calibrated against expert counselors. Results: We evaluated five GPT models plus draft-then-edit and retrieval-augmented generation. All systems underperformed human counselors on excessive empathy and questioning in single-turn evaluation. The rubric achieved human-human Krippendorff's $\alpha$ = 0.51 and LLM-human $\alpha$ = 0.54 (Pearson r = 0.80). In multi-turn evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation scored highest overall (0.961), with all systems within 0.058. Microskills and style/tone were near ceiling, while productivity and safety/risk accounted for most between-system variation. Counselors rated patient LLMs realistic (86%) and useful (92%). Conclusion: CrisisBench enables scalable, privacy-preserving evaluation of crisis counseling. Current systems perform strongly on core structural competencies but still diverge from experts on important response-level failure modes. We release the rubrics, judge prompts, and evaluation tasks.

translation.title: CrisisBench：危机心理疏导AI评估套件
translation.abstract: 背景：危机热线是心理健康体系的重要组成部分，但常面临人手与资金不足。LLM可以辅助疏导员，但现有基准无法刻画危机对话中至关重要的升级、风险评估和降级处理，且隐私限制阻碍了真实对话记录的使用。方法：我们提出CrisisBench，一个面向单轮与多轮危机疏导评估的隐私保护套件，包含来自200段去标识化对话的1,085个单轮任务，以及从热线元数据衍生的1,185个患者LLM。患者模型和23项LLM评判者均与专家疏导员进行了校准。结果：我们评估了五个GPT模型以及先起草后编辑和检索增强生成方法。在单轮评估中，所有系统在过度共情和过度提问方面均不及人类疏导员。评分标准的Krippendorff's α在人与人之间为0.51，LLM与人之间为0.54（Pearson r = 0.80）。在多轮评估中，检索增强生成总体得分最高（0.961），所有系统相差不超过0.058。微技能和风格/语气接近满分，而效率与安全/风险构成系统间差异的主要来源。疏导员认为患者LLM具有真实性（86%）和实用性（92%）。结论：CrisisBench实现了可扩展、隐私保护的危机疏导评估。当前系统在核心结构能力上表现良好，但在重要的响应级失败模式上仍与专家存在差距。我们发布了评分标准、评判提示词和评估任务。
translation.brief: 该论文解决危机疏导AI缺乏隐私保护且贴合真实场景的评估基准的问题，构建了基于去标识化对话和校准患者LLM的单轮与多轮评估套件CrisisBench。

papers.title: The Software Engineering Factory: Engineering Accountability and Control in the Age of Abundant Code
papers.abstract: AI agents can now plan, write, test, review, and revise code at a volume no human organization can inspect line by line. Final code review therefore cannot remain the primary organizational control for owning code changes. The Software Engineering (SE) Factory moves control into the process that produces the code. The Factory protocols define how work moves, what evidence must exist before it can proceed, and who owns the result. A deterministic protocol engine, implemented in conventional code rather than prompts, enforces those protocols by controlling stage transitions, requiring evidence, and invoking gates and human escalation, where needed, before work can advance. The SE Factory preserves human authority over consequential decisions and makes accountable acceptance possible without requiring humans to supervise every agent action. The SE Factory is not a dark factory. Humans remain in control by defining the scope and granularity of delegation, the boundaries and escalation conditions, and the consequential decisions that require accountable human judgment. We draw on our experience building three distinct SE Factory implementations, all of which have undergone multiple iterations and two of which are publicly available as open-source systems, into ten principles for conceiving, building, and operating SE Factories at scale, grounded in the organizational and technical realities of our implementations. We do not claim that these principles are exhaustive or constitute the only viable foundation for an SE Factory. Rather, we offer them as a conceptual scaffold and shared vocabulary for reasoning about SE Factories, evaluating their designs, and guiding their evolution. Our goal is to catalyze a community-wide dialogue that moves software engineering beyond controls designed for human-scale code production toward a disciplined, scalable, and trustworthy agentic future.

translation.title: 软件工程工厂：代码丰裕时代的工程问责与控制
translation.abstract: AI智能体现在可以以任何人类组织都无法逐行审查的规模进行规划、编写、测试、审查和修改代码。因此，最终的代码审查不能再作为掌控代码变更的主要组织控制手段。软件工程（SE）工厂将控制转移到产生代码的过程之中。工厂协议定义了工作如何流转、流转前必须存在何种证据，以及谁对结果负责。一个以常规代码而非提示词实现的确定性协议引擎，通过控制阶段转换、要求证据，并在必要时调用门控和人工升级来执行这些协议，阻止工作在未满足条件时继续推进。SE工厂保留了人类对重大决策的权威，使可问责的验收成为可能，而无需人类监督智能体的每个动作。SE工厂不是无人黑灯工厂：人类通过定义委托的范围与粒度、边界与升级条件，以及需要人类可问责判断的重大决策来保持控制。我们将构建三个不同SE工厂实现的经验（均经历多次迭代，其中两个已作为开源系统公开发布）提炼为十条原则，用于构思、构建和规模化运营SE工厂，并以我们实现的组织与技术现实为基础。我们不声称这些原则是详尽的或构成SE工厂唯一可行的基石，而是将其作为概念脚手架和共享词汇，用于推理SE工厂、评估其设计并指导其演进。我们的目标是引发社区范围的对话，推动软件工程超越为人类规模代码生产设计的控制手段，迈向有纪律、可扩展且可信赖的智能体化未来。
translation.brief: 该论文解决AI生成代码规模超出人类审查能力时代组织控制缺失的问题，提出用确定性协议引擎将问责与控制内嵌于代码生产过程的SE工厂方法及十条实践原则。

papers.title: Trustworthy AI Teammates for Software Engineering: A Research Agenda for Lifecycle Context, Explainability, and Agentic Collaboration
papers.abstract: Large Language Models are rapidly changing software engineering (SE) practice by supporting code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and program comprehension. Yet most current AI coding assistants remain reactive tools: they respond to local prompts, rely on limited context, and provide suggestions whose rationale is often difficult for developers to inspect. This paper argues that the next phase of AI-assisted SE requires a shift from coding assistants to trustworthy AI teammates. We present a research agenda for human-AI co-evolution in SE, organized around three requirements. First, AI systems must become lifecycle-aware, reasoning across requirements and other deployment artifacts rather than isolated files or prompts. Second, they must provide principled explanations that expose assumptions, evidence, trade-offs, and risks in ways that support developer judgment. Third, they must enable agentic collaboration, in which specialized AI agents participate in software workflows while preserving human oversight and accountability. We propose an evaluation framework that moves beyond isolated functional correctness toward collaborative quality, including contextual alignment, trust calibration, maintenance recovery cost, and traceability. We conclude by outlining open challenges for designing AI systems that improve software quality without weakening human understanding, agency, or responsibility.

translation.title: 可信的软件工程AI队友：生命周期上下文、可解释性与智能体协作研究议程
translation.abstract: 大语言模型正通过支持代码生成、测试、调试、文档和程序理解迅速改变软件工程（SE）实践。然而，当前大多数AI编码助手仍是被动式工具：它们响应局部提示词、依赖有限上下文，且其建议的理由往往难以被开发者查验。本文主张，AI辅助SE的下一阶段需要从编码助手转向可信赖的AI队友。我们提出一个以人机共同演进为核心的SE研究议程，围绕三项需求组织。第一，AI系统必须具备生命周期感知能力，能够跨需求文档及其他部署制品进行推理，而非局限于孤立文件或提示词。第二，它们必须提供有原则的解释，揭示假设、证据、权衡与风险，以支持开发者判断。第三，它们必须支持智能体协作，让专业化AI智能体参与软件工作流，同时保留人类监督与问责。我们提出一个超越孤立功能正确性、面向协作质量的评估框架，包括上下文对齐、信任校准、维护恢复成本和可追溯性。最后，我们概述了设计既能提升软件质量、又不削弱人类理解力、能动性与责任感的AI系统所面临的开放挑战。
translation.brief: 该论文解决AI编码助手被动、缺乏全局上下文与可解释性的问题，提出面向可信AI队友的研究议程，涵盖生命周期感知、有原则的解释和智能体协作三项需求及相应评估框架。

papers.title: Measuring Human-AI Alignment as an Early Indicator for Effective Collaboration in Hybrid SE Teams
papers.abstract: As AI agents increasingly integrate into software engineering (SE) processes, ensuring effective collaboration in these hybrid teams becomes a critical challenge. While existing metrics focus on observing dynamic run-time performance, there is a lack of systematic, static measurements for early human-AI alignment -- the degree to which an AI's actions and granularity map to human expectations. This position paper proposes a research agenda to develop an SE-specific alignment metric suite drawing principles from software architecture, organizational psychology, and human-computer interaction. Furthermore, it outlines a validation methodology using concepts and techniques from business process monitoring (BPM) and introduces static assessment tools leveraging declarative BPM languages to ensure agents adhere to specific project constraints.

translation.title: 将人机对齐作为混合软件工程团队有效协作的早期指标
translation.abstract: 随着AI智能体日益融入软件工程（SE）流程，确保混合团队中的有效协作成为关键挑战。现有指标侧重于观察动态运行时表现，缺乏针对早期人机对齐——即AI的行为和粒度与人类期望的契合程度——的系统性静态度量。本立场论文提出一个研究议程，借鉴软件架构、组织心理学和人机交互的原理，开发一套SE专用对齐度量体系。此外，论文概述了利用业务流程监控（BPM）的概念与技术进行验证的方法论，并引入基于声明式BPM语言的静态评估工具，以确保智能体遵守特定项目约束。
translation.brief: 该论文解决混合SE团队中人机对齐缺乏早期静态度量的问题，提出借鉴架构、心理学与人机交互的SE专用对齐指标体系及基于声明式BPM语言的验证方法。

papers.title: Trusting Trust in AI Software Engineering Agents: The Why, What, and How?
papers.abstract: AI software engineering agents are increasingly integrated into development workflows, from autocomplete assistants to autonomous repair agents and multi-agent software development pipelines. Trust matters because these agents can produce, revise, and pass on artifacts that developers, other agents, or organisations may later rely on under uncertainty and risk. Yet trust in such systems is often treated as a single measurable property of an AI system. This is insufficient for software engineering, where trust depends on who relies on the agent, how that reliance is structured, and which properties must hold in that deployment. We propose a structural framework for reasoning about trust in AI software engineering agents. Inspired by the recursive nature of trust in software systems, we decompose trust into three analytical questions: Why trust?, identifying the trust scenario; What trust?, identifying the trust configuration; and How much trust?, identifying the trust properties. From these questions, we derive three scenarios, four configurations, and five trust-relevant properties, state which of these are closed by construction and which remain open to revision, and instantiate the resulting profile on a ChatDev-style multi-agent workflow. The framework is conceptual, and is offered as a foundation for the empirical work that would validate it, rather than as a numerical trust metric.

translation.title: 信任 AI 软件工程智能体中的信任：为何、何物与如何？
translation.abstract: AI 软件工程智能体正日益融入开发工作流，从自动补全助手到自主修复智能体以及多智能体软件开发流水线。信任之所以重要，是因为这些智能体可以生成、修改并传递开发者、其他智能体或组织日后可能在不确定性和风险下依赖的制品。然而，这类系统中的信任往往被视为 AI 系统的单一可测量属性。这对软件工程而言是不够的，因为软件工程中的信任取决于谁依赖该智能体、这种依赖如何结构化，以及在该部署中哪些属性必须成立。我们提出了一个用于推理 AI 软件工程智能体信任的结构化框架。受软件系统中信任递归特性的启发，我们将信任分解为三个分析性问题：为何信任？（识别信任场景）、何物信任？（识别信任配置）以及信任多少？（识别信任属性）。从这些问题中，我们推导出三个场景、四种配置和五个与信任相关的属性，说明其中哪些由构造而闭合、哪些仍可被修改，并将由此产生的画像实例化到一个 ChatDev 风格的多智能体工作流上。该框架是概念性的，作为后续实证工作验证的基础，而非数值信任度量。
translation.brief: 提出一个将 AI 软件工程智能体信任分解为为何信任、何物信任与如何信任三个问题的概念性结构框架，并实例化到多智能体工作流。

papers.title: Can AI Help Explain AI? Effects of Multimodal LLM-Generated Explanations on Perceived Understanding and Perceived Trust in XAI Visualizations
papers.abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) aims to make machine learning models understandable, yet many XAI visualizations remain difficult for end-users to interpret. Here, we evaluate whether augmenting XAI outputs with textual explanations from multimodal LLMs improves perceived understanding and perceived trust. We conducted a pre-registered within-subject experiment ($N = 128$) across seven decision scenarios and five XAI methods, with and without LLM generated explanations. The explanations improved perceived understanding and perceived trust by 0.35 and 0.26 points on five-point scales (both $p < .001$). The gain appeared in all seven scenarios, did not differ between local and global explanations, and was largest for participants with the least prior XAI exposure. A mediation analysis indicates an indirect effect on perceived trust through perceived understanding. These results suggest that multimodal LLMs can provide a useful interpretive layer for XAI beyond expert audiences.

translation.title: AI 能否帮助解释 AI？多模态 LLM 生成的解释对 XAI 可视化感知理解与感知信任的影响
translation.abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）旨在使机器学习模型可被理解，但许多 XAI 可视化对最终用户而言仍难以解读。本文评估用多模态 LLM 的文本解释增强 XAI 输出是否能提升感知理解与感知信任。我们开展了一项预注册的被试内实验（N = 128），涵盖七个决策场景和五种 XAI 方法，分别在有和无 LLM 生成解释的条件下进行。解释使感知理解和感知信任在五点量表上分别提升了 0.35 和 0.26 分（均 p < .001）。该提升在所有七个场景中都出现，在局部与全局解释之间无差异，且对先前 XAI 经验最少的被试提升最大。中介分析表明存在一条通过感知理解对感知信任的间接效应。这些结果表明，多模态 LLM 可以为 XAI 提供超越专家受众的有用解释层。
translation.brief: 通过被试内实验验证为 XAI 可视化添加多模态 LLM 生成的文本解释能否提升用户的感知理解与感知信任。

papers.title: RAW: Refusal Aversion in the Wild, A Causal Measurement Method for Deployed LLMs
papers.abstract: Deployed LLMs field hundreds of millions of conversations a day and refuse a non-trivial fraction of user requests, yet the user-side cost of refusal, whether users disengage and by how much, is unmeasured on any production model: a blind spot for the consumer-facing platforms built on them. A/B-testing refusal is ethically and operationally constrained on frontier-lab products and unavailable to third-party platforms deploying these models through a fixed API. We introduce RAW, a method that uses LLM stochasticity as a natural experiment: at near-identical prompts in any existing log, the same model sometimes refuses and sometimes does not, and that variation identifies the causal user-side effect of refusal. Applying the method to 15 deployed LLMs in LMSYS-Chat-1M and WildChat, with user-clustered inference, we find that for about half of the models we can measure precisely, a refusal costs 3 to 17 pp of subsequent re-engagement; the rest show no distinguishable effect, among them one deployment whose positive point estimate we trace to persistent users retrying the refused request. Our contribution is the measurement method, which runs on any deployed model from logs alone for about \$0.30 per 1,000 conversations. We release labels, moderation scores, prompt embeddings, and pipeline code.

translation.title: RAW：真实场景中的拒绝回避，面向已部署 LLM 的因果测量方法
translation.abstract: 已部署的 LLM 每天处理数亿次对话，并拒绝其中相当一部分用户请求，但拒绝的用户侧代价——用户是否因此流失以及流失多少——在任何生产模型上都未被测量：这是建立在 LLM 之上的面向消费者平台的盲区。在最前沿实验室产品上进行拒绝的 A/B 测试在伦理和运营上受到限制，而通过固定 API 部署这些模型的第三方平台也无法进行。我们提出 RAW，一种利用 LLM 随机性作为自然实验的方法：在任意现有日志中几乎相同的提示下，同一模型有时拒绝、有时不拒绝，这种变异可以识别拒绝的因果性用户侧效应。将该方法应用于 LMSYS-Chat-1M 和 WildChat 中 15 个已部署 LLM，并采用用户聚类推断，我们发现，在可精确测量的模型中约有一半，一次拒绝会使后续再参与率损失 3 到 17 个百分点；其余模型无可辨别的效应，其中一个正点估计的部署被我们追溯到坚持不懈重试被拒请求的用户。我们的贡献在于测量方法本身，仅凭日志即可运行于任何已部署模型，每千次对话成本约 0.30 美元。我们发布了标注、审核分数、提示嵌入和流水线代码。
translation.brief: 提出 RAW 方法，利用 LLM 在近似相同提示下是否拒绝的随机变异作为自然实验，从日志中因果估计拒绝对用户再参与的影响。

papers.title: Asking What Matters: Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection for Interactive Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Interactive text-to-SQL requires an LLM agent not only to generate executable SQL, but also to decide which uncertainty to clarify within a limited interaction budget. However, current clarification policies have three limitations: (i) they target surface ambiguity without testing its SQL impact; (ii) they miss ambiguities implicit in schema routes or domain knowledge; and (iii) they spend limited turns on unfocused or redundant questions. These limitations expose a critical challenge: identifying SQL-impacting ambiguity before the intended SQL is known. In this paper, we propose DisGuAD, a Disagreement-Guided Ambiguity Detection framework that specializes clarification selection. DisGuAD treats disagreement among plausible SQL interpretations as direct evidence of which uncertainty matters to the final query. Specifically, it constructs a query-term inventory, elicits contrastive SQL interpretations through complementary probe families, compares their canonical SQL components, and attributes recurring differences to user-facing clarification targets. A lightweight prioritization and dialogue-state mechanism then selects one high-impact unresolved target for clarification. Experiments on BIRD-Interact Lite and Full with two LLM backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in task success and clarification quality. Compared with the original interaction policy, DisGuAD improves normalized Reward by 4.40--8.97 points and raises overall critical-ambiguity coverage from 48.62% to 82.75% and from 45.76% to 85.14%. Its clarification signals further improve two independently designed static text-to-SQL frameworks by up to 13.97 Reward points while keeping their SQL generators fixed. These results demonstrate that disagreement among plausible SQL queries provides actionable evidence for selecting clarification targets that matter to downstream generation.

translation.title: 追问要害：面向交互式 text-to-SQL 的分歧引导歧义检测
translation.abstract: 交互式 text-to-SQL 要求 LLM 智能体不仅生成可执行的 SQL，还要在有限的交互预算内决定澄清哪些不确定性。然而，当前的澄清策略存在三个局限：（i）只针对表面歧义而不检验其对 SQL 的影响；（ii）遗漏隐含在模式路径或领域知识中的歧义；（iii）将有限的轮次花在无重点或冗余的问题上。这些局限暴露了一个关键挑战：在目标 SQL 未知时识别影响 SQL 的歧义。本文提出 DisGuAD，一个通过分歧引导进行歧义检测并专精于澄清选择的框架。DisGuAD 将合理 SQL 解释之间的分歧作为哪些不确定性对最终查询重要的直接证据。具体而言，它构建查询词项清单，通过互补的探测家族引出对比性 SQL 解释，比较它们的标准 SQL 组件，并将反复出现的差异归因于面向用户的澄清目标。随后，轻量的优先级排序和对话状态机制选择一个高影响的未决目标进行澄清。在 BIRD-Interact Lite 和 Full 上使用两个 LLM 后端的实验显示任务成功率和澄清质量的一致提升。与原交互策略相比，DisGuAD 将归一化 Reward 提升 4.40–8.97 分，并将总体关键歧义覆盖率分别从 48.62% 提升到 82.75% 以及从 45.76% 提升到 85.14%。其澄清信号还在保持 SQL 生成器不变的情况下，使两个独立设计的静态 text-to-SQL 框架的 Reward 提升最多 13.97 分。这些结果表明，合理 SQL 查询之间的分歧为选择对下游生成重要的澄清目标提供了可操作的证据。
translation.brief: 提出 DisGuAD 框架，通过比较多个合理 SQL 解释之间的分歧来识别影响 SQL 的歧义并选择高影响的澄清目标。

papers.title: FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
papers.abstract: Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide on five journalistic document-exploration tasks using 38 Chicago Police Department public-records documents, comparing it with raw-file access and retrieval-augmented generation. Across the five tasks, FieldGuide used 27% fewer tokens and 41% less elapsed time than raw-file access; relative to RAG, it used 38% fewer tokens and 21% less elapsed time. An accuracy audit identified four minor issues in FieldGuide's responses, comparable to the other conditions. In blind ratings of generated reporting leads, FieldGuide's mean ratings were higher than RAG's and lower than the raw-file condition's. These descriptive results suggest that corpus orientation may reduce runtime token use and elapsed time without severe accuracy failures. They also motivate further study of whether selective access limits broad, cross-document discovery.

translation.title: FieldGuide：面向智能体文档探索的省语料地图
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 智能体可以帮助记者探索大型文档集合。但探索性工作流可能消耗大量 token 和时间，尤其当任务宽泛且相关子问题尚不可知时。本文介绍 FieldGuide，一个面向智能体的语料地图，它将文档集合组织成主题层级，并提供用于语料定向、范围搜索和有界阅读的工具。我在五项新闻文档探索任务上使用 38 份芝加哥警察局公共记录文档评估 FieldGuide，将其与原始文件访问和检索增强生成（RAG）进行比较。在五项任务中，FieldGuide 比原始文件访问少用 27% 的 token 和 41% 的耗时；相对 RAG，少用 38% 的 token 和 21% 的耗时。准确性审计发现 FieldGuide 回答中存在四个小问题，与其他条件相当。在对生成的报道线索的盲评中，FieldGuide 的平均评分高于 RAG、低于原始文件条件。这些描述性结果表明，语料定向可以在不出现严重准确性失败的情况下减少运行时 token 消耗和耗时。它们也激发了进一步研究选择性访问是否限制广泛的跨文档发现。
translation.brief: 提出 FieldGuide，一种面向智能体的语料地图（主题层级加定向、范围搜索、有界阅读工具），以降低探索大型文档集合时的 token 消耗与耗时。

papers.title: Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory
papers.abstract: Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events. We test this hypothesis on an LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) that stores what it learns in a text memory and rewrites that memory each night from the day's conversation transcript. The agent goes through ten simulated days of conversation built from LongMemEval. We corrupt 5, 10, 20 or 40 percent of the transcript's turns before each nightly rewrite in one of two ways. Detail corruption changes one or two details in a turn to plausible wrong ones, or replaces the turn with one by the same speaker from an earlier day. Random-text corruption replaces half of the selected turns with a passage of Moby-Dick and inserts Moby-Dick words into the other half. A size limit on the memory, rising from 19,500 to 117,000 tokens over ten nights, set from human free-recall data, forces it to forget. We learned that corruption did not help the agent apply what it learned in earlier conversations to new tasks in any of 30 runs (ten conditions, three different conversation histories). Replacing details in 40 percent of turns lowered recall from 76 to 60 percent. Random text had no consistent effect on recall, with a paired difference of 0 $\pm$ 2 points at 40 percent, because the model recognized it as corrupted and left it out of memory. Replaced details were stored as fact even when another turn held the correct value, and the agent answered 40 percent of those questions correctly, compared with 75 percent without corruption. These results suggest that a pretrained model can separate corrupted text from real events, so a fair test needs a learner that cannot make this separation as easily, such as a model fine-tuned on the corrupted days or an agent whose days take place in an invented world.

translation.title: LLM 会做梦吗？在具有文本记忆的智能体上检验过拟合大脑假说
translation.abstract: Hoel (2021) 提出梦境会扭曲重放的经历，以免大脑对近期事件过拟合。我们在一个 LLM 智能体（Claude Opus 5.5）上检验这一假说，该智能体将所学内容存储于文本记忆中，并每晚根据当天的对话记录重写记忆。该智能体经历由 LongMemEval 构建的十个模拟对话日。我们在每次夜间重写前以两种方式之一破坏对话记录中 5%、10%、20% 或 40% 的对话轮次。细节破坏将某轮中的一两个细节改为看似合理的错误内容，或用同一说话者更早一天的轮次替换该轮。随机文本破坏则用《白鲸记》的一段文字替换一半被选中的轮次，并在另一半中插入《白鲸记》的词语。记忆大小上限在十晚内从 19,500 个 token 逐渐升至 117,000 个 token（依据人类自由回忆数据设定），迫使其遗忘。我们发现，在全部 30 次运行（十个条件、三种不同对话历史）中，破坏均未帮助智能体将早期对话所学应用于新任务。替换 40% 轮次中的细节使召回率从 76% 降至 60%。随机文本对召回率没有一致影响，40% 处的配对差异为 0 ± 2 个百分点，因为模型识别出这是被破坏的文本并将其排除在记忆之外。即使另一轮中包含正确值，被替换的细节仍被作为事实存储，智能体在这些问题上仅答对 40%，而无破坏时为 75%。这些结果表明，预训练模型能够将破坏的文本与真实事件区分开来，因此公平的测试需要一种难以做这种区分的学习者，例如在破坏的日子上微调过的模型，或者其日子发生在虚构世界中的智能体。
translation.brief: 检验梦境式扰动能否防止 LLM 智能体记忆过拟合：在夜间重写记忆前对对话记录注入不同类型的破坏，观察其对任务应用和召回的影响。

papers.title: Literary Language Mashup: Curating Fictions with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose an alternative approach to human evaluation of literary fictions by employing LLMs themselves as evaluators within the GrAImes framework. We apply this methodology to assess human-written and AI-generated microfictions in Spanish, to five PhD professors in literature and sixteen literary enthusiasts, and to short stories in both Spanish and English. By comparing the evaluations performed by LLMs with those of human judges, we examine the degree of alignment and divergence between both perspectives, thereby assessing the feasibility of LLMs as auxiliary literary evaluators. Our analysis focuses on the alignment of responses from LLMs with those of human evaluators, providing insights into the potential of LLMs in literary assessment. The conducted experiments reveal that while LLMs cannot be regarded as substitutes for human judges in the evaluation of literary microfictions and short stories, with a Krippendorff's alpha reliability coefficient less than 0.66, they can serve as a valuable tool that offers an initial perspective on the editorial quality of the texts in question. Overall, this study contributes to the ongoing discourse on the role of artificial intelligence in literature, underlining both its methodological constraints and its potential as a complementary resource for literary evaluation.

translation.title: 文学语言混搭：用大语言模型策划小说作品
translation.abstract: 本文提出一种替代性的人类文学小说评价方法，即在 GrAImes 框架中让 LLM 自身充当评价者。我们将该方法应用于评估人类创作与 AI 生成的西班牙语微型小说（参与者为五位文学博士教授和十六位文学爱好者），以及西班牙语和英语的短篇小说。通过比较 LLM 与人类评委的评估，我们考察两种视角之间的契合与分歧程度，从而评估 LLM 作为辅助文学评价者的可行性。我们的分析聚焦于 LLM 与人类评价者回应的契合度，为 LLM 在文学评估中的潜力提供洞见。实验表明，尽管在评价文学微型小说和短篇小说方面 LLM 不能取代人类评委（Krippendorff's alpha 可靠性系数小于 0.66），但它们可以作为有价值的工具，为相关文本的编辑质量提供初步视角。总体而言，本研究为关于人工智能在文学中作用的持续讨论做出贡献，既强调其方法学局限，也强调其作为文学评价补充资源的潜力。
translation.brief: 研究以 GrAImes 框架让 LLM 充当文学评价者，通过对比其与人类评委对微型小说和短篇小说的评估来检验其作为辅助评价工具的可行性。

papers.title: Consistency Is Not Correction: Separating Confidence, Abstention, and Recovery in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: A controller that resamples an answer, escalates to a larger model, or abstains is usually justified by a confidence signal. Three claims about such a signal do not follow from one another: it ranks answers (discrimination), it supports withholding some of them (selective prediction), and it changes an answer for the better (correction utility). We give an exact decomposition of the third into gated recoveries minus gated harms, which bounds whether a comparison can succeed before it is run: a gate that only replaces a proposal can act only where the base policy was already wrong, so the initial error count caps the discordant pairs any correct gate can produce. When that cap falls below the count a paired test needs, the experiment cannot return a positive result for a working mechanism, nor distinguish one from a gate that never fired. We measure all three targets on two model scales and find the bound binds. In a small-model suite a perturbation-agreement verifier reaches within-policy AUROC 0.990 (95% interval [0.95, 1.00]) while every episode outcome matches single-sample decoding at 4.32 times the call count. In a controlled 840-episode study no verifier replaced the proposal on any of the 60 GSM8K decisions, so that comparison tested nothing; the entire GSM8K gain across six controllers is one task, and it is the task whose identical temperature-zero repeats disagreed, making it the one answer the service does not reproduce. On the diagnostic set the gate could reach four errors while the test needed six, so even a perfect gate had no significant result available. We report two checks that would have caught this before any budget was spent, and show that tie handling in rankings, tied selection cutoffs, and unequal output limits each move a headline number in the same dataset. The binding constraint on this literature is measurement resolution, not the choice of signal.

translation.title: 一致性不等于纠错：在 LLM 智能体中区分置信度、弃答与恢复
translation.abstract: 重新采样答案、升级到更大模型或弃答的控制器通常以置信度信号为依据。关于这种信号的三个论断彼此并不相互推出：它能对答案排序（区分度）、支持对部分答案弃答（选择性预测）、以及能改进答案（纠错效用）。我们给出第三者的精确分解——门控恢复减去门控伤害，它能在实验运行前界定一次比较能否成功：只做替换的门控只可能在基础策略本就出错的地方起作用，因此初始错误数封顶了任何正确门控所能产生的不一致对数。当该上限低于配对检验所需数量时，实验既无法为有效机制返回阳性结果，也无法将其与从未触发的门控区分开。我们在两个模型规模上测量全部三个目标，发现该界确实起约束作用。在小模型套件中，扰动一致性验证器的 within-policy AUROC 达到 0.990（95% 区间 [0.95, 1.00]），而每个回合的结果与单次采样解码完全一致，调用次数是 4.32 倍。在一项受控的 840 回合研究中，没有任何验证器在 60 个 GSM8K 决策中的任何一个上替换过提案，因此该比较什么也没检验；六个控制器在 GSM8K 上的全部收益是一个任务，而且恰恰是温度为零的相同重复结果不一致的那个任务，也就是服务不会复现的那个答案。在诊断集上门控最多能修正四个错误而检验需要六个，因此即使完美的门控也无法得到显著结果。我们报告两项可在花费任何预算之前发现此问题的检查，并展示排序中的平局处理、并列的选择阈值以及不等长输出限制如何在同一数据集中各自改变一个头条数字。该文献领域的约束性限制是测量分辨率，而非信号的选择。
translation.brief: 为 LLM 置信度信号的纠错效用给出精确分解，证明初始错误数上限会导致实验测量分辨率不足以区分有效与无效门控。

papers.title: Evaluating Semantic Insensitivity in Financial Sentiment Analysis: Implications for Sustainable Financial Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment, heavily relying on models like FinBERT. Despite high benchmark accuracy, these models remain vulnerable to subtle adversarial text modifications, threatening the integrity of algorithmic decision-making. In this paper, we propose Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), a novel adversarial attack framework targeting financial sentiment models through domain-specific semantic manipulation. Utilizing an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline, our approach identifies eligible financial news sentences and applies targeted lexical substitutions. We empirically evaluate ASI against FinBERT, one of the most widely deployed financial sentiment models. Our results reveal a striking vulnerability: the attack successfully deceived FinBERT in 90.85% of eligible cases, with the model frequently maintaining its original sentiment prediction despite the fundamental inversion of financial performance indicators. Through qualitative analysis and token-level investigation, we demonstrate that FinBERT critically over-relies on contextual keywords and syntactic patterns rather than true logical comprehension of financial semantics. Our findings highlight the urgent need for logic-aware, robust financial NLP models to ensure the reliability of automated decision-making systems.

translation.title: 评估金融情感分析中的语义不敏感性：对可持续金融决策的启示
translation.abstract: 金融情感分析对自动化交易、投资组合管理和风险评估至关重要，高度依赖 FinBERT 等模型。尽管基准准确率很高，这些模型仍易受细微的对抗性文本修改影响，威胁算法决策的完整性。本文提出 Agent-driven Semantic Inversion（ASI），一种通过领域特定的语义操纵攻击金融情感模型的新型对抗攻击框架。利用 LLM 驱动的多智能体流水线，我们的方法识别符合条件的金融新闻句子并进行有针对性的词汇替换。我们针对最广泛部署的金融情感模型之一 FinBERT 对 ASI 进行实证评估。结果揭示出惊人的脆弱性：该攻击在 90.85% 的符合条件的案例中成功欺骗了 FinBERT，尽管金融表现指标发生了根本性反转，模型却经常维持原有的情感预测。通过定性分析和 token 级别考察，我们证明 FinBERT 严重过度依赖上下文关键词和句法模式，而非对金融语义的真正逻辑理解。我们的发现凸显了对具备逻辑感知能力的稳健金融 NLP 模型的迫切需求，以确保自动化决策系统的可靠性。
translation.brief: 提出 ASI 多智能体对抗攻击框架，通过针对性词汇替换使金融情感指标语义反转，揭示 FinBERT 过度依赖关键词而非金融逻辑的脆弱性。

papers.title: Depth-Aware Activation Steering via Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Activation steering is a simple, training-free way to modulate LLM behavior, yet existing methods typically inject vectors at a single layer and lack mechanisms for depth-aware propagation or internal verification. We combine two recent ideas - Attention Residuals (AttnRes) providing learnable cross-layer pathways, and Jacobian-lens (J-space) concept readout - into a lightweight depth-aware steering pipeline. On two small open models (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-0.8B), distributing a persona vector according to AttnRes-style depth weights yields stronger internal alignment (deeper-layer concept cosine and rank, p<0.0001) and stronger behavioral shifts than single-layer injection. The effect is sign-specific: reverse vectors invert all six metrics, random directions degrade alignment (p<0.0001), and a short LoRA fine-tune erases the imprint. Injection rewires attention strictly downstream of the injection point (upstream JS = 0.00000). Three practical findings follow. First, a layer-wise geometric decomposition of cosine readouts: at the injection layer 123% of the increase is arithmetic, while 5-11 layers downstream 100% is dynamical. Second, an intensity window: effects are monotone over 0.3-0.7, then generation collapses (617 to 306 to 25 chars). Third, metric discipline: keyword-rule metrics fail LLM-judge validation (kappa <= 0.09), and two rule-based conclusions were retracted. Training the depth weights on a steering objective (200 steps, frozen backbone) raises final alignment 10x on held-out prompts. Cross-persona vectors retain 96-99% of the effect: specificity holds against random, not semantic, directions. We contribute a practical, low-overhead depth-aware steering method with a careful evaluation protocol. Code and data are released.

translation.title: 基于注意力残差的深度感知激活导向
translation.abstract: 激活导向是一种简单、免训练的调节 LLM 行为的方法，但现有方法通常在单层注入向量，缺乏深度感知的传播机制或内部验证手段。我们结合两个新近思路——提供可学习跨层通路的 Attention Residuals（AttnRes）和 Jacobian-lens（J-space）概念读出——构建一个轻量级的深度感知导向流水线。在两个小型开源模型（Qwen3-0.6B 和 Qwen3.5-0.8B）上，按 AttnRes 风格的深度权重分发人格向量，比单层注入产生更强的内部对齐（更深层概念余弦和排名，p<0.0001）和更强的行为改变。该效应具有符号特异性：反向向量使所有六个指标反转，随机方向降低对齐（p<0.0001），而短时 LoRA 微调会抹去该印记。注入严格重排注入点下游的注意力（上游 JS = 0.00000）。由此得出三个实用发现。第一，余弦读出的逐层几何分解：在注入层 123% 的提升是算术性的，而在下游 5-11 层则 100% 是动力学的。第二，强度窗口：效应在 0.3-0.7 区间单调，之后生成崩塌（617 到 306 到 25 字符）。第三，度量纪律：关键词规则度量未通过 LLM 裁判验证（kappa <= 0.09），两条基于规则的结论被撤回。在导向目标上训练深度权重（200 步，冻结骨干网络）使留出提示上的最终对齐提升 10 倍。跨人格向量保留 96-99% 的效果：特异性针对随机方向成立，而非语义方向。我们贡献了一种实用的、低开销的深度感知导向方法及严格的评估协议。代码与数据已发布。
translation.brief: 将 Attention Residuals 与 J-space 概念读出结合，提出按深度权重跨层分发导向向量的激活导向方法，以提升内部对齐和行为调节效果。

papers.title: Chimera: A Configurable LLM Decode Accelerator Architecture with Compute-Memory-Floorplan Co-Design for HBM-Equipped Multi-Die FPGAs
papers.abstract: GPUs are widely used for LLM inference, but single-request decoding is memory-bound, leaving their compute underutilized while they draw substantial power. HBM-equipped FPGAs are well suited to LLM decoding: their customizable datapaths use memory bandwidth more energy-efficiently than GPUs. However, high memory bandwidth alone does not ensure high decode performance: exploiting it requires parallel compute and memory interfaces, whose resource costs and placement on the chip can limit the throughput. We present Chimera, a configurable LLM decode accelerator architecture that co-designs compute, memory access, and floorplan. Specifically, HBM Proxy Ports extend HBM access to compute lanes on every super logic region (SLR) die, and tiered expert storage holds mixture-of-experts weights beyond the HBM capacity. In addition, a unified configuration analysis estimates per-token latency and per-SLR resource use and guides the design of each configuration within resource budgets. On an AMD Alveo U280, we build ten designs for eight dense, mixture-of-experts, hybrid linear/standard-attention, and ternary LLMs, up to an 80B-parameter mixture-of-experts LLM on four memory tiers. Chimera's designs achieve a geometric mean of 1.6$\times$ the token throughput of prior state-of-the-art FPGA implementations and 3.0$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ the energy efficiency of the RTX 3090 and A100 GPUs, setting a new benchmark for LLM decoding on HBM-equipped FPGAs.

translation.title: Chimera：面向配备HBM的多die FPGA、采用计算-内存-布局协同设计的可配置LLM解码加速器架构
translation.abstract: GPU被广泛用于LLM推理，但单请求解码是访存受限的，其计算资源利用率低下且功耗很高。配备HBM的FPGA非常适合LLM解码：其可定制的数据通路比GPU更节能地利用内存带宽。然而，仅有高内存带宽并不能保证高解码性能：要利用它需要并行的计算与内存接口，其资源开销和芯片上的布局会限制吞吐量。我们提出Chimera，一种协同设计计算、内存访问和布局的可配置LLM解码加速器架构。具体而言，HBM Proxy Ports将HBM访问扩展到每个super logic region（SLR）die上的计算通道，分层专家存储则容纳超出HBM容量的mixture-of-experts权重。此外，统一的配置分析可估算每token延迟和每SLR资源使用，并指导在资源预算内设计每种配置。在AMD Alveo U280上，我们为8个dense、mixture-of-experts、hybrid线性/标准注意力以及三值LLM构建了十种设计，其中包括在四级内存层级上运行的80B参数mixture-of-experts LLM。Chimera的设计达到了先前最先进FPGA实现1.6倍（几何平均）的token吞吐量，以及相对于RTX 3090和A100 GPU 3.0倍和1.5倍的能效，为配备HBM的FPGA上的LLM解码树立了新的基准。
translation.brief: 为解决FPGA上LLM解码因并行计算与内存接口资源及布局受限而无法充分利用HBM带宽的问题，提出Chimera架构，通过HBM Proxy Ports、分层专家存储和统一配置分析实现计算-内存-布局协同设计。

papers.title: RTLReviewBench: LLM Hardware Reviewers Rarely Miss Bugs but Routinely Reject Correct RTL
papers.abstract: Hardware teams increasingly ask large language models (LLMs) to review register-transfer level (RTL) code, yet it is unclear whether a model can tell a correct module from a buggy one without simulating it. We introduce RTLReviewBench, a benchmark of 114 matched pairs of buggy and correct Verilog modules. Each pair shares one specification, most buggy modules are real failures of LLM code generators, and every label is confirmed by simulation. Evaluating 12 commercial and open-weight models, we find a consistent asymmetry: reviewers rarely accept buggy code but often reject correct code, producing more than five false rejections for every missed bug. Synthetic mutants hide part of the problem: on the same designs, models miss far fewer injected bugs than real ones. Asking a model to reason before it commits to a verdict sharply reduces false rejections for weaker reviewers, and a controlled ablation shows that where the reasoning appears in the output matters more than the instruction to reason, whereas sampling and majority voting do not help. A blinded audit further shows that some correct "buggy" verdicts rest on false technical claims. We release the benchmark, a harder split for future models, all model responses, and the evaluation code at this https URL

translation.title: RTLReviewBench：LLM硬件审查者很少漏掉缺陷，却经常拒绝正确的RTL
translation.abstract: 硬件团队越来越多地让大语言模型（LLM）审查寄存器传输级（RTL）代码，但目前尚不清楚模型能否在不仿真的情况下区分正确模块与有缺陷模块。我们提出RTLReviewBench，一个包含114对buggy与正确Verilog模块匹配对的基准。每对共享同一规格说明，大多数buggy模块来自LLM代码生成器的真实失败案例，且每个标签均经仿真确认。对12个商业和开源权重模型的评估显示出一贯的不对称性：审查者很少接受有缺陷的代码，却经常拒绝正确的代码，每漏掉一个bug就会产生超过五次错误拒绝。合成变异体掩盖了部分问题：在相同设计上，模型漏掉注入bug的比例远低于真实bug。让模型在给出结论前先推理可显著减少较弱审查者的错误拒绝，受控消融实验表明推理出现在输出中的位置比要求推理的指令更重要，而采样和多数投票并无帮助。盲审进一步表明，一些正确代码被判为"buggy"的结论基于错误的技术论断。我们在该https URL发布基准、供未来模型使用的更难划分、全部模型响应和评估代码。
translation.brief: 为评估LLM在不仿真情况下能否区分正确与有缺陷的RTL代码，构建了114对经仿真确认的匹配模块基准RTLReviewBench，揭示了模型倾向错误拒绝正确代码的不对称性。

papers.title: FCP: Formal Context Protocol for Verifying LLM-Generated Artifacts
papers.abstract: When a language model writes both an artifact and the tests meant to check it, a passing test is weak evidence: one misreading of the request yields a faulty artifact and a check that accepts it. We present the Formal Context Protocol (FCP), which checks AI-generated artifacts against the request itself. FCP separates conformance (does the artifact satisfy a formal reading of a requirement?), which model checkers and SMT solvers decide, from fidelity (does the reading mean what the prose means?), which has no decision procedure but is refutable by a concrete witness. Eight ways a proof can falsely certify a requirement each become a mechanical check that returns a witness, and what no machine can settle becomes concrete questions for the request's author. Adapters place hardware, text, agents and code on the same engines. On four hardware designs, trusting AI-written assertions certified 23% of violated requirements, and FCP certified none. On ten code tasks, code from three language models passed its own tests and violated the request every time. Trusting the tests certified all 33 violations, and FCP certified three. Agreement among models, readings or tests did not imply correctness.

translation.title: FCP：用于验证LLM生成产物的形式化上下文协议
translation.abstract: 当一个语言模型同时编写产物和用于检查它的测试时，通过的测试只是弱证据：对请求的一次误读就会产生有缺陷的产物以及接受它的检查。我们提出形式化上下文协议（FCP），直接对照请求本身检查AI生成的产物。FCP将符合性（产物是否满足对需求的某种形式化解读？可由模型检查器和SMT求解器判定）与保真性（该解读是否与散文语义一致？无判定过程但可被具体反例驳倒）分离。证明可能错误认证需求的八种途径分别成为返回反例的机械检查，机器无法裁决的部分则成为向请求作者提出的具体问题。适配器将硬件、文本、代理和代码置于相同的引擎之上。在四个硬件设计上，信任AI编写的断言会认证23%被违反的需求，而FCP认证了零个。在十个代码任务上，三个语言模型生成的代码均通过了自己的测试却每次都违反请求。信任测试会认证全部33处违规，而FCP认证了三处。模型之间、解读之间或测试之间的一致并不代表正确。
translation.brief: 针对AI同时生成产物与测试导致测试通过不具证明力的问题，提出FCP协议，将符合性交由形式化工具判定、保真性交由反例可驳的检查与人工确认来验证LLM生成产物。

papers.title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six LLMs were evaluated, with overall accuracy ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across three distinct performance tiers. To assess reasoning quality, an LLM-based judge evaluated correctly answered responses using a multidimensional rubric. Although responses generally demonstrated strong problem comprehension, they scored lower in factual and procedural accuracy and distractor analysis, indicating that correct answers were not necessarily supported by technically sound justifications. Response clarity was also weakly indicative of technical quality. Furthermore, longer reasoning traces were associated with lower accuracy in both frontier reasoning models, suggesting that reasoning length may reflect question difficulty rather than improved problem-solving performance. Reasoning-token consumption may therefore provide an additional signal for identifying potentially unreliable responses. NEBench R1 establishes a benchmark for evaluating both answer accuracy and reasoning quality, providing a foundation for assessing the domain competence and reliability of LLMs in nuclear engineering.

translation.title: NEBench R1：评估大语言模型核工程领域能力的推理基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被探索用于核工程中知识密集且安全攸关的应用。然而，现有的核领域基准内容覆盖有限，或主要关注答案准确率而未系统评估底层推理的质量。本研究提出NEBench R1，一个面向推理的基准，包含7,546道从美国核管理委员会（NRC）反应堆操作员执照考试中提取的独特选择题，覆盖18个核设施。每道题按NRC知识与能力目录分类，并附有官方解释作为推理评估的参考。我们评估了六个LLM，总体准确率在34.0%到73.9%之间，分为三个明显不同的性能层级。为评估推理质量，基于LLM的评判者使用多维评分标准评估回答正确的答案。尽管回答总体表现出较强的问题理解能力，但在事实与程序准确性以及干扰项分析上得分较低，表明正确答案未必有技术上可靠的论证支撑。回答的清晰度对技术质量的指示作用也较弱。此外，在两个前沿推理模型中，更长的推理链与更低的准确率相关，说明推理长度可能反映题目难度而非更好的解题表现。因此，推理token消耗或可作为识别潜在不可靠回答的额外信号。NEBench R1建立了同时评估答案准确率与推理质量的基准，为评估LLM在核工程中的领域能力与可靠性奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 为解决现有核领域基准缺乏推理质量评估的问题，基于NRC操作员执照考试构建包含7,546道题的NEBench R1基准，并结合LLM评判的多维标准系统评估推理质量。

papers.title: DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution
papers.abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

translation.title: DeltaHarness：用于资源自适应工具执行的自进化执行框架
translation.abstract: 使用工具的代理依赖执行框架来组织和调度工具操作。相同的任务与资源描述可能隐藏运行时条件，从而逆转有效执行计划的延迟排序。化解这种不确定性需要在目标环境中进行第一手执行。我们提出DeltaHarness，一种执行引导的策略搜索方法，可从冷启动测量出发自适应调整代理框架。其QHI循环利用观测到的响应来更新运行时调度、修订物理计划并为后续提议选择实验。一个独立的确认面板控制策略替换。在固定调度下，修订的物化策略在三个新的任务对上将一个视频编辑任务的完整交付延迟降低了30.0%。在留出任务上，进化后的策略在一个种子中相对最佳固定计划降低延迟8.2%，在另一个种子中相对初始提议降低4.6%。
translation.brief: 针对执行计划延迟排序因运行时条件不确定而难以预先判定的问题，提出DeltaHarness执行引导策略搜索方法，通过冷启动测量和QHI循环自适应进化代理执行框架。

papers.title: EgoLink: Egocentric Language-Vision Interactive Network Knowledge Challenge Summary
papers.abstract: The EgoLink Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence linking first-person perception, social reasoning, and interactive action. Unlike benchmarks centered on visible objects and activities, EgoLink evaluates whether models can interpret emotional and social cues, resolve visually grounded references, and convert user requests into verified tool-mediated actions. Its two tracks cover social reasoning in egocentric video and interactive agents that complete service tasks through dialogue, tool use, and closed-loop execution. Together, they test whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline question answering and state-changing interaction. We highlight a multi-stage Track 1 data pipeline for multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation, chain-of-thought generation, automatic quality grading, and video-contribution filtering. We summarize the task design, evaluation metrics, rules, leaderboards, and representative solutions. The benchmark combines objective answer scoring with process- and result-based evaluation, enabling analysis of both final correctness and execution quality. The best Track 1 system achieved 0.9263 accuracy, while the best Track 2 system achieved 0.844 joint success and 0.916 micro accuracy. Participant reports reveal a shared principle: strong systems make intermediate evidence explicit through candidate verification, option-robust reasoning, scenario-aware planning, tool canonicalization, and state-aware correction before answering or acting. These findings highlight the importance of process verification and evidence-grounded reasoning for reliable egocentric multimodal intelligence.

translation.title: EgoLink：第一人称语言-视觉交互网络知识挑战赛总结
translation.abstract: ACM Multimedia 2026 的 EgoLink 挑战赛面向连接第一人称感知、社交推理与交互行动的自我中心多模态智能进行基准评测。与以可见物体和活动为中心的基准不同，EgoLink 评估模型能否解读情绪与社交线索、解决视觉接地的指代问题，并将用户请求转化为经过验证的工具中介行动。其两条赛道分别涵盖自我中心视频中的社交推理，以及通过对话、工具使用和闭环执行完成服务任务的交互智能体。二者共同检验感知、推理与决策在离线问答和改变状态的交互中是否保持耦合。我们重点介绍了赛道 1 的多阶段数据流程，包括选择题（MCQ）生成、思维链生成、自动质量评分和视频贡献过滤。我们总结了任务设计、评估指标、规则、排行榜和代表性解决方案。该基准将客观答案评分与基于过程和结果的评估相结合，可同时分析最终正确性与执行质量。赛道 1 最好系统达到 0.9263 准确率，赛道 2 最好系统达到 0.844 联合成功率和 0.916 微观准确率。参赛报告揭示了一个共同原则：强系统在回答或行动之前，通过候选验证、选项鲁棒推理、场景感知规划、工具规范化和状态感知纠错，使中间证据显式化。这些发现凸显了过程验证和证据接地推理对可靠自我中心多模态智能的重要性。
translation.brief: 针对自我中心多模态智能的评测基准 EgoLink，通过设计社交推理与交互智能体两条赛道及配套的多阶段数据生成与评估流程，检验模型的社交线索解读和工具中介任务执行能力。

papers.title: AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data
papers.abstract: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. % \sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.

translation.title: AdaFlowLite：面向异步移动数据的可扩展非阻塞推理
translation.abstract: 配备 LiDAR、摄像头等众多传感器的移动设备的兴起，推动了多模态深度智能在智能座舱、驾驶辅助等分布式感知任务中的应用。然而，由于模态大小和网络动态性，移动传感器数据的到达时间各不相同，这可能导致延迟（若等待慢数据）或精度下降（若不等待而直接推理）。此外，移动系统的多样性和动态性加剧了这一挑战。为此，我们提出转向面向异步分布式多模态数据的机会式推理，在部分数据到达时即开始推理。现有方法侧重于优化模态一致性与互补性（即模态亲和性），但在开放世界移动环境中缺乏控制这种亲和性的计算方法。AdaFlowLite 率先使用基于层次分析的归一化矩阵，在移动场景下对结构化跨模态亲和性进行形式化。该方法能容纳模态的多样性和动态性，并可泛化到不同类型和数量的输入。借助多模态轻量级 Swin Transformer（MMLST），AdaFlowLite 实现实时且灵活的数据插补，无需重训练即可适应各种模态和下游任务。实验表明，AdaFlowLite 将推理延迟显著降低最多 80.4%，精度提升最多 62.1%，能耗降低近 50%，优于现有方法。该方法还可通过预处理异步数据提升 LLM 性能。
translation.brief: 针对移动多模态数据异步到达导致的推理延迟或精度下降问题，提出基于层次化归一化矩阵建模跨模态亲和性和多模态轻量级 Swin Transformer 的机会式部分数据即时推理方法 AdaFlowLite。

papers.title: Watermark Evidence under Open-Weight LLM Modification: Exact Bounds for Low-Rank Output Watermarks
papers.abstract: Open-weight language models can continue generating after their released weights are modified, while a watermark verifier still scores outputs against the original base and marked models. We study how such modifications change the evidence available to an OpenStamp-style verifier. At each shared prefix, we represent the modification as a residual in the next-token logits. We derive an exact finite-vocabulary lower bound on the expected log-likelihood-ratio evidence under a residual-span constraint, along with a sharp span-only deviation bound. We also characterize the first-order evidence shift through a covariance term with an explicit second-order remainder, and determine the residual span needed to reach a target evidence level. For sequence-level detection, we derive an exact conditional exponential-moment bound and combine it with a supermartingale argument and a distribution-free order-statistic tolerance bound. This yields a high-confidence upper bound on miss probability after attack selection on calibration data and evaluation on independent certification continuations. In experiments with OpenStamp on Llama-2-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, INT8 quantization and 30% pruning retain test true-positive rates of 85.6-94.8%, while 500-step LoRA fine-tuning lowers them to 28.8% and 11.6%. The covariance prediction tracks the measured mean LoRA evidence drift on both models, with no remainder-bound violations across 160,000 test prefixes. Additionally, we observe zero false positives among 500 base-model continuations per model. Through these theoretical and empirical results, the current research provides a better understanding of watermark robustness to model-editing/tuning attacks.

translation.title: 开放权重 LLM 修改下的水印证据：低秩输出水印的精确界
translation.abstract: 开放权重语言模型在发布权重被修改后仍可继续生成，而水印验证器仍会依据原始基座和加水印模型对输出进行评分。我们研究此类修改如何改变 OpenStamp 风格验证器可获得的证据。在每个共享前缀处，我们将修改表示为下一词元 logits 中的残差。我们在残差跨度约束下推导了期望对数似然比证据的有限词表精确下界，以及仅跨度的尖锐偏差界。我们还通过带有显式二阶余项的协方差项刻画了一阶证据偏移，并确定了达到目标证据水平所需的残差跨度。对于序列级检测，我们推导了精确的条件指数矩界，并将其与超鞅论证和无分布顺序统计容差界结合。这给出了在校准数据上进行攻击选择、在独立认证延续上进行评估后漏检概率的高置信度上界。在 Llama-2-7B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上对 OpenStamp 的实验中，INT8 量化和 30% 剪枝保留了 85.6-94.8% 的测试真阳性率，而 500 步 LoRA 微调将其降至 28.8% 和 11.6%。协方差预测在两个模型上均跟踪了实测的 LoRA 平均证据漂移，在 160,000 个测试前缀上无余项界违反。此外，在每个模型 500 个基座模型延续中观察到零误报。通过这些理论与实证结果，本研究为水印对模型编辑/微调攻击的鲁棒性提供了更好的理解。
translation.brief: 针对开放权重 LLM 被修改（量化、剪枝、LoRA 微调）后水印验证证据变化的问题，通过将修改表示为 logits 残差，推导对数似然比证据的精确下界、协方差一阶偏移及序列级漏检概率上界。

papers.title: Bookkeeping Is Not Judgement: EJBench, an Engineering Judgement Benchmark Built from a Conjugate Heat Transfer Design Campaign
papers.abstract: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it. Unlike engineering benchmarks that test whether an agent can operate simulation or CAD software, EJBench is software-agnostic and asks what an engineer would conclude without running a simulation. Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature. Every answer is taken from a converged simulation, not from an LLM judge. The best of ten frontier models, GPT-6 Astra, scores 0.71, and models state almost the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on tasks they get right. We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, rewarded by the share of answer criteria the simulation results confirm; on the held-out test split its score rises from 0.071 to 0.106. We release the train, validation and test splits, the evaluation harness and the leaderboard.

translation.title: 记账不是判断：EJBench，基于共轭传热设计活动的工程判断基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出 EJBench，一个工程判断基准：模型能否根据少量先期结果预测设计在新区条件下的行为，并据此做出决策。与测试智能体能否操作仿真或 CAD 软件的工程基准不同，EJBench 与软件无关，考察工程师在不运行仿真时会得出什么结论。其任务来自电池冷板的共轭传热设计活动，分为三类：将未标注的测试结果匹配到其运行工况点、在签署设计前选择应揭示哪些已存储的运行记录、按峰值电芯温度对新工况排序。每个答案均取自收敛的仿真结果，而非 LLM 评审。十个前沿模型中最好的 GPT-6 Astra 得分 0.71，且模型在答错任务上声明的置信度与答对任务几乎相同。我们还用 LoRA 和强化学习对 Qwen3.5-9B 进行后训练，奖励为仿真结果所确认的答案标准比例；在留出测试集上其得分从 0.071 升至 0.106。我们发布了训练、验证和测试集划分、评估工具和排行榜。
translation.brief: 针对考察模型从少量先期仿真结果推断新工况下设计行为并决策的工程判断能力，构建与软件无关、答案取自真实仿真收敛结果的 EJBench 基准，并用 LoRA 与强化学习后训练提升模型得分。

papers.title: Learning In-Context Adaptivity for LLMs through Continual Gameplay
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon tasks where they must explore, gather experience, and adapt their decisions accordingly. We name this capability in-context adaptivity: improving decisions across episodes from experience accumulated in context. We propose to evaluate it in repeated imperfect-information games against unknown opponents. In these games, fixed game-theoretically optimal policies cannot achieve maximum reward, whereas adapting to the opponent increases returns across games. We design a paired protocol that evaluates each agent with and without memory under identical conditions to isolate experience gain from single-game skill. Evaluation shows that memory brings little performance gain for open-weight models and inconsistent gains for frontier models. Our analysis of the agents' summaries and actions identifies a memory-doing gap in which models accurately record opponent tendencies yet rarely depart from default play. To close this gap, we construct a pool of exploitable opponents and post-train Qwen3.5-9B with supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. We optimize full-match return across context segments so summary generation and action selection are trained together. On unseen opponents, our 9B RL policy doubles experience gain over supervised fine-tuning in Leduc Hold'em and increases it fivefold in No-Limit Hold'em. Across 35 opponents, our policy matches or surpasses frontier models, generalizes beyond its training horizon, and retains most of its gain on summaries from frontier models.

translation.title: 通过持续游戏对局学习 LLM 的上下文内适应性
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地部署在长时程任务中，需要探索、积累经验并据此调整决策。我们将这种能力命名为上下文内适应性：从上下文中积累的经验出发，跨回合改进决策。我们提出在与未知对手的重复不完全信息博弈中评估该能力。在这些博弈中，固定的博弈论最优策略无法获得最大回报，而适应对手可以跨局提升收益。我们设计了配对协议，在相同条件下分别带记忆和不带记忆评估每个智能体，以将经验增益与单局技能分离。评估显示，记忆对开放权重模型带来的性能提升很小，对前沿模型的提升也不一致。通过分析智能体的总结和动作，我们发现了记忆-行动差距：模型能准确记录对手倾向，却很少偏离默认打法。为弥合这一差距，我们构建了一个可被利用的对手池，并用监督微调加轨迹级强化学习对 Qwen3.5-9B 进行后训练。我们跨上下文片段优化整局回报，使总结生成与动作选择被联合训练。在未见过的对手上，我们的 9B RL 策略在 Leduc Hold'em 中将经验增益较监督微调翻倍，在无限注德州扑克中提升五倍。在 35 个对手上，我们的策略达到或超越前沿模型，泛化超出训练范围，并在基于前沿模型总结的情况下保留大部分增益。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在重复博弈中积累了记忆却仍不据此调整行动的记忆-行动差距问题，提出配对评估协议隔离经验增益，并通过对可利用对手池做监督微调加轨迹级强化学习（联合优化总结生成与动作选择）提升上下文内适应性。

papers.title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
papers.abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2\tau)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $\Delta^* = \beta^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.

translation.title: 用于大语言模型对齐的间隔动力学
translation.abstract: 从业者在选择 LLM 对齐方法时很大程度上依赖试错。我们提供了一个理论基础：每种成对方法都在概率单纯形上定义了一个向量场，支配模型在偏好与不偏好补全之间重新分配概率质量的方式。投影到单个偏好/不偏好对上，问题可化简为一维间隔常微分方程，并具有闭式解。这些解揭示出：DPO 的间隔无界增长（在梯度流极限下按 $O(\log t)$ 对数增长），而 IPO 的间隔收敛到有限的 $1/(2\tau)$；标签噪声会使 DPO 发生定性相变（无界变为有界），但对 IPO 只有定量影响；非对称加权下的梯度集中度决定了大规模下的可训练性。我们在四个基准上、跨五个模型家族验证了全部三个预测。闭式解还支持有原则的方法设计：我们证明向 SimPO 加入任意标签平滑 $\varepsilon > 0$ 会在 $\Delta^* = \beta^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$ 处产生有限的间隔吸引子，而 $\varepsilon = 0$（标准 SimPO）没有吸引子。我们在三个模型（8B-9B）上测试并验证了该预测：理论推导的配置（TPO-S，$\varepsilon = 0.05$）与最强基线具有竞争力，在所有三个模型上取得所比较方法中最高的平均 IFEval 分数，验证了预测的有限吸引子是一个可用的运行点，而非提出新的最先进损失。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 成对对齐方法选择缺乏理论依据的问题，通过将各方法化简为一维间隔常微分方程推导闭式解，解释间隔行为并指导有原则的方法设计。

papers.title: LLMs as Validators for Cross-Chain Bridges: Evaluating Source-Level and Transaction-Level Attack Detection on Solana
papers.abstract: Cross-chain bridges have suffered substantial asset losses due to vulnerabilities in their on-chain programs. On Solana, missing validation checks can enable exploits even when the underlying blockchain operates correctly. The ability of large language models (LLMs) to diagnose these flaws from source code or transaction records, rather than merely raise alarms, remains insufficiently understood. We implement a native Rust lock-and-mint bridge on a local Solana validator with four exploitable variants: two model flaws from the Cashio and Wormhole incidents, while the other two represent vulnerability classes documented in Solana security audits. Paired vulnerable and secure programs, together with successful attacks, benign sessions, and blocked attempts, allow us to distinguish correct diagnoses from unsupported alarms. We evaluate six configurations of five open-weight models across 16,800 responses, compare source inputs with and without comments, and grade 7,200 answers on vulnerable inputs using two blinded LLM graders. The results reveal substantial differences across conditions: without comments, models diagnose 24% of vulnerable source inputs while frequently flagging the secure bridge. Transaction diagnosis is high for the missing-signer scenario but averages 6% across the other three scenarios. Original comments, some of which describe the flaw, increase source diagnosis to 60%. These findings highlight the importance of distinguishing correct vulnerability diagnoses from unsupported alarms in bridge security review.

translation.title: 将 LLM 作为跨链桥验证者：评估 Solana 上源码级与交易级攻击检测
translation.abstract: 跨链桥因其链上程序中的漏洞而蒙受了巨大的资产损失。在 Solana 上，即使底层区块链运行正确，缺失的验证检查也可能导致漏洞利用。大型语言模型（LLM）能否从源代码或交易记录中诊断这些缺陷，而不仅仅是发出警报，目前仍理解不足。我们在本地 Solana 验证节点上实现了一个原生 Rust lock-and-mint 桥，带有四个可利用的变体：其中两个模拟 Cashio 和 Wormhole 事件中的缺陷，另外两个代表 Solana 安全审计中记录的漏洞类别。成对的易受攻击与安全程序，以及成功的攻击、良性会话和被阻止的尝试，使我们能够区分正确的诊断与缺乏依据的警报。我们评估了五个开源权重模型的六种配置，共 16,800 条响应，比较了带注释与不带注释的源码输入，并使用两个盲评 LLM 评分器对易受攻击输入上的 7,200 条答案进行评分。结果显示各条件间差异显著：不带注释时，模型对易受攻击源码输入的诊断率为 24%，同时经常误报安全桥。对于缺失签名者场景，交易诊断率较高，但其他三个场景平均仅为 6%。原始注释（其中一些描述了缺陷）将源码诊断率提高到 60%。这些发现凸显了在桥安全审查中区分正确漏洞诊断与无依据警报的重要性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 能否诊断跨链桥漏洞（而非仅报警）认识不足的问题，在本地 Solana 验证节点上构建带四个可利用变体的 Rust 桥并配对安全版本，系统评估模型在源码级与交易级的攻击检测能力。

papers.title: Revisiting the Survival of Agent-Attributed Code: How Measurement Choices Decide the Verdict
papers.abstract: Studies of how long code from AI coding agents survives after it is merged reach conflicting verdicts: agent code is reported to be retained longer than human code, about as long, or modified sooner. Each study makes defensible measurement choices, but how much these choices decide the verdict is unknown. We revisit the survival of agent-attributed code in our earlier study: 854,139 lines that 2,802 merged pull requests (PRs) added to 215 repositories of the AIDev dataset. We vary nine measurement choices in five research questions and build a specification curve of 88 survival analyses, tested under three variance estimators, several observation windows, and permuted labels. For code from human-supervised agents, mostly GitHub Copilot, the choices change the size of the effect but not its direction. For code from the fully-autonomous agent Devin, they decide the verdict. Across repositories, 15 of 22 specifications report it modified sooner when lines are treated as independent, but only 3 when standard errors are clustered by repository, no more than permuted labels produce. Within repositories, no specification detects a difference. LLM intent classifiers agree with human labels about as well as two humans agree with each other, whereas keyword rules do not (kappa = 0.69 to 0.72 against 0.38), and the two reach different verdicts on why agent code is modified. Humans make most modifications to agent code under every unit and window. Re-run on our data, five published designs each change their result with a single choice. Whether agent code survives longer than human code is therefore decided as much by the measurement as by the code. We derive an operationalization checklist for post-merge studies.

translation.title: 重新审视智能体生成代码的存续时间：测量选择如何决定结论
translation.abstract: 关于 AI 编码智能体生成的代码在合并后能存续多久的研究得出了相互矛盾的结论：有研究称智能体代码比人类代码保留得更久，有的说差不多，也有说更早被修改。每项研究的测量选择都说得通，但这些选择在多大程度上决定了结论尚不清楚。我们重新审视了我们早期研究中智能体归属代码的存续情况：2,802 个已合并的拉取请求（PR）向 AIDev 数据集的 215 个仓库添加的 854,139 行代码。我们在五个研究问题中变化九种测量选择，构建了包含 88 项存续分析的规范曲线，并在三种方差估计器、多个观测窗口和置换标签下进行检验。对于来自有人监督智能体（主要是 GitHub Copilot）的代码，测量选择只改变效应大小而不改变方向。对于来自完全自主智能体 Devin 的代码，它们决定了结论。跨仓库来看，当把行视为独立观测时，22 个规范中有 15 个报告代码更早被修改，但当标准误按仓库聚类时只有 3 个，不超过置换标签产生的数量。在仓库内部，没有任何规范检测到差异。LLM 意图分类器与人类标签的一致性接近两个人类之间的一致性，而关键词规则则不然（kappa 为 0.69 到 0.72 对 0.38），且两者对智能体代码为何被修改得出不同结论。在所有单位和窗口下，人类对智能体代码的修改占多数。将五个已发表设计在我们的数据上重跑，每个都因单一选择而改变结果。因此，智能体代码是否比人类代码存续更久，既取决于代码本身，也取决于测量方式。我们为合并后研究推导了一个操作化清单。
translation.brief: 针对智能体代码存续研究结论相互矛盾的问题，通过在 88 项存续分析中系统性变化九种测量选择并构建规范曲线，量化测量决策对结论的决定性影响。

papers.title: Regularized Score Centering
papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

translation.title: 正则化分数中心化
translation.abstract: 异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自过期策略的数据以及训练与推理之间的数值不匹配可能使学习不稳定。为了稳定离策略学习，分数中心化（SC）消除了奖励基线对期望更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断表明 SC 相比重要性采样（IS）产生更少极端的梯度，但当学习器远离生成数据的行为策略时，SC 仍可能失败。为了限制这种策略失配，我们引入了正则化分数中心化（RSC），它添加一个反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，鼓励学习器的下一 token 分布保持接近行为策略的下一 token 分布。RSC 无论是否使用截断重要性采样（TIS，即对 token 重要性权重设上限）都能工作。我们的理论分析支持这一方法，表明 KL 正则化改善了收敛保证。我们在数学推理和智能体任务（包括在线购物、工具使用、游戏和完全异步的软件工程）上评估稠密模型和混合专家模型。RSC 结合 TIS 在所有智能体基准上显著提高了样本效率，在相同采样响应数量下获得更高的训练奖励。在最终评估中，它在全部六个智能体任务上取得最优表现，在 AppWorld 上提升 14.3%，在 BabyAI 上达到最强基线分数的 9.9 倍。
translation.brief: 针对异步强化学习中过期策略数据导致的离策略学习不稳定问题，提出在分数中心化基础上加入反向 KL 正则化的 RSC 方法以限制策略失配。

papers.title: Can Coding Agents Write and Transpile Unit Tests
papers.abstract: Coding assistants built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a staple of modern software development, increasingly trusted to execute workflows and modernize code end-to-end. Much of this trust rests on passing tests, which are often written by the coding agents themselves. In this work, we examine the ability of these agents to both write reliable tests and translate them between programming languages. We benchmark three popular coding agents, each evaluated with a native frontier model and high reasoning effort. Verifying across a broad suite of metrics, we find that coding agents far exceed human written suites on traditional measures of coverage. This advantage, however, is uneven: agent test quality degrades sharply with project size, and much of the advantage lies in a greater number of written tests. We also show that agentic test translation---while seemingly strong in aggregate---remains inconsistent and unreliable.

translation.title: 编码智能体能否编写与转译单元测试
translation.abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的编码助手已成为现代软件开发的常用工具，越来越多地被信任来端到端地执行工作流程和现代化代码。这种信任很大程度上依赖于通过的测试，而这些测试往往由编码智能体自己编写。在本工作中，我们考察这些智能体编写可靠测试以及在编程语言之间翻译测试的能力。我们基准测试了三个流行的编码智能体，每个均使用原生前沿模型并以高推理努力进行评估。通过广泛的指标验证，我们发现编码智能体在传统覆盖率指标上远超人类编写的测试套件。然而这一优势并不均衡：智能体的测试质量随项目规模增大而急剧下降，且很大一部分优势来自编写了更多数量的测试。我们还表明，智能体测试翻译虽然在总体上看似表现强劲，但仍然不一致且不可靠。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体所写测试的可靠性及其跨语言翻译能力缺乏评估的问题，对三个主流编码智能体编写和转译单元测试的能力进行基准测试。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors.
