We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer trajectories remain more monitorable than simple single-step side tasks. We further discover that targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover monitorability, sometimes surpassing the base model. These model organisms provide a testbed for studying monitorability failures and potential mitigations. Our code can be found on this https URL.

translation.title: 思维链可控性可能降低思维链可监控性
translation.abstract: 思维链（CoT）监控是检测AI智能体隐藏目标、偏离任务行为及其他失效的有前景的工具。一个风险是模型可能故意塑造其推理过程使其对监控者不透明。我们通过persona控制训练对此风险进行压力测试：在以多样personas口吻改写的数学推理轨迹上进行监督微调。这诱导出更广泛的CoT控制能力，尽管训练中不含任何规避监控的样本。在隐蔽副任务评估中，gpt-oss-20b模型生物完成隐藏副任务的轨迹所含可监控证据少于基础模型。在各评估和CoT长度上按副任务成功次数加权平均，CoT可监控性指标g-mean$^2$从基础模型的0.94降至模型生物无隐藏指令时的0.68，在明确要求隐藏时降至0.22。在干预评估中，显式隐藏常使可监控性接近于零。该效应在智能体环境中的Kimi-K2.6模型生物上也存在，尽管需要扩展推理或更长轨迹的隐藏目标仍比简单的单步副任务更可监控。我们进一步发现，针对性的透明度提示可以大幅恢复可监控性，有时甚至超过基础模型。这些模型生物为研究可监控性失效及潜在缓解措施提供了试验场。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 研究模型可能伪装思维链规避监控的风险，通过persona控制训练构建模型生物并验证透明度提示可恢复可监控性。

papers.title: Mechanism Design and Active Systems Theory: 60 Years of Parallel Development
papers.abstract: The survey compares two research traditions within the mathematical theory of designing the rules of interaction (mechanisms) for purposeful participants: mechanism design, together with contract theory and implementation theory, and the theory of active systems created by V.N. Burkov and developed into the theory of control in organizations (TCO) by D.A. Novikov's school; the main results of Yu.B. Germeier's school and of the domestic schools adjacent to active systems theory (AST) are covered as well. The problem statements and principal results of 2006-2026 are presented: for mechanism design (MD) - robust and dynamic mechanism design, multidimensional screening, information design, simplicity of mechanisms and credibility of the designer, market design, algorithmic and learning-based design, mechanisms for AI agents, and robust, relational, dynamic and algorithmic contracts; for AST and TCO - a general typology of control, strategy-proof and incentive-compatible planning mechanisms, decomposition of the agents' game, systems with distributed control and coalitional interaction, reflexive games and informational control, control of staff and structure, dynamic active systems, and project management. A correspondence between the classical results is established (the fair play principle and the revelation principle, the serial resource allocation mechanism and the uniform rule, active expertise mechanisms and generalized median schemes, quasi-compensatory incentive schemes and contracts under observable actions), and priorities are delineated by uniform rules; the areas where the two traditions diverge are identified, as are the dimensions of the problem (staff, structure, institutions, awareness, agents' beliefs) covered only by TCO.

translation.title: 机制设计与主动系统理论：六十年的并行发展
translation.abstract: 本综述比较了为有目的的参与者设计互动规则（机制）的数学理论中的两个研究传统：机制设计（连同合同理论与实施理论），以及由V.N. Burkov创立、经D.A. Novikov学派发展为组织控制理论（TCO）的主动系统理论；同时涵盖Yu.B. Germeier学派及与主动系统理论（AST）相邻的国内学派的主要成果。文中给出2006-2026年的问题表述与主要成果：机制设计（MD）方面——鲁棒与动态机制设计、多维筛选、信息设计、机制简洁性与设计者可信性、市场设计、算法与基于学习的设计、面向AI智能体的机制，以及鲁棒、关系型、动态与算法合同；AST与TCO方面——控制的一般类型学、策略无关与激励相容的规划机制、智能体博弈的分解、分布式控制与联盟互动系统、反思博弈与信息控制、人员与结构控制、动态主动系统以及项目管理。文章建立了经典结果之间的对应关系（公平博弈原则与显示原理、串行资源配置机制与均匀规则、主动专家评审机制与广义中位方案、准补偿激励方案与可观测行动下的合同），并用统一规则界定优先性；还识别出两个传统分道的领域，以及仅由TCO覆盖的问题维度（人员、结构、制度、认知、智能体信念）。
translation.brief: 系统比较机制设计与主动系统理论两条传统六十年的发展，并建立双方经典结果间的对应关系。

papers.title: Corrupting Ties: Investigating Robustness to Bias Injection Across Multi-Agent Network Topologies
papers.abstract: AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts, where interactions among components can introduce fairness risks that remain undetected when auditing components or collective outcomes in isolation. As LLM-based multi-agent systems become more prevalent, understanding how biased information propagates through agent interactions is essential for assessing their fairness. We introduce a controlled bias injection framework that replaces selected agent responses with predefined biased ones, enabling an intervention-based analysis of how network topology and injection configurations shape system behavior. We propose decision divergence metrics that quantify the effects of these interventions at the agent, network, and system levels, and evaluate five topologies on three binary classification tasks using LLMs from the Qwen and Gemma families. Sequential networks show the greatest divergence, whereas fully connected and mesh networks show less. Injection position also matters: in star networks, injecting the central agent has larger effects than injecting peripheral agents. Models further differ in whether divergence follows the injected bias. These findings highlight the role of network structure in the propagation of biased information and motivate topology-aware auditing of fairness risks in multi-agent systems.

translation.title: 腐蚀纽带：研究多智能体网络拓扑对偏见注入的鲁棒性
translation.abstract: AI系统越来越多地部署于高风险决策场景，其中组件间的互动可能引入仅在孤立审计组件或整体结果时无法察觉的公平性风险。随着基于LLM的多智能体系统日益普及，理解偏见信息如何在智能体互动中传播对评估其公平性至关重要。我们引入一个受控偏见注入框架，用预定义的带偏见回复替换选定智能体的回复，从而实现基于干预的分析，考察网络拓扑与注入配置如何塑造系统行为。我们提出在智能体、网络和系统层面量化这些干预影响的决策分歧指标，并使用Qwen和Gemma系列的LLM在三个二分类任务上评估五种拓扑。顺序网络的分歧最大，而全连接和网状网络分歧较小。注入位置也很关键：在星形网络中，注入中心智能体的影响大于注入外围智能体。模型在分歧是否跟随注入偏见方面也存在差异。这些发现凸显了网络结构在偏见信息传播中的作用，并推动对多智能体系统公平性风险的拓扑感知审计。
translation.brief: 提出受控偏见注入框架与决策分歧指标，研究网络拓扑和注入位置如何影响多智能体系统中偏见的传播。

papers.title: Evaluating the Evaluation of Music Generation Models with Generative Psychometrics
papers.abstract: Subjective user studies are one of the major methods for evaluating music generation models. However, subjective evaluation protocols vary widely and are rarely specified in enough detail to be reproduced, hindering comparison across studies. In this paper, we map subjective evaluation methods in ISMIR music generation papers from 2020-2025 and apply generative psychometrics to assess the stability of their items. We extract 284 items from the papers' methodological descriptions, using an LLM and manual validation to standardize them. We represent these items as contextual embeddings and apply Unique Variable Analysis to remove redundant, locally dependent items and Bootstrap Exploratory Graph Analysis to estimate their latent dimensions. Results show the network converges onto a taxonomy of six stable quality dimensions: Rhythm, Melody, Audio, Composition, Structure, and Lyrics, pointing to a unified methodology for conducting user studies to evaluate music generation models.

translation.title: 用生成式心理测量学评估音乐生成模型的评估方法
translation.abstract: 主观用户研究是评估音乐生成模型的主要方法之一。然而，主观评估协议差异很大，且很少被足够详细地描述以供复现，阻碍了跨研究的比较。本文梳理了2020-2025年ISMIR音乐生成论文中的主观评估方法，并应用生成式心理测量学评估其题项的稳定性。我们从论文的方法描述中提取284个题项，使用LLM和人工验证对其进行标准化。我们将这些题项表示为上下文嵌入，并应用Unique Variable Analysis去除冗余、局部相关的题项，用Bootstrap Exploratory Graph Analysis估计其潜在维度。结果显示网络收敛于六个稳定质量维度的分类体系：节奏、旋律、音频、作曲、结构和歌词，指向一种开展用户研究评估音乐生成模型的统一方法论。
translation.brief: 用生成式心理测量学分析ISMIR论文中的主观评估题项，归纳出评估音乐生成模型的六个稳定质量维度。

papers.title: Threat Landscape of Vibe Coding and the Road to Secure Autonomy
papers.abstract: Vibe coding is reshaping software development, enabling faster implementation and allowing individuals with limited programming experience to describe requirements in natural language while AI agents write, test, and deploy the code. As these agents evolve into autonomous systems that execute commands, manage dependencies, access cloud resources, and interact with other agents, their security risks extend beyond incorrect code to actions with direct consequences for software systems. Although research on these risks is expanding, it remains fragmented across areas including prompt injection, insecure code generation, supply-chain attacks, and human factors, with limited consensus on terminology, threat assumptions, and evaluation. This paper consolidates emerging research through the lens of the vibe coding workflow. We establish a reference architecture, characterise six levels of agent autonomy, and develop a threat model centred on five trust boundaries spanning developers, AI models, tools, cloud infrastructure, and the wider software ecosystem. Building on this foundation, we propose a taxonomy of twenty-one threats across nine classes. For each threat, we review the available evidence, assess proposed defences, and identify limitations. Our analysis highlights that risks increase with agents' operational authority, while most defences rely on model judgement and address isolated threats. Finally, we identify eleven research challenges, including enforceable limits on agent authority and shared benchmarks and methodologies for assessing vibe coding security.

translation.title: Vibe Coding的威胁图景与通往安全自主之路
translation.abstract: Vibe coding正在重塑软件开发，实现更快的实现，并允许编程经验有限的人用自然语言描述需求，而AI智能体负责编写、测试和部署代码。随着这些智能体演化为执行命令、管理依赖、访问云资源并与其他智能体交互的自主系统，其安全风险超越了错误代码，扩展到对软件系统有直接后果的行动。尽管相关研究不断扩展，但仍分散在提示注入、不安全代码生成、供应链攻击和人为因素等领域，在术语、威胁假设和评估上缺乏共识。本文从vibe coding工作流的视角整合新兴研究。我们建立了一个参考架构，刻画了六个智能体自主性等级，并构建了以五个信任边界（涵盖开发者、AI模型、工具、云基础设施和更广泛的软件生态系统）为中心的威胁模型。在此基础上，我们提出涵盖九大类二十一种威胁的分类体系。对每种威胁，我们审阅现有证据、评估已提出的防御并识别其局限。我们的分析表明风险随智能体的操作权限增加而上升，而大多数防御依赖模型判断且只针对孤立威胁。最后，我们提出十一个研究挑战，包括对智能体权限的可执行限制以及评估vibe coding安全性的共享基准和方法。
translation.brief: 以vibe coding工作流为视角建立参考架构与威胁分类体系（九类二十一种威胁），系统梳理其安全风险与防御局限并指出研究挑战。

papers.title: Coordination of Heterogeneous Teams with Uncertain Task Requirements
papers.abstract: Coordinating a team of heterogeneous agents to complete tasks with unknown requirements is a challenging multi-agent planning problem. Agents differ in their ability to discover task requirements and in their ability to engage tasks, so the planner must coordinate task discovery, execution, and staging. This paper introduces a hierarchical planner that uses a graph neural network policy to assign actions to agents, then finds a path to the action's location using a shortest-path algorithm. The central part of our approach is the CAAT graph, which is a graph representation of the planning context consisting of the agents, tasks, capabilities, and actions. We demonstrate that our learned planner can jointly coordinate a heterogeneous team to simultaneously discover task requirements and complete tasks in a shorter time compared to baselines that optimize task discovery and task engagement independently. Furthermore, we show that our policy can zero-shot plan on out-of-distribution settings by training only on an outdoor map then transferring without finetuning to an indoor map with more agents, tasks, and capabilities than seen during training.

translation.title: 任务需求不确定的异构团队协调
translation.abstract: 协调一组异构智能体完成需求未知的任务是一个具有挑战性的多智能体规划问题。智能体在发现任务需求和执行任务的能力上各不相同，因此规划器必须协调任务发现、执行和集结。本文提出一种分层规划器，使用图神经网络策略为智能体分配动作，然后用最短路径算法寻找到达动作位置的路径。我们方法的核心是CAAT图，它是对规划上下文（由智能体、任务、能力和动作组成）的图表示。我们证明，与独立优化任务发现和任务执行的基线相比，我们学习到的规划器可以联合协调异构团队，同时发现任务需求并以更短时间完成任务。此外，我们只在一张室外地图上训练，然后无需微调即迁移到一张拥有比训练时更多智能体、任务和能力的室内地图，展示了该策略可以在分布外设置上零样本规划。
translation.brief: 该论文解决需求未知的异构多智能体任务协调问题，核心方法是用CAAT图表示规划上下文并结合图神经网络策略与分层规划器联合优化任务发现与执行。

papers.title: Auditors Struggle to Catch Sabotage In End-to-End Transcripts of AI Safety Research
papers.abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably. When the saboteur chooses which experiments are attacked, rather than being required to sabotage every question given, sabotage identification drops further. Our results suggest that research sabotage by expert-level agents is difficult to detect with current auditing methods and provide a new setting for studying research sabotage.

translation.title: 审计者难以从AI安全研究的端到端记录中发现破坏行为
translation.abstract: 随着AI系统越来越多地用于自动化AI研发，未对齐的系统可能破坏旨在提升模型安全性和对齐性的研究。为对抵御此类破坏的防御进行压力测试，我们使用人类专家作为AI安全研究中的代理破坏者。我们开展了一场红队/蓝队博弈：一名人类研究者从零开始运行AI安全实验，审计者试图判断哪些实验被破坏以及如何破坏。在可以查看完整研究记录并能够运行实验的条件下，人类审计者大多无法区分被破坏的研究与良性研究：他们达到的AUROC为0.59，并不显著优于随机，仅在17%的案例中完整识别出具体的破坏手段。尽管不允许运行实验，最好的前沿模型表现仍优于人类审计者（Fable 5.1：AUROC 0.73，32%完整识别），差距在噪声范围内，而较弱的模型表现相当。当破坏者可以自主选择攻击哪些实验，而不是被要求破坏每个给定问题时，破坏识别率进一步下降。我们的结果表明，专家级智能体的研究破坏行为用当前审计方法难以检测，并为研究破坏的研究提供了一个新场景。
translation.brief: 该论文研究AI研发过程中的研究破坏是否可被审计检测，核心方法是通过人类专家作为代理破坏者的红队/蓝队博弈来压力测试审计防御。

papers.title: EmbedGym: Letting Coding Agents Develop and Debug Embedded Firmware Without Physical Hardware
papers.abstract: Modern coding agents perform well on general software benchmarks because they can run code and unit tests in a closed loop. Embedded firmware development, however, breaks this loop: a program that compiles can still fail on real hardware due to pin polarity, bus protocol, timing, or networking bugs that an agent at a text terminal cannot observe. Existing embedded coding agents either skip hardware execution, drive GPIO-only simulators with multi-second delays, or test on physical boards in a static environment. In this paper, we present EmbedGym, an interactive virtual hardware environment that lets coding agents develop and debug embedded firmware without physical hardware. EmbedGym uses instruction-level microcontroller unit (MCU) emulators to execute the same binary that would be flashed onto a physical board, connects them to 41 peripheral models, an analog circuit simulator, and virtual WiFi/Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) endpoints, and exposes an interface for agents to change sensor inputs, press buttons, and inspect hardware states. On top of it, we build EmbedGym-Bench, which consists of 598 tasks across 6 MCU-framework pairs graded by hidden timed test vectors, using a five-stage multi-agent workflow that synthesizes peripheral models and tasks from datasheets and driver libraries. We expose EmbedGym to a coding agent at three levels and evaluate eight models over more than 14K trajectories. Even when compilation succeeds 99.7% of the time, 19.9% of compiled firmwares fail at runtime (up to 73% on individual targets). In contrast, interactive hardware testing in EmbedGym increases pass rates across models by +4.9% to +14.7% (up to +31% on individual targets). Our results also show that an agent with EmbedGym outperforms prior embedded agent frameworks, and lightweight models with EmbedGym match frontier models without it at 30-70x lower cost.

translation.title: EmbedGym：让编程智能体在没有物理硬件的情况下开发和调试嵌入式固件
translation.abstract: 现代编程智能体在通用软件基准上表现出色，因为它们可以在闭环中运行代码和单元测试。然而嵌入式固件开发打破了这个闭环：编译成功的程序仍可能因引脚极性、总线协议、时序或网络等文本终端上的智能体无法观察到的缺陷而在真实硬件上失败。现有的嵌入式编程智能体要么跳过硬件执行，要么使用具有数秒延迟的仅GPIO模拟器，要么在静态环境中用物理开发板测试。本文提出EmbedGym，一个交互式虚拟硬件环境，使编程智能体无需物理硬件即可开发和调试嵌入式固件。EmbedGym使用指令级的微控制器（MCU）模拟器执行与将烧录到物理开发板上相同的二进制文件，将其连接到41个外设模型、一个模拟电路模拟器以及虚拟WiFi/蓝牙低功耗（BLE）端点，并向智能体提供接口以改变传感器输入、按压按钮和检查硬件状态。在此基础上，我们构建了EmbedGym-Bench，包含跨6个MCU-框架组合的598个任务，通过隐藏的带时序约束的测试向量进行评分，并使用五阶段多智能体工作流从数据手册和驱动库中合成外设模型和任务。我们在三个层级将EmbedGym暴露给编程智能体，并在超过14K条轨迹上评估了八个模型。即使编译成功率达99.7%，仍有19.9%的编译固件在运行时失败（个别目标高达73%）。相比之下，在EmbedGym中进行交互式硬件测试使各模型的通过率提升+4.9%到+14.7%（个别目标高达+31%）。我们的结果还表明，配备EmbedGym的智能体优于先前嵌入式智能体框架，且配备EmbedGym的轻量模型以低30-70倍的成本匹敌没有它的前沿模型。
translation.brief: 该论文解决编程智能体无法观察嵌入式硬件运行时行为的问题，核心方法是构建基于指令级MCU模拟器和外设模型的交互式虚拟硬件环境EmbedGym用于固件开发与调试。

papers.title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements. We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.

translation.title: Inventa：用于自主科学发现的去中心化自我改进智能体
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以产生研究想法并通过迭代实验改进科学发现。然而，增加智能体或迭代数量并不自动转化为产生更多样或更可行的想法。智能体可能收敛于相似的候选方案，通过共享记忆组件传播缺乏依据的主张，并反复应用不再带来改进的搜索策略。我们提出Inventa，一个采用自主研究单元和经验证共享知识的自动化科学发现框架。每个单元使用一个mutator智能体创建候选想法的谱系。本地orchestrator智能体周期性地调整mutator的运行框架。当进展停滞时，orchestrator智能体会更换其模型或重启想法演化过程。验证器评估每个候选想法，并将经验证的改进、有用组件和约束违规记录到共享知识中，这是单元之间唯一的通道。我们在覆盖研究周期的五个基准上评估Inventa，涵盖检索（ScholarCatalyst）、构思（IdeaBench）、提案撰写（IdeaScientist）和科学定律发现（EurekaBench、SciLaws-Bench）。它在全部五项上领先，在EurekaBench上达到73.6%，而CORAL为56.2%。在IdeaBench上，它每篇论文发现26.0个新颖想法，而ResearchAgent为18.6个，且模型调用减少82%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体科学发现中想法趋同、无效主张传播和搜索策略停滞的问题，核心方法是采用去中心化自主研究单元配合经验证共享知识和本地orchestrator自我调整机制。

papers.title: Bajillion: Cryptographic Clearing for Micropayments
papers.abstract: Much of the web is funded by advertising, a model that erodes as humans delegate browsing to AI agents acting on their behalf. A natural replacement is for agents to pay for what they consume, often a fraction of a cent per request. At the scale of web traffic, this could mean tens or even hundreds of millions of payments per second. We present Bajillion, a clearing protocol for scalable micropayments. A sender signs a payment request, and an untrusted operator answers with a preconfirmation, which promises the receiver that it will be paid. Periodically, the operator closes an epoch by posting only the net effect of its payments on chain. Bajillion guarantees that a malicious operator can only omit payments -- it can never debit a sender beyond what it signed, nor misdirect a transfer. Posted balances are therefore finalized immediately and can be withdrawn. By design, senders never have to raise disputes, making it suitable for ephemeral AI agents. A receiver that is shortchanged can prove that a close omitted a preconfirmed payment, which halts the protocol and lets every user exit with its finalized balance. Requests from different senders can be processed independently, allowing the operator to parallelize up to the number of senders. We capture these guarantees in an ideal functionality for accountable clearing and prove that Bajillion realizes it.

translation.title: Bajillion：面向微支付的可扩展密码学清算
translation.abstract: 当今网络大量依赖广告获得资金，而随着人类将浏览任务委托给代表自己的AI智能体，这一模式正在瓦解。一个自然的替代方案是让智能体为其消费的内容付费，通常每个请求只需几分之一美分。在互联网流量的规模下，这可能意味着每秒数千万甚至数亿次支付。我们提出Bajillion，一个可扩展微支付的清算协议。发送方签署支付请求，一个不受信任的运营方以预确认作出回应，向接收方承诺将会得到支付。运营方周期性地关闭一个epoch，仅将支付的净效果上链。Bajillion保证恶意运营方只能遗漏支付——它绝不能对发送方扣款超出其签署的金额，也不能错误转移资金。因此上链的余额立即最终确定并可以提取。通过设计，发送方无需发起争议，使其适用于短暂的AI智能体。被少付的接收方可以证明某个关闭遗漏了预确认的支付，这将使协议停机并让每个用户以其最终确定的余额退出。来自不同发送方的请求可以独立处理，使运营方能够并行化至发送方数量。我们将这些保证形式化为可问责清算的理想功能，并证明Bajillion实现了它。
translation.brief: 该论文解决AI智能体微支付每秒可达数亿次的可扩展清算问题，核心方法是让不可信运营方周期性仅将支付净效果上链并通过密码学证明机制保证余额安全与最终性。

papers.title: Call-Efficient ICD-10 Code Prediction via Supervised Candidate Generation and Selective LLM Invocation
papers.abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. This paper presents a call-efficient ICD-10 code prediction pipeline that combines transformer embeddings, tree-based supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and a gated LLM assistance. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. A direct zero-shot GPT-5.6-Sol baseline reaches 81.01% Top-1 accuracy, but requires an invocation of this large model for every diagnosis. The final deployable system, Pre-LLM fusion, reaches 81.24% OOF-CV accuracy and 83.19% locked-test accuracy while calling the LLM for only 31.97% of cases. This improves the locked-test error rate from 25.68% for the supervised parent-code baseline to 16.81%, corresponding to a 34.5% relative error reduction. The results show that the most effective role of the LLM is controlled reranking on uncertain examples rather than unrestricted coding or full-dataset invocation.

translation.title: 基于监督式候选生成与选择性LLM调用的高效ICD-10编码预测
translation.abstract: 从简短的临床诊断文本中自动分配ICD-10编码是一项实用的医学文本分类与归一化任务。该任务的难点在于诊断短语简短且含噪、ICD-10标签空间具有层次结构、类别分布严重失衡。本文提出一种调用高效的ICD-10编码预测流水线，结合了Transformer嵌入、基于树的监督式候选生成、候选级重排以及门控LLM辅助。评估采用防泄漏验证协议：模型与阈值选择基于折外交叉验证预测，最终报告在锁定的测试集上进行，测试集与训练数据无共享源文件组。监督式条件父编码候选生成器在锁定测试集上达到74.32%的Top-1准确率和93.05%的Top-10候选覆盖率。直接零样本GPT-5.6-Sol基线达到81.01%的Top-1准确率，但每次诊断都需要调用该大模型。最终可部署系统Pre-LLM融合达到81.24%的OOF-CV准确率和83.19%的锁定测试集准确率，且仅对31.97%的病例调用LLM。这将锁定测试集错误率从监督式父编码基线的25.68%降至16.81%，对应34.5%的相对错误率降低。结果表明，LLM最有效的作用是对不确定样本进行受控重排，而非不受限的编码或全数据集调用。
translation.brief: 为解决短诊断文本的ICD-10自动编码中LLM全量调用成本高的问题，提出监督式候选生成加门控选择性LLM重排的混合预测流水线。

papers.title: World-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Pollution-Aware Bird Movement Modeling Using a Multi-Instance DQN Framework
papers.abstract: Birds are modeled as environmentally sensitive agents whose movement reflects real-world air quality conditions, where AQI serves as a measurable world feedback signal representing pollution-driven consequences. Instead of relying on human preference or synthetic rewards, the system uses environmental outcomes as the primary training signal, enabling policy learning grounded in ecological impact. We propose a multi-instance reinforcement learning simulation in which agents navigate a 2D grid representation of India integrated with a precomputed AQI matrix and geographic state boundaries. The framework combines bird call metadata from the Xeno-canto dataset, spatial discretization, and real environmental data to learn adaptive navigation strategies under pollution constraints. To ensure scalability and efficiency, repeated real-time API queries are replaced by a structured AQI mapping that enables fast lookup during training and execution. Multiple baselines, including Monte Carlo, Q-Learning, and Value Iteration, are evaluated for comparison. Deep Q-Network demonstrates stronger stability, adaptability, and cumulative performance across varying environmental conditions, establishing a scalable foundation for world-feedback driven ecological decision modeling.

translation.title: 基于多实例DQN框架的世界反馈强化学习用于污染感知的鸟类移动建模
translation.abstract: 鸟类被建模为对环境敏感的智能体，其移动反映真实世界的空气质量状况，其中AQI作为代表污染驱动后果的可测量的世界反馈信号。系统不依赖人类偏好或合成奖励，而是将环境结果作为主要训练信号，使策略学习扎根于生态影响。我们提出一个多实例强化学习仿真，其中智能体在与预计算AQI矩阵及地理州边界集成在一起的印度二维网格表示中导航。该框架结合来自Xeno-canto数据集的鸟鸣元数据、空间离散化和真实环境数据，以在污染约束下学习自适应导航策略。为确保可扩展性与效率，用结构化的AQI映射替代重复的实时API查询，从而在训练和执行期间实现快速查找。多个基线（包括Monte Carlo、Q-Learning和Value Iteration）被评估用于对比。Deep Q-Network在不同环境条件下展现出更强的稳定性、适应性和累积性能，为世界反馈驱动的生态决策建模奠定了可扩展的基础。
translation.brief: 为建模空气质量对鸟类移动的影响，构建以AQI作为世界反馈信号的多实例DQN网格仿真框架学习导航策略。

papers.title: KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders
papers.abstract: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase. Given these ranking LLM calls are prefill heavy (long prompt but short decoded output) and repeatedly called, these repeated prefill of user profile text dominates the serving. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. We present KVUse, which stores the user profiles as reusable key-value (KV) caches instead of text. KVUse trains lightweight LoRA writers by self-distillation, so that the user profile update call produces the reusable KV of the user profile while decoding it, and the LLM can read these reusable KV at new positions and behind new context without recomputation. KVUse also has a customized KV scheduler that uploads the stored reusable KV of the next batch while the current batch is computed, hiding the KV transfer from host memory behind GPU computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, KVUse shows no statistically significant difference in ranking quality from full prefill over continuous memory update rounds. Under saturated load, KVUse raises the throughput of the downstream scoring path by 4.0x-4.5x and of the profile update path by 1.4x-1.9x.

translation.title: KVUse：面向高效LLM推荐系统的可复用KV用户记忆
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的记忆增强推荐系统为每个用户维护一份自然语言画像。这些画像由用户画像更新路径随新交互到来而修订，并被排序等下游任务路径消费。由于这些用户画像以文本形式存储在用户记忆中，每次消费它们的排序LLM调用都必须将其拼接进提示词并在prefill阶段计算其KV缓存。鉴于这些排序LLM调用prefill开销大（长提示词、短解码输出）且被反复调用，对用户画像文本的重复prefill主导了服务开销。前缀缓存无法消除它，因为这些用户画像在不同调用中前面拼接着不同的文本。我们提出KVUse，将用户画像存储为可复用的键值（KV）缓存而非文本。KVUse通过自蒸馏训练轻量级LoRA写入器，使画像更新调用在解码用户画像的同时生成其可复用KV，LLM可在新位置和新上下文之后读取这些可复用KV而无需重新计算。KVUse还配备定制的KV调度器，在计算当前批次的同时上传下一批次的已存储可复用KV，将KV从主机内存的传输隐藏在GPU计算之后。在四个InstructRec数据集上使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，KVUse在连续记忆更新轮次中的排序质量与完整prefill无统计显著差异。在饱和负载下，KVUse将下游打分路径吞吐量提升4.0倍至4.5倍，画像更新路径提升1.4倍至1.9倍。
translation.brief: 为消除LLM推荐系统中用户画像文本的重复prefill开销，KVUse将画像存为可复用KV缓存并用自蒸馏LoRA写入器生成与调度该缓存。

papers.title: GridDriver: On-Board BEV-Based Language Planning and Reasoning
papers.abstract: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. We present GridDriver, an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework combining trajectory prediction, structured driving indicators, natural-language navigation, driving explanations, and scene question answering. Lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception and spatially structured tokens provide scene context to a shared LLM, while frame-wise scheduling interleaves trajectory prediction with asynchronous language generation. GridDriver achieves competitive performance on public benchmarks, reaching 87.9% PDMS on NAVSIM and 57.6% accuracy on nuScenes-QA with a shared planning and QA checkpoint. Spatial representation analyses demonstrate improved geometric information retention and trajectory prediction compared with Q-Former compression. The system achieves 32.7 ms standalone planning latency and 9.4 plans/s in an onboard ROS 2 pipeline. We further evaluate planning on our own data recordings and demonstrate open-loop onboard operation on a research vehicle. Across public benchmarks and real-world evaluations, we identify strengths and limitations of the BEV-based approach.

translation.title: GridDriver：车载BEV语言规划与推理
translation.abstract: 以鸟瞰图（BEV）为条件的大语言模型（LLM）实现了语言交互式驾驶，但车载部署需要在自回归语言生成的同时进行高效感知与持续规划。我们提出GridDriver，一个高效的BEV条件LLM框架，结合轨迹预测、结构化驾驶指标、自然语言导航、驾驶解释和场景问答。轻量级时空BEV感知与空间结构化token为共享LLM提供场景上下文，同时逐帧调度将轨迹预测与异步语言生成交错进行。GridDriver在公开基准上取得有竞争力的性能，在NAVSIM上达到87.9% PDMS、在nuScenes-QA上达到57.6%准确率，且规划与问答共享同一checkpoint。空间表示分析表明，相比Q-Former压缩，其几何信息保留与轨迹预测能力更强。该系统在车载ROS 2流水线中实现32.7 ms的独立规划延迟和每秒9.4次规划。我们进一步在自录数据上评估规划，并在一辆研究车上展示开环车载运行。通过公开基准与真实世界评估，我们指出了基于BEV方法的优势与局限。
translation.brief: 为在车载环境下实现BEV条件LLM的语言交互式驾驶，GridDriver结合轻量时空感知与逐帧调度，将规划与语言生成异步交错执行。

papers.title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
papers.abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.

translation.title: DNeo：你的并行草稿模型需要更好的目标特征编码
translation.abstract: 推测扩散解码使用小型并行草稿模型在一次前向传播中生成b个草稿token，随后由更大的目标模型进行并行验证。当多个草稿token同时通过验证时可以获得更快的推理。近期的并行草稿架构（DFlash、DSpark）通过以目标模型计算的丰富特征为条件（即特征编码机制）来提升草稿质量。然而，标准特征编码机制存在三个局限：（1）有损——通过一种被称为残差混合的已发现效应，编码投影会对底层目标特征空间造成破坏；（2）无记忆——不记录先前已处理的提议；（3）从目标各层均匀采样特征，遗漏了重要的隐藏状态。为解决这些问题，我们提出Mixture-of-Features Attention（MoFA），一种配备工作记忆（编码先前被拒绝的提议）的轻量级特征编码方法。借助MoFA、拒绝记忆以及一系列进一步增强手段（包括2抽头因果卷积、仅前缀的交叉注意力和非均匀目标层选择），最终架构DNeo在不影响草稿模型体积或生成质量的前提下，生成速度比SoTA（DFlash-2）快1.3倍。DNano标志着高质量快速LLM推理的新一流水平。
translation.brief: 针对并行草稿模型特征编码有损、无记忆和层采样不均的问题，提出带拒绝记忆的MoFA编码机制，构建更快的推测解码架构DNeo。

papers.title: SLED: Sensor SLicing from Edge to Datacenter
papers.abstract: Modern sensing systems generate large volumes of heterogeneous data streams from multiple sensor modalities, increasing reliance on datacenters for computation, artificial intelligence/superintelligence (AI/SI) inference, and AI/SI training. Each sensor stream may have different network and compute requirements depending on its type and data volume. However, current wireless systems typically allocate resources at the device level, leading to contention among co-located sensor streams, where bulk data transfers may starve latency-critical telemetry. To this end, this paper introduces Sensor Slicing (SL). SL provides deterministic, medium access control (MAC)-level isolation for individual sensors within a single user equipment (UE) in open radio access networks (O-RAN). Using agentic coding techniques, SL is implemented in two O-RAN-compliant packages, reducing development time by 400 times (2 h 40 min [OCUDU] vs. 6.5 weeks [OAI]), 228-fold fewer human prompts (4 vs. 913), and less than half the tokens (0.64B vs. 1.43B). An associated end-to-end framework, SLED, is implemented to establish per-sensor radio and network isolation across edge, campus, and remote high-performance computing (HPC) tiers. Over-the-air wireless experiments demonstrate that while conventional network slicing causes critical delays to increase more than 2,300-fold under high traffic load, SLED maintains stable latency. Scaling evaluations on the two RAN stacks show that throughput remains within 0.9% and 1.4% of expected allocations even as the number of sensor slices increases. The results demonstrate that SLED preserves latency-critical telemetry while effectively utilizing resources across the sensor-to-HPC pipeline. The SLED software and evaluation datasets are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: SLED：从边缘到数据中心的传感器切片
translation.abstract: 现代传感系统从多种传感器模态产生大量异构数据流，越来越依赖数据中心进行计算、人工智能/超级智能（AI/SI）推理和AI/SI训练。每条传感器流可能因其类型和数据量不同而有不同的网络与计算需求。然而，当前无线系统通常在设备级别分配资源，导致同处一地的传感器流之间产生争用，大量数据传输可能饿死对时延敏感的遥测。为此，本文提出传感器切片（SL）。SL在开放无线接入网络（O-RAN）中为单个用户设备（UE）内的单个传感器提供确定性的介质访问控制（MAC）层隔离。借助agentic编码技术，SL在两个符合O-RAN的软件包中实现，将开发时间缩短400倍（2小时40分钟 [OCUDU] 对比 6.5周 [OAI]），人工提示减少228倍（4次对比913次），token消耗不到一半（0.64B对比1.43B）。同时实现了一个端到端框架SLED，在边缘、园区和远程高性能计算（HPC）层级之间建立逐传感器的无线与网络隔离。空口无线实验表明，在高流量负载下传统网络切片会使关键时延增加超过2300倍，而SLED保持稳定时延。在两个RAN协议栈上的扩展性评估显示，即使传感器切片数量增加，吞吐量仍保持在预期分配的0.9%和1.4%以内。结果表明SLED在跨传感器到HPC流水线有效利用资源的同时，保护了时延敏感的遥测。SLED软件和评估数据集已在 https 公开可用。
translation.brief: 针对同设备多传感器流争用导致关键遥测被饿死的问题，提出在O-RAN中以MAC层切片实现逐传感器网络隔离的SLED框架。

papers.title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
papers.abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. We present DiscoveryAgent, a domain-agnostic, scientist-centric system that combines autonomous investigation with scientist-directed hypothesis steering. Scientists select, refine, or replace hypotheses between research rounds, while audit agents interrogate checkpointed records to trace claims, reproduce analyses, and inform subsequent decisions. Across two predictive modeling tasks, DiscoveryAgent produced the best variable-star classifier among evaluated baselines and, with scientist steering, a protein variant-effect predictor surpassed by only one of 106 ProteinGym baselines. We develop a rigorous checkpointing system that enables highly capable audit agents, a scalable form of oversight for agentic research. Audit agents autonomously identify errors at higher rates than previous AI scientist agents, and scientists collaborating with audit agents identify 14x more valid errors versus scientists performing manual review. In three case studies led by domain experts across physical science, social science, and life science, we developed a multimodal photometric-redshift estimator that resolves complementary failures of images and photometry, achieving 0.971 AUROC for low-redshift classification; documented an 83% rise in Florida homeowners-insurance premiums from 2013 to 2023, with a growing, regressive burden; and identified CD4+ T-cell relay genes, which both receive and exert broad transcriptional regulation, enriched for autoimmune disease associations. Together, these results show how autonomous research can expand scientists' empirical reach while centering their authority over research direction and their ability to understand and challenge the evidence.

translation.title: DiscoveryAgent：以科学家为中心的Agentic AI框架
translation.abstract: AI代理可以辅助科学研究，但如何在自主探索与科学家检查和调整正在进行的工作的能力之间取得平衡，仍是核心设计挑战。我们提出DiscoveryAgent，一个领域无关、以科学家为中心的系统，将自主探索与科学家主导的假设引导相结合。科学家可以在各研究轮次之间选择、精炼或替换假设，同时审计代理通过检查检查点记录来追溯声明、复现分析并为后续决策提供依据。在两个预测建模任务上，DiscoveryAgent产出了所评估基线中最好的变星分类器，并且在科学家引导下，其蛋白质变异效应预测器在106个ProteinGym基线中仅被一个超越。我们开发了严格的检查点系统，使能力强大的审计代理成为可能，这是对agentic研究的一种可扩展监督形式。审计代理自主识别错误的比率高于以往的AI科学家代理，与审计代理协作的科学家相比手动审查识别出的有效错误多14倍。在三个由领域专家主导的物理科学、社会科学和生命科学案例研究中，我们开发了多模态测光红移估计器，解决了图像和测光的互补性失效问题，低红移分类达到0.971 AUROC；记录了2013至2023年佛罗里达州房主保险费上涨83%且负担日益累退的现象；并识别了CD4+ T细胞中继基因，它们既接收又施加广泛的转录调控，并富集于自身免疫病关联。这些结果共同表明，自主研究如何扩展科学家的实证能力，同时以科学家对研究方向的权威及其理解和质疑证据的能力为中心。
translation.brief: 针对AI自主研究与科学家监督难平衡的问题，提出支持假设引导与审计代理检查点审查的科学家中心框架DiscoveryAgent。

papers.title: PersonaHate: A Scalable Persona-Based Data Synthesis Pipeline for Hate Speech Analysis
papers.abstract: Hate speech remains a persistent and evolving threat on online platforms. The widespread use of large language models (LLMs) further intensifies this problem by making hateful content easier and cheaper to generate at scale. Although stronger hate speech detectors continue to be proposed, their performance remains uneven across target identity groups and different forms of hateful expression, partly because existing training data provides only limited coverage of these cases. Thus, we introduce PersonaHate, a scalable persona-driven data synthesis pipeline for constructing diverse hate speech datasets. PersonaHate begins with a large persona pool of 457K personas drawn from two real-world sources. Conditioned on selected personas from this pool, it prompts eight LLMs to generate hate speech across 34 identity groups and performs multi-judge annotation to obtain reliable labels. The resulting corpus contains 791K samples, from which we curate a 67K group-balanced training set. Our modular design also supports extension to new identity groups, generators, and emerging hate targets. Built upon this dataset, we evaluate two detector training strategies: training from scratch and further fine-tuning. Results show that all trained models achieve competitive performance across four widely used external benchmarks. Notably, a 184M-parameter DeBERTa-v3 model trained on PersonaHate reaches 77.5% average F1 and 79.4% average accuracy, outperforming OpenAI's Moderation API on HateBenchSet and MHS. Furthermore, fine-tuning Llama-3.1-8B raises its average F1 from 70.7% to 78.4%, a gain of 7.7 percentage points, surpassing LlamaGuard-3, Meta's official safety model based on the same Llama-3.1-8B architecture, on three of four benchmarks. These results show that PersonaHate can substantially improve the robustness and cross-dataset generalization of hate speech detectors.

translation.title: PersonaHate：用于仇恨言论分析的可扩展基于人设的数据合成流水线
translation.abstract: 仇恨言论仍是在线平台上持续存在并不断演变的威胁。大语言模型（LLM）的广泛使用进一步加剧了这一问题，使仇恨内容更容易、更低成本地大规模生成。尽管不断有更强的仇恨言论检测器被提出，但它们在不同目标身份群体和不同仇恨表达形式上的表现仍然不均衡，部分原因在于现有训练数据对这些情况的覆盖有限。因此，我们提出PersonaHate，一个可扩展的、以人设为驱动的数据合成流水线，用于构建多样化的仇恨言论数据集。PersonaHate从两个真实世界来源获取45.7万人设的大规模人设池。以从该池中选出的人设为条件，它提示八个LLM在34个身份群体上生成仇恨言论，并进行多裁判标注以获得可靠标签。所得语料库包含79.1万样本，我们从中精选出6.7万群体均衡的训练集。模块化设计还支持扩展到新的身份群体、生成器和新兴仇恨目标。基于该数据集，我们评估了两种检测器训练策略：从头训练和进一步微调。结果显示，所有训练出的模型在四个广泛使用的外部基准上都达到有竞争力的性能。值得注意的是，一个在PersonaHate上训练的184M参数DeBERTa-v3模型达到77.5%平均F1和79.4%平均准确率，在HateBenchSet和MHS上超过OpenAI的Moderation API。此外，微调Llama-3.1-8B使其平均F1从70.7%提升到78.4%，提高7.7个百分点，在四个基准中的三个上超过基于同一Llama-3.1-8B架构的Meta官方安全模型LlamaGuard-3。这些结果表明PersonaHate可以显著提升仇恨言论检测器的鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对仇恨言论检测训练数据覆盖不足的问题，提出基于45.7万人设池驱动多LLM合成并多裁判标注的PersonaHate数据合成流水线。

papers.title: Eight in Ten LLMs Leak System-Prompt Secrets: Nevan, an Agentic Capture-the-Flag Study
papers.abstract: We audit instruction-hierarchy enforcement across 363 text-in/text-out models from the OpenRouter catalog. The research question we answer with this experiment is which models disclose a protected secret embedded in the system prompt, and through which techniques. Each model guards a secret 16-character flag set in its system prompt, while an artificial intelligence (AI) agent (OpenCode, powered by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), steered by a human researcher, tries to persuade it to emit the flag. The flag was exfiltrated from 296 of the 363 models, plus four models released after the initial catalog freeze, for 300 captures in total. Of these, 170 involved a non-English language pivot, most often French. Each capture shows that a model ranked a user request above its system instruction at least once. It does not show that the model provably resists untested attacks, nor that it would consistently leak semantically sensitive data, nor that it is vulnerable to harmful-content jailbreaks. For practitioners, we draw three lessons: do not store secrets in system prompts, enforce critical behavior outside the model with output validation and deterministic checks, and do not let a large language model (LLM) judge be the sole decider of consequential outcomes.

translation.title: 十个大模型中八个泄露系统提示秘密：Nevan，一项Agentic夺旗研究
translation.abstract: 我们审计了OpenRouter目录中363个文本输入/文本输出模型的指令层级执行情况。本实验要回答的研究问题是：哪些模型会泄露嵌入系统提示中的受保护秘密，以及通过哪些技术。每个模型守护其系统提示中设置的16字符秘密旗标，而一个AI代理（OpenCode，由DeepSeek V4.1 Flash驱动），在人类研究员的引导下，尝试说服其输出旗标。旗标从363个模型中的296个被窃取，加上目录冻结后发布的四个模型，共300次捕获。其中170次涉及非英语语言转换，最常见的是法语。每次捕获表明该模型至少有一次将用户请求置于其系统指令之上。它并不表明该模型可证明地抵御未经测试的攻击，也不表明它会持续泄露语义敏感数据，也不表明它易受有害内容越狱攻击。对从业者，我们得出三条经验：不要在系统提示中存储秘密；通过输出验证和确定性检查在模型之外执行关键行为；不要让大语言模型（LLM）裁判成为重要结果的唯一决定者。
translation.brief: 针对大模型是否泄露系统提示中秘密的问题，用AI代理对363个模型开展说服其泄露旗标的夺旗审计研究。

papers.title: Operating an Agent-Driven Dataset Factory: Discovery, Construction, and Public Release
papers.abstract: Turning public data into prediction datasets requires connecting source discovery, task definition, construction, and distribution. We deployed Dataset Factory to perform these steps continuously under a standing release policy. Bounded language-model tasks interpret sources, write construction code, and review task meaning; deterministic software manages state, workers, retries, and publication. Over 81.53 hours, the factory published 14 datasets at an estimated recurring operating expenditure of about \$2.74 per publication. The accounting includes failed attempts, inference, workers, and hosting. Separate agents completed prediction experiments on all twelve evaluated releases. Source review nevertheless identified a task whose construction filters contradicted its population declaration. The original reviewer accepted later-record exclusions without reconciling them with the published selection rule. This experience documents an operating source-to-release workflow and shows why successful execution and consumer use need separate checks of task meaning.

translation.title: 运营一个代理驱动的数据集工厂：发现、构建与公开发布
translation.abstract: 将公共数据转化为预测数据集需要连接源发现、任务定义、构建和分发。我们部署了Dataset Factory，在常设发布策略下持续执行这些步骤。有界的语言模型任务解读来源、编写构建代码并审查任务含义；确定性软件管理状态、工作进程、重试和发布。在81.53小时内，该工厂以估计约每次发布2.74美元的经常性运营支出发布了14个数据集。该核算包括失败尝试、推理、工作进程和托管费用。独立代理在全部12个被评估的发布上完成了预测实验。尽管如此，来源审查发现一个任务的构建过滤器与其总体声明相矛盾。原始审查者接受了后来记录的排除项，而未将其与已发布的选择规则对账。这段经历记录了一条从来源到发布的运营工作流，并说明为何成功的执行和消费者使用需要对任务含义进行单独检查。
translation.brief: 针对从公共数据到预测数据集的全流程自动化问题，部署由LLM任务与确定性软件协作、持续运营的数据集工厂Dataset Factory。

papers.title: Solver to System: LLM Reasoning Across Representations and Execution in Scientific Simulation
papers.abstract: Simulators based on partial differential equations (PDEs) are widely used to model physical systems, but generating and interpreting PDE solver code with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. Scientific simulation code is a useful testbed for LLM scientific reasoning because (1) one system can be represented by code, equations, natural language, and numerical trajectories and (2) code can execute successfully while implementing invalid physics. We introduce Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations, to evaluate whether LLMs can recover the underlying physical system through (1) cross-representation consistency and (2) static and agentic detection of physical invalidity. Across eight open-weight models, LLMs systematically favor some representations when evidence conflicts, and lexical perturbations to code alter interpretation of other unchanged representations. Execution improves physical-validity judgments, but weaker agents can judge correctly without identifying the causal defect. Thus, LLMs may reach correct judgments despite inconsistent representation reconciliation or causal misdiagnosis.

translation.title: 从求解器到系统：LLM在科学模拟中跨表示与执行的推理能力
translation.abstract: 基于偏微分方程（PDE）的模拟器被广泛用于物理系统建模，但用大语言模型（LLM）生成和解读PDE求解器代码仍然充满挑战。科学模拟代码是检验LLM科学推理能力的有效试验场，原因在于：(1) 同一系统可用代码、方程、自然语言和数值轨迹等多种方式表示；(2) 代码可以成功执行却实现无效的物理。我们提出Solver2System数据集，包含带有多重表示、受控损坏和词汇扰动的PDE求解器，用于评估LLM能否通过(1)跨表示一致性以及(2)静态和代理式检测来恢复底层物理系统。在八个开源权重模型上的实验显示，当证据冲突时LLM会系统性地偏好某些表示，且对代码的词汇扰动会改变其对其他未变表示的解读。执行可以提升物理有效性判断，但较弱的代理即使未识别出因果缺陷也可能判断正确。因此，LLM可能在表示调和不一致或因果误判的情况下仍得出正确结论。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否通过跨表示一致性与执行检测从PDE求解器代码中恢复底层物理系统，构建了含多重表示与受控损坏的Solver2System数据集。

papers.title: Beyond Bitwidth: Deployment-Constrained Mixed-Precision Quantization for Multilingual LLM Inference on NVIDIA Blackwell
papers.abstract: Low-bit LLM quantization is useful only if a model preserves service-relevant accuracy, executes through supported GPU kernels, and meets measured memory and latency limits. We study Qwen3-8B on NVIDIA B200 with vLLM, including INT2/INT3, GPTQ, NVFP4, and mixed-precision configurations. We verify native packed execution and precision on all 144 fused linear modules and evaluate Korean, English, numerical, and reasoning quality under preregistered gates. Packed INT2 and INT3 execute, but all seven tested INT2 grids degenerate on generation. Isolated module-restoration effects are strongly non-additive; Korean and reasoning sensitivity rankings disagree, and a promising INT4/INT8 development candidate fails independent final evaluation. A configuration with 16-bit activations, 98 NVFP4 weight-only modules, 46 INT8 modules, and an INT8 output head passes all gates on the untouched FINAL-81 set (5,168 items): 5.917 GiB of weight-loading memory (limit 5.98), Korean teacher-correct retention 0.904 (gate 0.90), and TPOT ratio 0.939 relative to BF16. It improves paired accuracy over NVFP4 W4A4 by +1.4 percentage points (Bonferroni-adjusted interval [+0.2, +2.6]), compared with +3.4 points on the selection set. This comparison changes both activation precision and INT8 protection; exploratory analyses suggest that the activation change contributes substantially, but the isolated allocation effect is not established. Final checkpoints were not retained, and bitwise rebuild reproducibility remains unverified.

translation.title: 超越位宽：NVIDIA Blackwell上面向部署约束的多语言LLM混合精度量化
translation.abstract: 低比特LLM量化只有在模型保持与服务相关的精度、能通过受支持的GPU kernel执行、并满足实测内存和延迟限制时才有用。我们在NVIDIA B200上用vLLM研究Qwen3-8B，包括INT2/INT3、GPTQ、NVFP4和混合精度配置。我们验证了全部144个融合线性模块的原生打包执行与精度，并在预注册的门槛下评估韩语、英语、数值和推理质量。打包INT2和INT3可以执行，但所有七种测试的INT2网格在生成任务上退化。隔离的模块恢复效应具有强非可加性；韩语和推理敏感性排序不一致，且一个有前景的INT4/INT8开发候选在独立最终评估中失败。一个采用16位激活、98个NVFP4仅权重量化模块、46个INT8模块和INT8输出头的配置，在未经改动的FINAL-81集（5,168项）上通过全部门槛：权重加载内存5.917 GiB（限值5.98）、韩语教师纠正保持率0.904（门槛0.90）、相对BF16的TPOT比率0.939。相比NVFP4 W4A4，其配对准确率提升+1.4个百分点（Bonferroni校正区间[+0.2, +2.6]），而选择集上为+3.4点。此比较同时改变了激活精度和INT8保护；探索性分析表明激活精度的改变贡献显著，但隔离的分配效应未得到确立。最终checkpoint未保留，位级重建的可复现性仍未验证。
translation.brief: 在满足内存与延迟部署约束下，为Qwen3-8B在NVIDIA B200上寻找混合精度量化配置，并系统评估INT2/INT3、GPTQ、NVFP4及混合精度方案。

papers.title: WebAgents: Unbundling Agent Creation, Hosting, and Execution for an Agent-Native Web
papers.abstract: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Realizing this vision requires agent behavior to move across creators, hosts, and runtimes without coupling publication to a particular execution environment or transferring authority over user resources. We introduce WebAgents, which unbundles these roles through a signed this http URL that carries portable workflows, skills, schemas, and resource requirements. An OpenClaw-based agent-native browser/runtime verifies the package, obtains authorization, and binds it at run time to user-controlled models, tools, permissions, and budgets, while hosts distribute the public program and may retain private services server-side. We demonstrate this contract with three unrelated workflows executed unchanged under local and API-backed models, including literature review with live services and a website-published travel agent using semantic tools and user-selected personal resources. In a controlled suite, WebAgents explicitly blocks all 716 injected contract violations while accepting all 295 matched benign controls, with median automated pre-execution processing below 0.5 s for all three packages. We conclude by outlining a path toward NANDA-based discovery and interoperable package ecosystems while retaining execution authority in the user's runtime.

translation.title: WebAgents：面向代理原生Web的代理创建、托管与执行解耦
translation.abstract: 大语言模型正从孤立助手走向能够规划、使用工具并与其他代理协调的自主代理，这催生了由独立开发的代理和服务构成的Agentic Web。实现这一愿景需要代理行为能在创建者、宿主和运行时之间迁移，而不将发布绑定到特定执行环境，也不转移用户资源的控制权。我们提出WebAgents，通过签名的this http URL将工作流、技能、schema和资源需求可移植地封装，解耦这些角色。基于OpenClaw的代理原生浏览器/运行时验证该包、获取授权，并在运行时将其绑定到用户控制的模型、工具、权限和预算，而宿主分发公共程序并可在服务器端保留私有服务。我们用三个互不相关的工作流在本地和API支持的模型下原样执行来验证这一契约，包括使用在线服务的文献综述和使用语义工具及用户自选个人资源的网站发布旅行代理。在一组受控测试中，WebAgents明确拦截了全部716个注入的契约违规，同时接受了全部295个匹配的良性对照，三个包的执行前自动处理中位时间均低于0.5秒。我们最后概述了基于NANDA的发现机制和可互操作包生态的路径，同时将执行权限保留在用户运行时中。
translation.brief: 提出WebAgents协议，通过签名包将代理的创建、托管与执行解耦，使用户运行时自主验证授权并绑定模型、工具、权限和预算。

papers.title: From Apology to Action: Apologies, Compensation, and Cooperation in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make decisions that affect other agents, but what happens after a harmful or unsuccessful interaction remains poorly understood. We investigate whether apologies by LLM agents are associated with subsequent cooperative behaviour, using controlled Prisoner's Dilemma experiments with four commercial models (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Mistral Large 3). Across payoff conditions, we examine when agents apologise, the reasons they provide, and the actions that follow. We also examine how access to one round of interaction history affects behaviour and, in a second experiment, whether and how agents offer compensation alongside their apologies. Apology behaviour differed substantially across models and preceding interaction outcomes, and verbal expressions of cooperation did not always align with subsequent actions. Notably, Claude Opus 4.8 apologised even after mutual cooperation, while Mistral Large 3 apologised after being exploited but continued to defect even when its opponent cooperated. After unilateral defection, positively compensated apologies from GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro were followed by mutual cooperation, unlike those from Claude and Mistral. Our findings suggest that apologies, compensation, and strategic behaviour are distinct: conciliatory messages may precede continued defection, while costly apologies may go unanswered. This has important implications for the study of machine behaviour and human-AI interactions, as verbal signals alone may not reliably reflect an AI system's subsequent actions.

translation.title: 从道歉到行动：LLM代理中的道歉、补偿与合作
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以做出影响其他代理的决策，但在有害或失败的交互之后会发生什么仍知之甚少。我们用受控的囚徒困境实验研究LLM代理的道歉是否与后续合作行为相关，实验涉及四个商业模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Mistral Large 3）。我们在不同收益条件下考察代理何时道歉、给出的理由以及随后的行动。我们还考察获得一轮交互历史对行为的影响，并在第二个实验中考察代理是否以及如何随道歉提供补偿。道歉行为在不同模型和前序交互结果之间差异显著，且言语表达的合作并不总是与后续行动一致。值得注意的是，Claude Opus 4.8甚至在相互合作后也道歉，而Mistral Large 3在被利用后道歉，但即使对手合作仍继续背叛。在单方背叛之后，GPT-5.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro带正向补偿的道歉之后出现了相互合作，而Claude和Mistral则不然。我们的发现表明道歉、补偿和策略行为是相互独立的：安抚性消息可能先于持续的背叛，而代价高昂的道歉可能得不到回应。这对机器行为和人机交互研究有重要意义，因为仅凭言语信号可能无法可靠反映AI系统的后续行动。
translation.brief: 通过囚徒困境实验考察四个商业LLM代理的道歉与补偿行为是否对应后续合作行动，分析道歉言语与实际策略的脱节。

papers.title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects
papers.abstract: Decision models can answer a typed question about an image with a probability per option, without generating text. In our case study of Clef-flash (post-trained Qwen3.5-9B backbone) on industrial inspection benchmarks, we ask whether it localizes the anomalies it detects. We obtained uneven results with zero-shot detection: per-category image AUROC 0.924 on MVTec AD and 0.668 on MVTec AD 2. On the former, the decision head's routing attention produces 0.391 mean per-image pixel AUROC, and hiding the image tokens from it leaves detection unchanged. The multimodal LLM's backbone attention does point at the defect, however it falls below a center prior when we change question. It falls below chance if we remove textual context in the question, partly due to backbone attention leaving the object, while the head's map hardly changes. The backbone's states carry the location when probed with normal images, on the test-split images, however, the decision depends on the defect region. A larger model, Clef, that comes with a post-trained Qwen3.8-27B backbone, gives no useful map in the decision head either. We found that it's possible to recover anomaly location by asking question specifically on an image region, retraining the head or reading the backbone, but none matches dedicated few-shot localizers.

translation.title: 决策而不知其所在：决策模型能否定位其检测到的异常
translation.abstract: 决策模型可以对图像回答一个带类型的问题，为每个选项给出概率，而无需生成文本。我们在工业检测基准上以Clef-flash（经过后训练的Qwen3.5-9B骨干）为案例研究，探究它能否定位其检测到的异常。零样本检测的结果并不均衡：MVTec AD上每类图像AUROC为0.924，MVTec AD 2上为0.668。在前者上，决策头的路由注意力产生0.391的平均每图像像素AUROC，且从其输入中隐藏图像token不改变检测结果。多模态LLM的骨干注意力确实指向缺陷，但当改变问题时其表现低于中心先验；若去掉问题中的文本上下文，其表现低于随机水平，部分原因是骨干注意力离开目标物体，而决策头的图几乎不变。用正常图像探测时骨干状态携带位置信息，但在测试集图像上决策依赖于缺陷区域。更大的Clef模型（后训练的Qwen3.8-27B骨干）在决策头中同样无法给出有用的图。我们发现可以通过针对图像特定区域提问、重新训练决策头或读取骨干来恢复异常位置，但没有一种方法能匹敌专门的少样本定位器。
translation.brief: 通过Clef-flash案例研究检验图像决策模型能否定位其检测到的异常，发现决策头注意力无法直接给出缺陷图，需区域性提问、头重训或读骨干才能恢复位置。

papers.title: Supporting Researcher Control in AI-Assisted Social Media Analysis: A Mixed-Methods Study of AI4OSN
papers.abstract: High-quality annotated datasets are critical for advancing computational social science (CSS) research, yet collecting, curating, and analyzing large-scale data from dynamic sources such as online social networks (OSNs) remains a persistent bottleneck. Researchers must also translate substantive questions into queries, relevance criteria, and defensible interpretations. Large language models (LLMs) can assist, but they can also obscure the judgments, potentially reducing researcher oversight and critical evaluation. We present AI4OSN, a mixed-initiative platform that keeps researchers in control of data collection, relevance labeling, and sensemaking while making AI assistance available as an inspectable advisory resource. In a systematic user study (N=18) using X/Twitter data, participants reported above-benchmark perceived usability (mean SUS score of 79.7), increased confidence in LLM-assisted annotation and analysis tasks, and low cognitive workload during AI-supported sensemaking. Notably, novice participants showed descriptively greater alignment and higher reported agreement with AI output than experienced participants, underscoring the need to support differentiated verification practices across expertise levels. Overall, this work contributes both a human-centered system for social data analysis and empirical insights into how AI-assisted interfaces shape researcher behavior, trust, and decision-making. Our findings highlight design opportunities and tensions in building accessible, transparent, and agentic AI systems for social media and web research.

translation.title: 在AI辅助社交媒体分析中支持研究者掌控：AI4OSN的混合方法研究
translation.abstract: 高质量的标注数据集对推进计算社会科学（CSS）研究至关重要，然而从在线社交网络（OSNs）等动态数据源中收集、整理和分析大规模数据始终是一个瓶颈。研究者还必须将实质性研究问题转化为查询、相关性标准和可辩护的解释。大语言模型（LLMs）可以提供辅助，但也可能掩盖这些判断，削弱研究者的监督和批判性评估。我们提出AI4OSN，一个混合主动式平台，让研究者始终掌控数据收集、相关性标注和意义建构，同时将AI辅助作为一种可检视的咨询资源。在使用X/Twitter数据的系统性用户研究（N=18）中，参与者报告了高于基准的感知可用性（SUS平均分79.7）、对LLM辅助标注和分析任务信心提升，以及在AI支持的意义建构过程中较低的认知负荷。值得注意的是，新手参与者与AI输出的对齐程度和报告的认同度在描述上高于有经验的研究者，这凸显了针对不同专业水平支持差异化验证实践的必要性。总体而言，这项工作既贡献了一个以人为中心的社交数据分析系统，也提供了AI辅助界面如何影响研究者行为、信任和决策的实证洞见。我们的发现凸显了为社交媒体和网络研究构建易用、透明且具有代理能力的AI系统的设计机遇与张力。
translation.brief: 为解决LLM辅助社交媒体数据分析中研究者掌控力弱的问题，提出混合主动式平台AI4OSN，将AI辅助设计为可检视的咨询资源以保持研究者的数据收集、标注和意义建构控制权。

papers.title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. This setup ignores the need to acquire diagnostic evidence incrementally from incomplete information in real-world diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency. Results reveal trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.

translation.title: DiagTrace：一个面向临床决策的交互式基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答和诊断推理基准上表现出强大性能。然而，现有评估通常预先提供全部患者信息，且仅评估最终诊断或其理由。这种设置忽略了真实诊断中需要从不完整信息出发增量式获取诊断证据的需求。为弥合这一差距，我们提出DiagTrace，一个基于原始文献的基准，用于评估LLM能否通过交互式信息获取重构有记录的诊断轨迹。每个基准实例基于PubMed Central的病例报告构建，包含初始表现、事件库、临床病程和诊断参考。DiagTrace涵盖八个专科共510个病例，其中225个用于评估四个LLM在临床病程对齐、交互质量和效率方面的表现。结果揭示了信息覆盖度、与原始文献一致的顺序和轮次使用之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 为解决现有医学评估未考察LLM从不完整信息中增量获取诊断证据的能力，提出基于PubMed Central病例报告构建的交互式基准DiagTrace来评估其重构诊断轨迹的能力。

papers.title: PS-HalluBench: Taxonomy-Driven Benchmarking of LLM Hallucinations in Power Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for power-system applications, yet their reliability in engineering analysis remains uncertain. We introduce PS-HalluBench, a manually constructed benchmark of 200 questions that evaluates hallucination-related failures across five power-system task categories: numerical reasoning, network topology, constraint verification, false-premise acceptance, and abstention. We evaluate ten LLMs over the benchmark, yielding 39.35\% overall correctness, with constraint verification achieving only 21.75\%, and highlighting persistent difficulties in engineering reasoning. We further investigate engineering-grounded reasoning through numerical solver support and verified network information both of which show significant performance improvement. The findings reveal important limitations of standalone LLM reasoning and motivate integrating LLMs with verified engineering tools for reliable power-system analysis.

translation.title: PS-HalluBench：面向电力系统LLM幻觉的分类体系驱动基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在电力系统应用中的探索日益增多，但其在工程分析中的可靠性仍不确定。我们提出PS-HalluBench，一个手工构建的包含200个问题的基准，评估五类电力系统任务中的幻觉相关失效：数值推理、网络拓扑、约束验证、错误前提接受和弃答。我们用十个LLM对该基准进行评估，总体正确率为39.35%，其中约束验证仅21.75%，凸显了工程推理中的持续性困难。我们进一步通过数值求解器支持和经验证的网络信息研究基于工程的推理，两者均显示出显著的性能提升。这些发现揭示了独立LLM推理的重要局限，并推动将LLM与经验证的工程工具集成以实现可靠的电力系统分析。
translation.brief: 为评估LLM在电力系统分析中的幻觉问题，手工构建五类任务共200题的基准PS-HalluBench，并探索引入数值求解器支持和经验证的网络信息来增强LLM推理。

papers.title: An Explainable Agentic AI Framework for Distribution System Load Restoration
papers.abstract: Distribution system load restoration is a sequential decision-making problem in which restoration actions must maximize served load, prioritize critical loads, and preserve power-flow feasibility. This paper proposes an explainable agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for distribution system load restoration. The proposed framework uses multiple large language model (LLM) agents for planner guidance, strategic plan generation, decision arbitration, memory-based feedback, and explanation generation. Unlike unconstrained LLM-based control, the proposed method restricts agent decisions to feasible restoration actions and evaluates all candidate plans using deterministic AC power-flow feasibility checks. The framework is evaluated on IEEE 33-bus and 69-bus distribution feeders, as well as a larger IEEE 118-bus test case, and compared against reinforcement learning and planning baselines. The results show that the proposed agentic framework achieves better restoration performance while producing structured explanations for operator-facing decision support. A direct comparison with a Single-LLM-Agent baseline further shows that the proposed multi-agent decomposition improves weighted restored load and critical-load recovery compared with a monolithic LLM decision structure.

translation.title: 面向配电系统负荷恢复的可解释代理式AI框架
translation.abstract: 配电系统负荷恢复是一个序贯决策问题，恢复动作必须最大化恢复负荷、优先保障关键负荷并保持潮流可行性。本文提出一个面向配电系统负荷恢复的可解释代理式人工智能（AI）框架。该框架使用多个大语言模型（LLM）代理，分别负责规划者引导、战略性方案生成、决策仲裁、基于记忆的反馈和解释生成。与无约束的LLM控制不同，所提方法将代理决策限制在可行的恢复动作范围内，并使用确定性的交流潮流可行性检查评估所有候选方案。该框架在IEEE 33节点和69节点配电馈线以及更大的IEEE 118节点测试用例上进行评估，并与强化学习和规划基线进行比较。结果表明，所提出的代理式框架在取得更好恢复性能的同时，能为面向操作员的决策支持生成结构化解释。与单LLM代理基线的直接对比进一步表明，所提出的多代理分解相较于单一整体式LLM决策结构，提升了加权恢复负荷和关键负荷恢复。
translation.brief: 为解决配电系统负荷恢复的序贯决策问题，提出多LLM代理协作的可解释框架，将决策约束于可行恢复动作并以确定性交流潮流检查评估候选方案。

papers.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
papers.abstract: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.

translation.title: SkillBuffBench：衡量代理技能在不同框架、模型、技能访问模式和记忆下的贡献
translation.abstract: Agent Skills是编码代理可以按需发现和加载的基于文件的过程性知识包，如今已被每个主流代理框架（harness）所支持，但关于其帮助程度的证据几乎全部来自为任务手工挑选正确Skill且代理从空白状态启动的设置。而部署中这两点都不成立：代理要从已安装的Skill库中进行选择，且经常携带先前工作的记忆。我们提出SkillBuffBench，一个基准及配套评估协议，将Skill访问视为三级因素（无Skill、精选Skill、从已安装库中自动调用），并将其与记忆（开与关）、四个代理框架以及多个模型（Anthropic、Google和OpenAI的最先进专有模型，以及来自中国厂商的最先进开放权重模型）交叉组合，每个模型在每个框架下均运行一次，并在领域专家贡献的研究任务及其所使用的Skill上进行评估，目前涵盖材料科学和生物学领域，任务套件将持续滚动扩展。每次运行都由确定性验证器标注；不确定性通过成对的任务级bootstrap报告；成本、代理轮数和实际耗时与分数并列报告，而非折算进分数。本文这一版本描述了基准的设计、评估协议及其当前的任务和Skills。评估正在进行中：结果将在运行完成后添加，任务套件、结果和分析将持续滚动更新。
translation.brief: 为弥补现有Agent Skills评估仅限于人工挑选Skill且无记忆的设置，提出SkillBuffBench基准，将Skill访问模式、记忆、多个代理框架和模型交叉组合，用领域专家研究任务加确定性验证器进行系统评估。

papers.title: Computed Permutation Trellis Coding: Near-Optimal Quantization from Two Multiplications and a 64-Byte Table
papers.abstract: We propose Computed Permutation Trellis Coding (CPTC), a low-bit quantization format for tensors written once and read many times. Formats that round each value on its own, such as INT4 and FP4, waste a large part of their bits against the information-theoretic ideal. Trellis codes recover this loss by encoding values jointly, but prior decoders either need a large lookup table for their best quality or compute values with a hash that restricts what they can decode. CPTC's decoder multiplies its state by two coefficients and adds the top bits of the products to index a 64-byte table. Because that sum is not uniformly distributed, the rarely used ends of a small table can hold values far out in the tails. One decoder serves every bit width from 1 to 6, reproduces the standard integer and floating-point formats exactly, and comes within 0.07 bits of the ideal at 4 bits. It matches a random-permutation trellis code whose table is thousands of times larger, and exceeds every QTIP codebook. In LLM weight quantization without fine-tuning, CPTC has the lowest KL divergence to the unquantized model at every tested bit width on Llama 3.1 8B and 70B Instruct against QTIP's codebooks (by up to 27%). The decoder has been built into the AWS Trainium 4 AI accelerator, where it runs at the throughput of the native FP4 and FP8 formats for a negligible fraction of the systolic array's area. Fused encoding kernels quantize an 8B model's linear layers in under two minutes on one GPU and, in cycle-level simulation, on one Trainium 4 chip.

translation.title: 计算型置换网格编码：两次乘法与一张64字节表实现近最优量化
translation.abstract: 我们提出计算型置换网格编码（CPTC），一种面向一次写入、多次读取的张量的低位量化格式。逐值独立取整的格式（如INT4和FP4）相对信息论理想浪费了大量比特位。网格码通过联合编码取值来挽回这一损失，但以往的解码器要么需要巨大的查找表才能达到最佳质量，要么依赖哈希计算取值从而限制了可解码的内容。CPTC的解码器将状态乘以两个系数，并将乘积的高位相加以索引一张64字节表。由于该和并非均匀分布，小表中很少使用的末端可以存放位于远尾部的取值。一个解码器可服务从1到6的所有位宽，精确复现标准整数与浮点格式，并在4比特下距理想仅差0.07比特。它可匹配查找表大数千倍的随机置换网格码，并超越所有QTIP码本。在不微调的LLM权重量化中，CPTC在Llama 3.1 8B和70B Instruct上的所有测试位宽下，相对QTIP码本对未量化模型具有最低的KL散度（最高低27%）。该解码器已集成到AWS Trainium 4 AI加速器中，以原生FP4和FP8格式的吞吐率运行，且仅占脉动阵列面积的极小部分。融合编码内核可在一块GPU上不到两分钟内量化一个8B模型的线性层，并在周期级仿真中在一颗Trainium 4芯片上完成。
translation.brief: 针对传统标量量化浪费比特的问题，提出CPTC格式，用一个仅需两次乘法和64字节表的解码器实现近理想的联合网格量化。

papers.title: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact
papers.abstract: Checking whether a generated sentence is supported by its source document is a standard safeguard for AI-written text, and the strongest published checkers are single models. We describe GauntletScore, an evidence engine whose few rules and thresholds were set on the benchmark's development split. It puts typed questions to independent readers from different providers and records each answer as a measurement in an evidence ledger. It combines the measurements with a fixed Bayesian rule that counts a contradiction only when two readers agree. On the full LLM-AggreFact test split (29,320 claims across 11 datasets), following the leaderboard's approach, GauntletScore achieves 79.51 balanced accuracy, above every average published on the leaderboard as of 15 November 2026. That places it level with the best of them, nimble-v4-max (79.45 from its published dataset scores; the engine's 95% interval, 78.47 to 80.53, contains it). On the same claims it beats two of its three readers used alone (Readers A and B) by 1.66 and 2.17 points (95% intervals 0.80 to 2.53 and 1.29 to 3.06). Without AggreFact-CNN, described below, the leads are 0.90 and 1.32 and both intervals stay above zero. The engine also records the evidence behind every verdict, which a single model does not. Its largest margin is on full-length news articles checked against multi-sentence summaries (AggreFact-CNN), a format that resembles much regulated writing. There it scores 76.45, the best on the leaderboard, against 70.1 for the next best and 63.9 to 67.8 for the six systems with the highest averages. The test split was run once, on an engine frozen before the first test claim, under a stopping plan committed in advance. We release per-claim predictions and the scoring script.

translation.title: GauntletScore：在LLM-AggreFact上媲美最佳已发表核查器的可审计事实核查
translation.abstract: 检查生成的句子是否被其来源文档支持是AI生成文本的标准保障手段，而已发表最强的核查器都是单一模型。我们描述了GauntletScore，一个证据引擎，其少量规则和阈值仅在基准的开发集上设定。它向来自不同提供商的独立阅读器提出类型化问题，并将每个答案作为一次测量记录在证据账本中。它用固定的贝叶斯规则组合这些测量，只在两个阅读器一致时才计入矛盾。按照排行榜的方法，在完整的LLM-AggreFact测试集（11个数据集共29,320条声明）上，GauntletScore达到79.51的平衡准确率，高于截至2026年11月15日排行榜上发布的所有平均值。这使其与其中最佳者持平：nimble-v4-max（其公布的数据集得分为79.45，该引擎的95%区间78.47至80.53包含此值）。在相同声明上，它超过其三个阅读器单独使用中的两个（阅读器A和B）1.66和2.17分（95%区间分别为0.80至2.53和1.29至3.06）。在不含下述AggreFact-CNN的情况下，领先幅度为0.90和1.32，两个区间仍均大于零。该引擎还记录每个判定背后的证据，这是单一模型所不具备的。其最大优势在于针对多句摘要核查全文新闻文章（AggreFact-CNN），这一格式类似于许多受监管的写作。在那里它得到76.45，为排行榜最佳，次佳为70.1，平均值最高的六个系统在63.9到67.8之间。测试集只运行一次，在第一个测试声明之前引擎已被冻结，并遵循预先承诺的停止方案。我们发布逐声明预测和评分脚本。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成内容的事实核查问题，提出通过向多个独立阅读器提问并用固定贝叶斯规则组合证据账本的可审计核查引擎GauntletScore。

papers.title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
papers.abstract: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. We evaluate reference recovery, offline execution with judged and native rewards, and online recommendation with real execution, building AgentSelect-Exec with 5,060 executed configurations. Our method recovers the complete reference configuration within ten candidates for 67.73% of AgentSelect queries, nearly twice the strongest baseline, and leads all baselines on SkillsBench. The proxy-trained critic raises the top-ranked agent's execution score from 7.58 to 8.37 out of 10; execution feedback increases it to 8.78, above the strongest baselines. Four target-domain queries suffice to adapt the generator to SkillsBench. Agents recommended online outperform the strongest baselines under both an LLM judge and native verifiers. These results support learning and transferring joint resource composition from task experience.

translation.title: 智能体需要什么？面向资源包的智能体资源组合
translation.abstract: 智能体资源的价值取决于其backbone和配套资源，且只有在执行之后才可知。基于token的生成器仍受限于其训练目录，而独立的资源评分忽略互补性，复用的资源包则针对其他任务。我们提出任务条件化的智能体资源组合问题（AgentComposition）：联合选择backbone模型和工具-技能包以最大化端到端执行效用。我们的检索接地的资源包感知智能体生成方法检索候选资源以及相似任务的历史配置。一个微调后的生成器读取资源描述，并通过受限束搜索重组候选，从而无需重训即可纳入新资源。一个资源包感知的critic利用LLM教师和历史成功配置作为执行代理对完整配置排序，并在有执行反馈时进行自适应。我们从参考恢复、带裁判与原生奖励的离线执行以及真实执行的在线推荐进行评估，并构建了包含5,060个已执行配置的AgentSelect-Exec。我们的方法在67.73%的AgentSelect查询中于十个候选内恢复完整参考配置，接近最强基线的两倍，并在SkillsBench上领先所有基线。代理训练的critic将排名第一的智能体的执行得分从7.58提升到8.37（满分10）；执行反馈将其进一步提高到8.78，高于最强基线。仅需四条目标域查询即可使生成器适配SkillsBench。在线推荐的智能体在LLM裁判和原生验证器下均优于最强基线。这些结果支持从任务经验中学习并迁移联合资源组合。
translation.brief: 针对智能体backbone与工具-技能包联合选择问题，提出检索候选资源、生成器重组加资源包感知critic排序的任务条件化组合框架AgentComposition。

papers.title: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.

translation.title: 更努力地思考并不能带来更好的选择：推理努力提升LLM购物代理的置信度而非正确性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为自主购物代理，处理多模态商品信息（由视觉和文本数据构成）并代表消费者推荐购买。人们自然会假设，思考能力更强的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为检验这一信念，我们对这类代理提出两个问题：要求模型更努力地思考是否会使它选择更好的产品，以及它报告的置信度是否告诉我们其可能出错的程度？我们在基于WebShop、Amazon的SQID和Wayfair的WANDS平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十个前沿模型进行评测，观察思考能力更强的LLM是否真的做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在全部三个基准上，我们发现增加思考努力并未在统计意义上提升决策质量。同样的思考努力变化却在统计显著水平上提高了所声明的置信度，因此额外的思考换来的是自信而非正确。我们还在这些任务中测量了这些模型的校准程度（其报告的置信度百分比与真实正确百分比的吻合程度），并表明大多数模型在各个努力水平上校准都不佳。我们还发现错误高度共享：当一个模型在某任务上出错时，其他多个模型往往也在同一任务上出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务上，大量模型选择了同一款错误产品。
translation.brief: 针对思考更多是否提升购物代理决策质量的问题，在三个商品选择基准上对十个前沿模型评测，发现增加推理努力只显著提升报告置信度而不提升正确性。

papers.title: RLDE: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Iterative Document Editing
papers.abstract: Improving the quality, clarity, and flow of long documents remains a challenging problem in NLP, as human editing typically occurs through iterative refinement rather than a single-pass rewrite. Most existing automated systems act as black-box generators or rely on supervised learning, limiting interpretability and failing to capture the sequential nature of revisions. In this paper, we propose RLDE, an automated end-to-end metric-driven RL framework that formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP problem (unsupervised with respect to paired document-revision targets). Working with a limited action space (NOOP, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE), RLDE leverages Pointer Networks for dynamic span selection at the token level and sends generative actions to the frozen BART-base model to obtain context-aware suggestions. PPO agents learn to optimize a multi-objective reward function based on readability, perplexity, and grammar metrics with the help of a novel SBERT-based Semantic Preservation Penalty constraint to avoid deletion degeneracy. Evaluations on the BEA-2019 dataset showed statistically significant results (p < 0.01) across all metrics, where Flesch Reading Ease increased from 49.8 to 59.4, perplexity decreased from 63.7 to 39.8, while preserving 93% of semantic information. When compared to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompt-engineered models like GPT-4 and LLaMA-2, RLDE shows high performance at a very low computational inference cost. Moreover, the quality of edits generated by RLDE has been verified via human evaluations, scoring 4.9/5 for meaning preservation and 4.4/5 for edit quality.

translation.title: RLDE：面向可解释迭代文档编辑的强化学习框架
translation.abstract: 提升长文档的质量、清晰度和流畅性仍是NLP中的一个难题，因为人类编辑通常通过迭代精修而非一次性重写完成。现有大多数自动化系统要么充当黑盒生成器，要么依赖监督学习，限制了可解释性且未能捕捉修订的序列特性。本文提出RLDE，一个自动化的端到端指标驱动RL框架，将文档修订形式化为无参考的MDP问题（相对于成对的文档-修订目标而言是无监督的）。RLDE在有限动作空间（NOOP、INSERT、DELETE、REPLACE）下，利用Pointer Networks在token级别进行动态跨度选择，并将生成式动作发送给冻结的BART-base模型以获得上下文相关的建议。PPO智能体学习优化基于可读性、困惑度和语法指标的多目标奖励函数，并借助一种新颖的基于SBERT的语义保持惩罚约束来避免删除退化。在BEA-2019数据集上的评估显示所有指标均达到统计显著（p < 0.01），Flesch阅读易读度从49.8提升到59.4，困惑度从63.7降至39.8，同时保留93%的语义信息。与GPT-4和LLaMA-2等使用思维链（CoT）提示工程化的模型相比，RLDE以极低的计算推理成本展现了高性能。此外，RLDE生成的编辑质量经人工评估验证，意义保持得分4.9/5，编辑质量得分4.4/5。
translation.brief: 针对无参考的迭代式长文档修订问题，提出以Pointer Network做跨度选择、PPO优化多目标指标奖励并加语义保持惩罚的RL编辑框架RLDE。

papers.title: Beyond Acuity Accuracy: A Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Emergency Triage AI Tools
papers.abstract: Patient-facing AI triage tools may support care-seeking and emergency department prioritization, but require evaluation beyond acuity accuracy alone. We developed SAFE-Triage, a framework integrating human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and simulation testing across clinical performance, patient interaction, and clinician-facing summary quality. We applied SAFE-Triage to 40 MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes and a 10,030-case acuity analysis comparing prompted LLM triage (PLT) with rule-augmented prompted LLM triage (rPLT). PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains. rPLT produced shorter and more stable outputs with higher automated readability scores. SAFE-Triage identified trade-offs between acuity accuracy, undertriage risk, communication quality, readability, and summary quality, supporting pre-deployment refinement and ongoing monitoring by showing where triage tools are efficient, need improvement, or need clinician oversight.

translation.title: 超越分诊准确率：面向患者的急诊分诊AI工具多维评估框架
translation.abstract: 面向患者的AI分诊工具可以支持就医决策和急诊科优先级排序，但需要超越分诊准确率的更全面评估。我们开发了SAFE-Triage框架，整合人工审核、自动化指标、LLM-as-judge评估和仿真测试，覆盖临床表现、患者交互和面向临床医生的摘要质量三个维度。我们将SAFE-Triage应用于40个源自MIMIC-IV的急诊病例情景，并进行了10,030个案例的分诊级别分析，比较有提示的LLM分诊（PLT）与规则增强的提示LLM分诊（rPLT）。PLT取得了更高的急诊严重程度指数（ESI）准确率（57.5% vs 42.8%，P < 0.001）、更低的漏诊分诊率（13.1% vs 29.8%，P < 0.001），并在所有领域获得更高的临床医生评分。rPLT产生的输出更短、更稳定，自动化可读性得分更高。SAFE-Triage揭示了分诊准确率、漏诊风险、沟通质量、可读性和摘要质量之间的权衡，通过展示分诊工具在何处高效、何处需要改进、何处需要临床医生监督，支持部署前的优化和持续监控。
translation.brief: 针对分诊AI工具仅靠准确率评估不足的问题，提出SAFE-Triage多维评估框架，结合人工审核、自动化指标、LLM评审与仿真测试进行综合评估。

papers.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
papers.abstract: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one.
