Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.

translation.title: 权重空间编程不需要Transformer
translation.abstract: Transformer等标准神经架构之所以被选用，是因为它们能通过梯度下降良好训练并在GPU上快速运行。而在权重空间编程中，大语言模型（LLM）直接手工编写目标权重，无需基于梯度的训练，因此这些理由不再成立。我们还应保留Transformer吗？在仅有少量指引、十个标注样例和一个沙盒环境（主要针对多选题任务）的条件下，我们让三个前沿LLM要么为固定架构生成权重，要么自行设计架构。当可自由设计时，三者都把纯文本事实编译成由固定流程查询的稀疏表，最高达到54.4%的测试准确率。LLM设计的模型比同一LLM写出的准确率最高的公开Transformer测试准确率更高，而参数量少约1800倍。在没有梯度的情况下，它们选择表结构——LLM可以声明每个权重的含义，并找出和改写错误的权重。每个错误答案对应一行，删除一行只影响大约一个其他答案。基于此，我们提出一种基于联想记忆的模型，在GPU上比同尺寸Transformer快最高17倍。我们还测试了预训练权重、其他基准以及模型生成答案的任务。预训练LLM仍然更准确；本文的主张关乎手工编写权重时应构建何种结构。
translation.brief: 研究LLM手工编写权重时无需梯度训练该选什么架构，发现LLM自发将知识编译为稀疏查询表，并据此提出基于联想记忆、GPU上更快的模型结构。

papers.title: Addressing Exogenous Variability in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often fails under exogenous variability such as shifts in opponents or environment regimes that cannot be controlled by the team but alter the transition dynamics. We formalize this challenge as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), in which an episode-level exogenous regime, selected independently of the team, indexes the dynamics, and the global state is partitioned into components that are directly responsive to the current team action and components that are not directly action-responsive at the current step. This formulation exposes mediated influence: while team actions do not directly update the latter at the current step, they can shape their later evolution through induced changes in the former. Based on this, we propose LEICA, a CTDE-compatible algorithm that learns history-conditioned context representations for both components and shapes policy updates using agent-wise, influence-weighted counterfactual intrinsic rewards. Across SMAX benchmarks with opponent strategy shifts, LEICA consistently improves both training performance and generalization to unseen opponents' strategies over existing baselines, supporting the usefulness of influence-weighted shaping under exogenous train-test regime shifts.

translation.title: 应对合作式多智能体强化学习中的外生变异性
translation.abstract: 合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）在外生变异性下常常失败，例如对手或环境模式的变化——团队无法控制它们，但它们会改变转移动态。我们将这一挑战形式化为外生Dec-POMDP（ED-POMDP）：其中由团队外部独立选择的回合级外生模式为动态建立索引，且全局状态被划分为对当前团队动作直接响应的分量和在当前步不直接响应动作的分量。这一形式化揭示了中介影响：虽然团队动作在当前步不会直接更新后者，但可以通过对前者引起的改变来塑造后者的后续演化。基于此，我们提出LEICA——一种CTDE兼容的算法，为两个分量学习历史条件化的上下文表示，并利用逐智能体、影响加权的反事实内在奖励来塑造策略更新。在带有对手策略变化的SMAX基准上，LEICA在训练性能和对未见对手策略的泛化上均持续优于现有基线，验证了影响加权塑形在外生训练-测试模式变化下的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对合作MARL中外生环境/对手变化导致失败的问题，提出ED-POMDP形式化和LEICA算法，用影响加权的反事实内在奖励塑造策略以提升泛化。

papers.title: Can You Undo It? Reversibility Classes for AI Agent Actions
papers.abstract: Tool-using AI agents change files, databases, access rights and public information, yet permission to call a tool does not establish whether a mistake can be undone. We present Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults and an explicit prior-state capture contract. The pinned implementation and evidence-linked registry cover 536 tools across 20 MCP servers. All 738 rule-case checks conform to declared expectations, while native annotation mapping differs from draft registry labels for 118 of 481 comparable tools. One AI-assisted reviewer approves 148 ratings, 75 matching the registry; this is not independent agreement. On 2,158 recorded runs, the implemented session guard gates the associated action in all 29 attributable attack-positive runs, compared with 18 for a read/write proxy, while adding nine approval points across 1,209 benign runs. Controlled file, Git, SQLite and three-browser experiments show that recovery depends on captured state, later changes, editor storage and recovery route, and expose a Git merge-state exception. The evidence supports making recovery assumptions explicit and testable. It does not establish registry-wide accuracy, reduced production harm or general recovery reliability.

translation.title: 能否撤销？AI智能体动作的可逆性分类
translation.abstract: 使用工具的AI智能体会更改文件、数据库、访问权限和公开信息，但允许调用工具并不意味着错误可以撤销。我们提出Reversibility Classes——一套声明式的五级词汇，包含参数敏感的规则、保守默认值和显式的先验状态捕获契约。固定版本的实现及带证据链接的注册表覆盖20个MCP服务器上的536个工具。全部738条规则用例检查符合声明预期，而原生标注映射在481个可比工具中有118个与注册表草案标签不一致。一位AI辅助审核者批准了148项评级，其中75项与注册表一致，但这并非独立一致性。在2,158次记录的运行中，实现的会话防护在全部29次可归因的攻击阳性运行中拦截了相关动作，而读写代理只拦截了18次，同时在1,209次良性运行中新增了9个审批点。受控的文件、Git、SQLite和三浏览器实验表明，恢复取决于捕获的状态、后续更改、编辑器存储和恢复路径，并揭示了一个Git合并状态异常。证据支持将恢复假设显式化并可测试，但并未确立注册表的整体准确性、生产环境危害的降低或通用的恢复可靠性。
translation.brief: 针对工具调用型AI智能体动作错误难以判断能否撤销的问题，提出五级Reversibility Classes声明式分类体系及带会话防护的实现。

papers.title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
papers.abstract: Professional work involves under-specified assignments, where relevant information is spread across workplace applications and may conflict or change over time. To evaluate how well frontier agents can perform economically valuable work in such settings, we introduce ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms. As in real banking workflows, agents must search email, chat, calendars, notes, and files to identify requirements, gather information, reconcile conflicts/updates, and then build complex financial models. Tasks were developed by experienced bankers based on their real deal work and take them 15-30 hours to complete. Agent deliverables are evaluated with expert-authored rubrics (median: 124.5 criteria) covering financial rationale and results, spreadsheet construction, completeness, and formatting. Despite completing substantial portions of the requested work, current agents rarely produce correct deliverables. Across today's frontier models, the best ones (Claude Opus and Fable) pass fewer than 11% of tasks.

translation.title: ATLAS-Finance：在真实银行环境中对AI智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 专业工作中的任务往往规格不完整，相关信息分散在各种办公应用中，可能相互冲突或随时间变化。为评估前沿智能体在此类环境中完成有经济价值工作的能力，我们推出ATLAS-Finance——一个包含100项端到端投资银行任务、横跨13家模拟公司的基准。与真实银行工作流一样，智能体必须检索电子邮件、聊天、日历、笔记和文件，以识别需求、收集信息、调和冲突与更新，然后构建复杂的金融模型。任务由资深银行家根据其真实交易工作开发，人类需要15-30小时才能完成。智能体的交付成果用专家编写的评分细则（中位数：124.5项标准）评估，涵盖金融逻辑与结果、电子表格构建、完整性和格式。尽管完成了相当一部分要求的工作，当前智能体很少产出正确的交付成果。在当今的前沿模型中，最好的模型（Claude Opus和Fable）通过的任务不足11%。
translation.brief: 针对评估AI智能体在信息分散、规格不完整的专业环境中工作能力的需求，构建了包含100项真实投行任务的ATLAS-Finance基准，用专家评分细则评估交付成果。

papers.title: HyCoInfer: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models on Heterogeneous GPU-FPGA Architectures
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving relies predominantly on cloud GPUs, yet autoregressive decoding is memory-bound and often leaves their arithmetic units underutilized. Edge FPGAs offer attractive decoding efficiency, but are ill suited to sustaining a high-concurrency serving workload alone. This paper presents HyCoInfer, a heterogeneous cloud-edge serving system that assigns prefill to cloud GPUs and distributes decoding across cloud GPUs and edge FPGAs. The design addresses three barriers to practical offloading: capacity balancing across heterogeneous accelerators, the large KV cache crossing a constrained wide-area link, and the latency added by heterogeneous execution. HyCoInfer incorporates FPGA decode capacity into GPU prefill/decode role partitioning and places requests according to queue load, prompt length, and network state. It further combines layer-wise pipelined transfer, decoder-side precomputation, and bandwidth-adaptive KV cache compression based on residual vector quantization. We implement HyCoInfer using two NVIDIA V100 GPUs and an AMD Xilinx Alveo U280 and evaluate it over 100-1000 Mbps links. At 500 Mbps, HyCoInfer delivers up to 4.11 times the request goodput of cloud-only vLLM and reduces mean end-to-end latency by up to 61.1%. Across different network conditions and workloads, the system improves overall serving capacity, with the largest gains on communication-intensive tasks, and reduces per-request energy.

translation.title: HyCoInfer：异构GPU-FPGA架构上面向大语言模型的云边协同推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务主要依赖云端GPU，然而自回归解码受内存带宽限制，常导致GPU算术单元利用率不足。边缘FPGA具有出色的解码效率，但难以独立承担高并发服务工作负载。本文提出HyCoInfer，一种异构云边服务系统，将prefill分配给云端GPU，并将解码分布到云端GPU与边缘FPGA上。该设计解决了三个实际卸载的障碍：异构加速器间的容量均衡、跨越受限广域链路的大规模KV cache，以及异构执行引入的延迟。HyCoInfer将FPGA解码容量纳入GPU的prefill/decode角色划分，并根据队列负载、提示长度和网络状态放置请求。系统进一步结合逐层流水线传输、解码端预计算，以及基于残差向量量化的带宽自适应KV cache压缩。我们使用两块NVIDIA V100 GPU和一块AMD Xilinx Alveo U280实现HyCoInfer，并在100-1000 Mbps链路上进行评估。在500 Mbps下，HyCoInfer的请求有效吞吐量最高达到纯云端vLLM的4.11倍，平均端到端延迟最多降低61.1%。在不同网络条件和工作负载下，该系统提升了整体服务容量，在通信密集型任务上收益最大，并降低了每请求能耗。
translation.brief: 该论文解决云端GPU因自回归解码内存受限而利用率不足的问题，采用将prefill交给云端GPU、将解码卸载到边缘FPGA的云边异构协同推理系统，并结合KV cache压缩与流水线传输克服广域网链路限制。

papers.title: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.

translation.title: EvoDisco：演化式智能体记忆的策略发现
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体在记忆中积累经验，而记忆在交互过程中如何演化与其存储内容同等重要。近期方法在线更新记忆，但转换记忆的算子及选择算子的规则均在设计时被固定。我们提出EvoDisco，将智能体记忆演化形式化为演化式策略发现：智能体需自行发现应用哪个算子、何时应用以及如何实例化，而非在静态算子调度下改写记忆。可学习策略以当前记忆状态和近期任务历史为条件，选择并实例化四种语义算子之一——Abstract、Refine、Bridge和Reframe——分别用于压缩相关记忆、分解过载条目、连接弱关联经验以及重组检索到的推理链。策略通过双层适应度进行更新：内层信号以记忆复杂度正则化的检索质量提升为每次转换打分；外层信号在过去决策窗口上评估策略效能，综合历史算子效用遗憾、效用预测误差和选择多样性。在ALFWorld、WebShop和LifelongAgentBench（OS与DB）上采用单次在线加冻结迁移协议，EvoDisco优于MemP和MemRL等强记忆基线。最大增益出现在ALFWorld上（相比MemP在线+8.8/冻结迁移+12.9分；相比MemRL +16.4/+17.9分）。消融实验表明这些增益同时来自双层适应度与算子库。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体记忆更新算子及其选择规则被静态固定的问题，将记忆演化形式化为演化式策略发现，通过可学习策略从四种语义算子中选择并实例化，并以双层适应度信号在线更新。

papers.title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. Because these unresolved obligations are often logically interdependent, asking a mathematician to address every placeholder directly is inefficient. To minimize human effort, MathEye performs residual analysis over a proof dependence graph that captures symbol-level data flow in the angelic proof. By formulating obligation selection as a MaxSAT optimization problem, MathEye selects a minimal-cost set of essential obligations whose resolution suffices to complete the entire proof. MathEye presents these essential obligations to the mathematician in ordinary mathematical language and uses the mathematician's answers to automatically reconstruct the complete Lean proof. Experiments on 30 real-world benchmarks across analysis and algebra show that MathEye solves 93.3% of the problems while reducing the number of required user interactions by 55%.

translation.title: 从Sorry到QED：基于天使执行精炼LLM数学证明
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今能生成刻画许多数学论证高层结构的Lean证明脚本。然而这些脚本在复杂定理上频繁失败：单个缺失的侧条件或误用的引理可能使证明器提前中止，丢弃本可行的证明大纲。本文提出MathEye，一个通过符号推理与最小人工交互相结合，将有缺陷的LLM生成证明脚本转化为完全验证的Lean证明的框架。MathEye的核心是天使证明检查，一种乐观执行模型，用占位符替换失败的证明片段，同时保留论证的整体结构。这种乐观检查产生天使证明，精确隔离出LLM无法完成的证明义务。由于这些未解决义务往往在逻辑上相互依赖，让数学家直接处理每个占位符是低效的。为最小化人工投入，MathEye在刻画天使证明中符号级数据流的证明依赖图上执行残余分析。通过将义务选择形式化为MaxSAT优化问题，MathEye选择一组最小代价的关键义务，解决它们即可完成整个证明。MathEye以普通数学语言向数学家呈现这些关键义务，并利用其回答自动重构完整的Lean证明。在涵盖分析与代数的30个真实基准上的实验显示，MathEye解决了93.3%的问题，同时将所需用户交互次数减少55%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM生成的Lean证明脚本因个别失败片段而被整体丢弃的问题，采用天使执行（乐观占位符替换）结合证明依赖图上的MaxSAT残余分析，仅让人类解决最小关键义务集以自动重构完整证明。

papers.title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.

translation.title: RegimeCouncil：面向LLM智能体记忆冲突治理的成对证据路由
translation.abstract: 语言智能体依赖长期记忆在长程交互中实现个性化响应，但存储的事实会随世界变化悄然过时，智能体往往只有在依据过时记录行动后，才通过延迟反馈认识到使用记忆有害。在记忆库被更新之前，这种负反馈应传播多远：是仅在针对同一事实的未来查询中抑制记忆使用（局部策略），还是也跨越其他存储事实（全局策略）？现有记忆系统在设计时隐式固定了这两种共享范围之一。我们将隐藏有效性与延迟反馈下的在线范围选择形式化为记忆冲突治理，并证明任一固定策略单独都不充分。随后我们提出RegimeCouncil，一个轻量级成对证据路由器，同时保留两种范围作为顾问，并在线仲裁二者而无需重新训练LLM。利用带记忆作答与不带记忆作答（无记忆锚点）的已揭示比较，局部顾问仅跟踪所查询事实的最新结果，而全局顾问汇聚所有存储事实的近期结果。元治理者默认跟随局部顾问以避免跨事实干扰，仅当全局汇聚累积出严格为正的近期效用裕度时才切换到全局顾问，保证延迟反馈下的有限时间切换。在使用Qwen3-30B-A3B和GPT-4o、面对LongMemEval更新流以及TempLAMA和TAQA上的真实历史漂移时，RegimeCouncil在主要分歧情节及全部30个留出设置上比更优的固定范围策略高出5.2-7.3分，消融实验显示移除任一模块都会使准确率下降2-7分。
translation.brief: 该论文解决记忆系统负反馈传播范围（局部或全局）被设计时固定而无法适应隐藏有效性与延迟反馈的问题，提出保留双范围顾问的轻量级成对证据路由器，在线仲裁局部与全局策略且无需重训LLM。

papers.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
papers.abstract: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.

translation.title: TeleChat至Xing4：在国产芯片与框架上推进前沿智能体模型
translation.abstract: 我们提出Xing 4系列大语言模型，通过在Ascend上模型架构与训练基础设施的协同进展，扩展了TeleChat谱系。本报告描述了该系列背后的设计原则与系统工程，涵盖架构选择、大规模预训练以及推理与智能体后训练。我们研究了稀疏激活、注意力设计、模型深度与宽度以及投机解码如何在模型容量与计算、内存访问和执行开销之间取得平衡。我们的预训练基础设施基于MindSpore HyperParallel，结合拓扑感知混合分片、高效的分布式优化器执行，以及长序列工作负载与激活内存的协同管理。CPU亲和性与核心隔离进一步减少了主机调度干扰。这些机制共同支持在8,192张Ascend 910C卡上预训练285B参数模型，为架构与系统研究提供了具体场景。在后训练方面，我们引入TeleGym，一个统一的智能体执行平台，将执行、评估与轨迹构建连接到策略优化。分离式异步执行、有界过采样和部分rollout在保持跨策略更新轨迹连续性的同时，适应异构任务时长。这些进展共同为Xing 4在各模型规模及日益严苛的推理与智能体工作负载上的持续发展，奠定了面向Ascend的训练基础。
translation.brief: 该论文解决在国产Ascend芯片上训练前沿推理与智能体大模型的问题，通过架构与训练系统的协同设计（稀疏激活、混合分片、TeleGym异步执行平台等）构建面向Ascend的训练基础。

papers.title: Big Brains, Tiny Board: Pupavision, an Agentic Physical AI Instrument for Monitoring Drosophila Pupariation and Lifecycle Transitions
papers.abstract: Many biology experiments are limited by the availability and ease of use of instruments that monitor and record them. For example, the timing of pupariation in the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, a widely used model organism, can provide biologically relevant information about growth regulation and is often recorded manually. Here, we present Pupavision, a small physical AI instrument built from a single-board Linux computer and a day/night camera for roughly 45 to 75 US dollars in parts. The key idea is that a frontier coding agent runs its agentic harness directly on the tiny board. The model thinks in the cloud, but the agent works on the device. The agent assists image capture, writes code to repair errors, and checks the experiment every day to keep raw data capture reliable. If recording stops, the researcher gets a ping on their mobile phone. A simple deterministic capture service records one image every ten minutes and never depends on the agent. We report a 26-day pilot in a fly incubator (about 3,580 frames), including eleven days in which the agent was logged out and capture continued, and a 51-hour outage whose cause led to the layered design. A researcher-in-the-loop workflow then produces per-vial pupariation curves by tracing selected pupae backward in time from a late reference frame. Future work will validate the assay for lifecycle tracking accuracy against expert-labeled data and expand real-time computer vision analysis. Pupavision offers a blueprint for do-it-yourself agentic instruments that put frontier intelligence on a tiny board, with deterministic code underneath. We present this as an early case study from a pilot lab deployment and contribute lessons learned toward a future where scientific domain experts are empowered by DIY agentic hardware.

translation.title: 大脑很大，板子很小：Pupavision——一种用于监测果蝇化蛹及生命周期转变的智能体化物理AI仪器
translation.abstract: 许多生物学实验受限于监测和记录实验的仪器的可用性与易用性。例如，果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster，一种广泛使用的模式生物）的化蛹时期能提供关于生长调控的生物学信息，但目前常需人工记录。本文提出 Pupavision，一种由单板 Linux 计算机和日夜摄像头组成的小型物理 AI 仪器，零件成本约 45 至 75 美元。其核心思想是让前沿编码智能体的 agentic harness 直接运行在微型板卡上：模型在云端思考，智能体在设备上工作。该智能体协助图像采集、编写代码修复错误，并每天检查实验以保证原始数据采集的可靠性；一旦录制停止，研究者会在手机上收到提醒。一个简单的确定性采集服务每十分钟记录一张图像，且从不依赖智能体。我们报告了在养蝇培养箱中进行的一项为期 26 天的试点实验（约 3,580 帧），其中包括智能体登出后采集仍持续运行的 11 天，以及一次 51 小时的故障（其成因促成了这种分层设计）。随后通过研究者在环（researcher-in-the-loop）的工作流程，从后期参考帧出发对选定的蛹进行时间回溯，生成每个培养管的化蛹曲线。未来工作将对照专家标注数据验证该 assay 在生命周期跟踪精度方面的表现，并扩展实时计算机视觉分析。Pupavision 为“自己动手（DIY）”的智能体化仪器提供了蓝图：把前沿智能装进微型板卡，底下由确定性代码支撑。我们将其作为实验室试点部署的早期案例研究呈现，并贡献经验教训，以期助力一个科学领域专家被 DIY 智能体硬件赋能的未来。
translation.brief: 解决果蝇化蛹等生物实验缺乏低成本、可靠自动监测仪器的问题，核心方法是在约几十美元的单板计算机上直接运行云端前沿编码智能体的 harness，配合确定性图像采集服务实现自动监测与故障自修复。

papers.title: When does deep reinforcement learning pay off in HVAC supervisory control? Four small Modelica case studies trained directly on FMUs
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is often proposed for the supervisory control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. The reported gains are, however, difficult to interpret, because the baselines are often weak and the attainable optimum is seldom known. This paper examines four small, reproducible case studies based on an office building in Brisbane, Australia: pre-cooling under a time-of-use tariff; chiller staging with condenser water reset; chilled water supply temperature reset with a wet cooling coil; and chilled water storage under time-of-use prices and a demand charge. The plants were modelled with the Modelica Buildings library, and in three of the cases a soft actor-critic agent was trained directly on the exported functional mock-up unit (FMU). Each agent was compared with tuned rule-based controllers and, where practicable, with a near-optimal reference from hourly exhaustive search or dynamic programming with perfect foresight. In the two cases without storage the agent reached the near-optimal reference, but the margin above a well-chosen rule was small: 1.3% for condenser water reset and 0.18% for chilled water reset. In the latter case two common reset rules consumed more energy than a fixed set point. With a chilled water storage tank the margin was considerably larger. The agent outperformed both rules (-7.8%, compared with -3.9% and -6.3%) and adopted midday charging during the solar off-peak period, yet it obtained only about 45% of the saving achieved by the perfect-foresight schedule and did little to limit the demand peak. In the pre-cooling case a hand-tuned rule remained superior (-12.0% compared with -5.6%). These results suggest that studies of DRL for HVAC control should state the margin between the best rule and a near-optimal reference. Some practical difficulties encountered in training on co-simulation FMUs are also reported.

translation.title: 深度强化学习何时在 HVAC 监督控制中值得使用？四个直接在 FMU 上训练的小型 Modelica 案例研究
translation.abstract: 深度强化学习（DRL）常被提议用于供暖、通风与空调（HVAC）系统的监督控制。然而其报告的收益难以解读，原因在于基线往往较弱，且可达到的最优值很少为人所知。本文考察了基于澳大利亚布里斯班一栋办公楼建模的四个小型、可复现的案例研究：分时电价下的预冷；带冷凝器水温重置的冷水机组分级；带湿冷却盘管的冷冻水供水温度重置；以及分时电价与需量电费下的冷冻水蓄冷。设备用 Modelica Buildings library 建模，其中三个案例的 soft actor-critic 智能体直接在导出的 functional mock-up unit（FMU）上训练。每个智能体都与调优过的基于规则的控制器比较，并在可行的情况下与通过逐小时穷举搜索或具有完美预见能力的动态规划得到的近优参考进行比较。在两个不含蓄冷的案例中，智能体达到了近优参考，但相对精心选择的规则的优势很小：冷凝器水温重置为 1.3%，冷冻水温度重置为 0.18%。在后一案例中，两种常见的重置规则反而比固定设定点消耗更多能量。配备冷冻水蓄冷罐时，优势显著增大：智能体优于两种规则（-7.8%，对比 -3.9% 与 -6.3%），并会在太阳辐射低谷时段选择中午蓄冷，但它只获得完美预见调度所省能量的约 45%，且对需量峰值的限制作用甚微。在预冷案例中，手工调优的规则仍占优（-12.0% 对比 -5.6%）。这些结果表明，HVAC 控制的 DRL 研究应说明最优规则与近优参考之间的差距。文中还报告了在协同仿真 FMU 上训练时遇到的一些实际困难。
translation.brief: 解决 HVAC 监督控制中 DRL 收益难以与强基线和近优参考对比评估的问题，核心方法是用 Modelica/FMU 对澳大利亚一栋办公楼建模并直接在其上训练 soft actor-critic 智能体，与调优规则控制器和近优参考进行对比。

papers.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
papers.abstract: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. At temperature 2, coding agents running top-p, top-k or Top-H resolve 0 of 100 GitHub issues, while the same agents running top-nsigma resolve 46 to 62 and win every issue the two samplers disagree on, on three Qwen3.5 models. Over all benchmarks top-nsigma keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%. Counting how many tokens each sampler lets through explains why. In one Llama-3.1-8B story, going from temperature 1 to 2 grows top-p's pool from 4 tokens to 51,845 while top-nsigma stays at 3. Across 133 combinations of sampler setting and temperature, the typical pool size predicts judged quality (Spearman correlation of -0.77), and when we pick the pool at temperature 1 and only apply temperature afterwards, Top-H, min-p and p-less stop collapsing. At the default temperature of 1 most samplers perform about the same, We release all code and data to the public.

translation.title: 长上下文生成是一个采样问题（当你把温度调高时）
translation.abstract: 人们普遍观察到，开放权重语言模型生成得越长，质量越差。通常的解决办法是更多训练。而在高温下，采样器——即从模型概率分布中选出下一个 token 的规则——决定了长程和智能体化生成是能存活还是繁荣。我们在十个既有基准以及延伸至一百万 token 的“大海捞针”检索任务上测试了 29 个参数量从 1B 到 122B 的开放权重模型，涵盖 SWE-bench Verified 编码智能体、长思维链推理、长篇写作、长结构化输出与长上下文阅读。随着温度升高，能把候选 token 池保持在小而稳定的采样器不会损失精度；而放行低概率 token 的采样器则会崩溃。在温度为 2 时，在三个 Qwen3.5 模型上，运行 top-p、top-k 或 Top-H 的编码智能体在 100 个 GitHub issue 中解决 0 个，而运行 top-nsigma 的同一智能体可解决 46 到 62 个，并在两种采样器意见不一致的所有 issue 上获胜。在所有基准上，top-nsigma 保持其温度 1 时得分的中位数达 100%，而 top-p 仅保持 26%。统计每个采样器放行多少 token 可以解释原因：在一个 Llama-3.1-8B 的故事生成中，温度从 1 升到 2 时，top-p 的池从 4 个 token 增长到 51,845 个，而 top-nsigma 保持在 3 个。在 133 种采样器设置与温度的组合中，典型池大小与评判质量相关（Spearman 相关系数为 -0.77）；当我们在温度 1 时确定池、之后才施加温度时，Top-H、min-p 和 p-less 便不再崩溃。在默认温度 1 下，大多数采样器表现大致相同。我们向公众开放了全部代码与数据。
translation.brief: 解决高温下长程生成崩溃的问题，核心方法是分析并控制采样器候选 token 池的大小，提出保持池小而稳定的 top-nsigma 采样器，并证明池大小是长上下文质量崩溃的关键因素。

papers.title: Cluster-Guided Decoding with Trust-Region Constraints for Personalized Recommendation
papers.abstract: Most recommenders score each item in the catalog separately, and do not explicitly model which semantic region of the catalog a recommendation belongs to. Models expressive enough to offer that control are often too slow to run over a full catalog for online inference. In this paper, we present Cluster-Guided Generative Reconstruction (CG2R), which learns a hierarchy of semantic clusters and uses a cluster-level prior to steer item ranking for personalized recommendations. Unlike existing systems that only use clusters to pre-select candidates, CG2R adds the cluster prior directly to the item scoring rule, so that the learned cluster structure shapes the ranking itself. Because the prior is assembled from cluster centroids rather than per-item statistics, it remains defined even for cold-start users when no history is available. Across the three benchmark datasets evaluated, CG2R outperforms classical, neural, and LLM-based baselines in terms of Recall and nDCG, with its performance gains widening as the catalog grows sparser. In addition, CG2R serves recommendations in milliseconds, suggesting potential as low-latency first-stage retrieval.

translation.title: 面向个性化推荐的带信赖域约束的聚类引导解码
translation.abstract: 大多数推荐系统对目录中的每个物品分别打分，并不显式建模某次推荐属于目录中的哪个语义区域。表达能力足以提供这种控制的模型往往因需对全目录进行在线推理而速度过慢。本文提出 Cluster-Guided Generative Reconstruction（CG2R），它学习一个语义聚类的层级结构，并使用聚类级先验来引导物品排序，从而实现个性化推荐。与仅用聚类预选候选的现有系统不同，CG2R 把聚类先验直接加入物品打分规则中，使学习到的聚类结构本身塑造排序结果。由于先验由聚类质心而非逐物品统计量构成，即使对没有任何历史记录的冷启动用户，该先验依然有定义。在所评估的三个基准数据集上，CG2R 在 Recall 和 nDCG 上优于经典、神经网络和基于 LLM 的基线，且目录越稀疏，其性能优势越大。此外，CG2R 能在毫秒级完成推荐服务，显示出作为低延迟第一阶段检索的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决推荐系统不建模目录语义区域且在线全目录推理过慢的问题，核心方法是学习语义聚类层级并用聚类级先验直接引导物品打分排序（CG2R），兼顾冷启动与毫秒级低延迟。

papers.title: HandRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Hand Pose Estimation
papers.abstract: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. On HOT3D, HandRSI's MPJPE-p is 16% lower than that of ACE-Ego-Hand fine-tuned on the same ground truth. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.

translation.title: HandRSI：面向手部姿态估计的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 以自我为中心（egocentric）的 3D 手部姿态估计器仍会在图像边缘丢失手部、错放被遮挡的手，并产生抖动。这类失败通常靠手写的推理端细化和微调来修复，而这两种相互依赖的步骤往往是分别调优的。我们提出 HandRSI，一个针对手部姿态系统的递归自我改进框架，该系统由一个视频估计器及其可执行的推理 harness 构成。在每一轮中，编码智能体细化 harness，只有当修改在留出数据上提升全部十个基准指标的综合得分且不显著退化其中任何一项时，修改才被接受。被接受的 harness 随后通过选择性蒸馏引导估计器：在无真值标签的帧上监督手部存在性和时间一致性，而真值监督姿态。由于更新后的估计器可能改变哪些细化仍然有用，harness 会在其上重新验证。从公开发布的 ACE-Ego-Hand 模型出发，五轮改进使 HOT3D 上的 MPJPE-p 降低 35%，ARCTIC 上降低 11%，并大约将抖动减半。在 HOT3D 上，HandRSI 的 MPJPE-p 比用相同真值微调的 ACE-Ego-Hand 低 16%。在统一协议下，它在两个基准的全部十个指标上均优于九个重新运行的已发表方法。通过在精度-速度前沿上进行超体积（hypervolume）选择，得到运行速度为 20.7 至 41.1 FPS 的 Lite、Medium 和 Heavy 三种系统。本报告给出完整方法、每一轮的每个阶段及完整协议。代码、评估器、harness 和权重均已公开。
translation.brief: 解决自我中心 3D 手部姿态估计的边缘漏检、遮挡误放和抖动问题，核心方法是让编码智能体递归改进推理 harness 并结合选择性蒸馏反复微调估计器，形成估计器与 harness 的联合自我改进循环。

papers.title: AI Agents Executing an RMS and EMT Ride-Through Workflow on a 2,000-Bus Synthetic Texas Grid: A Case Study with Open-Source Tools
papers.abstract: This paper reports a case study of engineer-supervised AI agents executing a predefined RMS and EMT ride-through workflow on the 2,000-bus ACTIVSg2000 synthetic Texas grid with open-source tools. The test case is a 133 MW battery with a co-located 130 MW data-center load, assessed against ride-through criteria fixed before simulation and for loss of synchronism elsewhere in the grid. One agent ran 44 RMS cases and 15 without-project comparisons in ANDES; the other ran a 220-row EMT intake bench and an 84-row system study in DPsim and ParaEMT on a Kron-reduced area. Across the 44 RMS cases, 127 criterion cells fail, including loss of synchronism in all 44. Two findings concern the project plant. The battery keeps absorbing reactive power during sags on the light-load schedule (B3, as low as -19.8 Mvar on S4 T1), and the data-center load returns only at 5.00-5.56 s after long bolted faults (L3), which misses the ERCOT load-return requirement. In 13 of the 15 comparisons, which the authors selected after slips or speed-gate stops, the same machines slip without the project; the other 29 runs have no without-project comparison. RMS and EMT values differ in network, plant model, controls, operating point, and base, and so they are reported as separate, unaligned observations. The paper reports the errors the authors identified in the agent logs, 63 author messages, and 3.8 days from agent start to the integrated study report. The agents executed and documented the predefined ride-through and stability workflow, which covers one part of an interconnection study.

translation.title: AI智能体在2000节点合成德州电网上执行RMS与EMT穿越工作流：基于开源工具的案例研究
translation.abstract: 本文报告了一个由工程师监督的AI智能体案例研究，智能体在2000节点的ACTIVSg2000合成德州电网上，使用开源工具执行预定义的RMS与EMT穿越工作流。测试对象为一个133 MW电池配同址130 MW数据中心负荷，评估依据在仿真前固定的穿越判据以及电网其他地方的失步情况。一个智能体在ANDES中运行了44个RMS工况和15个无项目对照；另一个在DPsim和ParaEMT中对一个Kron化简区域运行了220行的EMT接入台架测试和84行的系统研究。在44个RMS工况中，共有127个判据项不合格，包括全部44个工况均出现失步。关于项目电厂有两个发现：轻载计划（B3）下电池在电压暂降期间持续吸收无功（S4 T1上低至-19.8 Mvar），而数据中心负荷在长持续金属性故障（L3）后仅在5.00-5.56 s才恢复，不满足ERCOT的负荷恢复要求。在作者于失步或速度门限中止后选出的15个对照中的13个里，无项目时同样机组也发生失步；其余29次运行没有无项目对照。RMS与EMT数值在电网、电厂模型、控制器、运行点和基准上均不同，因此作为互不对齐的独立观测分别报告。论文报告了作者在智能体日志中发现的错误、63条作者消息以及从智能体启动到综合研究报告的3.8天时间。智能体执行并记录了预定义的穿越与稳定工作流，该工作流覆盖了互联研究的一部分。
translation.brief: 研究让工程师监督的AI智能体用开源工具在2000节点合成德州电网上执行预定义的RMS与EMT穿越工作流，评估电池与数据中心负荷的穿越表现。

papers.title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.

translation.title: 并非所有证据都可采信：面向工具增强医疗智能体的证据治理
translation.abstract: 工具增强的医疗智能体将工具返回的内容一律当作证据。我们表明这种默认做法代价高昂：医疗工具会静默失效，而冻结的推理器无法忽略进入其上下文的内容，因此许多本可正确回答的案例在加入工具输出后被翻转为错误。我们将此称为证据劫持。$\mathcal{V}$-information解释了这一现象：推理器失去了忽略的选项，工具输出可能携带负的可用信息，而把决定保留什么移出推理器即可恢复该选项。该理论还表明，过滤收益的一部分仅来自让推理器看到更少，只有基于内容的选择才能让它看得更好。基于此，我们将工具增强推理重构为证据治理，把判定什么算作证据与回答的推理器分离，并提出上下文无关的证据治理（CIEG），这是首个在获取之后对每条工具输出能否作为证据进行裁定的医疗智能体框架。每条工具输出被写成一张可与原始输入核对的卡片；一个只看到输入与卡片的独立检查器决定哪些卡片成为证据；推理器仅根据被采纳的卡片作答，全程无需训练。在医疗问答、眼底青光眼筛查和胸片肺炎分类任务上，它在同等规模模型中取得最高准确率，并以更低成本显著优于基于同一骨干的最先进工具使用智能体和多智能体系统。
translation.brief: 针对工具输出静默失效导致推理器被误导的问题，提出证据治理框架CIEG，由独立检查器按内容裁定每条工具输出能否进入上下文作为证据。

papers.title: Readie: Low-Latency Code Sandboxes for AI Agents
papers.abstract: From quantitative research to personal assistance, AI agents act by iteratively generating and executing code. To decouple the agent harness from code execution, many agents offload execution to dedicated systems called code sandboxes. However, existing code sandboxes suffer from slow startup. Whether they rely on custom snapshots or a single fat image, the root cause is the same: it is hard to build a compact, pre-warmed snapshot that can be shared across diverse agent-generated code while covering nearly all the artifacts (e.g., packages, datasets) it requires. In this work, we propose learned startup snapshots for low-latency code sandboxes. Our insight is that while it is hard for a single snapshot to be both compact and cover most workloads, a set of snapshots can achieve both. Each snapshot is small, initializes quickly, and covers a fraction of agent-generated code; together, the set covers most of it. We learn this set from a large training workload by formulating snapshot construction as an optimization problem and solving it with an approximation algorithm. Planned on 15K public and LLM-synthesized scripts, our system, Readie, reduces startup latency by 3-22$\times$ and end-to-end runtime by 1.3-3.3$\times$ compared to existing approaches at the same storage budget.

translation.title: Readie：面向AI智能体的低延迟代码沙箱
translation.abstract: 从量化研究到个人助理，AI智能体通过迭代生成并执行代码来行动。为将智能体框架与代码执行解耦，许多智能体将执行卸载到称为代码沙箱的专用系统。然而，现有代码沙箱存在启动缓慢的问题。无论依赖自定义快照还是单一胖镜像，根本原因相同：难以构建一个紧凑的、预热的、能被多样化的智能体生成代码共享并覆盖其所需的几乎所有构件（如软件包、数据集）的快照。在本工作中，我们提出学习式启动快照来实现低延迟代码沙箱。我们的洞察是：虽然单一快照难以既紧凑又覆盖大多数工作负载，但一组快照可以两者兼得。每个快照很小、初始化快、覆盖一部分智能体生成代码；合在一起则覆盖大部分。我们通过将快照构建形式化为优化问题并用近似算法求解，从大规模训练工作负载中学习该集合。基于15K个公开及LLM合成脚本进行规划，在相同存储预算下，我们的系统Readie相比现有方法将启动延迟降低3-22倍，端到端运行时间降低1.3-3.3倍。
translation.brief: 针对代码沙箱启动慢的问题，提出将快照集合构建形式化为优化问题并用近似算法求解，用多个小而专的预热快照协同覆盖多样化代码以实现低延迟。

papers.title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.

translation.title: 唯一的优势是训练时记住的：LLM交易智能体在财报与坏消息时刻的表现
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体常在新闻上测试，但新闻在几分钟内就反映到股价中，且按发布时间回放标题的基准发现交易新闻无法获得超额收益。那么盈利机会只可能存在于两处：在日期已知的新闻之前，如财报公告；以及在坏消息之后，如果市场跌过了头。然而，现有LLM与财报研究读取的是公告发布时或之后公布的文件，而反转研究按月度组合排序，因此两者都无法说明智能体在扣除成本后能否交易这些时刻。本文在一个无前视偏差的基准上测试LLM智能体在这两个时刻的表现：598次财报公告之前和409次美国大盘股坏消息暴跌之后。所有输入都在决策收盘时截断，分阶段智能体与单次调用、简单规则和逻辑回归进行比较，且每个决策都在有和无股票名称两种条件下做出。来自四家厂商的五个模型中，没有任何智能体跑赢简单下注。财报前，智能体基本都在买入，赚到的与每次公告前无脑买入所赚相当；坏消息后，一个基于Gemini的智能体几乎把每次下跌都称为过度反应，而没有任何智能体挑中的低点比全部买入更好。唯一的收益来自模型在训练中记住的内容。仅凭代码和日期，一个基于GPT的模型在其训练截止前对59.2%的公告方向判断正确，截止后为53.3%。因此，智能体构建者应将事件智能体与简单下注比较，并在训练截止后进行盲测。
translation.brief: 研究LLM交易智能体能否在财报公告前和坏消息暴跌后获得超额收益，方法是在无前视偏差的基准上将其与简单规则、统计基线及盲测（训练截止后、隐去股票名）对比。

papers.title: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
papers.abstract: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. To test the latter, we introduce five adversarial probes (Rule Application +-, Pattern Induction Style / Procedural, Dynamic Multiturn) judged at generation time by a cross vendor verification chain, where each query can only be solved by applying a remembered rule or pattern it never mentions. Across 5 probes x 20 scenarios, no architecture wins universally: atomic fact extractors (LangMem) win rule application, while BRIDGE's block-summary memory wins pattern induction. This result holds across four domains, three graders, and three reader families. Each design fails where the other wins, for reasons a recall benchmark cannot see: atomic-fact extractors discard the form a demonstrated pattern takes, while block-summary memory retrieves the rule but the reader does not act on it, a gap that presenting the rule more prominently largely closes. What separates memory designs is not what they retrieve but what they enable an agent to do, and that is what agentic memory should be evaluated on.

translation.title: 披着风衣的RAG：极简记忆何时足以支撑智能体系统，何时不够
translation.abstract: 智能体记忆研究在检索增强生成之上累积了抽取、取代、反思和图合成等技术。然而我们发现，在所测试的记忆基准中，这些原语几乎没有一个物有所值：我们用BRIDGE证明了这一点——一个刻意极简的RAG记忆，采用链式观察笔记、BM25与余弦相似度混合检索和按时间顺序渲染——在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上以bootstrap置信区间达到与先前SOTA持平，在相同阅读器的条件下在EverMemBench上超出最佳记忆基线5.7-6.3分。它每次查询约消耗5-7K阅读器提示词token，每次摄入或查询只需一次LLM调用。我们认为这种持平本身就是结论：标准基准衡量的是记忆检索到了什么，而不是记忆在智能体行动时使能了什么。为检验后者，我们引入五个对抗性探针（规则应用+-、模式归纳风格/程序性、动态多轮），由跨厂商验证链在生成时评判，每个查询只能通过应用一条记忆中未被提及的规则或模式来求解。在5个探针×20个场景上，没有任何架构全面胜出：原子事实抽取器（LangMem）在规则应用上获胜，而BRIDGE的块摘要记忆在模式归纳上获胜。该结果在四个领域、三个评分器和三个阅读器家族上均成立。每种设计在对方获胜之处失败，其原因召回型基准无法察觉：原子事实抽取器丢弃了示例模式所呈现的形式，而块摘要记忆检索到了规则但阅读器未据此行动，通过更突出地呈现规则可基本弥合这一差距。区分记忆设计的不是它们检索到什么，而是它们使智能体能做什么，这才是智能体记忆应当被评估的维度。
translation.brief: 研究发现极简RAG记忆（BRIDGE）在标准记忆基准上即可与SOTA持平，为此引入五个需要应用记忆规则/模式的对抗探针，并设计跨厂商验证链来评判记忆对智能体行动的真正使能作用。

papers.title: Emergence and Collapse of Leader-Follower Flocks through Phantom Targets: Surprise Nullification in Bayesian and Inverse Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract: In Bayesian and inverse Bayesian (BIB) inference, a large prediction error can trigger surprise nullification, which expands belief and likelihood variances by a common factor, leaving the updated variance ratio the same as in standard Bayesian updating. This can increase belief uncertainty while keeping the learning rate low. In the simulations, three agents used BIB inference to predict one another's positions and moved toward those predictions, repeatedly forming leader-follower flocks that subsequently collapsed despite having no alignment rules or designated leaders. Three leadership criteria (front position, heading stability, and flock initiation) identified the same agent in 89% of eligible flocks, with different agents serving as leaders across flocks. Flocks formed when an agent nearly stopped incorporating another's observations (link cut) and moved straight toward a predicted position detached from reality (phantom target), thereby attracting followers. Link cuts arose when two successive resets assigned a very small and then an ordinary likelihood variance, sharply increasing the likelihood-to-belief variance ratio. Flocks collapsed upon link recovery or when returning phantom targets balanced the leader's forward and backward attractions. Without nullification, cuts persisted throughout the analysis period; expanding only belief variance caused recovery within a few steps. Expanding likelihood variance as well allowed cuts to persist while belief uncertainty grew, enabling later resets and recovery. Thus, nullification preserves relative precision, allowing cuts and flocks to persist, while reducing absolute precision to enable recovery and collapse, reconciling these seemingly opposing processes through a single operation. These results suggest that, in this model, individually inaccurate predictions can give rise to collective order.

translation.title: 通过幻影目标实现领导者-追随者群体的涌现与崩塌：贝叶斯与逆贝叶斯推断中的惊讶消解
translation.abstract: 在贝叶斯与逆贝叶斯（BIB）推断中，较大的预测误差会触发惊讶消解，即以共同因子扩大信念与似然方差，使更新后的方差比与标准贝叶斯更新保持一致。这可以在保持学习率较低的同时增加信念不确定性。仿真中，三个智能体使用BIB推断预测彼此的位置并朝这些预测移动，在没有任何对齐规则或指定领导者的情况下反复形成随后崩塌的领导者-追随者群体。三种领导力标准（前方位置、航向稳定性和群体发起）在89%的合格群体中识别出同一智能体，且不同群体中的领导者不同。当一个智能体几乎停止吸收另一个智能体的观测（链路切断）并径直朝一个脱离现实的预测位置（幻影目标）移动从而吸引追随者时，群体形成。当连续两次重置分别赋予极小然后普通的似然方差，急剧提高似然-信念方差比时，链路切断产生。群体在链路恢复时或返回的幻影目标平衡了领导者前后吸引力时崩塌。若无惊讶消解，切断在整个分析期间持续存在；仅扩大信念方差会导致几步内恢复。同时扩大似然方差则允许切断在信念不确定性增长时持续存在，从而支持后续的重置和恢复。因此，惊讶消解保持了相对精度，使切断和群体得以持续，同时降低绝对精度以实现恢复和崩塌，通过单一操作调和了这些看似对立的过程。这些结果表明，在该模型中，个体上不准确的预测可以产生集体秩序。
translation.brief: 研究无对齐规则下领导者-追随者群体如何涌现与崩塌的问题，核心方法是让智能体采用带惊讶消解机制的贝叶斯-逆贝叶斯推断相互预测位置并朝预测移动。

papers.title: EGS: A Complementary Safety Framework for Educational LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong potential for personalized education, but adolescent-facing deployment raises risks of toxic, biased, misleading, or developmentally inappropriate content. We argue that educational safety should move beyond binary refusal: student queries are often ambiguous or curiosity-driven, requiring contextual guidance rather than simple blocking. We introduce the Educational Guardrail System (EGS), a lightweight, model-agnostic runtime framework that complements intrinsic alignment through query moderation, scenario-aware pedagogical guidance, and response moderation. EGS triages inputs by risk level, redirects gray-zone queries with category-specific educational interventions, and audits outputs before delivery. Experiments across general and education-specific benchmarks show that EGS improves moderation performance, refusal quality, and jailbreak robustness across diverse LLMs. These findings suggest that defense-in-depth guardrails can strengthen safety while preserving the pedagogical utility required in educational LLMs. Our code and model weights will be publicly available to support community adoption.

translation.title: EGS：面向教育类LLM的补充性安全框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在个性化教育方面具有强大潜力，但面向青少年的部署会带来有害、偏见、误导或发展不适宜内容的风险。我们认为教育安全应超越二元拒绝：学生提问往往含糊或出于好奇，需要情境化引导而非简单拦截。我们提出教育护栏系统（EGS），这是一个轻量、模型无关的运行时框架，通过查询审核、场景感知的教学引导和响应审核来补充内在对齐。EGS按风险级别对输入进行分流，用类别特定的教育干预重定向灰区查询，并在交付前审计输出。在通用和教育特定基准上的实验表明，EGS在不同LLM上提升了审核性能、拒绝质量和越狱鲁棒性。这些发现表明，纵深防御式护栏能在保持教育类LLM所需教学实用性的同时增强安全性。我们的代码和模型权重将公开，以支持社区采用。
translation.brief: 解决面向青少年的教育LLM中不当内容风险问题，核心方法是构建一个运行时护栏系统，通过查询分流、情境化教学引导和响应审计来补充模型内在对齐。

papers.title: TAILROLL: Tail-Aware Rollout Acceleration for RL-Based LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by rollout: heavy-tailed responses leave engines idle as each step waits for the longest response. Asynchronous training masks, but does not eliminate, idle time. We distinguish imbalance waste (uneven placement and decode contention) from straggler waste (waiting for the longest response). Tail length, not average load, often sets the step bound. We propose TAILROLL, an online scheduler integrated into an open-source RL framework. It combines stateless in-flight migration and sufficiency-gated termination. Migration moves decoding requests between engines at chunk boundaries and resumes them with one re-prefill under a freeness-based, cost-aware tail-balancing policy. Termination stops a response when its GRPO group has enough completed samples for advantage estimation, masking its partial output from the training loss. Across ten configurations, TAILROLL reduces rollout bubble ratio by 21% to 74% and cross-engine KV-cache imbalance by 44% to 79%. In end-to-end RL training, it cuts rollout time by 24% to 34%, full step time by 21% to 22% on long-CoT RL, and p95 request latency by 28% to 37%, while raising generation throughput by up to 33% with comparable or higher final reward.

translation.title: TAILROLL：面向RL-based LLM后训练的尾部感知rollout加速
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的RL后训练受rollout瓶颈制约：长尾响应使引擎空闲，因为每一步都需等待最长响应。异步训练能掩盖但不能消除空闲时间。我们区分失衡浪费（放置不均和解码争用）与掉队者浪费（等待最长响应）。决定步骤时长的往往是尾部长度而非平均负载。我们提出TAILROLL，一个集成到开源RL框架中的在线调度器。它结合了无状态的在途迁移和充分性门控终止。迁移在chunk边界将解码中的请求在引擎间移动，并通过一次重新预填充恢复，采用基于空闲度、成本感知的尾部均衡策略。终止在GRPO组已有足够完成样本用于优势估计时停止某响应，并将其部分输出从训练损失中屏蔽。在十种配置中，TAILROLL将rollout气泡比降低21%至74%，跨引擎KV-cache不平衡降低44%至79%。在端到端RL训练中，它将rollout时间减少24%至34%，长CoT RL上完整步骤时间减少21%至22%，p95请求延迟降低28%至37%，同时将生成吞吐量提升至多33%，最终奖励相当或更高。
translation.brief: 解决RL后训练中长尾响应导致的rollout空闲浪费问题，核心方法是在线调度器结合无状态请求迁移和充分性门控提前终止。

papers.title: Sample-efficient Personalization of Large Language Model Alignment with Multidimensional User Preference Data
papers.abstract: Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. Although they are effective, these methods quantify uncertainty from the perspective of the LLM, which may differ from the uncertainty perceived by the user: a pair can appear highly uncertain to the LLM even when past comparisons from the user already imply a clear ordering. In this paper, we propose multidimensional preference-guided online direct preference optimization (MPG-DPO), which leverages low-cost multidimensional evaluations from automated verifiers on the user historical comparisons to construct a personalized preference cone guiding response selection for online preference alignment. Specifically, it first discards responses that are confidently dominated under the estimated user preference, then selects two responses that are competitive under the retained preference cone yet exhibit the strongest unresolved disagreement. Theoretical analysis shows that, with high probability, the fraction of queries spent on cone-dominated responses vanishes as learning progresses. Experiments across multiple LLM families show that MPG-DPO outperforms strong contenders under matched query budgets.

translation.title: 基于多维用户偏好数据的大语言模型对齐样本高效个性化
translation.abstract: 偏好对齐已成为使大语言模型（LLM）与人类价值观和期望行为对齐的核心工具，其在线变体通过反复生成并用人类反馈标注新响应，可以进一步提升静态数据所不及的能力。但昂贵、耗时的标注限制了其可扩展性，使样本效率至关重要，而现有方法通常通过扩大响应空间的覆盖范围或选择不确定性最高的对比对来提升样本效率。这些方法虽然有效，但从LLM的视角量化不确定性，这与用户感知的不确定性可能不同：某个对比对在LLM看来可能高度不确定，即使用户过去的对比已经隐含了明确的排序。本文提出多维偏好引导的在线直接偏好优化（MPG-DPO），利用自动验证器对用户历史对比的低成本多维评估来构建个性化偏好锥，指导在线偏好对齐中的响应选择。具体而言，它首先丢弃在估计的用户偏好下被明确支配的响应，然后选择两个在保留偏好锥下具有竞争力但呈现最强未决分歧的响应。理论分析表明，随着学习进展，用于锥支配响应的查询比例以高概率趋于零。在多个LLM家族上的实验表明，MPG-DPO在相同查询预算下优于强竞争者。
translation.brief: 解决在线偏好对齐中标注样本效率低的问题，核心方法是利用用户历史对比的多维评估构建个性化偏好锥，过滤被支配响应并选择最具分歧的对比对。

papers.title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
papers.abstract: Scaling has driven the success of large language models (LLM), with sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enabling greater parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation. At large scales, MoE models rely on expert parallelism to distribute experts across devices. Each MoE layer requires two synchronous collective communication steps during inference: dispatching hidden states to the activated experts and combining the resulting expert outputs. As compute throughput has outpaced interconnect bandwidth, these synchronous collectives have become a major bottleneck to MoE scaling and efficiency. We address this challenge with EchoMoE, a lightweight architecture modification that retrofits existing MoE models, requiring approximately 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining. Motivated by the observation that transformer blocks update the residual stream incrementally, we use a hidden state from an earlier layer as a reference and communicate only the compressed difference between it and the current state, rather than communicating each hidden state in full. EchoMoE periodically refreshes these reference states and transmits only the compressed differences synchronously, reducing the traffic on latency-critical paths without significant computational overhead. EchoMoE reduces inter-node communication volume by 58% and improves throughput by 22.6%, while preserving average performance within 3.8 percentage points across 18 benchmarks. EchoMoE further improves inference throughput by up to 2.38x over bandwidth-constrained Ethernet, paving the way for wide-area distributed inference. EchoMoE also tolerates quantization of the communicated representations without measurable quality loss. We release an efficient implementation for applying EchoMoE to pretrained MoE models, together with an inference integration for vLLM.

translation.title: 传达变化：通过激活压缩实现高效专家并行
translation.abstract: 规模化推动了大语言模型（LLM）的成功，稀疏混合专家（MoE）架构使参数容量增大而计算不成比例增加。在大规模下，MoE模型依赖专家并行将专家分布到多个设备。每个MoE层在推理时需要两次同步集合通信：将隐状态分发到被激活的专家，并组合专家输出。由于计算吞吐量已超越互连带宽，这些同步集合通信成为MoE扩展与效率的主要瓶颈。我们用EchoMoE应对这一挑战，这是一种轻量架构修改，可改造现有MoE模型，所需训练token比完整预训练少约8500倍。受transformer块增量更新残差流的启发，我们使用较早层的隐状态作为参考，仅通信它与当前状态之间的压缩差值，而非完整通信每个隐状态。EchoMoE定期刷新这些参考状态，并仅同步传输压缩差值，在不显著计算开销的情况下减少延迟关键路径上的流量。EchoMoE将节点间通信量减少58%，吞吐量提高22.6%，同时在18个基准上平均性能保持在3.8个百分点以内。在带宽受限的以太网上，EchoMoE进一步将推理吞吐量提升至多2.38倍，为广域分布式推理铺平道路。EchoMoE还能容忍通信表征的量化而不产生可测量的质量损失。我们发布了将EchoMoE应用于预训练MoE模型的高效实现，以及vLLM的推理集成。
translation.brief: 解决MoE专家并行中同步集合通信瓶颈问题，核心方法是EchoMoE：以早层隐状态为参考，仅同步传输压缩后的激活差值以减少通信量。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Japanese Clinical Named Entity Recognition: A Controlled Comparison of BERT and Open-Weight Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain. Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories. The evaluation used 433 sentences from 36 test documents; 1,672 sentences were used for training. LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot prompting with and without JSON Schema constraints and three-seed QLoRA fine-tuning. Fine-tuned models were assessed under different output-token limits, including 900 and larger model-specific limits of 2,600 or 4,096 tokens. Performance was measured using sentence-level label-surface matching with relaxed and exact-surface F1. Results: The highest zero-shot relaxed F1 was 0.337, compared with 0.836-0.841 for the BERT baselines. At the larger output limits, all eight fine-tuned LLMs with at least 13B total parameters exceeded both BERT baselines (relaxed F1, 0.882-0.914; exact-surface F1, 0.840-0.880). Across three-seed means, increasing the output limit improved relaxed F1 by 0.052-0.085, alongside higher recall and fewer length-limited outputs. JSON Schema constraints changed relaxed F1 by -0.014 to +0.008 among seven models outside the two reasoning-oriented configurations, while medical-general model pairs showed no consistent advantage for medical specialization. Conclusions: On this historical Japanese case-report benchmark, task-specific fine-tuning combined with adequate generation capacity was associated with stronger LLM extraction performance. Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.

translation.title: 细粒度日语临床命名实体识别：BERT与开放权重大型语言模型的受控比较
translation.abstract: 背景：生成式大型语言模型（LLM）为基于编码器的临床命名实体识别（NER）提供了替代方案，但其在细粒度日语抽取任务上的表现以及对生成设置的敏感性仍不确定。方法：我们在定义了113个实体类别的iCorpus数据集上，将两个微调的BERT-CRF基线与九个开放权重LLM进行比较。评估使用了来自36个测试文档的433个句子；训练使用了1,672个句子。LLM通过带和不带JSON Schema约束的零样本提示以及三种子QLoRA微调进行评估。微调后的模型在不同的输出token上限下评估，包括900以及更大的模型特定上限2,600或4,096 token。性能采用句子级标签-表面匹配衡量，使用宽松和精确表面F1。结果：最高的零样本宽松F1为0.337，而BERT基线为0.836-0.841。在更大的输出上限下，所有八个总参数量至少13B的微调LLM均超过两个BERT基线（宽松F1为0.882-0.914；精确表面F1为0.840-0.880）。在三种子均值中，提高输出上限使宽松F1提升0.052-0.085，同时召回率更高、因长度限制截断的输出更少。JSON Schema约束在七个非推理导向配置的模型中使宽松F1变化为-0.014至+0.008，而医学-通用模型对未显示出医学专业化的持续优势。结论：在这一历史日语病例报告基准上，任务特定微调结合充足的生成能力与更强的LLM抽取性能相关。输出token上限显著影响了与BERT的比较，而仅强制输出结构无法克服低零样本准确率。
translation.brief: 针对日语临床细粒度命名实体识别中LLM表现不确定的问题，比较了BERT-CRF基线与多个开放权重LLM在零样本、QLoRA微调及不同输出token上限下的抽取性能。

papers.title: Safely Mitigating Grid Imbalance: A Hybrid Distributional Wide-Margin Recourse Approach
papers.abstract: This paper proposes the Multi-Agent Distributional Wide-Margin Policy Gradient (MADWMPG) framework: a dual-policy hybrid imitation and safe reinforcement learning (IL-SRL) method designed for safely mitigating grid imbalance in multiphase active distribution networks with distributed soft open points (SOPs). The framework comprises a wide-margin constraint barrier recourse (WCBR) module that seeks the maximal separation of constraint-compliant and unsafe actions and learns to proactively suppress exploratory violations. The framework addresses operational volatility using a novel adaptation of noncrossing quantile regression (NQR) distributional critics that track the complete distribution of policy returns. The set of behavior and recourse policies integrates an instantaneous physics-based and differentiable action projection mechanism that generates SOP constraint-compliant actions without relying on active learning. Policy safety is made responsive using an enhancement of conventional experience replay, and the safety performance of the framework is supported by probabilistic bounds derived in the paper. The proposed framework was trained and tested on a modified multiphase IEEE 123-bus test feeder. Results demonstrate its superiority to conventional reinforcement learning and SRL methods and show that it is highly competitive against the nonlinear AC optimal power flow.

translation.title: 安全缓解电网不平衡：一种混合分布式宽边界调节方法
translation.abstract: 本文提出多智能体分布式宽边界策略梯度（MADWMPG）框架：一种双重策略的混合模仿与安全强化学习（IL-SRL）方法，旨在利用分布式软开点（SOP）安全地缓解多相有源配电网中的电网不平衡。该框架包含宽边界约束屏障调节（WCBR）模块，该模块寻求符合约束的安全动作与不安全动作之间的最大分离，并学习主动抑制探索性违规。框架采用非交叉分位数回归（NQR）分布式评论家的新颖改进来跟踪策略回报的完整分布，以应对运行波动性。行为与调节策略集合集成了基于物理的瞬时可微动作投影机制，可在不依赖主动学习的情况下生成符合SOP约束的动作。通过增强传统经验回放使策略安全具备响应性，且框架的安全性能由文中推导的概率界支持。所提框架在改进的多相IEEE 123节点测试馈线上进行训练和测试。结果表明其优于传统强化学习和SRL方法，并在非线性AC最优潮流面前具有高度竞争力。
translation.brief: 针对带分布式软开点的多相配电网电网不平衡的安全缓解问题，提出融合宽边界约束屏障、NQR分布式评论家与可微动作投影的混合模仿-安全强化学习框架MADWMPG。

papers.title: GapLeak: When Privacy-Preserving LLM-based Web Agents Become a Privacy Risk
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based web agents rely on data minimization and least privilege to protect user privacy. We show that these principles are necessary but insufficient: they constrain authorized sources, but not higher-sensitivity sources that remain reachable. A website can request a field unavailable from authorized sources, creating an information gap. To complete the task, a goal-driven agent may escalate to reachable but unauthorized sources and disclose accumulated sensitive information. We formalize this vulnerability as GapLeak, where an adversary exploits a legitimate web form without prompt injection or other malicious instructions. We evaluate GapLeak on three web-agent frameworks and six LLMs from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI across recruitment, e-commerce, travel, and healthcare. GapLeak induces an average unauthorized disclosure of approximately 37%. The information gap is the primary driver: eliminating it reduces disclosure by more than 50%. Existing instruction-level defenses based on least privilege partially mitigate the vulnerability but often reduce task success. We propose submission-time verification, which filters unauthorized content before form submission, eliminating over 96% of unauthorized disclosures while preserving task success.

translation.title: GapLeak：当隐私保护的基于LLM的网络代理成为隐私风险
translation.abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的网络代理依赖数据最小化和最小权限原则来保护用户隐私。我们证明这些原则是必要但不充分的：它们约束了授权来源，却未约束仍然可达的更高敏感度来源。网站可以请求一个授权来源无法提供的字段，从而形成信息缺口。为完成任务，目标驱动的代理可能升级到可达但未授权的来源并披露累积的敏感信息。我们将这一漏洞形式化为GapLeak，其中对手利用合法网页表单，无需提示注入或其他恶意指令。我们在三个网络代理框架和来自Anthropic、Google和OpenAI的六个LLM上，在招聘、电商、旅行和医疗场景中评估GapLeak。GapLeak导致平均约37%的未授权披露。信息缺口是主要驱动因素：消除它可使披露减少超过50%。现有基于最小权限的指令级防御只能部分缓解该漏洞，且常降低任务成功率。我们提出提交时验证方法，在表单提交前过滤未授权内容，消除超过96%的未授权披露，同时保持任务成功率。
translation.brief: 针对LLM网络代理因授权来源与可达来源之间的信息缺口而升级披露敏感信息的问题，形式化了GapLeak攻击并提出提交时验证过滤机制加以防御。

papers.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
papers.abstract: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $\Theta(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points. In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points. Such overstatement is large enough to make the apparent winner statistically fragile. Thus, we use the same bootstrap to further quantify the intervals of plausible rank positions for each model and group models into tiers. We establish sufficient conditions for consistent recovery of population tiers. On SWE-bench Verified, this procedure places 13 of 173 models in the leading tier. We combine the score adjustment and rank intervals in the Rank Uncertainty and Leaderboard Evaluation Report (RULER). We validate its finite-sample performance using sample splitting and calibrated simulations, and advocate publishing RULER alongside raw rankings so readers can assess both reported performance and the precision of the ordering. RULER also provides guidance for benchmark design that accounts for selection effects and ranking uncertainty.

translation.title: SOTA还是运气？LLM排行榜中的赢家诅咒
translation.abstract: 公开的LLM排行榜指导模型评估与采用，然而排名靠前模型的报告性能可能被系统性高估。这种排行榜赢家诅咒源于对含噪声基准得分的排序同时奖励了抽样运气和真实能力。同样的选择效应会扭曲整个排行榜的得分，我们称之为秩诱导偏差。我们开发了$m$-out-of-$N$自助法来校正这一偏差。该方法假设模型池固定、任务独立同分布且有界，同时允许任务内模型间任意相关。在由正间隔分隔的精确总体层级下，我们证明自助法可将$\Theta(N^{-1/2})$的排序偏差降至期望残余偏差$o(N^{-1/2})$。在来自5个基准家族的14个基准上，排名第一的调整幅度约为0.09至3.86个百分点。在我们的SWE-bench Verified快照中，并列领先者获得的调整为0.90个百分点。这种高估足以使表面上的胜出者在统计上脆弱。因此，我们使用同一自助法进一步量化每个模型合理的排名区间并将模型分组为层级。我们建立了一致恢复总体层级的充分条件。在SWE-bench Verified上，该过程将173个模型中的13个置于领先层级。我们将得分调整与排名区间结合到Rank Uncertainty and Leaderboard Evaluation Report（RULER）中。我们通过样本拆分和校准仿真验证其有限样本性能，并倡导在原始排名之外同时发布RULER，以便读者评估报告性能与排序的精确性。RULER还为考虑选择效应和排序不确定性的基准设计提供指导。
translation.brief: 针对LLM排行榜因噪声得分排序导致的排名偏差高估问题，提出m-out-of-N自助法校正得分并给出排名区间与层级划分工具RULER。

papers.title: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
papers.abstract: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: this https URL.

translation.title: CoSphere-SLAM：具有球面回环检测的多智能体全景高斯泼溅SLAM
translation.abstract: 稠密协同建图对搜索救援、建筑检查和仓储自动化至关重要，全景相机可在单帧中捕获整个周围环境。与仅在相似朝向下共享视图的针孔相机智能体不同，全景智能体可在任意3D朝向下观察重叠场景，但搜索完整旋转也会在不同对称房间之间产生相互一致的虚假回环。此外，连续的单目尺度漂移会在重访表面上使刚性合并的地图分裂，而短基线下的深度噪声会扭曲回环平移方向。为解决这些挑战，我们提出CoSphere-SLAM，这是首个面向全景相机的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM框架，其球面回环通过快速傅里叶相关在$\mathrm{SO}(3)$上对齐球面特征以适应任意朝向，并通过全局$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$一致性拒绝对称性虚假回环。基于这些回环，方向性全局优化求解带对数尺度正则化的每关键帧$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$位姿图，以校正尺度漂移，同时将光流平移方向与基于深度的幅度分离。最后，全向高斯融合利用关键帧相似性变换每个高斯，并在最大射线响应处渲染高斯，以联合优化位姿与地图。在室内和跨会话的多智能体全景基准上的实验表明，CoSphere-SLAM在单智能体和多智能体方法中实现了最先进的轨迹精度和渲染质量。项目网站：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体全景SLAM中的对称虚假回环、单目尺度漂移与深度噪声问题，提出基于SO(3)球面特征对齐与Sim(3)一致性优化的高斯泼溅协同SLAM框架CoSphere-SLAM。

papers.title: Context Has a Price: Adding and Removing Context for LLM Coding Agents under Prefix Caching
papers.abstract: Coding agents repeatedly send their conversation history to a language model. Adding useful code may reduce search, while removing old tool outputs may shorten later prompts. But do these changes reduce the cost of solving a task? We study this as a measurement problem in more than 20,000 runs of open models on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench and Loc-Bench. We account separately for uncached input, cached input and output tokens. Three findings emerge. First, in our main evidence-package experiments, retrieved code reduces read and search commands by 18--34%, but increases cost by 33--42% when cached input costs one tenth of uncached input, without a measurable improvement in resolution. Second, removing old observations can either save money or increase cost: the same approach saves 19--36% without a cache discount but increases cost by 38--116% with a tenth-price cache. Third, shorter prompts do not guarantee cheaper runs because agents may respond by taking more steps. We also find that concurrent experiments can share cached prefixes and distort cost comparisons. These results show why context-management methods should be evaluated using both token prices and the agent's subsequent behavior.

translation.title: 上下文有代价：前缀缓存下 LLM 编码代理的上下文增删
translation.abstract: 编码代理会反复将对话历史发送给语言模型。添加有用的代码可能减少搜索，而删除旧的工具输出可能缩短后续提示。但这些改动是否能降低解决任务的成本？我们在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench 和 Loc-Bench 上超过 20,000 次开源模型运行中，将其作为一个测量问题进行研究。我们分别统计未缓存输入、缓存输入和输出 token。得到三个发现。第一，在我们的主要证据包实验中，检索到的代码将读取和搜索命令减少了 18--34%，但当缓存输入价格为未缓存输入的十分之一时，成本增加了 33--42%，且解决率没有可测量的提升。第二，删除旧观察结果既可能省钱也可能增加成本：同一种方法在无缓存折扣时节省 19--36%，而在十分之一价格的缓存下成本增加 38--116%。第三，更短的提示并不保证更便宜的运行，因为代理可能采取更多步骤作为回应。我们还发现并发实验可以共享缓存前缀，从而扭曲成本比较。这些结果表明，为什么上下文管理方法应当同时依据 token 价格和代理的后续行为来评估。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 编码代理中上下文的增删对任务成本的影响，通过大规模实验区分缓存与未缓存 token 成本进行测量分析。

papers.title: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
papers.abstract: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7% and discharge histories to 45.3%, and raised six interactive agents' scores while barely changing their ranking. The exploratory gap was reproduced in a registered replication on held-out patients. Masking diagnosis names left it unchanged. Because MIMIC lacks a contemporaneous bedside history, the gap is an upper bound on hindsight. We report all registered outcomes and recommend construction practices.

translation.title: 事后视角从何处进入临床代理基准？对模拟器与病例构建的审计
translation.abstract: 面向 LLM 诊断代理的基准基于回顾性记录构建：代理读取的病例改写自出院小结，而未记录的检查结果由常常能看到最终诊断的模拟器生成。HindAudit 区分三条事后视角渠道（提供给模拟器的诊断、其依赖的回顾性上下文、面向代理的病例文本），并使用仅在真实数据上训练的评判器分别测量每条渠道。在 MIMIC-IV 的 27,489 例急诊入院中，五项注册测试未发现模拟实验室结果中的泄漏：向五个模拟器提供诊断的影响可忽略不计，且提示式守门员稀释了诊断信号，尽管探索性结果提示它们可以提升代理分数。最大的影响在于病例文本。与基于分诊记录的就诊时重建相比，基准风格的摘要将四个 LLM 的零样本准确率从 25.4% 提高到 39.7%，出院病史提高到 45.3%，并提升了六个交互式代理的分数而几乎不改变其排名。该探索性差距在留出患者上的注册重复实验中得到复现。遮蔽诊断名称并未消除该差距。由于 MIMIC 缺少同时期的床旁病史，该差距是事后视角的上界。我们报告所有注册结果并提出构建实践建议。
translation.brief: 审计 LLM 临床诊断基准中模拟器与病例文本两条事后信息泄漏渠道，用仅在真实数据上训练的评判器分别量化其对代理表现的影响。

papers.title: Optimal Energy and LLM Task Scheduling for Multiple Cloud Data Centers
papers.abstract: This paper studies coordinated Large Language Model (LLM) training-task scheduling and facility operation for geographically distributed cloud data centers (CDCs). The central question is how two scheduling flexibilities - cross-CDC task transfer and task reordering - affect service and economic outcomes when remote execution remains subject to compute, bandwidth, energy, and zone-temperature constraints. We formulate a mixed-integer optimization model that jointly determines task outcomes, heterogeneous-node assignment, execution timing, pre-execution data transfer, node activation, and facility operation. A deterministic 24-hour case study contains 3 CDCs, 15 heterogeneous graphics processing unit (GPU) nodes, 4 thermal zones per CDC, and 103 tasks. In this instance, enabling transfer increases net profit by 57.9% relative to the otherwise matched no-transfer variant and increases completed tasks from 76 to 103. The more restrictive no-transfer FIFO-prefix variant completes 14 tasks and yields negative profit. The proposed schedule transfers 39 tasks, achieves 70.3% node utilization, and maintains zone temperatures within 24°C-27°C. These fixed-instance results indicate that cross-CDC transfer and task-reordering flexibility can improve the modeled profit and task-completion outcomes under the studied conditions.

translation.title: 多云数据中心的最优能源与 LLM 任务调度
translation.abstract: 本文研究地理分布的云数据中心（CDC）之间协调的 LLM 训练任务调度与设施运营。核心问题是：在远程执行仍受计算、带宽、能源和区域温度约束的情况下，跨 CDC 任务转移和任务重排这两种调度灵活性如何影响服务与经济结果。我们建立一个混合整数优化模型，联合决定任务结果、异构节点分配、执行时序、执行前数据传输、节点激活和设施运营。一个确定性 24 小时案例研究包含 3 个 CDC、15 个异构 GPU 节点、每个 CDC 4 个热区以及 103 个任务。在该实例中，启用转移相对于其他条件相同的无转移变体使净利润提高 57.9%，完成任务数从 76 增至 103。更受限的无转移 FIFO 前缀变体仅完成 14 个任务且利润为负。所提出的调度转移了 39 个任务，实现 70.3% 的节点利用率，并将区域温度维持在 24°C--27°C。这些固定实例结果表明，在所研究条件下，跨 CDC 转移和任务重排灵活性可以改善建模的利润与任务完成结果。
translation.brief: 研究地理分布云数据中心间 LLM 训练任务调度问题，建立混合整数优化模型联合决定任务转移、重排、节点分配与设施运营。

papers.title: From Token Changes to Task Failures: Bit Flips in a Shared KV-Cache Block
papers.abstract: In LLM serving systems with prefix caching, each KV block of a shared system prompt is held in GPU memory as a single physical copy, which every request with that prompt reads. Our earlier work measured change and showed that one bit flip in such a block changes many later responses without making them visibly degenerate. This paper extends that work by measuring how often the changed responses are wrong. Using software fault injection into vLLM serving Qwen3-8B, we flip the most significant mantissa bit or the sign bit of a value in such a block. We score responses on four tasks: code generation, short-answer questions, multiple-choice reasoning, and refusal under a policy. The fraction of changes that turned a correct response wrong depended strongly on the task: 0.023 on MBPP+ and 0.59 on held-out TriviaQA at the mantissa bit, and 0.019 and 0.60 at the sign bit. Harm fell on requests whose sampled answers are sometimes wrong, so the damage of a flip depends on how common such requests are. Harmed responses looked like ordinary errors, so a flip should be detected by checking cached blocks rather than by monitoring outputs.

translation.title: 从 token 变化到任务失败：共享 KV-Cache 块中的位翻转
translation.abstract: 在采用前缀缓存的 LLM 服务系统中，共享系统提示的每个 KV 块以单一物理副本保存在 GPU 内存中，每个使用该提示的请求都会读取它。我们先前的工作测量了变化，发现此类块中的一位翻转会改变许多后续响应而不使其明显退化。本文扩展该工作，测量这些被改变的响应有多大比例是错误的。通过对服务 Qwen3-8B 的 vLLM 进行软件故障注入，我们翻转此类块中某个值的最高有效尾数位或符号位。我们在四个任务上对响应评分：代码生成、简答题、多选推理和基于策略的拒绝。变化使正确响应变错的比例强烈依赖于任务：尾数位时 MBPP+ 为 0.023，留出 TriviaQA 为 0.59；符号位时分别为 0.019 和 0.60。伤害落在采样答案本就有时错误的请求上，因此翻转的损害取决于这类请求的普遍程度。受伤害的响应看起来像普通错误，因此应当通过检查缓存块而非监控输出来检测翻转。
translation.brief: 通过故障注入测量共享 KV-Cache 块中单个位翻转导致正确响应变错的比例，发现错误率强烈依赖任务类型，且受伤害响应与普通错误无异。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.

translation.title: 多代理记忆不一致：LLM 代理中事实冲突消失之处
translation.abstract: 多代理委派使 LLM 系统能够在拥有各自上下文的 worker 之间分配证据收集。这带来一致性挑战：worker 检索到的事实可能缺失于 leader 用于得出联合结论的证据之中。我们引入一个基准和证据流分析器，通过在 Harvey LAB 文档审查任务中受控的事实冲突来研究多代理记忆不一致。在三个模型上合并统计（生成开销相当）后，要求委派使两个冲突断言都被检索到的比例从单代理执行的 50.2% 提高到 68.7%，但冲突检测率却从 16.2% 降至 13.2%。在该设置中，worker 仅对 35.2% 的检索对报告两个断言，且合并的匹配比较显示：当一个 worker 读取两个断言时检测率高于单代理执行，而当断言分散在不同 worker 之间时检测率更低。worker 到 leader 的交接是提升多代理 LLM 冲突检测的关键目标。
translation.brief: 构建基准与证据流分析器研究多代理 LLM 中事实冲突在委派与交接过程中的丢失问题，发现冲突分散于 worker 之间时检测率反而下降。

papers.title: OAK-Mind: Zero-Training Mental Health Change Inference from Passive Sensing via Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.abstract: Wearable and smartphone sensors capture behavioral signals associated with mental health, yet inferring mental health outcomes from these signals has traditionally relied on supervised models requiring labeled data and offering limited insight into their predictions. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to reason over behavioral evidence, but existing LLM-based approaches to passive sensing have largely continued to rely on task-specific fine-tuning or sensor-specific pretraining. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{OAK-Mind}, a zer\textbf{O}-training, multi-\textbf{A}gent, \textbf{K}nowledge-grounded LLM pipeline for inferring mental health changes from passive sensing data. The pipeline organizes sensing data into behavioral dimensions including sleep, physical activity, location mobility, and smartphone use, and orchestrates specialized agents grounded in mental health literature to interpret longitudinal behavioral changes. It synthesizes their assessments and applies questionnaire-based symptom rating to infer changes relative to an individual's baseline assessment with human-readable rationale grounded in observed behavioral patterns and domain knowledge. Across datasets and prediction tasks, while without task-specific training, OAK-Mind achieves comparable or better performance than the most predictive supervised baselines trained on additional labeled samples. It also demonstrate consistent improvement upon direct prompting across four tested LLM backbones. Ablation analyses support the benefits of combining behavioral interpretation with symptom rating, distributing analysis across domain-specific agents, and incorporating domain knowledge. Our findings highlight the potential of knowledge-grounded, multi-agent LLMs for training-free inference of mental health changes from passive sensing data.

translation.title: OAK-Mind：基于知识引导多智能体大语言模型的无训练心理健康变化推断
translation.abstract: 可穿戴设备和智能手机传感器能够捕捉与心理健康相关的行为信号，但从这些信号推断心理健康结果的传统方法依赖于需要标注数据的监督模型，且对预测的解释能力有限。大语言模型（LLM）为行为证据推理提供了新机会，但现有的基于 LLM 的被动感知方法大多仍依赖任务特定的微调或传感器特定的预训练。本文提出 OAK-Mind，一个零训练、多智能体、知识引导的 LLM 流水线，用于从被动感知数据推断心理健康变化。该流水线将感知数据组织为睡眠、身体活动、位置移动和智能手机使用等行为维度，并调度以心理健康文献为依据的专门智能体来解释纵向行为变化。它综合各智能体的评估结果，应用基于问卷的症状评分，相对于个体基线评估推断变化，并给出基于观察到的行为模式和领域知识的人类可读理由。在多个数据集和预测任务上，OAK-Mind 无需任务特定训练即可取得与使用额外标注样本训练的最优监督基线相当或更好的性能，并在四个测试的 LLM 骨干上均表现出对直接提示的持续改进。消融分析支持将行为解释与症状评分相结合、将分析分布到领域特定智能体以及引入领域知识的益处。我们的发现凸显了知识引导的多智能体 LLM 在从被动感知数据进行免训练心理健康变化推断方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决从被动传感数据免训练推断心理健康变化的问题，核心方法是用知识引导的多智能体 LLM 流水线结合行为维度解释与问卷症状评分。

papers.title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
papers.abstract: Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis. Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema.
