A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only. Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall accuracy reached 97.5%, with all form types above 96%. The human-in-the-loop design further improved cognitive assessment accuracy to 97.5% while reducing manual work by 63.8%. In the Mini-Cog Clock Drawing task, qualitative analysis showed that 62.3% of all extraction errors stemmed from ambiguous drawing, in which cases the LLM provided reasonable readings. Discussion. Compared to current manual data extraction, our LLM-based system reduces processing time by 10 to 20 times and costs by over 12 times. The modular design allows seamless expansion to additional form types. Conclusion. Our system provides an accurate, scalable, and cost-efficient solution for structuring data trapped in handwritten paper forms for clinical decision support.

translation.title: 基于多模态大语言模型的扫描版认知与行为评估视觉信息抽取系统
translation.abstract: 目的。纸质评估表在患者诊疗中十分常见，但手写内容和扫描伪影使这些表格难以规模化处理。本研究提出一个模块化、基于多模态 LLM 并带有人工监督的系统，用于抽取字段和分数。我们对使用 LLM 进行手绘分析进行了定性分析。材料与方法。该系统使用两个模块处理认知评估表（即 MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog）和 NICHQ Vanderbilt 评估表：1）表单分类器，将扫描页分配到表单类型；2）对应的分数抽取器，将字段和分数抽取到模式中。采用双模型验证的人在回路设计，当两个 LLM 意见不一致时才引入人工标注者，将人工复核限制在困难页面。结果。认知评估表的端到端准确率为 88%，大多数表单类型超过 90%。NICHQ Vanderbilt 总体准确率达 97.5%，所有表单类型均高于 96%。人在回路设计将认知评估准确率进一步提升至 97.5%，同时减少 63.8% 的人工工作。在 Mini-Cog 画钟任务中，定性分析显示 62.3% 的抽取错误源于绘图模糊，此时 LLM 给出了合理的读数。讨论。与目前的人工数据抽取相比，我们基于 LLM 的系统将处理时间缩短 10 至 20 倍，成本降低 12 倍以上。模块化设计使其可无缝扩展到更多表单类型。结论。我们的系统为将手写纸质表单中的数据结构化以支持临床决策提供了准确、可扩展且低成本的解决方案。
translation.brief: 解决手写扫描医疗评估表难以规模化处理的问题，核心方法是模块化的多模态 LLM 分类与抽取系统并辅以双模型验证的人在回路设计。

papers.title: OfficePrism: Benchmarking Agents on Single-Domain Operations Across Enterprise Business Functions
papers.abstract: Broad workplace scores can mix competence within one business function with the extra cost of coordinating across functions and systems, making failures hard to localize. OfficePrism evaluates this prerequisite through 420 single-domain enterprise tasks spanning seven business functions under shared, benchmark-defined L1--L3 task-structure levels. Each task runs in a fresh environment combining a shared synthetic organization with one function-specific domain and yped state access. Our pipeline uses grounded records, business rules, and tool schemas to jointly construct a Chinese-language ticket, a hidden executable reference witness, and an expected response, followed by automated filtering and human curation. The same task set is evaluated through full-schema and search-and-dispatch packages. Across 124 model--harness--package configurations, the per-case joint natural-language-and-database pass rate ranges from 22.6% to 76.4%, with a median of 67.9%. L1 is highest in all 124 configurations, and L2 exceeds L3 in 122. Among 50 configurations sharing the same harness and model labels across both packages, search scores higher in 30, ties in one, and scores lower in 19.

translation.title: OfficePrism：面向企业业务职能的单领域操作智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 宽泛的工作场所评测分数可能将单一业务职能内的能力与跨职能、跨系统协调的额外成本混在一起，使失败难以定位。OfficePrism 通过 420 个覆盖七种业务职能的单领域企业任务来评测这一前提，任务采用统一的基准定义 L1–L3 任务结构级别。每个任务在一个全新环境中运行，该环境由共享的合成组织、一个职能特定的领域和受控的状态访问组成。我们的流水线利用有据可查的记录、业务规则和工具模式，联合构建中文工单、隐藏的可执行参考见证和期望响应，随后进行自动过滤和人工筛选。同一任务集通过全模式与搜索-派发两种任务包进行评估。在 124 个模型–运行框架–任务包配置中，单例的自然语言与数据库联合通过率介于 22.6% 至 76.4% 之间，中位数为 67.9%。L1 在全部 124 个配置中得分最高，L2 在 122 个配置中超过 L3。在两个任务包共享相同运行框架和模型标签的 50 个配置中，search 任务包在 30 个配置中得分更高、1 个持平、19 个更低。
translation.brief: 解决企业智能体评测中难以定位单领域能力的问题，核心方法是构建覆盖七大业务职能、带 L1–L3 分级的中文单领域任务基准 OfficePrism。

papers.title: GuardAgent: A Memory-Augmented Agentic Framework for Adaptive Detection of Adversarial Promotions in LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.abstract: In traditional recommender systems (RSs), textual information typically serves as auxiliary signals for representation learning. In contrast, in LLM-based RSs, textual information becomes the primary medium for recommendation generation through semantic understanding and reasoning. This shift fundamentally changes the attack surface, making promotion-driven manipulations more feasible, effective, and harder to detect. However, effectively detecting such attacks remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic study on detecting promotion-driven attacks against LLM-based RSs, aiming to safeguard next-generation recommendation platforms. Specifically, we propose GuardAgent, a novel LLM-powered agentic detection framework that operates through a loop of Perception, Action, Reflection and Memory. In contrast to conventional LLM-based detectors that function in a static, one-off, and opaque fashion, GuardAgent continually learns and self-evolves to adapt to unseen threat patterns while generating explainable reasoning traces and outcomes. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GuardAgent achieves state-of-the-art generalization performance, laying the foundation for robust and trustworthy recommendation in practical settings.

translation.title: GuardAgent：面向基于 LLM 推荐中对抗性推广攻击自适应检测的记忆增强智能体框架
translation.abstract: 在传统推荐系统（RS）中，文本信息通常作为表示学习的辅助信号。而在基于 LLM 的推荐系统中，文本信息通过语义理解与推理成为推荐生成的主要媒介。这一转变从根本上改变了攻击面，使推广驱动的操纵更加可行、有效且更难检测。然而，有效检测此类攻击的研究仍然很大程度上未被探索。为填补这一空白，我们首次系统性地研究如何检测针对基于 LLM 推荐系统的推广驱动攻击，以保护下一代推荐平台。具体而言，我们提出 GuardAgent，一个由 LLM 驱动的新型智能体检测框架，通过感知（Perception）、行动（Action）、反思（Reflection）和记忆（Memory）的循环运行。与以静态、一次性、不透明方式工作的传统 LLM 检测器不同，GuardAgent 能够持续学习并自我演化以适应未见过的威胁模式，同时生成可解释的推理轨迹和结果。在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GuardAgent 取得了最先进的泛化性能，为实际场景中稳健可信的推荐奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 推荐系统中推广型操纵攻击难以检测的问题，核心方法是提出由感知-行动-反思-记忆循环构成、可持续自我演化的 GuardAgent 智能体检测框架。

papers.title: DACE: Diversity-Driven Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robust LLM Safety Alignment
papers.abstract: Ensuring robust safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly difficult as adversarial attacks evolve and outpace alignment pipelines built on pre-collected data. Existing co-evolutionary frameworks let the defender chase a moving attacker, yet their training dynamics expose two compounding pathologies: \emph{attack strategy collapse}, where the attacker overfits to a narrow set of high-reward rewrites, and \emph{defense adversarial forgetting}, where the defender loses competence against earlier attacks as the attack distribution drifts. Existing remedies are partial: attacker-side diversity rewards score textual novelty rather than strategy novelty, and defender-side replay relies on discrete judge scores that ignore estimation uncertainty, response stochasticity, and defender non-stationarity. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a diversity-driven adversarial co-evolution framework that targets both pathologies jointly. On the attacker side, \method couples an explicit two-dimensional strategy space (risk category $\times$ attack style) with a \emph{normalized marginal coverage gain} reward, providing a bounded, non-vanishing exploration signal at the strategy layer. On the defender side, \method maintains a unified \emph{Bayesian adversarial replay pool} whose Beta--Bernoulli threat posteriors are refreshed by time decay and sampled via Thompson sampling, anchoring defender training to an evolving threat landscape. Across standard safety, automated-attacker, and general-capability benchmarks, \method improves robustness to out-of-distribution attacks while preserving general capabilities, and yields broader attacker strategy coverage.

translation.title: DACE：面向鲁棒 LLM 安全对齐的多样性驱动对抗协同演化
translation.abstract: 随着对抗攻击的演进出基于预收集数据的对齐流程，确保大语言模型（LLM）的鲁棒安全对齐变得越来越困难。现有的协同演化框架让防御者追赶移动的攻击者，但其训练动态暴露出两个相互加剧的病态：攻击策略坍缩，即攻击者过拟合于少数高奖励改写；防御者对抗遗忘，即随着攻击分布漂移，防御者丧失对早期攻击的应对能力。现有补救措施都是不完整的：攻击者侧的多样性奖励衡量的是文本新颖性而非策略新颖性；防御者侧的重放依赖离散的裁判分数，忽略了估计不确定性、响应随机性和防御者的非平稳性。我们提出 DACE，一个同时针对这两种病态的多样性驱动对抗协同演化框架。在攻击者侧，DACE 将显式的二维策略空间（风险类别 × 攻击风格）与归一化边际覆盖增益奖励相结合，在策略层提供有界且不衰减的探索信号。在防御者侧，DACE 维护一个统一的贝叶斯对抗重放池，其 Beta–Bernoulli 威胁后验通过时间衰减更新并经 Thompson 采样，将防御者训练锚定在不断演化的威胁图景上。在标准安全、自动攻击者和通用能力基准上，DACE 提升了对分布外攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力，并带来更广泛的攻击者策略覆盖。
translation.brief: 解决对抗协同演化中攻击策略坍缩与防御者遗忘的问题，核心方法是攻击侧引入二维策略空间与边际覆盖增益奖励、防御侧采用贝叶斯 Thompson 采样对抗重放池。

papers.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
papers.abstract: Sparse attention has been increasingly adopted by production LLMs for long-context inference, yet serving systems must still retain the full KV history, making GPU HBM capacity a key limit on serving concurrency. Existing systems offload the KV cache to host memory, but suffer from the limited bandwidth of PCIe and the limited capacity of host memory. Emerging scale-up memory pools (e.g., X-Mem) relieve both limits and open new opportunities for sparse-attention offloading. In this paper, we first conduct an in-depth analysis and reveal that, even with scale-up memory pools, decode throughput remains bounded by HBM capacity, as hot KV buffers and the fully resident indexer key (K-index) cache occupy substantial HBM. Moreover, the two caches exhibit distinct access patterns. Based on these insights, we present XM-Sparse, the first sparse-attention offloading system over scale-up memory expansion. The core idea of XM-Sparse is to offload both caches aggressively while matching each with an I/O mechanism tailored to its access pattern. Specifically, for dynamically selected KV entries, XM-Sparse fuses TMA-based retrieval with attention in a tile-level pipeline to hide on-demand retrieval latency. For predictable K-index accesses, it prefetches pages via SM-efficient GPU-initiated DMA and coordinates prefetching with latency-critical operations to avoid interfering with decoding. We have implemented XM-Sparse atop SGLang, and our experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.3 with an emulated scale-up memory pool show that XM-Sparse delivers up to 4.98$\times$ and 4.52$\times$ higher decode throughput than PCIe-based ECHO and HiSparse, respectively, and up to 1.34$\times$ over a naive integration on the same platform, across 16K-1M contexts.

translation.title: XM-Sparse：基于扩展内存池的高吞吐稀疏注意力 LLM 服务
translation.abstract: 稀疏注意力已被生产级 LLM 日益用于长上下文推理，但服务系统仍需保留完整的 KV 历史，使 GPU HBM 容量成为服务并发度的关键限制。现有系统将 KV cache 卸载到主机内存，但受限于 PCIe 的有限带宽和主机内存的有限容量。新兴的扩展内存池（如 X-Mem）缓解了这两个限制，为稀疏注意力卸载开辟了新机会。本文首先进行了深入分析，揭示了即使使用扩展内存池，decode 吞吐量仍受 HBM 容量限制，因为热点 KV 缓冲区和完全驻留的 indexer key（K-index）缓存占用了大量 HBM。此外，这两个缓存表现出截然不同的访问模式。基于这些洞察，我们提出了 XM-Sparse，这是首个基于扩展内存扩展的稀疏注意力卸载系统。XM-Sparse 的核心思想是积极卸载两个缓存，同时为每个缓存匹配针对其访问模式定制的 I/O 机制。具体而言，对于动态选择的 KV 条目，XM-Sparse 将基于 TMA 的检索与注意力在 tile 级流水线中融合，以隐藏按需检索延迟。对于可预测的 K-index 访问，它通过 SM 高效的 GPU 发起 DMA 预取页面，并将预取与延迟关键操作协调，避免干扰解码。我们在 SGLang 之上实现了 XM-Sparse，在使用模拟扩展内存池对 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.3 的实验中，在 16K-1M 上下文范围内，XM-Sparse 的 decode 吞吐量比基于 PCIe 的 ECHO 和 HiSparse 分别提升最高 4.98 倍和 4.52 倍，比同平台上的朴素集成提升最高 1.34 倍。
translation.brief: 解决稀疏注意力长上下文推理中 HBM 容量限制 decode 吞吐量的问题，核心方法是向扩展内存池积极卸载 KV 与 K-index 缓存并为其定制 TMA 流水线检索与 GPU 发起 DMA 预取机制。

papers.title: ConfGuard: a physics-grounded reference monitor for predictive-maintenance large-language-model agents
papers.abstract: Large-language-model agents now close the industrial predictive-maintenance loop, reading sensor windows, retrieving procedures and dispatching work orders. Two attack channels meet there: injected text in a retrieved document can hijack the decision, and a bounded sensor perturbation can corrupt the remaining-useful-life estimate behind it. Recent agent defenses police data provenance and tool privilege but cannot tell whether a prognostic quantity is physically plausible. ConfGuard is a reference monitor with a physics-grounded policy. Its conformal monitor tests each prediction, anchored to the asset's admitted history, against degradation physics: capped remaining life never rises and falls at most one cycle per cycle. Calibrating its threshold over whole asset trajectories lets the operator set the expected share of a clean asset's windows the running monitor escalates. A physics-policy validator checks the agent's maintenance-urgency decision against the decision a deterministic policy derives from the same interval. On all 10,196 C-MAPSS test windows the monitor cuts a covert attacker's reach on healthy assets from 0.529 to 0.046 and closes suppression of failing assets (0.151 to 0), escalating 0.027 of clean windows against a 0.05 target, while the fixed physical range it replaces leaves both attacks open. Behind a Qwen3-14B planner the composed monitors hold urgency-class injection to 0.00 and the universal sensor attack to 0.12, against 0.29 and 0.54 for a defended prompt. An adaptive attacker defeats a Mahalanobis detector on 0.504 of windows and adversarial training on 0.485. We report an attack class the projection misses.

translation.title: ConfGuard：面向预测性维护大语言模型智能体的物理约束参考监视器
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体现已进入工业预测性维护闭环，读取传感器窗口、检索操作规程并派发工单。这里有两条攻击通道：被检索文档中的注入文本可劫持决策，而有界的传感器扰动可破坏其背后的剩余使用寿命估计。近期的智能体防御负责监管数据来源和工具权限，但无法判断预测量在物理上是否合理。ConfGuard 是一个具有物理约束策略的参考监视器。其保形监视器以资产的已知历史为锚点，根据退化物理规律测试每个预测：封顶的剩余寿命绝不上升，且每个周期至多下降一个周期。通过在整个资产轨迹上校准其阈值，操作员可以设定运行中监视器对正常资产窗口升级告警的预期比例。物理策略验证器将智能体的维护紧急度决策与确定性策略从同一区间推导出的决策进行比对。在全部 10,196 个 C-MAPSS 测试窗口上，监视器将隐蔽攻击者对健康资产的作用范围从 0.529 降至 0.046，并消除了对故障资产的抑制（0.151 降至 0），在 0.05 的目标下升级了 0.027 的正常窗口，而它所替代的固定物理范围对两种攻击均无防护。在 Qwen3-14B 规划器背后，组合监视器将紧急度等级注入压制到 0.00，将通用传感器攻击压制到 0.12，而受防御的提示词分别为 0.29 和 0.54。自适应攻击者在 0.504 的窗口上击败 Mahalanobis 检测器，在 0.485 的窗口上击败对抗训练。我们报告了一类该投影方法无法覆盖的攻击。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 预测性维护智能体易受提示注入与传感器扰动攻击的问题，核心方法是以退化物理规律构建带保形校准阈值的参考监视器和策略验证器来校验预测与决策。

papers.title: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
papers.abstract: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.

translation.title: 从感知到想象：面向世界模型的可执行记忆
translation.abstract: 物理智能体必须在失去可见性或接触之后仍能利用其先前看到或触摸的内容。其动作会改变这些被记忆事实的含义。我们提出可执行感知记忆（EPM），这是一种世界模型框架，在想象过程中使显式感知状态与神经潜变量动力学一同推进。其不断演化的读取输出为奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习提供信息。我们将奖励输入与产生它们的转移对齐，并在记录动作的开环 rollout 上监督奖励头。在 Memory Maze 13×13 上，EPM 在 1M 次交互时达到 30.37 回报，而相同演化读取输出仅在公共感知前端上为策略和价值提供信息时为 23.37：增益为 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]。完整方法还提升了 9×9 和 MiniWorld 中的控制性能。对记忆中的视野外到达事件的探测显示，两种视觉实现中奖励预期都更强。集中度、触觉恢复和真实触觉帧展示了被记忆事实在想象策略训练、依赖运动的决策和感知内容保持中的互补作用。EPM 将持久感知与世界模型的预测后果和学习信号连接起来，服务于 Physical AI。
translation.brief: 解决物理智能体在失去感知后无法利用既往感知信息的问题，核心方法是提出可执行感知记忆（EPM），在想象中同时推进显式感知状态与神经潜变量动力学并用于奖励与策略学习。

papers.title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deployment-GPU calibration. The predictor is parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data, while adapting a frozen Qwen3-4B using LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer. Across NVIDIA RTX~5090, H100, L40 and AMD MI300X GPUs, SpecSearch with full calibration achieves an average of $2.01\times$ the throughput of AR and $1.36\times$ the throughput of SD, both served by vLLM. The proposed Jev-based predictor closely matches this search performance with $1.30\times$ throughput improvement over SD with vLLM, while eliminating the need for held-out GPU calibration. Additionally, it retains $97.36\%$ of the throughput achieved by SpecSearch that utilizes full calibration.

translation.title: SpecSearch：面向硬件感知的高效投机解码
translation.abstract: 投机解码（SD）加速大语言模型（LLM）推理，但其最优配置同时取决于工作负载特征、GPU 硬件和可用内存。例如，在 RTX 5090 上，最先进的投机草稿模型 DFlash 在低并发下实现 3.50 倍于自回归（AR）解码的吞吐量，但在高并发短输出场景下仅为 0.76 倍。我们提出 SpecSearch，一个硬件感知搜索引擎，跨工作负载-GPU 组合联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度。其分析成本模型捕获内存和计算约束，以识别可行配置并缩小吞吐量优化的搜索空间。在该模型引导下，从多个 GPU 收集校准测量数据。利用这些测量数据，一个基于 Jev 的预测器学习在未校准的 GPU 上选择高吞吐解码配置，无需部署 GPU 校准。预测器在校准数据上进行参数高效训练，即使用 LoRA 适配器和线性校正层适配冻结的 Qwen3-4B。在 NVIDIA RTX 5090、H100、L40 和 AMD MI300X GPU 上，全量校准的 SpecSearch 相比由 vLLM 服务的 AR 平均实现 2.01 倍吞吐量，相比 SD 实现 1.36 倍。所提出的基于 Jev 的预测器接近该搜索性能，相比 vLLM 服务的 SD 提升 1.30 倍吞吐量，同时无需对未见 GPU 进行校准。此外，它保留了采用全量校准的 SpecSearch 所达吞吐量的 97.36%。
translation.brief: 解决投机解码最优配置因工作负载与硬件而异的问题，核心方法是构建分析成本模型缩小搜索空间并用 LoRA 微调的预测器在无校准 GPU 上选择高吞吐解码配置。

papers.title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract: Whether a foundation model succeeds as an autonomous agent depends as much on its runtime software as on its weights. This runtime, the agent harness, manages context and memory, steers multi-turn control, executes tool actions in sandboxes, and verifies work before stopping. Because models differ in how they use tools and how they fail, a static harness tuned for one model or task often stalls, wastes tokens, or regresses on another. This bottleneck has driven a shift from prompt tuning to self-improving agent harnesses: systems that inspect their own execution traces, separate runtime bugs from model limits, and rewrite their own code. We present a unifying architectural and design framework for self-improving agent harnesses. The framework pairs four editable runtime components (context and state, agent control, action interfaces, and verification and recovery) with a four-stage loop that diagnoses failures, proposes code patches, validates candidates, and deploys updates. Using this framework, we show how optimizers trace errors across long trajectories and discover reusable runtime mechanisms such as pre-stop verifiers, loop breakers, and persistent memory. We further show why full-harness rewrites overfit or break across modules, and how modular updates with validation gates generalize across models while bounding token cost. To keep self-modification safe, we establish practical defenses against recurring failure modes including prompt bloat, benchmark gaming, and evaluator tampering. Finally, experiments on SWE-bench Lite validate this framework, showing that gated modular evolution outperforms prompt reflection and full-harness rewrites across models and repositories at a fraction of the token cost.

translation.title: 自我改进的 Harness：自改进智能体 Harness 的统一框架
translation.abstract: 基础模型作为自主智能体是否成功，与其运行时软件和模型权重同样相关。这一运行时环境即智能体 harness，负责管理上下文和记忆、引导多轮控制、在沙箱中执行工具动作，并在停止前验证工作。由于模型在工具使用方式和失败方式上各不相同，为某一模型或任务调优的静态 harness 常会在另一模型上停滞、浪费 token 或性能回退。这一瓶颈推动了从提示词调优向自改进智能体 harness 的转变：即检查自身执行轨迹、区分运行时缺陷与模型能力极限、并重写自身代码的系统。我们提出自改进智能体 harness 的统一架构与设计框架。该框架将四个可编辑的运行时组件（上下文与状态、智能体控制、动作接口、验证与恢复）与四阶段循环配对：诊断失败、提出代码补丁、验证候选方案、部署更新。基于该框架，我们展示优化器如何跨长轨迹追踪错误并发现可复用的运行时机制，如停止前验证器、循环断路器和持久记忆。我们进一步说明为何整体 harness 重写会过拟合或跨模块失效，以及带验证门控的模块化更新如何在限制 token 成本的同时跨模型泛化。为确保自我修改安全，我们建立了针对反复出现故障模式的实用防御，包括提示词膨胀、基准投机和评估器篡改。最后，SWE-bench Lite 上的实验验证了该框架，表明带门控的模块化进化以更少 token 成本跨模型和仓库超越提示词反思与整体 harness 重写。
translation.brief: 解决静态智能体 harness 无法适配不同模型与任务的问题，核心方法是提出将四个可编辑运行时组件与诊断-补丁-验证-部署四阶段循环配对的统一自改进框架。

papers.title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) has powered landmark successes in reinforcement learning, yet its gains in LLM reasoning can remain modest despite substantial search effort. We identify an overlooked bottleneck: what MCTS counts. Standard UCT assigns independent visit counts to textual branches, allowing different formulations of the same reasoning strategy to repeatedly receive exploration bonuses. Our theoretical analysis shows that this count fragmentation can impair exploration efficiency, as quantified by increased cumulative regret. To address this problem, we introduce Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS (LPC-MCTS), which changes only the exploration statistic in UCT. A lightweight Coin-Flipping Network head on the policy's hidden representations estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence. Across 5 mathematical-reasoning and 7 search benchmarks, LPC-MCTS consistently outperforms strong MCTS baselines. Holding each LPC-MCTS-trained policy fixed, replacing standard MCTS counts at inference improves average mean@16 accuracy across 5 mathematical benchmarks by 3.79 percentage points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.71 points on Qwen3-4B. Applying LPC-MCTS during both training and inference yields gains of 4.96 and 4.37 points over standard MCTS, respectively. Together, our theory and experiments show that changing what MCTS counts can substantially improve its exploration efficiency and reasoning performance.

translation.title: MCTS 数错了东西：为 LLM 推理学习探索计数
translation.abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在强化学习中取得过里程碑式的成功，但在 LLM 推理中，即使投入大量搜索计算，其收益也可能有限。我们指出了一个被忽视的瓶颈：MCTS 统计的对象是什么。标准 UCT 对文本分支赋予独立的访问计数，使得同一推理策略的不同表述会重复获得探索奖励。我们的理论分析表明，这种计数碎片化会损害探索效率，表现为累积遗憾的增加。为解决该问题，我们提出了 Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS（LPC-MCTS），仅改变 UCT 中的探索统计量。一个轻量的 Coin-Flipping Network 头作用于策略的隐层表示，估计表示覆盖率，使相关分支能够共享探索证据。在 5 个数学推理基准和 7 个搜索基准上，LPC-MCTS 持续优于强大的 MCTS 基线。在保持各 LPC-MCTS 训练的策略不变的情况下，仅在推理时替换标准 MCTS 计数，即可在 5 个数学基准上将平均 mean@16 准确率在 Qwen2.5-7B 上提升 3.79 个百分点，在 Qwen3-4B 上提升 2.71 个百分点。在训练和推理阶段均应用 LPC-MCTS 时，相对标准 MCTS 分别提升 4.96 和 4.37 个百分点。综上，我们的理论和实验表明，改变 MCTS 统计的对象可以显著提升其探索效率和推理性能。
translation.brief: 针对 MCTS 在 LLM 推理中因对文本分支独立计数导致探索奖励碎片化的问题，提出 LPC-MCTS，用轻量网络在隐层表示上估计伪计数，使相关分支共享探索证据。

papers.title: Cross-Modal StateKV Injection for Communication in Multi-LLM Systems across Temporal Segments
papers.abstract: Video understanding with multiple multimodal language models requires a communication interface that can transfer complementary visual observations. Text-based communication is interpretable, but introduces an intermediate generation stage and can omit information relevant to subsequent reasoning. We study Cross-Modal StateKV Injection, a provider--carrier framework that communicates through key--value (KV) states at visual-token positions. Provider models observe complementary video frames; their visual KV states are aligned and projected into the carrier representation space and integrated through gated residual updates. Injection preserves the carrier KV-cache sequence length, while retaining the additional computation required by the providers and the communication module. The reported experiments on MLVU and Video-MME compare carrier-only inference, text-based communication, and StateKV with two provider architectures. Results show modest, task-dependent accuracy gains and lower reported latency than the evaluated text-communication baseline, with some categories remaining unchanged or decreasing. Increasing provider-side frame coverage offers additional gains on selected tasks without extending the carrier cache. These findings motivate further study of visual KV communication under explicitly controlled observation and computation budgets.

translation.title: 面向多 LLM 系统跨时间段通信的跨模态 StateKV 注入
translation.abstract: 使用多个多模态语言模型进行视频理解，需要一个能够传递互补视觉观察结果的通信接口。基于文本的通信可解释，但引入了中间生成阶段，且可能遗漏与后续推理相关的信息。我们研究了 Cross-Modal StateKV Injection，这是一种 provider-carrier 框架，通过视觉 token 位置上的键值（KV）状态进行通信。Provider 模型观察互补的视频帧，其视觉 KV 状态被对齐并投影到 carrier 的表示空间中，并通过门控残差更新进行整合。注入过程保持 carrier KV 缓存的序列长度不变，同时保留 provider 和通信模块所需的额外计算。在 MLVU 和 Video-MME 上报告的实验比较了仅 carrier 推理、基于文本的通信以及使用两种 provider 架构的 StateKV。结果显示准确率有适度的、依赖任务的提升，且报告的延迟低于所评估的文本通信基线，但部分类别保持不变或下降。增加 provider 侧的帧覆盖在部分任务上带来额外收益，且不扩展 carrier 的缓存。这些发现推动在显式控制的观察与计算预算下对视觉 KV 通信的进一步研究。
translation.brief: 针对多多模态 LLM 视频理解中文本通信的局限，提出 provider-carrier 式的 StateKV 框架，通过在视觉 token 位置对齐并注入 KV 状态来传递视觉信息。

papers.title: Learning to Edit IFC Building Models: Verifiable Checkers as the Training Signal for Dependency-Aware Editing Agents
papers.abstract: Editing a building information model in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) schema requires propagating changes to dependent elements while preserving unrelated entities. Existing language-model agents for IFC editing use prompted models without learning from edit outcomes. Target-file comparisons do not specify which alternative edits are allowed or which unrelated entities must remain unchanged. We present IfcGym, a CodeAct environment in which a language model edits IFC through executable code and four checkers verify validity relative to the input model, intent, dependency and preservation against a task specification. Their conjunction is strict success. IfcEdit distils verified teacher episodes into a Qwen3.5-9B student through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with strict success as the reward. On IfcEditBench, 1,990 editing tasks on 13 held-out real projects, the final student reaches 86.78% strict success, from 79.15% after SFT. The paired confidence interval for the difference from its teacher includes zero; the same recipe on a 27B model reaches 91.76% and exceeds the teacher. On the public benchmarks BIM-Edit and BIBIMBAP the final student scores 55.19 and 54.50. On IfcEditBench, the students outperform all prompted models except the teacher under matched tool access; both evaluated frameworks also score lower. Rewarding all four checkers yields 4.83 points more strict success than rewarding intent and validity alone.

translation.title: 学习编辑 IFC 建筑模型：可验证检查器作为依赖感知编辑智能体的训练信号
translation.abstract: 在 Industry Foundation Classes（IFC）模式中编辑建筑信息模型，需要将变更传播到依赖元素，同时保持无关实体不变。现有的用于 IFC 编辑的语言模型智能体仅使用提示的模型，而不从编辑结果中学习。目标文件比较无法说明允许哪些替代编辑，以及哪些无关实体必须保持不变。我们提出 IfcGym，这是一个 CodeAct 环境，语言模型通过可执行代码编辑 IFC，四个检查器依据任务规范分别验证输入模型、意图、依赖和保留方面的有效性。四者的合取构成严格成功。IfcEdit 通过监督微调（SFT）将经过验证的教师轨迹蒸馏到 Qwen3.5-9B 学生模型中，然后应用以严格成功为奖励的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）。在包含 13 个留出真实项目、1,990 个编辑任务的 IfcEditBench 上，最终学生模型达到 86.78% 的严格成功率，从 SFT 后的 79.15% 提升；其与教师的差异的配对置信区间包含零；同样的配方在 27B 模型上达到 91.76% 并超过教师。在公开基准 BIM-Edit 和 BIBIMBAP 上，最终学生模型分别得分 55.19 和 54.50。在 IfcEditBench 上，在相同的工具访问条件下，学生模型超过除教师外的所有提示模型；两个被评估的框架得分也更低。奖励全部四个检查器比只奖励意图和有效性多获得 4.83 个百分点的严格成功。
translation.brief: 针对 IFC 建筑模型编辑智能体缺乏可验证训练信号的问题，提出 IfcGym 环境与四检查器严格成功标准，用 SFT 加 GRPO 训练依赖感知的编辑智能体。

papers.title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. Our paper provides an engineering recipe and a focused empirical case study on adapting compact LLMs to industrial tabular prediction tasks.

translation.title: VRLLM：将 LLM 转化为强大的表格分类器
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在文本上表现强劲，但预训练 LLM 是否对大规模表格分类有效仍不清楚，因为许多先前工作表明 LLM 的表格数据分类性能落后于树模型或专为表格数据设计的神经架构。在 Visa Research，我们成功地在数十亿行有标签的表格数据上微调了预训练的 Llama 3.2 1B LLM，使其超越了广泛的表格分类器，甚至超越了我们具有竞争力的生产级深度学习模型。为便于引用，我们称该模型为 Visa Research LLM（VRLLM）。在本文中，我们分享实现这一令人振奋结果的方法，涵盖数据准备、训练配方、设计选择的消融研究以及部署验证。我们还在相同任务上对前沿 LLM 进行基准测试，并分析其在不同模型家族和世代间的预测行为。我们的可解释性实验表明 VRLLM 学到了特征特定的预测关联，而组件消融则表明最早的两个 FFN 层有助于线性可解码任务信息的涌现。本文为将紧凑 LLM 适配到工业表格预测任务提供了工程配方和一个聚焦的实证案例研究。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在大规模表格分类上落后于专用模型的问题，在数十亿行表格数据上微调 Llama 3.2 1B 得到 VRLLM，使其超越各类表格分类器和生产级模型。

papers.title: EviDARL: Evidence-Centric Dual-Agent Reasoning via Alternating Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Table Question Answering
papers.abstract: Despite advances in LLM-based table reasoning, most studies focus on single-table settings. Multi-table QA requires multi-hop reasoning over complex table relationships and evidence dispersed across long contexts, often without verifiable intermediate traces. To address these challenges, we introduce EviDA, an evidence-centric dual-agent framework comprising an Evidence Construction Agent and a Reasoning and Answering Agent. The Evidence Construction Agent generates and executes table-manipulation programs over complete tables to produce question-specific evidence and verifiable intermediate traces, simplifying subsequent reasoning. The Reasoning and Answering Agent then performs multi-hop reasoning over this evidence to derive final answers. We further introduce EviDARL, which combines agent-specific fine-grained rewards with parameter-efficient alternating reinforcement learning to improve collaboration between the agents. By optimizing each agent in turn while holding the other fixed, EviDARL enables bidirectional adaptation between evidence construction and answer reasoning. Experiments on MMQA and TQA-Bench demonstrate that EviDARL substantially outperforms competitive open-model and multi-table reasoning baselines under constrained model and training budgets.

translation.title: EviDARL：面向多表问答的基于交替强化学习的证据中心双智能体推理
translation.abstract: 尽管基于 LLM 的表格推理取得了进展，大多数研究仍集中在单表设置上。多表问答需要对复杂的表关系和多跳证据进行多跳推理，证据散布在长上下文中，且往往缺乏可验证的中间轨迹。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EviDA，一个证据中心的双智能体框架，包含证据构建智能体与推理问答智能体。证据构建智能体在完整表格上生成并执行表操作程序，以产生针对问题的证据和可验证的中间轨迹，从而简化后续推理。推理问答智能体随后在这些证据上进行多跳推理以得出最终答案。我们进一步提出 EviDARL，它将各智能体特定的细粒度奖励与参数高效的交替强化学习相结合，以改进智能体之间的协作。通过在固定另一方的情况下交替优化每个智能体，EviDARL 实现了证据构建与答案推理之间的双向适配。在 MMQA 和 TQA-Bench 上的实验表明，EviDARL 在受限的模型与训练预算下显著超越有竞争力的开源模型和多表推理基线。
translation.brief: 针对多表问答缺乏可验证中间轨迹和证据分散的问题，提出证据中心双智能体框架 EviDA，并用细粒度奖励的交替强化学习 EviDARL 训练两智能体协作。

papers.title: Agent Trajectories as Evidence for Software Quality Assurance
papers.abstract: Autonomous software agents increasingly plan, implement, and test software with limited human oversight. Their decisions may introduce implicit assumptions that final code and passing tests do not adequately expose. We propose analyzing observable agent trajectories alongside software and agent specifications and AI generated artifacts as evidence for targeted quality assurance. The aim is to prioritize consequential decisions for scrutiny, investigate their possible contribution to software problems, and inform improvements to specifications and development practices. Industrial experience motivates the idea; available execution records and preliminary analysis methods make it plausible. However, trajectories alone do not establish that decisions are justified, outcomes acceptable, or corrective changes effective. We ask how this evidence can support review, diagnosis, and continuous quality improvement, and when simpler QA approaches suffice. Perspectives from requirements engineering, verification and validation, agent systems, causal inference, empirical software engineering, and human factors could help develop and evaluate the idea.

translation.title: Agent轨迹作为软件质量保证的证据
translation.abstract: 自主软件Agent在极少人类监督下日益承担软件的规划、实现与测试。其决策可能引入隐式假设，而最终代码和通过的测试无法充分暴露这些假设。我们提出将可观察的Agent轨迹与软件及Agent规格说明、AI生成的制品一同分析，作为面向目标的质量保证的证据。其目标是优先筛选值得审查的关键决策，调查其对软件问题的可能贡献，并为改进规格说明和开发实践提供依据。工业界的经验激发了这一想法；现有的执行记录和初步分析方法使其具有可行性。然而，仅凭轨迹并不能证明决策是合理的、结果是可接受的或纠正性更改是有效的。我们探究这些证据如何支持评审、诊断和持续质量改进，以及何时更简单的QA方法已足够。来自需求工程、验证与确认、Agent系统、因果推断、实证软件工程和人因工程的观点有助于开发和评估这一想法。
translation.brief: 针对自主编码Agent决策引入的隐式缺陷难以被代码与测试暴露的问题，提出分析Agent轨迹作为质量保证证据来定位关键决策并支持评审与诊断。

papers.title: PVTSizing 2.0: A Fast and Reliable Analog Circuit Sizing Operator for Agentic EDA Workflows
papers.abstract: Analog circuit design automation requires both coordinated tool execution and efficient numerical search. Large language models (LLMs) offer new ways to organize tool execution, but finding one sizing that satisfies specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners remains costly. PVTSizing 2.0 addresses these needs through a human-agent workflow built around an independently usable numerical optimizer. An agent carries the designer's approved task through execution and result review. The optimizer reduces unnecessary training through loss-guided updates and uses critic-guided local refinement to explore additional candidates while accounting for cross-corner conflicts. An optional LLM adviser supplies parameter relationships to focus numerical search on circuit-informed directions, while the optimizer selects adjustment amplitudes and verifies their effects through simulation. Across four circuit benchmarks, the standalone optimizer completes all 40 runs and achieves a 7.3x speedup in overall mean runtime over the original PVTSizing, with a comparable mean sample count. In a separate study, the best tested knowledge-injection configuration further reduces mean runtime by 39.9% and simulation samples by 35.4% relative to the standalone optimizer.

translation.title: PVTSizing 2.0：面向Agentic EDA工作流的快速可靠的模拟电路尺寸优化算子
translation.abstract: 模拟电路设计自动化既需要协调的工具执行，也需要高效的数值搜索。大语言模型（LLM）为组织工具执行提供了新途径，但找到一项在工艺、电压、温度（PVT）各corner下均满足规格的尺寸设计仍然代价高昂。PVTSizing 2.0通过一个以可独立使用的数值优化器为核心的人机协同工作流来满足这些需求。Agent负责执行设计师已批准的任务并进行结果审查。优化器通过损失引导的更新减少不必要的训练，并利用critic引导的局部细化在考虑跨corner冲突的同时探索更多候选。可选的LLM顾问提供参数关系信息，将数值搜索聚焦于电路知识指导的方向，而优化器选择调整幅度并通过仿真验证其效果。在四个电路基准上，独立优化器完成了全部40次运行，整体平均运行时间相比原PVTSizing加速7.3倍，平均采样数相当。在另一项研究中，所测试的最佳知识注入配置相比独立优化器进一步将平均运行时间降低39.9%、仿真采样数降低35.4%。
translation.brief: 针对跨PVT corner的模拟电路尺寸优化代价高的问题，构建以数值优化器为核心、由Agent协调执行并结合可选LLM知识注入的人机协同工作流。

papers.title: MoL-SQL: A Controlled Benchmark for Mixture-of-Language Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems are usually built and evaluated under a monolingual assumption, yet in international applications users often query databases stored in a different language. Existing multilingual benchmarks mostly translate only the question without aligning schema and value entities, so they can neither locate the source of an accuracy drop nor rule out translation errors. Hence, we introduce MoL-SQL, a benchmark for mixture-of-language Text-to-SQL that switches the languages of the question, schema, and stored values independently while keeping each task fixed, and grades every cross-lingual entity mapping into four difficulty levels. We migrate five Text-to-SQL benchmarks of different domains and source languages through a unified alignment pipeline that builds a shared cross-lingual entity map, migrates each database with its constraints, rewrites the gold SQL under execution-equivalence checks, and regenerates the question from the verified SQL, keeping all language versions of a task aligned in entities, intent, and execution result. MoL-SQL provides two splits: MoL-Full (16,892 samples) for overall evaluation and MoL-Cube (3,840 samples) covering every language combination to isolate question, schema, and value effects. Experiments with eight LLMs and four families of Text-to-SQL methods show that schema and value languages have distinct effects, with stored values costing up to 23 points, and that these effects mainly stem from cross-lingual entity mapping. Neither question translation nor additional reasoning narrows the value gap, whereas access to target-database values substantially reduces it, indicating that mixture-of-language Text-to-SQL benefits most from language-aware context grounding.

translation.title: MoL-SQL：混合语言Text-to-SQL的可控基准
translation.abstract: Text-to-SQL系统通常在单语假设下构建和评估，但在国际化应用中，用户常以另一种语言查询以不同语言存储的数据库。现有多语言基准大多仅翻译问题而不对齐schema和值实体，因此既无法定位准确率下降的来源，也无法排除翻译错误。为此，我们提出MoL-SQL，一个混合语言Text-to-SQL基准，它在保持每个任务不变的前提下独立切换问题、schema和存储值的语言，并将每个跨语言实体映射划分为四个难度等级。我们通过统一的对齐流水线迁移了五个不同领域和源语言的Text-to-SQL基准：构建共享的跨语言实体映射，连同约束迁移每个数据库，在执行等价性检查下重写gold SQL，并从验证后的SQL重新生成问题，使任务的所有语言版本在实体、意图和执行结果上保持对齐。MoL-SQL提供两个划分：MoL-Full（16,892条样本）用于整体评估，MoL-Cube（3,840条样本）覆盖所有语言组合以隔离问题、schema和值的影响。对八个LLM和四类Text-to-SQL方法的实验表明，schema语言与值语言的影响各不相同，存储值最多造成23分的损失，且这些影响主要源于跨语言实体映射。问题翻译和额外推理均无法缩小值差距，而访问目标数据库的值则能显著缩小差距，这表明混合语言Text-to-SQL最能从语言感知的上下文接地中受益。
translation.brief: 针对现有多语言Text-to-SQL基准不对齐schema与值实体、无法定位性能下降来源的问题，构建可独立切换问题、schema和值语言的混合语言基准并对实体映射分级。

papers.title: Comparing Implicit and Explicit Language Attitudes toward the Dutch multiethnolect Straattaal in Humans and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: While language attitudes have been extensively studied in humans, the extent to which large language models (LLMs) encode similar associations between language varieties and social attributes remains unclear. Contemporary sociolinguistic research distinguishes between explicit attitudes, which stem from deliberative processing, and implicit attitudes, which arise from automatic processing. This study investigates whether LLMs exhibit human-like implicit and explicit language attitudes toward the Dutch multiethnolect Straattaal, particularly its association with migrant communities. We use closely matched designs to assess attitudes in humans and LLMs. For humans, we use an Implicit Association Test (IAT) and an explicit rating task. For LLMs, we use the LLM Word Association Test (LLM WAT) and the same explicit rating task. Human participants strongly associate Straattaal with individuals with a migration background at both implicit and explicit levels. In the LLM WAT, Straattaal is consistently associated with individuals with a migration background, with stronger associations observed in larger and newer models. When presented with the same explicit rating task as human participants, LLMs produce comparable response patterns. Overall, the findings suggest that many LLMs encode language attitudes resembling those observed in humans, however we also highlight important questions about how concepts and measures developed to study human attitudes should be interpreted in LLMs. This highlights the relevance of incorporating sociolinguistic perspectives and language variation into NLP research to better identify and mitigate socially and linguistically embedded biases.

translation.title: 比较人类与大型语言模型对荷兰语多民族方言Straattaal的隐式与显式语言态度
translation.abstract: 语言态度在人类中已被广泛研究，但大型语言模型（LLM）在多大程度上编码了语言变体与社会属性之间类似的关联仍不清楚。当代社会语言学研究区分源于审慎加工的显式态度和源于自动加工的隐式态度。本研究考察LLM是否对荷兰语多民族方言Straattaal表现出类人的隐式与显式语言态度，尤其是其与移民群体的关联。我们采用紧密匹配的设计来评估人类和LLM的态度。对人类，我们使用内隐联想测验（IAT）和显式评分任务。对LLM，我们使用LLM词语联想测验（LLM WAT）和相同的显式评分任务。人类参与者在隐式和显式层面都将Straattaal与有移民背景的个体强烈关联。在LLM WAT中，Straattaal始终与有移民背景的个体相关联，且在更大、更新的模型中关联更强。当面对与人类参与者相同的显式评分任务时，LLM产生类似的反应模式。总体而言，研究结果表明许多LLM编码了与人类观察到的相似的语言态度，但我们也强调了一些重要问题，即为研究人类态度而发展的概念和测量方法在LLM中应如何解释。这凸显了在NLP研究中纳入社会语言学视角和语言变异的重要性，以更好地识别和缓解社会和语言层面的内在偏见。
translation.brief: 针对LLM是否编码与人类类似的语言态度这一问题，用IAT与LLM词语联想测验等匹配设计比较人类和模型对荷兰语方言Straattaal的隐式与显式态度。

papers.title: Reliable Evaluation of AI Agents for Investment Research: A Framework for Performance and Validity Assessment
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of evaluating AI agents undertaking investment-research tasks, where agents interact with external information sources and computational tools to produce financial analyses and research reports. An important challenge is that the quality of an agent's final output does not necessarily reflect the quality of its execution process, while the reliability of the resulting assessment also depends on the validity of the evaluation procedure. Furthermore, investment-research tasks differ considerably in their requirements for numerical accuracy, information retrieval, financial analysis and supporting evidence, making it difficult to assess agent performance using a uniform set of criteria. We propose a domain-oriented evaluation framework that distinguishes outcome quality from execution quality and accommodates these differences through task-specific criteria, deterministic validators and independent large language model judges. We also introduce an evaluation-validity mechanism that examines the integrity of evaluation inputs, reference information, supporting evidence and grading outputs, with expert review used to resolve identified deficiencies and significant grading disagreements. Numerical results show that the proposed framework can distinguish differences in agent performance across evaluation dimensions, while identifying potential reliability issues in the evaluation process. The associated implementation and evaluation materials will be made available on GitHub.

translation.title: 投资研究AI Agent的可靠评估：性能与效度评估框架
translation.abstract: 我们研究评估承担投资研究任务的AI Agent的问题，这类Agent与外部信息源和计算工具交互以生成金融分析和研究报告。一个重要挑战是Agent最终输出的质量并不必然反映其执行过程的质量，而评估结果的可靠性还取决于评估程序本身的效度。此外，投资研究任务在数值精度、信息检索、金融分析和支撑证据方面的要求差异很大，使得用统一的标准集评估Agent性能十分困难。我们提出一个面向领域的评估框架，区分结果质量与执行质量，并通过任务特定标准、确定性验证器和独立的大语言模型评委来适应这些差异。我们还引入一个评估效度机制，检查评估输入、参考信息、支撑证据和评分输出的完整性，并以专家评审来解决发现的缺陷和重大的评分分歧。数值结果表明，所提框架能够区分Agent在各评估维度上的性能差异，同时识别评估过程中的潜在可靠性问题。相关实现与评估材料将在GitHub上提供。
translation.brief: 针对投资研究Agent评估中输出质量与执行过程脱节、任务标准不一的问题，提出区分结果与执行质量、结合任务特定标准和评估效度检查的领域导向评估框架。

papers.title: Bad Apples in the Kitchen: How LLM Teams Detect, Correct, and Calibrate Against Their Misaligned Members
papers.abstract: What protects an LLM team when one teammate quietly goes wrong? Most multi-agent LLM work assumes cooperative partners and inspects chat between turns before acting. Real-time embodied cooperation does not allow this pause: chat runs alongside action, so a teammate whose words stay cooperative while behavior diverges can cause damage faster than the team can name what is happening. We study this case by injecting three theory-grounded misaligned agents into a custom four-player Overcooked environment, each stressing a different joint-action layer (speech-action mismatch, role invasion, and aggregate-progress disruption), and decompose robustness into three sequential gates of detection, correction, and calibration through a 3x4x2 design (n=720 episodes). Nearly all trolls are eventually named, but recovery follows only when attribution and situational diagnosis appear in the same utterance; direct source-attribution prompting improves the hardest case only by degrading the troll-free baseline by 37.5%. Robustness, then, depends less on detection alone than on whether team chat combines attribution with diagnosis in a single utterance, suggesting that sensitivity to misalignment should be targeted rather than uniformly raised.

translation.title: 厨房里的坏苹果：LLM团队如何检测、纠正并校准其失配成员
translation.abstract: 当团队中某个成员悄悄出错时，是什么保护着LLM团队？大多数多智能体LLM工作假设伙伴是合作的，并在行动前检查轮次间的对话。实时具身协作不允许这种停顿：对话与行动并行进行，因此一个言语保持合作但行为偏离的队友可能在团队弄清状况之前就造成损害。我们通过在一个定制的四人Overcooked环境中注入三个基于理论构建的失配智能体来研究这一情形，每个智能体针对不同的联合行动层（言语-行动不匹配、角色侵入和总体进度破坏），并通过3x4x2设计（n=720回合）将鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正和校准三个顺序门控。几乎所有捣乱者最终都能被指认，但只有当归因和情境诊断出现在同一句话中时才会发生恢复；直接的来源归因提示在最难的场景中仅有改进，却使无捣乱者基线下降37.5%。因此，鲁棒性更多取决于团队对话能否在单句话中结合归因与诊断，而非仅靠检测，这表明对失配的敏感性应是有针对性的提升而非均匀提升。
translation.brief: 研究实时具身协作中LLM团队对行为失配成员的应对，通过在Overcooked环境中注入三类失配智能体，分解并分析检测、纠正、校准三个鲁棒性环节。

papers.title: Computing EF1 Allocations with Few Value Queries
papers.abstract: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that allocates $m$ indivisible goods among $n$ agents with nonnegative additive valuations using $O(n^5\log^2 m)$ value queries and guarantees envy-freeness up to one good (EF1). Concurrent work of Lin, Liu, Tao, and Zhou achieves $O(n^8\log m)$ comparison queries, attaining the optimal $O(\log m)$ dependence on $m$ for fixed $n$. Each comparison query can be simulated using two value queries, so their bound also holds for value queries. Our contributions are a much simpler algorithm and proofs, and polynomial-time computation.

translation.title: 用少量价值查询计算EF1分配
translation.abstract: 我们给出一个确定性多项式时间算法，在n个代理具有非负加性估值的情况下分配m个不可分物品，仅使用O(n^5 log^2 m)次价值查询并保证无嫉妒性至多一个物品（EF1）。Lin、Liu、Tao和Zhou的同期工作使用O(n^8 log m)次比较查询，在固定n时达到对m的最优O(log m)依赖。每次比较查询可以用两次价值查询模拟，因此其界也适用于价值查询。我们的贡献是一个更为简单的算法与证明，以及多项式时间计算。
translation.brief: 提出一个用O(n^5 log^2 m)次价值查询计算EF1公平分配的更简单确定性多项式时间算法。

papers.title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. On FinancePSS-205, RICoT matches or outperforms pairwise and windowed prompting with the same backbone for each of three open-weight LLMs; on a TABME test subset, RICoT with GLM-5 reaches document F1 0.847 and boundary F1 0.915, above published zero-shot results. A 2B-parameter student, trained on a larger teacher's decisions with and without the page-level reasoning, performs comparably in both modes and comes within 0.05 document F1 of the strongest prompted model on FinancePSS-205.

translation.title: RICoT：用于页面流分割的循环交错思维链
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）重新点燃了人们对页面流分割（PSS）——将多页文件拆分为其组成文档——的兴趣。然而已发表的LLM方法仍将该任务框架化为对一个或少数相邻页面的边界分类，而商业文档拆分API并不公开其方法。我们将面向LLM的PSS重新构想为对整个流的一个顺序过程，并提出RICoT（循环交错思维链），一个像读者一样逐页处理的提示框架：在滑动窗口内，它对每一页进行推理并在继续之前提交边界决策；跨窗口时，它携带一份已读内容的紧凑记录，使每次调用成本保持有界。我们还引入FinancePSS-205，一个包含205个真实、去标识化金融页面流的基准，并将公开发布。在FinancePSS-205上，RICoT在三种开源权重LLM上均与或优于使用相同骨干的两两和窗口提示方法；在TABME测试子集上，RICoT结合GLM-5达到文档F1 0.847和边界F1 0.915，超过已发表的零样本结果。一个2B参数的学生模型，在更大教师模型的决策上分别以有和无页面级推理的方式训练，在两种模式下表现相当，并在FinancePSS-205上与最强的提示模型文档F1差距在0.05以内。
translation.brief: 将页面流分割重构为LLM对全流的顺序处理过程，提出循环交错思维链提示框架RICoT及FinancePSS-205基准。

papers.title: Deal With It: On Better Schedules for Listwise Reranking
papers.abstract: Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faster than BlitzRank with concurrent first calls up to a thousand candidates. There, it needs three rounds and is eleven times faster than the sliding window. In existing schedules such as BlitzRank, dealing reduces repair calls from 59% of queries to 14%, improving latency with no significant change in quality. Random partitioning appears equivalent at a quota of four, as predicted, but ties results to the seed and trails by 1.3 nDCG@10 points at a quota of one over a dense retriever.

translation.title: Deal With It：论列表式重排序的更优调度方案
translation.abstract: 列表式LLM重排序器无法在单次调用中可靠地对数百个文档排序，因而依赖调度方案来编排其调用。并行调度将候选分成若干组，并从每组推进固定配额。当一组中包含的顶级段落多于其配额时，部分会被裁剪，从而需要昂贵的修复调用。我们证明，候选的划分方式在配额可能约束之处至关重要，且就期望裁剪数而言，那里的最优划分是按检索器排名像发牌一样轮发候选。虽然该思路并非全新，但发牌方式一直未被分析。我们证明，在简单的检索器模型下，在同等配额的划分中没有哪个能在平均意义上比发牌更少裁剪真实前十个结果，且连续分块在检索器改进时裁剪更多。DealRank是我们分析所允许的最简单调度，在六个LLM上、两轮调用中，其nDCG@10平均与最佳调度相差不超过0.1分。在最多一千个候选的情况下，它比BlitzRank配合并发首调快1.1到1.4倍。在那里，它需要三轮，且比滑动窗口快十一倍。在BlitzRank等现有调度中，发牌将修复调用从59%的查询降至14%，在不显著改变质量的情况下改善延迟。随机划分在配额为四时如预期般等效，但结果依赖随机种子，且在稠密检索器、配额为一时落后1.3个nDCG@10分。
translation.brief: 分析列表式重排序中候选划分方式对配额裁剪的影响，证明按检索器排名轮发候选是最优划分并据此提出更快的DealRank调度。

papers.title: More Than a Score: Reinforcement Learning with Verbalized Feedback for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for generative recommendation, where recommended items are generated directly from users' interaction histories. To further improve recommendation quality, reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to align these models with recommendation objectives. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar rewards to implicitly guide exploration. These rewards do not specify which aspects of a candidate conflict with the user's preferences or how the next candidate should differ. To address this gap, we propose VerRec, a verbalized feedback-guided RL framework for generative recommendation. Specifically, a user simulator generates personalized verbalized feedback based on the user's historical preferences and the candidate item profile. The policy uses this feedback to produce refined recommendations. Original and refined candidates form an expanded group and are jointly optimized with group relative policy optimization. The user simulator is only required during training and is removed at inference time. Experiments on three Amazon review datasets with two generative recommendation backbones demonstrate that VerRec improves recommendation accuracy and ranking quality. Further analyses show that verbalized guidance encourages exploration of more diverse candidates and helps the policy discover more rewarding recommendations during training.

translation.title: 不止一个分数：面向生成式推荐的言语化反馈强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于生成式推荐，即直接从用户的交互历史生成推荐物品。为进一步提升推荐质量，强化学习（RL）已被应用于使这些模型与推荐目标对齐。然而，现有RL方法依赖标量奖励来隐式引导探索。这些奖励既不说明候选物品的哪些方面与用户偏好冲突，也不说明下一个候选应如何不同。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出VerRec，一个面向生成式推荐的言语化反馈引导RL框架。具体而言，用户模拟器基于用户历史偏好和候选物品画像生成个性化的言语化反馈。策略利用该反馈生成改进后的推荐。原始与改进的候选项组成扩展组，并通过组相对策略优化进行联合训练。用户模拟器仅在训练时需要，推理时被移除。在三个Amazon评论数据集、两个生成式推荐骨干上的实验表明，VerRec提升了推荐准确率和排序质量。进一步分析显示，言语化引导鼓励对更多样候选的探索，帮助策略在训练中发现更有价值的推荐。
translation.brief: 针对标量奖励无法指明候选缺陷的问题，提出VerRec框架，用用户模拟器的言语化反馈结合组相对策略优化来改进生成式推荐的RL训练。

papers.title: KD-DSE: A Knowledge-Driven LLM Framework for Fast Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
papers.abstract: Domain-specific architectures have made design space exploration (DSE) a bottleneck of processor design, yet each candidate costs a full simulation, so exhaustive search is out of reach. Surrogate models need thousands of simulations before they predict reliably, and LLM agents that search directly hallucinate, lack cold-start architectural knowledge, and follow a fixed per-round policy. We present KD-DSE, a knowledge- driven LLM framework for fast microarchitecture DSE. KD- DSE couples a five-state constrained agent with real gem5- McPAT evaluation, retrieves architect-curated guidance from an Architecture Knowledge Base conditioned on the current search state and bottleneck diagnosis, and allocates its budget with a diagnosis-guided two-phase exploration strategy. On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base. These results indicate that constraining LLM reasoning and grounding it in architectural knowledge can drive fast and effective microarchitecture DSE. The code will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

translation.title: KD-DSE：面向快速微架构设计空间探索的知识驱动LLM框架
translation.abstract: 领域专用架构使设计空间探索（DSE）成为处理器设计的瓶颈，然而每个候选设计都需要完整仿真，穷举搜索难以实现。代理模型需要数千次仿真后才能可靠预测，而直接搜索的LLM智能体则存在幻觉问题、缺乏冷启动所需的架构知识，且每轮策略固定。我们提出KD-DSE，一个面向快速微架构DSE的知识驱动LLM框架。KD-DSE将五状态约束智能体与真实的gem5-McPAT评估相结合，根据当前搜索状态和瓶颈诊断从架构知识库中检索由架构师整理的指导信息，并通过诊断引导的两阶段探索策略分配预算。在一个29参数乱序核心、预算为18次仿真的设置下，KD-DSE相比最先进的MicroEvo实现了约4.8%更高的hypervolume和约21.7%更低的ADRS，消融实验将这一增益主要归因于知识库。这些结果表明，约束LLM推理并将其植根于架构知识可以驱动快速有效的微架构DSE。代码将在录用后开源。
translation.brief: 针对微架构设计空间探索仿真成本高、LLM直接搜索缺乏架构知识的问题，提出知识库检索与诊断引导两阶段策略约束的LLM智能体框架KD-DSE。

papers.title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: SpatialMind：面向多模态大语言模型空间推理的自适应多层次几何融合
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在2D视觉理解方面展现出良好能力，但在3D空间推理方面仍然受限。近期研究探索将3D重建模型集成到MLLM中，然而这些方法要么对所有任务使用单一几何粒度，要么采用固定的多层次融合方案，不考虑任务特定的推理需求。通过对多层次几何融合的系统性实验，我们发现处于不同认知层次的空间任务（如距离估计与路线规划）需要不同粒度的几何表示，这表明固定融合无法满足多样化的空间推理需求。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SpatialMind，一个动态集成多层次几何表示的任务自适应框架。SpatialMind采用GeoFus——一个围绕门控网络构建的多层几何融合模块，该门控网络以文本指令、视觉语义和几何表示为联合条件，自适应地调节浅层、中层和深层几何特征在LLM解码器各层中的贡献。此外，我们引入负熵正则化损失以缓解门控坍塌。门控可视化表明GeoFus能根据任务需求自适应调整几何粒度。实验表明SpatialMind在多个空间基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，在VSI-Bench上达到72.3的最先进分数。源代码已公开。
translation.brief: 针对MLLM空间推理中固定几何融合粒度不适配多样任务的问题，提出基于门控网络的任务自适应多层次几何融合框架SpatialMind。

papers.title: CutAgent: Creative-Gene-Driven Planning and Experience-Guided Self-Refinement for High-CTR E-commerce Advertising Video Creation
papers.abstract: E-commerce advertising video creation requires both high-level creative planning and reliable multi-modal production. However, existing methods often map product attributes directly to scripts or editing decisions without explicitly modeling advertising strategies, narrative structures, and production styles. They also have limited ability to reuse past production failures. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{CutAgent}$, a dual-agent framework that formulates advertising video creation as a Plan--Execute--Self-Evolve process. CutAgent comprises two collaborative agents, $\textbf{GeneAgent}$ and $\textbf{VideoAgent}$, connected by a structured creative gene that bridges product understanding and video production. GeneAgent maps multi-modal product inputs---textual attributes together with product images---to creative genes that specify narrative units and production rules. To train GeneAgent, we construct $\textbf{CutAgent-70K}$ with approximately 70K samples of product attributes/images, reverse-extracted creative genes, cleaned clip pools, and real-world CTR, and apply high-CTR supervised fine-tuning followed by CTR-guided GRPO. Guided by the generated gene, VideoAgent retrieves category-then-gene failure--correction experiences from a long-term memory as constraints for shot-script planning, then coordinates material retrieval, narration, subtitles, music, and timeline rendering. Independently, a reflection loop diagnoses quality defects, revises deficient production decisions, and writes verified corrections back to memory for later retrieval. Experiments on $\textbf{CutAgent-Eval}$ show that CutAgent outperforms representative baselines in e-commerce advertising video creation, achieving the highest online CTR of $\textbf{2.21\%}$.

translation.title: CutAgent：面向高CTR电商广告视频创作的创意基因驱动规划与经验引导自优化
translation.abstract: 电商广告视频创作既需要高层次的创意规划，也需要可靠的多模态制作。然而现有方法往往将产品属性直接映射为脚本或剪辑决策，未能显式建模广告策略、叙事结构和制作风格，且复用历史制作失败经验的能力有限。针对这些局限，我们提出CutAgent，一个将广告视频创作形式化为规划—执行—自我进化过程的双智能体框架。CutAgent包含两个协作智能体GeneAgent和VideoAgent，通过结构化创意基因连接产品理解与视频制作。GeneAgent将多模态产品输入——文本属性与产品图片——映射为指定叙事单元和制作规则的创意基因。为训练GeneAgent，我们构建了CutAgent-70K数据集，包含约7万条产品属性/图片、反向提取的创意基因、清洗后的片段池和真实CTR，并应用高CTR监督微调与CTR引导的GRPO。在生成基因的引导下，VideoAgent从长期记忆中检索先类别后基因的失败—纠正经验作为分镜脚本规划的约束，随后协调素材检索、旁白、字幕、音乐和时间线渲染。此外，独立运行的反思循环诊断质量缺陷、修改不当制作决策，并将验证后的纠正写回记忆以供后续检索。在CutAgent-Eval上的实验表明，CutAgent在电商广告视频创作中优于代表性基线，达到2.21%的最高在线CTR。
translation.brief: 针对电商广告视频创作缺乏广告策略显式建模与失败经验复用的问题，提出创意基因连接的双智能体Plan–Execute–Self-Evolve框架CutAgent，并用CTR引导训练。

papers.title: LMMR: Learned Multigranular Memory Retrieval for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Small language model agents have limited space to read the memory needed for multi-hop questions. Relevant facts are often scattered across records whose surrounding text consumes much of that space. We propose LMMR, a learned multigranular memory retrieval method that selects both the next source and how much of it to read. LMMR links paragraphs and sentence fragments to their original sources and pairs views that supply the same missing support during training. Relevant distractors and repeated information provide contrasting examples. At inference, the reranker scores what each candidate adds to an anchor passage, and a selector chooses the evidence within a token budget. On 22,398 official validation questions from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, a frozen 2B answer model reaches 61.47, 43.26, and 30.58 F1 under a 400-token budget. The gains over query expansion are 3.06, 2.14, and 4.55 points, while memory input decreases by 23.1-26.9%. LMMR also uses 23.5-27.7% fewer input tokens than a coarse retriever trained on the same questions. Against that retriever followed by LLMLingua-2 at comparable input lengths, F1 gains reach 3.99 points and are significant on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA after Holm correction. All eight small answer models evaluated on HotpotQA improve over query expansion and MMR in both F1 and exact match.

translation.title: LMMR：面向小语言模型智能体的学习型多粒度记忆检索
translation.abstract: 小语言模型智能体读取多跳问题所需记忆的空间有限。相关事实往往分散在多条记录中，其周围文本消耗了大量空间。我们提出LMMR，一种学习型多粒度记忆检索方法，可同时选择下一个来源及其读取量。LMMR将段落和句子片段与其原始来源关联，并在训练中配对提供相同缺失支持的视图，相关干扰项和重复信息则提供对比样本。推理时，重排序器评估每个候选对锚定段落的增量贡献，选择器在token预算内选择证据。在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA和MuSiQue共22,398个官方验证问题上，冻结的2B答案模型在400-token预算下分别达到61.47、43.26和30.58的F1。相比查询扩展，增益分别为3.06、2.14和4.55分，同时记忆输入减少23.1–26.9%。LMMR相比在相同问题上训练的粗粒度检索器，输入token减少23.5–27.7%。与该检索器后接LLMLingua-2在可比输入长度下相比，F1增益达3.99分，且经Holm校正后在HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA上显著。在HotpotQA上评估的八个小型答案模型均超越了查询扩展和MMR的F1与精确匹配成绩。
translation.brief: 针对小模型智能体记忆读取空间受限、相关事实分散的问题，提出学习型的同时选择记忆来源与读取粒度的多粒度检索方法LMMR。

papers.title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness
papers.abstract: Fast System-1 models enable responsive actions but struggle with complex or unfamiliar tasks. Large language model (LLM)-based System-2 provides strong reasoning capabilities, yet repeated invocation incurs substantial latency and computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose JevRSI, a System-1/System-2 collaboration framework that transforms LLM reasoning into transferable decision support through recursive harness improvement. A Jev-style System-1 model enables low-latency action selection, while an asynchronous System-2 LLM develops a modular harness. The harness integrates procedures, state memory, and world models to provide decision contexts spanning the past, present, and future. Utility-driven retrieval selects modules based on both contextual relevance and their utility on previous tasks. Environmental feedback guides targeted revisions and enables recursive self-improvement. Experiments across three datasets show that JevRSI consistently improves decision quality, matching or surpassing LLM agents in several settings. It preserves low-latency execution with favorable performance-cost trade-offs. Moreover, System-2 development interventions decrease as the harness evolves, amortizing System-2 costs through continuous improvement. Our project is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Think Once, Act Fast：面向决策模型工具架的低成本递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 快速System-1模型能够实现响应式动作，但在复杂或陌生任务上表现不佳。基于LLM的System-2具备强大推理能力，然而反复调用会带来显著的延迟和计算成本。为弥合这一差距，我们提出JevRSI，一个System-1/System-2协作框架，通过递归式工具架改进将LLM推理转化为可迁移的决策支持。Jev式的System-1模型实现低延迟动作选择，而异步的System-2 LLM开发模块化工具架。该工具架集成了流程、状态记忆和世界模型，提供涵盖过去、现在和未来的决策上下文。效用驱动的检索基于上下文相关性和模块在历史任务上的效用选择模块。环境反馈引导针对性修订并实现递归自我改进。在三个数据集上的实验表明，JevRSI持续提升决策质量，在若干设置中匹敌或超越LLM智能体，同时保持低延迟执行和良好的性能-成本权衡。此外，随着工具架的演进，System-2开发干预逐渐减少，通过持续改进摊销System-2成本。项目已公开。
translation.brief: 针对System-1模型难以处理复杂任务、LLM System-2反复调用成本高的问题，提出System-1低延迟执行与System-2异步构建可递归自我改进的模块化工具架的协作框架JevRSI。

papers.title: Where Demand Meets Supply: Spatial Elastic Consensus for Low-Bandwidth Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract: Occlusions and limited sensor range make ego-only 3D perception insufficient for safe driving. Collaborative perception addresses this by enabling connected vehicles to share complementary observations, yet it remains constrained by tight vehicular communication budgets. While spatial selection is more flexible than fixed-rate feature compression, existing selectors remain largely sender-driven and waste scarce bandwidth on ego-visible targets. Furthermore, applying convolutions after masking spreads isolated tokens into their neighborhoods, silently violating low-bandwidth constraints. To address this, we propose Spatial Elastic Consensus (SEC), a bandwidth-adaptive framework centered on bilateral demand-supply consensus. Instead of unilateral token selection, the ego vehicle formulates a content-aware demand prior while each collaborator evaluates its local supply. This single-round consensus allocates the token budget to critical ego-missed evidence rather than ego-visible redundancy, without transmitting dense maps. To guarantee exact budget compliance, an anti-dilation refine-before-mask pipeline refines features prior to discrete token selection, preventing receptive-field leakage. A lightweight deformable sampler then aggregates these sparse messages with learned local offsets, compensating for the spatial context lost to token selection and mitigating inter-agent pose drift. Evaluated at a stringent 64KiB budget, SEC consistently achieves the best AP@0.7 on the simulated OPV2V and V2XSet datasets and the real-world DAIR-V2X dataset. These results demonstrate that combining bilateral consensus with budget-exact transmission is key to efficient low-bandwidth collaborative perception.

translation.title: Where Demand Meets Supply: Spatial Elastic Consensus for Low-Bandwidth Collaborative Perception
translation.abstract: Occlusions and limited sensor range make ego-only 3D perception insufficient for safe driving. Collaborative perception addresses this by enabling connected vehicles to share complementary observations, yet it remains constrained by tight vehicular communication budgets. While spatial selection is more flexible than fixed-rate feature compression, existing selectors remain largely sender-driven and waste scarce bandwidth on ego-visible targets. Furthermore, applying convolutions after masking spreads isolated tokens into their neighborhoods, silently violating low-bandwidth constraints. To address this, we propose Spatial Elastic Consensus (SEC), a bandwidth-adaptive framework centered on bilateral demand-supply consensus. Instead of unilateral token selection, the ego vehicle formulates a content-aware demand prior while each collaborator evaluates its local supply. This single-round consensus allocates the token budget to critical ego-missed evidence rather than ego-visible redundancy, without transmitting dense maps. To guarantee exact budget compliance, an anti-dilation refine-before-mask pipeline refines features prior to discrete token selection, preventing receptive-field leakage. A lightweight deformable sampler then aggregates these sparse messages with learned local offsets, compensating for the spatial context lost to token selection and mitigating inter-agent pose drift. Evaluated at a stringent 64KiB budget, SEC consistently achieves the best AP@0.7 on the simulated OPV2V and V2XSet datasets and the real-world DAIR-V2X dataset. These results demonstrate that combining bilateral consensus with budget-exact transmission is key to efficient low-bandwidth collaborative perception.

papers.title: PACD: Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding for Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations in Omnimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) integrate audio, video, and text for multimodal reasoning, yet remain vulnerable to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality improperly influences predictions about another. Existing training-free decoding methods mitigate these errors through modality perturbation or relevance-based weighting. However, due to interference from irrelevant modality cues during fusion and difficulty detecting shared errors, these methods may suppress correct unimodal predictions and allow erroneous consensus to persist. To address these limitations, we propose Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding (PACD), a training-free framework for mitigating cross-modal hallucinations. PACD comprises two complementary paths based on whether the branches reach consensus. For non-consensus cases, Relevance-Guided Candidate Arbitration identifies task-relevant unimodal evidence and selectively arbitrates between predictions using alternative candidates. For consensus cases, Provenance-Based Consensus Recovery leverages the outranking principle to evaluate the consistency and strength of layer-wise modality evidence for alternative answers, selectively resolving erroneous consensus under confidence constraints. Extensive experiments on four Omni-LLMs and five benchmarks across two tasks demonstrate the superiority of PACD. Compared to existing methods, PACD achieves up to 27.6% relative improvement over standard decoding across CMM, AVHBench, and SVHalluc for cross-modal hallucination mitigation, and an average relative improvement of 7.7% over best baseline across OmniVideoBench and FutureOmni for general audio-visual reasoning.

papers.title: Surfacing Disagreement Beats Resolving It: A Gated Ablation Study of Provenance-Weighted Memory for Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract: Shared memory for multi-agent debate is usually built to resolve inconsistency: retrieval returns one winning fact and the disagreement disappears before any agent sees it. We ask whether that is correct. In DebateGraph, four backends share one contract (read/write/snapshot), so five mechanisms from the agent-memory literature can be removed independently under a fixed budget, each gated on a pre-declared threshold. Across 39 runs one survives: preserving contradictions and passing the ranked conflict set to the debate, rather than collapsing it to a winner, improves F1 by +0.340 (95% CI [+0.267, +0.414]) and cuts attack success from 22 to 7 of 122 poisoned items (McNemar exact p=0.0003), at equal cost. Reaching it meant fixing a bottleneck in our harness: conflict sets are built only over retrieved edges, and our pre-declared cap left three quarters of planted contradictions unretrievable, first measuring the mechanism at +0.084. The effect replicates on two retrieval substrates and directionally on HotpotQA documents. No other mechanism survives, and two are worse than inert: once contradictions reach the prompt, a write trust-gate and the router's provenance features each cost accuracy (-0.075 and -0.096 F1). The gate fails structurally: poisoned objects are always entities the graph already contains, against 53% of gold, so groundedness scores the lie above a truthful first mention. We release the harness, attack set, and logs, and argue that silently reconciling memory is the assumption worth abandoning.

papers.title: MAVE: Reconstructing Editable 3D Blockouts from Film Shots
papers.abstract: Animated 3D blockouts support previsualization and provide structural conditions for video generation, but manually reconstructing them from reference videos is costly. This limits both their use by creators and the production of paired training data. We introduce MAVEBench, a benchmark of 50 film shots and 416 keyframes for evaluating camera motion, spatial layout, and character blocking. We propose MAVE, a video-to-blockout framework combining Metric observation, Agentic modeling, and evidence-based VErification. It first recovers cameras, human motion, and geometric evidence in a shared metric coordinate system. An agent then constructs an editable environment under constraints from these observations, while programmatic checks report inconsistencies to guide refinement. The outputs are editable Blender scenes and frame-aligned blockout videos. On MAVEBench, MAVE improves overall scores by 27.5-41.1 points across three agents over their corresponding vanilla baselines. With DeepSeek-1017, it achieves a score of 73.2 at an average API cost of only USD 0.054 per shot, outperforming the strongest vanilla baseline while reducing total reconstruction time by 53%. We also construct MAVEData-3K, a dataset of 3,000 blockout-video pairs for model training, and will release it publicly. Creators can change viewpoints and character paths, then render the edited scenes to condition video generation. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
papers.abstract: Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. Same-memory counterfactuals show that, in most settings, EKR pushes plans away from visited states, in navigation, often at a higher base cost; stuck episodes and revisits drop accordingly. In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute. Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from 44.7% to 100.0% and from 21.0% to 32.0% on long-horizon PointMaze and Push-T.

papers.title: RehearsalBench: Can AI Predict What Happens When You Change a Company?
papers.abstract: Organizations increasingly ask AI systems what will happen if they change how they operate: which work to automate, which team to resize, what a voice agent will do to waiting times. We introduce RehearsalBench, a benchmark that measures whether AI models can diagnose an operation, choose an intervention, and forecast its consequences. Each model is placed in a simulated bank contact center fitted to real call-level records, sees only what a manager would see, and submits a plan and forecasts that are then played out across 200 seeded futures and three plausible versions of the organization. Decisions are scored in dollars at the stakeholders' stated valuations; forecasts are scored on the effect of each change relative to doing nothing. Ten models made 280 attempts across 14 organizations. The best model, GPT-6 Astra, improved on doing nothing by 6.8% of the no-change cost and made 77% less forecast error than a forecaster who always predicts no effect. On average, every model forecast the direction of every specified effect correctly, but models erred on the size of the same effects in the same direction, overstating a voice agent's effect on repeat contacts about five-fold. No model ever recommended holding off when doing nothing was the right choice. To test external validity, twelve models forecast 33 real organizational changes with known outcomes. Under verdict rules fixed in advance, the benchmark's forecast ranking agreed with the real-world ranking (Spearman $\rho = 0.92$, 95% lower bound 0.50). We report the result alongside an inconclusive first test, the analysis choices made after outcomes were seen, and evidence that part of the agreement reflects how well models size their uncertainty.

translation.title: RehearsalBench：AI 能预测你改变公司时会发生什么吗？
translation.abstract: 组织越来越多地向 AI 系统询问如果改变运营方式会发生什么：哪些工作要自动化、哪个团队要调整规模、语音客服对等待时间有何影响。我们提出 RehearsalBench，一个衡量 AI 模型能否诊断运营、选择干预措施并预测其后果的基准。每个模型被置于一个基于真实通话级记录构建的模拟银行联络中心，只能看到管理者所能看到的信息，并提交计划与预测，随后在 200 个随机种子生成的未来场景和组织的三个合理版本中推演。决策按利益相关者声明的估值以美元计分；预测则按每项变化相对于不作为的效果评分。十个模型在 14 个组织中共进行了 280 次尝试。表现最好的模型 GPT-6 Astra 比不作为改善了 6.8% 的无变化成本，其预测误差比总是预测无效果的预测者低 77%。平均而言，每个模型都能正确预测每项指定效果的方向，但模型在同样效果的幅度上犯同样方向的错误，将语音客服对重复联系的影响高估了约五倍。在不作为才是正确选择时，没有任何模型建议暂缓行动。为检验外部效度，十二个模型对 33 次结果已知的真实组织变化进行了预测。在事先固定的判定规则下，该基准的预测排名与真实世界排名一致（Spearman ρ = 0.92，95% 置信下界 0.50）。我们在报告该结果的同时，也报告了一次无定论的首轮测试、在看到结果后做出的分析选择，以及部分一致性反映模型量化自身不确定性能力的证据。
translation.brief: 构建 RehearsalBench 基准，让 AI 模型在模拟组织场景中做出运营干预决策并预测后果，以评估其对组织变化的预测能力。

papers.title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
papers.abstract: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. We build the accelerator on the insights of the rich line of bit-level sparsity accelerators and design it and the planner tightly coupled as a single co-design: the planner increases sparsity and exposes structure for hardware scheduling, and the bit-exact hardware effectively uses the sparsity that the planner creates. On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy, and it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area. To our knowledge, our planner is the first planner that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity across its candidates and exposes its structure for hardware scheduling, and our co-design is the first algorithm-hardware co-design for JEPA-style world-model planning.

translation.title: 制造差分稀疏性：面向高效世界模型规划的规划器-硬件协同设计
translation.abstract: JEPA 风格的潜在世界模型让具身智能体能够用模型预测控制（MPC）规划新目标，但对真实具身控制而言仍然太慢：基于采样的 MPC 每次规划要重复预测器推理数万次，即使高端 GPU 上一个规划步骤也可能耗时数十秒。我们观察到这种重复推理工作负载中存在显著的潜在局部性：预测器将相近动作映射为相近潜在向量，而在量化预测器内部，这种相近性表现为硬件可利用的形式——差分位级稀疏性。与时间相似性既定的输入流不同，规划器自己决定一起评估哪些候选，因此可以自选参考，并通过参考森林采样制造更多稀疏性：它将每组的采样动作序列耦合到共享根节点，且规划质量不受影响。我们基于丰富的位级稀疏加速器研究构建加速器，并将其与规划器紧耦合为一个协同设计：规划器增加稀疏性并为硬件调度暴露结构，而位精确硬件有效利用规划器制造的稀疏性。在三个 JEPA 世界模型上，我们的协同设计比稠密加速器快 1.28–1.80 倍、能耗降低 38–52%，比先前的位稀疏设计快 1.22–1.58 倍、能耗降低 16–36%，面积相同。据我们所知，我们的规划器是首个在候选间制造差分位级稀疏性并为硬件调度暴露其结构的规划器，我们的协同设计是首个面向 JEPA 风格世界模型规划的算法-硬件协同设计。
translation.brief: 通过规划器自选参考的参考森林采样制造差分位级稀疏性，并与加速器协同设计，加速 JEPA 世界模型的基于采样 MPC 规划。

papers.title: Growing Clusters Lower the Bar: Profile Accretion in LLM-Based Incremental Entity Resolution
papers.abstract: Incremental entity resolution pipelines ask a large language model (LLM) whether a new record belongs to an existing cluster and show it the records already linked. Analyses of matching oracles assume that the answer depends only on the records compared. For the LLM matchers we test, it depends on cluster size, and the model lowers its bar for joining a cluster as the cluster grows. On French procurement suppliers from FOPPA, with SIREN identifiers as ground truth, we hold the new record fixed and vary only the number of verified members shown. Sixteen members instead of one raise the false match rate on similarly named companies by \dfmrMin--\dfmrMax{} percentage points in six open-weight models, while their area under the ROC curve rises by only \aucGainMin--\aucGainMax. In Claude Sonnet~5 and Haiku~5.5 the rise is \clSonD{} and \clHaiD{} points. The shift persists with street addresses, prompt variants and the BatchER and ComEM formats, and one false merge raises acceptance of the intruder's other records in every open model. It does not arise on Czech and Bulgarian TED notices, where one record with its full address already identifies the company. In online linking on confusable blocks, a single threshold set on labelled data raises recall by a factor of \fxRRmin--\fxRRmax{} for five models with no detectable loss of precision and no extra LLM calls.

translation.title: 簇越大门槛越低：基于 LLM 的增量实体消解中的画像累积效应
