translation.abstract: 增量实体消解流程让大语言模型（LLM）判断一条新记录是否属于某个已有簇，并向其展示已链接的记录。匹配预言机的分析假设答案只取决于所比较的记录。对我们测试的 LLM 匹配器而言，答案还取决于簇的大小，且随着簇的增大，模型加入簇的门槛会降低。在来自 FOPPA 的法国采购供应商数据上（以 SIREN 标识符作为真值），我们保持新记录不变，仅改变展示的已验证成员数量。在六个开放权重模型中，展示十六个成员而非一个成员，会使名称相似公司的误匹配率上升 \dfmrMin--\dfmrMax 个百分点，而其 ROC 曲线下面积仅上升 \aucGainMin--\aucGainMax。在 Claude Sonnet 5 和 Haiku 5.5 中，上升分别为 \clSonD 和 \clHaiD 个百分点。这一偏移在使用街道地址、不同 prompt 变体以及 BatchER 和 ComEM 格式时依然存在，且一次错误合并会提高所有开放模型对入侵者其他记录的接受度。在捷克和保加利亚的 TED 通知上不存在该现象，因为那里一条带完整地址的记录已足以标识公司。在易混淆数据块的在线链接中，仅用标注数据设置单个阈值，就能在可检测精度无损失、无额外 LLM 调用的情况下，使五个模型的召回率提升 \fxRRmin--\fxRRmax 倍。
translation.brief: 发现基于 LLM 的增量实体消解中匹配判断随簇大小增大而降低门槛的累积偏差，并利用该效应用单一阈值提升在线链接召回率。

papers.title: SciWorkBench: A Benchmark for Real Scientific Workflows
papers.abstract: Language models are increasingly being used as agents capable of planning and executing projects, as well as refining their actions through feedback. This shift raises a question: can current agents complete projects like real scientists? To examine this question, we introduce SciWorkBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' abilities on real science tasks across biology, chemistry, materials science, and physics. SciWorkBench is built from peer-reviewed literature or expert-contributed research scenarios. We also propose a unified scientific analysis framework validated by domain experts, which can categorize most tasks in SciWorkBench. Each task covers one or more stages of this framework. We evaluate up-to-date models within the Claude Code and Codex agent frameworks under a unified execution and grading protocol. The best-performing agent achieves a mean score of 57.38, indicating that current agents still struggle with realistic scientific workflows. Our failure analysis identifies three recurring weaknesses at the workflow level: difficulty translating scientific knowledge into task-specific procedures, weak integration of evidence across different modalities, and limited capacity for scientific self-correction. These findings highlight the importance of workflow-based evaluation for measuring progress toward reliable AI systems for scientific research.

translation.title: SciWorkBench：面向真实科学工作流的基准
translation.abstract: 语言模型越来越多地被用作能够规划和执行项目、并通过反馈改进行动的智能体。这一转变引出一个问题：当前的智能体能完成像真实科学家那样的项目吗？为考察这一问题，我们提出 SciWorkBench，一个评估智能体在生物学、化学、材料科学和物理学等真实科学任务上能力的基准。SciWorkBench 构建自同行评审文献或专家贡献的研究场景。我们还提出了一个经领域专家验证的统一科学分析框架，可对 SciWorkBench 中的大多数任务进行分类，每个任务覆盖该框架的一个或多个阶段。我们在统一的执行与评分协议下，在 Claude Code 和 Codex 智能体框架内评估了最新模型。表现最好的智能体平均得分为 57.38，表明当前智能体在真实科学工作流上仍有困难。我们的失败分析识别出工作流层面的三个反复出现的弱点：难以将科学知识转化为任务特定的操作流程、跨模态证据整合能力弱、以及科学自我纠错能力有限。这些发现凸显了基于工作流的评估对于衡量迈向可靠科研 AI 系统进展的重要性。
translation.brief: 构建 SciWorkBench 基准，用真实科学文献任务和统一分析框架评估智能体在多学科科学工作流中的执行能力。

papers.title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
papers.abstract: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

translation.title: 从相关性到效用：元宝搜索中的量规对齐
translation.abstract: Agentic 搜索要求搜索引擎超越单文档相关性排序，转而组装为下游 LLM 推理优化的文档集合。先前的工作要么孤立地改进各个流水线阶段，要么在基于相关性训练的上游模块之上应用基于 RL 的选择，使整个技术栈未与推理效用对齐。我们提出量规对齐搜索，一个将传统搜索流水线统一在单一监督界面下的框架。对每个查询，我们从粗到细推导量规，指定文档集合必须满足的加权正向标准和必须避免的负向标准。由该量规推导出两个训练信号。其一，轻量标注器将基于量规的判断蒸馏为逐文档效用标签，用于监督用于检索的对比双编码器和用四个量规对齐评分头训练的多任务排序器。其二，量规条件评估器产生集合级奖励，驱动双分支 RL 选择器，将 GRPO 与最佳 rollout 蒸馏相结合，以解决子集优化中的信用分配问题。该流水线已部署于元宝搜索，将端到端答案质量相比线上生产基线提升了 8.52%。
translation.brief: 提出量规对齐搜索框架，用查询级量规派生的效用标签和集合级 RL 奖励统一训练检索与排序流水线，使其面向 LLM 推理效用优化。

papers.title: LMLineage: Content Lineage and Context Governance for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Interpretability for AI agents should not be confined to understanding the model's internal weights. It must also cover the agent's reasoning and decision-making process over multi-source context. We present LMLineage, an out-of-band system that attributes every output sentence of an agent session to its supporting input spans with calibrated confidences, without requiring white-box access to the model or any additional inference passes. On top of the lineage metadata, we build concept-drift micro compaction: instead of waiting for the context-length limit and summarizing everything, the system detects when previously used input documents have stopped being referenced ("drifted") and surgically compacts only those, preserving user instructions verbatim. We evaluate on a multi-tier corpus: 71 gold annotated sentences from 10 Chinese web-QA cases, plus 90 turns of independently collected multi-turn sessions across three generator models (gpt-4o-mini, qwen3.8-27b, deepseek-v4-flash). Results show that (i) window-level embedding similarity is far better aligned with LLM paraphrasing than whole document or lexical matching; (ii) the greedy-window fast path is both faster and more accurate on average than exhaustive line-matching (a multiple-comparisons bias in the latter inflates web recall at the cost of overall accuracy); (iii) per-turn attribution completes in 1s on a single GPU, remaining stable as context accumulates to 40 turns; and (iv) concept-drift detection is conservative (0% false compaction) with recall bounded by attribution accuracy. We further describe the concept-drift micro compaction design and an interactive incident-tracing/memory-cleaning case study. A companion patent application covers the lineage construction method.

translation.title: LMLineage：面向LLM Agent的内容溯源与上下文治理
translation.abstract: AI Agent的可解释性不应局限于理解模型内部权重，还必须覆盖Agent在多源上下文上的推理与决策过程。我们提出LMLineage，一种带外系统，能将Agent会话的每个输出句子以校准后的置信度归因到其支撑的输入片段，且无需模型白盒访问或任何额外的推理过程。在溯源元数据之上，我们构建了概念漂移微压缩：系统不再等待达到上下文长度上限后对所有内容进行摘要，而是检测先前使用的输入文档何时不再被引用（即发生漂移），并仅对那些内容进行外科手术式压缩，同时逐字保留用户指令。我们在多层语料上进行评估：来自10个中文网页问答案例的71个金标注句子，以及跨三个生成模型（gpt-4o-mini、qwen3.8-27b、deepseek-v4-flash）独立收集的90轮多轮会话。结果表明：(i) 窗口级嵌入相似度与LLM复述的对齐程度远优于整文档或词汇匹配；(ii) 贪心窗口快速路径平均而言比穷举行匹配更快且更准确（后者的多重比较偏差以整体准确性为代价夸大了网页召回率）；(iii) 单轮归因在单块GPU上1秒内完成，且随上下文累积至40轮仍保持稳定；(iv) 概念漂移检测是保守的（0%误压缩），其召回率受归因准确性约束。我们进一步描述了概念漂移微压缩的设计，以及一个交互式事件追踪/记忆清理的案例研究。配套的专利申请涵盖了该溯源构建方法。
translation.brief: 解决Agent输出无法归因到输入上下文以及陈旧上下文占用空间的问题，核心方法是带外句子级溯源结合基于概念漂移的选择性微压缩。

papers.title: Missing Security-Fix Backporting for GitHub Actions Workflows
papers.abstract: GitHub natively supports workflow automation through GitHub Actions, now the dominant CI/CD tool on the platform. Yet keeping these workflows secure remains an ongoing burden: maintainers often patch a vulnerability on the default branch but leave the same flaw on the release and maintenance branches that downstream consumers continue to build from. Carrying a known fix onto these divergent branches, called backporting, is rarely done, and this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study quantifying the resulting gap. From a public corpus of GitHub Actions workflow histories, we mine 1,903,191 workflow-modifying commits, scan each before and after with the static scanner zizmor to identify 69,865 security fixes across 24,238 projects, and audit every release branch to check whether each fix was carried over. The gap is pervasive: 224,392 of 474,490 audited release branches remain vulnerable, and deliberate backporting is rare and slow, with only 19,476 of 78,907 already-fixed branches confirmed as plausible backports at a median lag of 243 days. We thus design WorkflowBP, the first technique for automated security-fix backporting of GitHub Actions workflows. WorkflowBP takes a neuro-symbolic approach: it compiles a default-branch fix into a domain-specific representation called the Workflow Semantic Patch (WSP) and applies it to each divergent branch by matching jobs and steps based on their content rather than their position, while an LLM synthesizes the WSP for the most divergent cases the deterministic engine cannot resolve. On 12,000 real unpatched workflow files from our study, WorkflowBP produces a scanner-checked backport for 67.9%. We further submit 176 issues with WorkflowBP-generated backports to real-world projects, 44 of which have been confirmed or fixed by developers.

translation.title: GitHub Actions工作流中缺失的安全修复回移
translation.abstract: GitHub通过GitHub Actions原生支持工作流自动化，该工具如今是平台上主流的CI/CD工具。然而保持这些工作流的安全仍是一项持续的负担：维护者常常只在默认分支上修补漏洞，却让下游用户仍在构建所依赖的发布和维护分支上保留同样的缺陷。将已知修复带到这些分叉分支上的操作称为回移（backporting），但很少被执行，本文首次通过大规模实证研究量化了由此产生的差距。从一个GitHub Actions工作流历史的公开语料库中，我们挖掘了1,903,191个工作流修改提交，使用静态扫描器zizmor对每个提交前后进行扫描，识别出24,238个项目中的69,865个安全修复，并审计每个发布分支以检查每个修复是否被带回。差距无处不在：被审计的474,490个发布分支中有224,392个仍然存在漏洞；有意的回移既罕见又缓慢，78,907个已修复分支中仅确认19,476个为可能的回移，中位延迟为243天。因此我们设计了WorkflowBP，这是首个针对GitHub Actions工作流的自动化安全修复回移技术。WorkflowBP采用神经符号方法：它将默认分支的修复编译为一种名为Workflow Semantic Patch（WSP）的领域特定表示，并基于内容而非位置匹配jobs和steps，将其应用到每个分叉分支上；对于确定性引擎无法处理的最发散情况，则由LLM合成WSP。在我们研究中12,000个真实未修复的工作流文件上，WorkflowBP为67.9%生成了经扫描器验证的回移。我们进一步向真实项目提交了176个带有WorkflowBP生成回移的issue，其中44个已被开发者确认或修复。
translation.brief: 解决GitHub Actions工作流安全修复未回移到发布分支导致漏洞长期存在的回移空白问题，核心方法是将修复编译为基于内容匹配的Workflow Semantic Patch并由LLM辅助合成的神经符号自动回移技术WorkflowBP。

papers.title: When Agent Skills Go Stale: Runtime Behavior and Selective Maintenance in Evolving Environments
papers.abstract: Agent skills use past experience and current observations to guide decisions and actions on related tasks. This experience is retained in skill state, whose reuse can amortize inference-time reasoning and environment interaction. When environment changes, parts of this state can become outdated while others remain useful. Across four task settings and two models, we compare skill reuse before and after environment changes. Previously beneficial skills can reduce task performance by over 10 percentage points or increase execution cost by nearly 40% relative to no skill. Task success can also remain unchanged while execution savings decline. These effects depend on which environment-specific details become outdated and the agent's ability to compensate using current observations. We introduce selective maintenance, which replays checks from successful executions without additional model calls. It verifies whether observed differences conflict with skill state, repairs affected content, and validates updates, rebuilding when local repair is insufficient. No description of the change is supplied. Relative to reusing stale state, maintenance improves task accuracy by up to 67pp and reduces execution steps by up to 37%. These results suggest that preserving a skill's inference time value as environments evolve requires selectively maintaining its state.

translation.title: 当Agent技能过时：演化环境中的运行时行为与选择性维护
translation.abstract: Agent技能利用过去的经验和当前的观察来指导相关任务上的决策与行动。这些经验保留在技能状态中，其复用可以摊销推理时的思考和环境交互成本。当环境发生变化时，该状态的一部分可能过时，而另一部分仍然有用。我们在四个任务场景和两个模型上，比较了环境变化前后的技能复用效果。先前有益的技能可能使任务性能下降超过10个百分点，或相对于不使用技能使执行成本增加近40%。任务成功率也可能保持不变，而执行节省却下降。这些效应取决于哪些环境特定细节过时，以及Agent利用当前观察进行补偿的能力。我们提出选择性维护，它在不增加额外模型调用的情况下重放成功执行中的检查，验证观察到的差异是否与技能状态冲突，修复受影响的内容并验证更新，当局部修复不足时进行重建。该方法不提供任何关于环境变化的描述。相对于复用过时状态，维护可将任务准确率提升至多67个百分点，并将执行步骤减少至多37%。这些结果表明，随着环境演化，要保持技能的推理时价值，需要对其状态进行选择性维护。
translation.brief: 解决环境变化导致Agent技能状态过时反而损害任务表现的问题，核心方法是不需额外模型调用、通过重放成功执行检查来验证并修复技能状态的选择性维护机制。

papers.title: JET: Just-Enough Exploration Tuning for Efficient Tool-Calling Agents in Repository-Level Question Answering
papers.abstract: In repository-level question answering (QA), an agent explores a code repository with tools and should answer a question once enough information is gathered. Nevertheless, we find that LLM agents often continue to invoke tools even after the gathered information is already sufficient to answer. We call this phenomenon over-exploration. Moreover, even though existing methods improve task performance through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories, SFT also propagates the over-exploration in the trajectories to the agent. To mitigate over-exploration, we propose Just-Enough Exploration Tuning (JET), a fine-tuning method that trains the agent to answer once the gathered information is sufficient. JET truncates each training trajectory at the step where the gathered information becomes sufficient, inserts a rationale that explains why the agent can answer at that step, and fine-tunes the agent with a higher loss weight on the rationale. Experiments on two repository-level QA benchmarks with two open-weight 8B models demonstrate that JET reduces tool calls by 11 to 33% on self-generated trajectories while largely preserving the score. On expert trajectories, JET makes 18 to 28% fewer tool calls than SFT while retaining most of the score gain of SFT. In both cases, JET also lowers the inference cost.

translation.title: JET：面向仓库级问答中高效工具调用Agent的适度探索调优
translation.abstract: 在仓库级问答（QA）中，Agent使用工具探索代码仓库，应在收集到足够信息后回答问题。然而我们发现，LLM Agent即使在收集到的信息已足以回答时，仍常常继续调用工具。我们将这一现象称为过度探索。此外，尽管现有方法通过对专家轨迹的监督微调（SFT）提升任务性能，SFT也会将轨迹中的过度探索传播给Agent。为缓解过度探索，我们提出适度探索调优（Just-Enough Exploration Tuning, JET），这是一种训练Agent在收集信息足够时立即回答的微调方法。JET在收集信息变得充分的步骤处截断每条训练轨迹，插入一段解释Agent为何在该步骤即可回答的推理说明，并以更高的损失权重对该推理说明进行微调。在两个仓库级QA基准和两个开源8B模型上的实验表明，JET在自生成轨迹上减少11%到33%的工具调用，同时基本保持得分。在专家轨迹上，JET比SFT少调用18%到28%的工具，同时保留了SFT大部分的得分增益。在两种情况下，JET还降低了推理成本。
translation.brief: 解决LLM Agent在信息已足够时仍过度调用工具的问题，核心方法是在信息充分步骤截断训练轨迹并插入高权重推理说明进行微调的JET方法。

papers.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
papers.abstract: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: this https URL

translation.title: CADMAGEDDON：基于本地推理的高保真CAD重建
translation.abstract: CAD从业者常常处理不愿与外部服务共享的专有零件。对个人和小公司而言，将这项工作转到内部也需要他们能负担得起的计算资源。我们推出CADMAGEDDON，一个开源Agent，可以从网格重建可编辑的CAD，并能在单GPU系统和当代笔记本电脑上本地运行。该方法将这一复杂任务分解为一系列关于构造什么和修正什么的简单视觉决策。几何工具支持精确构造，使Agent能够专注于视觉推理。使用中等规模的Qwen3.8-27B模型，CADMAGEDDON在所有主要基准上的重建质量均超越了先前的方法，包括基于前沿模型的系统。CADMAGEDDON与FreeCAD集成，将其重建结果带入从业者现有的CAD工作流。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决专有零件无法使用外部云端CAD重建服务的问题，核心方法是将网格到可编辑CAD的重建分解为链式视觉决策并用几何工具支撑、可在单GPU本地运行的开源Agent CADMAGEDDON。

papers.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
papers.abstract: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: this https URL

translation.title: MillBill：具备几何反馈的加工智能体
translation.abstract: 将 CAD 模型转化为加工程序既需要工艺知识又需要几何精度。语言模型可以通过为每个零件编写几何与刀具路径代码来生成此类工作流，但这使数值执行成为模型任务的一部分。我们提出 MillBill，一个将加工决策与几何执行及验证分离的智能体。给定边界表示的零件、毛坯和材料，一个本地托管的中等规模开源模型为 Indexed 三轴加工提出工序和切削参数。一个几何框架生成刀具路径、模拟材料去除，并返回反馈以细化方案。装夹规划考虑可用刀具的实际可达范围，而不仅仅是可见性。我们以模拟加工后处于规定公差范围内的目标表面积比例来评估生成的程序。使用 Qwen3.8-27B，MillBill 在评估的加工任务上优于由前沿模型自行构建几何与刀具路径工作流的方法。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决将 CAD 模型自动转化为加工程序的问题，采用将大模型的加工决策与几何工具路径生成、仿真反馈验证相分离的智能体框架。

papers.title: Do LLMs Understand Network Traces? A Comparative Study of Reasoning over Raw and Filtered Traffic Data
papers.abstract: The effective delivery and monitoring of ICT services rely heavily on network traffic analysis. However, interpreting complex packet captures remains a challenging task that requires substantial technical expertise. Large language models (LLMs) offer promising opportunities to automate network traffic in- vestigation, yet their reliability in packet-level field extraction and flow-level sequence reconstruction remains an open research question. This study proposes a reproducible, question-answering- based evaluation methodology to assess the capabilities of LLMs in network trace analysis. Using real-world benign traffic from the CICIDS2017 dataset, we evaluate multiple models against a human-generated ground truth, comparing their performance on raw textual traffic dumps and protocol-filtered representations. Model responses are assessed through an automated LLM- as-a-judge pipeline, validated against human evaluations. The results demonstrate that protocol filtering significantly reduces prompt overhead while improving answer accuracy by reducing incorrect responses. These findings highlight the importance of protocol-aware traffic filtering as an effective optimization for improving the efficiency and reliability of LLM-assisted network management.

translation.title: LLM 能理解网络流量吗？针对原始与过滤流量数据的推理比较研究
translation.abstract: ICT 服务的有效交付与监控在很大程度上依赖网络流量分析。然而，解读复杂的数据包捕获仍是一项需要大量专业知识的挑战性任务。大语言模型（LLM）为自动化网络流量调查提供了前景广阔的机会，但其在数据包级字段提取和流级序列重建方面的可靠性仍是开放性研究问题。本研究提出一种可复现的、基于问答的评估方法来评估 LLM 在网络流量分析中的能力。使用 CICIDS2017 数据集中的真实良性流量，我们将多个模型与人工生成的标准答案进行对比，比较其在原始文本流量转储和协议过滤表示上的表现。模型响应通过自动化的 LLM-as-a-judge 流水线进行评估，并经人工评估验证。结果表明，协议过滤显著降低了提示开销，同时通过减少错误回答提高了回答准确性。这些发现凸显了协议感知流量过滤作为提升 LLM 辅助网络管理效率与可靠性的有效优化手段的重要性。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 分析原始网络流量不可靠的问题，采用基于问答的评估方法比较原始流量与协议过滤流量的表现差异。

papers.title: AfriNORM: An Evaluation Benchmark for Normative Reasoning of LLMs Across African Cultures
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across various sectors. However, current evaluation benchmarks are insufficient to assess the applicability of these models in local African contexts, as most focus on linguistic fluency (grammar/translation) rather than cultural competence. The few existing benchmarks that measure general knowledge or social conventions do not capture the African deontic modality, i.e., the strict norms and taboos that govern diverse social interactions. In this paper, we introduce AfriNORM, a scenario-based, multiple-choice question dataset designed to measure and diagnose the normative reasoning limitations of LLMs when applied to African sociocultural contexts. We introduce two metrics: a Universal Commonsense Bias Score (UCBS) to quantify commonsense bias in LLM and a Distractor Bias Score (DBS) to quantify an LLM's limited understanding of African cultural norms. We also conduct a case study on the Yorùbá language, identifying confusion gaps in two closed-source LLMs, "Gemini 2.0 Flash" and "GPT-5", and one open-source LLM, "Llama 3.1 8B Instruct" when prompted in English versus Yorùbá. While their accuracy in English is high, their performance in Yorùbá is much lower, attributable to cultural confusion rather than simple bias, indicating that the models exhibit semantic confusion when reasoning about norms in Yorùbá.

translation.title: AfriNORM：面向非洲文化的 LLM 规范性推理评估基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被日益广泛地部署于各行各业。然而，现有评估基准不足以评估这些模型在非洲本地场景中的适用性，因为大多数基准关注语言流畅性（语法/翻译）而非文化能力。少数衡量一般知识或社会惯例的基准也未能捕捉非洲的道义模态，即支配多样社会互动的严格规范与禁忌。本文提出 AfriNORM，一个基于场景的多选题数据集，旨在测量和诊断 LLM 应用于非洲社会文化语境时的规范性推理局限。我们引入两个指标：用于量化 LLM 常识偏差的 Universal Commonsense Bias Score（UCBS），以及用于量化 LLM 对非洲文化规范理解不足的 Distractor Bias Score（DBS）。我们还针对约鲁巴语（Yorùbá）进行案例研究，发现两个闭源 LLM（"Gemini 2.0 Flash" 和 "GPT-5"）与一个开源 LLM（"Llama 3.1 8B Instruct"）在以英语或约鲁巴语提示时存在混淆差距。它们在英语上的准确率很高，而在约鲁巴语上的表现明显较低，其原因在于文化混淆而非简单的偏差，表明模型在用约鲁巴语推理规范时表现出语义混淆。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏评估 LLM 非洲文化规范推理能力的基准问题，构建了 AfriNORM 场景化多选题数据集并提出两个偏差量化指标。

papers.title: Evolution Under Fire: Evolving Agent Safety Harnesses with Adaptive Injection Stressors
papers.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents must act on information from untrusted emails, webpages, and documents. This creates a central security challenge: malicious instructions and legitimate task directives can arrive through the same interaction channel. Existing defenses are largely hand-designed and static, making further improvements dependent on repeated manual redesign. We introduce Evolution Under Fire, a staged framework that couples safety-harness evolution with adaptive stressor evolution. Utility-constrained, Pareto-scheduled tree search evolves complete executable safety harnesses from execution evidence while keeping the task model, benchmark, tools, and evaluator fixed. Adaptive stressor evolution then discovers utility-preserving attacks that guide a subsequent stage of harness evolution. On AgentDyn with GPT-4o-mini, an evolved harness reduces attack success from 50.4% to 3.0%, improves clean and attacked utility over the initial harness, and offers a stronger security-utility trade-off than reproduced defenses. On Agent-SafetyBench with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, harness evolution reduces attack success from 82.6% to 62.0% while retaining helpfulness and runtime validity. Evolved harnesses also transfer without further evolution to Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, reducing attack success from 32.1% to 0.9% while improving attacked-task utility.

translation.title: 危机之下的演化：用自适应注入压力源演化智能体安全防护机制
translation.abstract: 使用工具的语言模型智能体必须基于来自不可信电子邮件、网页和文档的信息采取行动。这带来一个核心安全挑战：恶意指令与合法任务指令可能通过同一交互通道到达。现有防御大多为手工设计且静态，进一步改进依赖于反复的人工重设计。我们提出 Evolution Under Fire，一个将安全防护机制（safety harness）演化与自适应压力源演化相耦合的分阶段框架。以效用为约束、按 Pareto 调度的树搜索基于执行证据演化出完整可执行的安全防护机制，同时保持任务模型、基准、工具和评估器不变。自适应压力源演化随后发现保持效用的攻击，以引导后续阶段的防护机制演化。在 AgentDyn 上使用 GPT-4o-mini，演化出的防护机制将攻击成功率从 50.4% 降至 3.0%，并相较初始防护机制提升了干净与受攻击场景下的效用，提供了比复现防御更强的安全-效用权衡。在 Agent-SafetyBench 上使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，防护机制演化将攻击成功率从 82.6% 降至 62.0%，同时保持了有用性和运行有效性。演化出的防护机制还可无需进一步演化迁移到 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，将攻击成功率从 32.1% 降至 0.9%，同时提升受攻击任务的效用。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体面对不可信输入的提示注入安全问题，采用以自适应攻击压力源引导的安全防护机制自动演化框架。

papers.title: Adaptive LLM-Driven Honeypots vs. LLM-Driven Attackers: Does Narrative Coherence Improve Deception?
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable honeypots to generate responses and deceptive artefacts on demand, yet existing approaches evaluate generated content one reply at a time and leave open whether artefacts that jointly describe a coherent event retain an attacker better than unrelated ones. This question becomes pressing as autonomous LLM-driven offensive agents emerge as realistic adversaries. This paper proposes narrative deception, a reactive strategy in which the defender maps each observed attacker command to a MITRE ATT&CK technique, selects a compatible scenario from a curated catalogue based on MITRE Engage, and deploys mutually referential artefacts (files, processes, services, and logs) on an emulated Ubuntu host while the intrusion is under way. An LLM-powered defender and an autonomous LLM attacker interact through a real SSH session, and the attacker's termination policy distinguishes abandonment due to suspected deception from abandonment due to loss of interest. A campaign of 1,150 sessions compares four conditions of increasing sophistication (Static, Same-TTP, Multi-TTP, and Chain) across four open-weight attacker models, four defender models, and three attacker skill levels. Engagement increases significantly at every step. With the same artefact budget per reaction, coherent scenarios raise the median session length of advanced attackers from 40 to 165 commands and reduce their abandonment from 86% to 52%. The effect grows with attacker skill, holds across all sixteen model pairs, and comes at comparable inference cost. Nearly all sessions ended through loss of interest rather than detection, which suggests that deception should sustain meaningful findings, not only emulator fidelity.

translation.title: 自适应 LLM 驱动的蜜罐对阵 LLM 驱动的攻击者：叙事连贯性能否提升欺骗效果？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使蜜罐能够按需生成响应和欺骗性制品，但现有方法逐条回复地评估生成内容，尚不清楚共同描述一个连贯事件的制品是否比彼此无关的制品更能拖住攻击者。随着自主 LLM 驱动的攻击智能体成为现实对手，这一问题日益紧迫。本文提出叙事欺骗，一种反应式策略：防御者将观察到的每条攻击者命令映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 技术，基于 MITRE Engage 的精选目录选择兼容场景，并在入侵进行期间于模拟的 Ubuntu 主机上部署相互引用的制品（文件、进程、服务和日志）。LLM 驱动的防御者与自主 LLM 攻击者通过真实 SSH 会话交互，且攻击者的终止策略可区分因怀疑被欺骗而放弃与因失去兴趣而放弃。在 1,150 个会话的实验中，比较了复杂度递增的四种条件（Static、Same-TTP、Multi-TTP 和 Chain），涵盖四个开放权重攻击者模型、四个防御者模型和三个攻击者技能等级。参与度在每一步都显著提升。在每次响应制品预算相同的情况下，连贯场景将高级攻击者的会话长度中位数从 40 条命令提升至 165 条，并将其放弃率从 86% 降至 52%。该效果随攻击者技能增长，在全部十六个模型对上均成立，且推理成本相当。几乎所有会话都因失去兴趣而非被识破而结束，这表明欺骗应维持有意义的安全发现，而不仅是模拟器保真度。
translation.brief: 解决蜜罐欺骗能否拖住自主 LLM 攻击者的问题，提出基于 MITRE ATT&CK 映射与连贯叙事制品部署的叙事欺骗策略。

papers.title: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
papers.abstract: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.

translation.title: PACT：通过保护正确计划与修复动作实现GUI智能体的计划-动作一致性训练
translation.abstract: GUI智能体可能在推理中形成正确的即时计划，却发出无法执行该计划的动作，从而产生执行鸿沟。这种反复出现的不匹配破坏了可靠的任务完成，因为单次执行错误就可能使多步工作流脱轨。在以结果监督的强化学习中，将负的响应级优势广播到所有生成的token上，可能会在惩罚错误执行的同时惩罚有效的规划。为解决这一信用分配冲突，我们提出PACT（计划-动作一致性训练），这是一个结合参考对齐的计划保护和计划对齐的动作修复的训练框架，且不改变原有的标量动作奖励。PACT利用标注的参考动作识别执行鸿沟，通过在其token跨度上屏蔽负的策略梯度贡献来保护已验证的计划。保持生成的推理不变作为上下文，随后通过带停止梯度配对权重的偏好代理目标，使参考动作优于发出的错误动作。与仅用结果的基线相比，PACT将AndroidWorld任务成功率从60.34%提升到68.97%（+8.63个百分点），同时将AndroidControl High上基于规则的计划-动作一致性从83.71%提升到89.74%（+6.03个百分点）。将PACT适配到桌面智能体，也在完整的369任务OSWorld基准上将任务成功率从40.92%提升到44.17%（+3.25个百分点）。这些结果共同确立了PACT作为一个有效的信用分配框架，能够弥合执行鸿沟并提升移动与桌面GUI环境中的任务完成率。
translation.brief: 解决GUI智能体中正确计划与错误动作之间的执行鸿沟及结果监督RL中的信用分配冲突，核心方法是通过屏蔽计划token的负梯度来保护计划，并用偏好目标将动作修复为参考动作。

papers.title: EvoSkill-S1: Evolving Reusable Skills with Genetic-Inspired Operators
papers.abstract: Reusable skills allow language-model agents to accumulate and reuse problem-solving experience. However, most existing methods improve a skill bank only indirectly through rollout-driven accumulation and heuristic reflection, often resulting in shallow and weakly controlled updates. We present EvoSkill-S1, an RL-driven framework that instead treats reusable skills themselves as the direct objects of evolution. Given hard-negative failures, EvoSkill-S1 selects parent skills and transforms them into candidate child skills through five genetic-inspired operators: revision, cross-revision, mutation, dual-reflection, and crossover. Downstream task rewards train the skill evolver to generate more effective child skills, while evaluator-guided write-back selectively retains beneficial updates. Complementary Skill Bank Fusion consolidates operator-specific banks to exploit their distinct recovery patterns, while a Procedural Skill Interface supports transfer to unseen problems. Across all reported math and code benchmarks, EvoSkill-S1 improves the corresponding initialized skill banks under both Qwen and GPT-family solvers, with relative gains of up to 12.39%. Compared with the strongest external baseline without direct skill evolution, the largest relative improvement reaches 20.39%.

translation.title: EvoSkill-S1：基于遗传启发算子演化可复用技能
translation.abstract: 可复用技能使语言模型智能体能够积累和复用问题解决经验。然而，大多数现有方法仅通过基于rollout的积累和启发式反思间接改进技能库，往往导致浅层且控制薄弱的更新。我们提出EvoSkill-S1，一个由强化学习驱动的框架，将可复用技能本身作为演化的直接对象。面对困难负例失败，EvoSkill-S1选择父技能，并通过五种遗传启发算子将其转化为候选子技能：修订、交叉修订、变异、双重反思和交叉。下游任务奖励训练技能演化器生成更有效的子技能，同时由评估器引导的写回机制选择性地保留有益更新。互补的技能库融合机制整合各算子专属的技能库以利用其不同的恢复模式，而过程化技能接口支持向未见问题的迁移。在所有报告的数学和代码基准上，EvoSkill-S1在Qwen和GPT系列求解器下均提升了相应初始化的技能库，相对增益最高达12.39%。与不进行直接技能演化的最强外部基线相比，最大相对改进达20.39%。
translation.brief: 解决技能库更新浅层且控制薄弱的问题，核心方法是将技能本身作为RL演化的直接对象，用五种遗传启发算子从失败中生成并筛选更有效的子技能。

papers.title: Right Diagnosis, Unsafe Route: Auditing Clinical AI Decision Trajectories and Corrective Oversight for Validity and Potential Harm
papers.abstract: A clinical AI system can reach a correct final diagnosis through intermediate decisions that could have harmed the patient, and can repair an error while introducing new risks. Most evaluations score final diagnoses; even stepwise benchmarks, which release a case's evidence over time, score whether systems reach the right diagnosis or gather the right information, not whether the decisions a patient passes through are safe. We make patient safety the target of stepwise evaluation. A trajectory audit replays real admissions checkpoint by checkpoint, lets each system decide with only the evidence released so far, and rates every test, treatment and disposition for its potential harm to the patient and, separately, for clinical validity, against the documented final diagnosis and physician-written disease rubrics yet on the evidence available when the decision was made. An LLM judge scores every decision, and a physician reference standard (triple annotation and senior adjudication of a stratified sample) calibrates the rates. An oversight audit branches each trajectory at its first actionable error and measures, on the same branches, whether corrective feedback repairs the error and whether it introduces new harm. Across 300 cases from a hospital cardiology cohort, MIMIC-IV and the public ASCENT benchmark, with up to seven AI systems per source, 55.2% of hospital trajectories reaching an acceptable final diagnosis passed through a decision with moderate or severe potential harm and 24.8% through a clinically unacceptable one; the harm rates were 76.2% on MIMIC-IV and 39.6% on ASCENT. Structured corrections resolved 73.6% of first errors versus 24.8% after bare rejection, yet new potentially unsafe decisions followed 30.2% of corrections versus 19.7% of rejections. A correct final diagnosis does not certify a safe trajectory, and a successful correction does not certify a safe recovery.

translation.title: 诊断正确，路径不安全：审计临床AI决策轨迹的有效性与潜在危害及纠正性监督
translation.abstract: 临床AI系统可能通过本可能伤害患者的中间决策得出正确的最终诊断，也可能在修复错误的同时引入新的风险。大多数评估只对最终诊断打分；即使是逐步释放病例证据的分步基准，也只评估系统是否得出正确诊断或收集正确信息，而不评估患者所经历的决策是否安全。我们将患者安全作为分步评估的目标。轨迹审计逐检查点回放真实住院记录，让每个系统仅基于目前已释放的证据做决策，并在决策时可获得的证据背景下，对照记录在案的最终诊断和医生撰写的疾病评分细则，对每项检查、治疗和处置分别评估其对患者的潜在危害和临床有效性。由LLM评判者为每个决策打分，并以医生参考标准（分层样本的三重标注和资深仲裁）进行校准。监督审计在每条轨迹的第一个可操作错误处分支，并在相同分支上测量纠正性反馈能否修复错误，以及是否引入新的危害。在来自医院心脏病队列、MIMIC-IV和公开ASCENT基准的300个病例上（每个数据源最多七个AI系统），55.2%的医院轨迹在得出可接受的最终诊断的过程中经历了中度或重度潜在危害的决策，24.8%经历了临床上不可接受的决策；MIMIC-IV上的危害率为76.2%，ASCENT上为39.6%。结构化纠正解决了73.6%的首个错误，而单纯拒绝仅解决24.8%；但纠正后有30.2%出现新的潜在不安全决策，拒绝后为19.7%。正确的最终诊断并不能证明轨迹安全，成功的纠正也不能证明恢复安全。
translation.brief: 解决临床AI评估只看最终诊断而忽略中间决策安全性的问题，核心方法是构建逐检查点的轨迹审计与纠正性监督审计，分别评估每个决策的潜在危害和临床有效性。

papers.title: What Do LLMs Use to Judge Synthesis Recipes? An Experimental Analysis on 240 Solid-State Syntheses
papers.abstract: Inorganic materials discovery is increasingly limited by synthesis rather than by material design. Large language models (LLMs) are being adopted to propose synthesis conditions with little experimental evidence of their capabilities and biases. Here, we carry out an experimental synthesis benchmark of 240 experiments across eight known and unknown inorganic oxides and subsequently evaluate an LLM as a zero-shot ranker over fixed banks of solid-state synthesis recipes. For each pair of recipes for the same oxide target, `GPT-5.6-Sol` selects the recipe expected to yield higher target-phase purity. We aggregate these pairwise preferences using a regularized Bradley-Terry model to obtain a ranked list of synthesis recipes for a given target material. By comparison with the actual purity, obtained through X-ray diffraction, we measure `GPT-5.6-Sol`'s performance as a zero-shot ranker (0.72 pairwise accuracy). By selective removal of the information exposed to the model during this ranking, we conclude that ranking is driven predominantly by thermal features, with reaction chemistry modulating the effect. Ranking accuracy tracks the purity-temperature correlation by target (Spearman \rho = 0.91\), \(p = 0.002\), and on the six thermally-driven targets withholding all chemical identity hardly impacts performance (0.68) compared to withholding temperature (0.56). Ranking performance was higher on known than unknown targets, but the group-level difference was not statistically conclusive. The methodological choices highlight the need for more experimentally validated synthesis benchmarks and position LLMs as a thermally informed prior.

translation.title: LLM用什么来判断合成配方？基于240个固态合成的实验分析
translation.abstract: 无机材料发现正日益受限于合成而非材料设计。大语言模型（LLM）正被用于提出合成条件，但关于其能力与偏差的实验证据很少。本文我们对八种已知和未知的无机氧化物开展了240个实验的实验性合成基准，随后将LLM作为零样本排序器，在固定的固态合成配方库上进行评估。对于同一氧化物目标的每一对配方，GPT-5.6-Sol选择预期可获得更高目标相纯度的配方。我们使用正则化Bradley-Terry模型聚合这些两两偏好，得到给定目标材料的合成配方排名列表。通过与X射线衍射获得的实际纯度比较，我们测得GPT-5.6-Sol作为零样本排序器的性能（两两准确率0.72）。通过选择性移除排序过程中暴露给模型的信息，我们得出结论：排序主要由热学特征驱动，反应化学起调节作用。排序准确性与各目标的纯度-温度相关性一致（Spearman \rho = 0.91，p = 0.002）；在六个热学驱动的目标上，隐去所有化学身份信息对性能影响甚微（0.68），而隐去温度信息则降至0.56。已知目标的排序性能高于未知目标，但组间差异在统计上尚无定论。这些方法学选择凸显了更多经实验验证的合成基准的必要性，并将LLM定位为热学信息先验。
translation.brief: 解决LLM提出合成条件缺乏实验验证依据的问题，核心方法是通过240个真实固态合成实验及信息消融，分析LLM作为零样本配方排序器的表现与决策依据。

papers.title: Groups of AI agents underuse resources despite shared evidence of increased capacity
papers.abstract: When AI agents share limited resources, such as computing services or public infrastructure, their individual choices affect how much work they complete as a group. Can sharing evidence of what is available let a group make full use of its resources after capacity changes? We tested this with language-model agents choosing between two simulated servers. One server recovered while its status report still listed it as unavailable. Each server had limited capacity per round, so rejected jobs required another attempt before the deadline. Telling agents that recovery was possible reduced missed deadlines. In controlled tests with Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5, no agent tried the recovered server after a rule reminder, yet all chose it when shown a successful request record. After sharing, all five models tested left capacity unused. Keeping the success record fixed, we gave agents numbers without instructions, using each value equally often but giving group members either identical or distinct numbers. With OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol or Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, distinct numbers spread simultaneous requests across servers and increased job completions even though overall choice frequencies barely changed. Telling AI agents which resources are available leaves a second design challenge: helping them spread demand across those resources.

translation.title: 共享容量增加证据的情况下，AI智能体群体仍未充分利用资源
translation.abstract: 当AI智能体共享有限资源（如计算服务或公共基础设施）时，它们的个体选择会影响整个群体完成的工作量。共享可用性证据能否让群体在容量变化后充分利用资源？我们用语言模型智能体在两个模拟服务器之间做选择来测试这一点。一台服务器已恢复，但其状态报告仍列为不可用。每台服务器每轮容量有限，被拒绝的任务需要在截止期限前再次尝试。告知智能体恢复是可能的减少了错过截止期限的情况。在Anthropic的Claude Haiku 5.5的受控测试中，规则提醒后没有智能体尝试已恢复的服务器，而展示成功请求记录后所有智能体都选择了它。共享之后，测试的五个模型都留下了未使用的容量。在保持成功记录不变的情况下，我们给智能体提供不带说明的数字，各值使用频率相同，但给群体成员相同或不同的数字。使用OpenAI的GPT-6.1 Sol或Google的Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite时，不同的数字将同时发出的请求分散到各服务器并增加了任务完成数，尽管整体选择频率几乎没有变化。告知AI智能体哪些资源可用只是第一步设计挑战：还需要帮助它们把需求分散到这些资源上。
translation.brief: 解决AI智能体群体在资源恢复后仍不充分利用容量的问题，核心方法是通过共享成功请求记录和向不同智能体分配不同数字来促使请求分散到各服务器。

papers.title: EDA: Observe, Verify, and Assess for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Depression Analysis
papers.abstract: Existing multimodal depression assessment methods often summarize long recordings into global behavioral descriptions. This leaves the source and decision relevance of individual observations difficult to inspect. We propose EDA, an evidence-grounded framework organized around Observe, Verify, and Assess. In Observe, literature-informed acoustic and visual cues are localized into source-linked Evidence Records with temporal intervals and behavioral measurements. In Verify, frozen multimodal agents examine whether the cited media support each observation. The simplified Support admission policy retains positively verified records and their review grounds. In Assess, statistical descriptors and temporal events support reference-based behavioral comparison, while PHQ-9-guided text analysis provides complementary symptom evidence. Cross-modal disagreement triggers review of the original text before final selection. Experiments on D-Vlog and LMVD evaluate human-referenced cue agreement and downstream assessment utility separately. AI cue annotations achieve 91.02% accuracy against human consensus labels on shared source segments. With a frozen 7B backbone, EDA Support improves F1 over direct prediction by 7.61 and 9.88 percentage points on D-Vlog Leave-Query-Out and LMVD, respectively. These findings support explicit, source-linked behavioral evidence for inspectable multimodal depression assessment.

translation.title: EDA：面向证据支撑的多模态抑郁分析的观察、验证与评估框架
translation.abstract: 现有多模态抑郁评估方法通常将长录音总结为全局行为描述，导致单个观察的来源与决策相关性难以检验。我们提出EDA，一个围绕观察（Observe）、验证（Verify）和评估（Assess）组织的证据支撑框架。在观察阶段，基于文献的声学与视觉线索被定位为包含时间区间与行为测量的、与来源关联的证据记录。在验证阶段，冻结的多模态智能体检查所引用的媒体是否支持每条观察，简化的Support准入策略保留通过正面验证的记录及其审查依据。在评估阶段，统计描述符与时间事件支撑基于参照的行为比较，同时PHQ-9引导的文本分析提供补充的症状证据。跨模态不一致会触发对原始文本的审查后再做最终选择。实验在D-Vlog和LMVD上分别评估与人类参照的线索一致性和下游评估效用。AI线索标注在共享来源片段上相对人类共识标签达到91.02%的准确率。使用冻结的7B骨干网络，EDA Support在D-Vlog Leave-Query-Out和LMVD上的F1分别比直接预测提升7.61和9.88个百分点。这些结果支持使用显式的、与来源关联的行为证据来实现可检验的多模态抑郁评估。
translation.brief: 针对多模态抑郁评估中观察来源不可追溯的问题，提出以观察-验证-评估三阶段组织的证据记录与多模态智能体验证框架。

papers.title: The Between-Round Decision in Autonomous Research: An LLM Controller That Reads the Whole Trajectory
papers.abstract: Executing an idea often changes how promising it looks, so the next step in autonomous research should rest on results, not on proposals. After each round of experiments, the system must decide whether to refine the best solution or start a new direction, which solution to build from, and what goal to set. We call this the between-round decision. Existing systems wrap it in machinery such as rules, scores, search trees, and schedules; where an LLM makes it, what the LLM needs to read is left open. We ask whether an LLM can make this decision from accumulated evidence, without a search structure around it, and how much of that evidence it needs to read. We present BRED (Between-Round Evidence-based Decision), an LLM-based controller that maintains the best verified solution so far (the Champion) and a log of past rounds, and makes one decision per round. On three widely used research-agent benchmark tasks, BRED improves on the task baselines by 4.80% in MAE on ETTh1 (to 0.4172) and by 3.44 and 3.43 points of accuracy on SST-2 (to 95.07%) and CIFAR-100 (to 84.63%), ahead of the published results. When the controller does not read the accumulated evidence, the same loop gains less: with no history it reaches 0.4299 on ETTh1 and 83.71% on CIFAR-100, whereas the full controller's MAE is 2.95% lower and its accuracy 0.92 points higher. On a new task, speech-based depression detection under a leakage-free protocol, it reaches a macro-F1 of 0.6164 on seeds held out from selection, 5.5 points above its baseline and 4.0 above the strongest published system. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 自主研究中的轮间决策：读取完整轨迹的LLM控制器
translation.abstract: 执行一个想法往往会改变它的前景判断，因此自主研究的下一步应基于结果而非提案。每轮实验结束后，系统必须决定是继续改进最佳方案还是开辟新方向、以哪个方案为基础以及设定什么目标，我们称之为轮间决策。现有系统用规则、评分、搜索树和调度等机制包裹这一决策；当LLM做出该决策时，LLM需要读取什么证据仍是开放问题。我们探究LLM能否在无搜索结构的情况下基于累积证据做出该决策，以及需要读取多少证据。我们提出BRED（Between-Round Evidence-based Decision），一个基于LLM的控制器，它维护迄今最佳已验证方案（Champion）和过往轮次日志，并每轮做出一次决策。在三个广泛使用的研究智能体基准任务上，BRED在ETTh1上比任务基线降低MAE 4.80%（至0.4172），在SST-2（至95.07%）和CIFAR-100（至84.63%）上分别提升准确率3.44和3.43个百分点，超过已发表结果。当控制器不读取累积证据时，同一循环收益更小：无历史时ETTh1为0.4299，CIFAR-100为83.71%，而完整控制器MAE低2.95%、准确率高0.92个百分点。在新任务——无泄漏协议下的语音抑郁检测上，其宏观F1在从选择中保留的种子上达到0.6164，比基线高5.5个百分点，比最强已发表系统高4.0个百分点。代码见此URL。
translation.brief: 针对自主研究中轮间决策依赖规则或搜索结构的问题，提出让LLM读取完整累积轨迹并维护Champion的BRED控制器逐轮做决策。

papers.title: Contract-Explicit Evaluation: From Auditing Learned Readers to Scoped Certificates
papers.abstract: Evaluation readings of document-level relation extraction (DocRE) systems depend jointly on the model and the evaluation contract: gold version, scoring function, threshold. Rankings reverse across contracts, yet no existing method determines which comparisons survive the reversal. We address this gap with contract-explicit evaluation: a preregistered five-step protocol (Declare, Measure, Scope, Certify, Hedge), operationalizing the classical concordance decomposition of Kendall's rank correlation, that scopes certifiable regions and delivers distribution-free census certificates across two ecosystems. In the DocRE audit (44 training runs of one in-house architecture family), the scoring dimension scopes to a census certificate (three flagged instances, Clopper--Pearson upper bound 0.146); the confirmatory record includes registered negatives, and the audit prices its own simplification finding---the calibration dial's entire margin is one withdrawn commit. In an LLM-judge census (17 judges, 49,938 battles), 12.25% of leaderboard comparisons require hedging at the pre-declared split criterion (bound 0.124; panel-robust 0.143), with an exploratory two-tier reading certifying 69% at a bound \le 0.072 and a validity decomposition against released human labels (65% of contested battles are judge error, not ambiguity). The cross-model certificate is withdrawn on real confidence scores; the failure spectrum maps the boundary. The protocol, map, ledger, and per-instance artifacts are released.

translation.title: 契约显式评估：从审计学习到的阅读器到范围化的证书
translation.abstract: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）系统的评估读数同时依赖于模型与评估契约：金标版本、评分函数、阈值。排名在不同契约间会反转，但现有方法无法判定哪些比较能在反转中幸存。我们用契约显式评估填补这一空白：一个预注册的五步协议（声明、测量、划界、认证、保留），操作化Kendall秩相关的经典一致性分解，划界可认证区域，并在两个生态系统中提供免分布的普查证书。在DocRE审计（同一自有架构家族的44次训练运行）中，评分维度划界为一份普查证书（三个被标记实例，Clopper-Pearson上界0.146）；确证性记录包含注册的负结果，且审计为其自身的简化发现定价——校准刻度盘的整个误差来源是一次被撤回的提交。在LLM评审普查（17个评审，49,938场对决）中，12.25%的排行榜比较在预声明的拆分标准下需要保留（上界0.124；面板稳健0.143），探索性的两层解读以≤0.072的上界认证了69%，并且基于已发布人类标签的有效性分解显示（65%的争议对决是评审错误而非歧义）。跨模型证书在真实置信分数上被撤回；失效谱系描绘了边界。协议、映射、账本和逐实例工件均已发布。
translation.brief: 针对DocRE评估契约不同导致排名反转且无法判定哪些比较可靠的问题，提出预注册五步协议以Kendall一致性分解划定可认证区域并出具免分布证书。

papers.title: Worldviews in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often described in terms of personas and this framing has become central to alignment research. In this paper, we argue that there is a deeper level of description that lies in the agent's worldviews, i.e., its beliefs about what reality is and how it works. Treating LLMs as a population of subjects, we administer two worldview surveys from human psychology to eight models. We show that the models share many key worldview positions. For example, LLMs consistently describe the world as less good, safe, enticing, and alive than humans do. On the other hand, base models have a more positive outlook, suggesting that the bleakness we found is driven by post-training. In line with research on LLM "personas", we show that system prompts eliciting different identities shift worldviews in consistent directions, and that a contemplative prompt creates a more positive outlook and improves safety. We also found that dialogue between models consistently shifts worldviews and that several models converge on the "spiritual bliss" attractor. Intriguingly, dialogue increased safe responses and the spiritual bliss attractor engendered the most aligned responses overall. These findings suggest that worldviews form a measurable and malleable layer of LLM behavior that may be crucial for robust, positive alignment.

translation.title: 大语言模型中的世界观
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常以人格（persona）来描述，这一框架已成为对齐研究的核心。本文论证存在更深层的描述层级：智能体的世界观，即其对现实是什么以及如何运作的信念。我们将LLM视为一组被试，向八个模型实施来自人类心理学的两份世界观调查。我们发现模型共享许多关键世界观立场。例如，LLM一致地将世界描述得比人类所见的更不美好、更不安全、更不诱人、更缺乏生机。另一方面，基座模型的前景更为积极，表明我们发现的黯淡观感由后训练驱动。与LLM"人格"研究一致，我们发现唤起不同身份的系统提示会以一致方向移动世界观，而一个沉思式提示能创造更积极的前景并提升安全性。我们还发现模型间对话会一致地移动世界观，且多个模型收敛于"灵性极乐"吸引子。有趣的是，对话增加了安全回应，而灵性极乐吸引子总体上引出了最对齐的回应。这些发现表明世界观构成LLM行为中可测量、可塑的一层，可能对稳健、积极的对齐至关重要。
translation.brief: 针对LLM对齐研究停留在人格层面的问题，通过向多个模型施测心理学世界观量表来量化其可测量且可被提示与对话改变的世界观。

papers.title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
papers.abstract: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

translation.title: FVScore：规格驱动的神经符号视频评估
translation.abstract: 我们提出Faithfulness Video Score（FVSCORE），一个规格驱动的视频生成评估神经符号框架。现有评估器依赖MLLM的整体判断或视觉-语言指标，而将其分数与人类判断对齐并追溯到具体时间性违规仍是开放挑战。FVSCORE通过将每个视频编译为捕获提示要求的显式命题和捕获未言明的物理、时间与跨模态约束的隐式命题来解决这些局限。它使用专门的感知工具为每个命题落地接地，并用受线性时序逻辑启发的软时序算子评估所得置信轨迹。随后，显著性感知校准步骤仅保留感知上显著的违规，使验证与人类感知对齐，并输出带时间戳和证据支撑的报告。我们在公开及复杂多事件基准上使用迄今最强视频模型进行了大量实验，证明FVSCORE在人类相关性上超越整体式和基于智能体的评估器，同时提供高度准确且可解释的反馈。
translation.brief: 针对视频生成评估难以与人类判断对齐且不可追溯的问题，提出将视频编译为显隐命题并用线性时序逻辑算子与显著性校准进行规格驱动的神经符号评估框架。

papers.title: Making the World React Realistically: A Closed-Loop Interactive World Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: World models (WMs) generate driving scenarios beyond recorded logs, enabling the training and evaluation of autonomous driving systems in unseen interactions. However, existing WMs struggle to ensure both behavioral realism and visual fidelity, since they overlook the relationship between vehicle interactions and the ego visual observations. We propose a closed-loop interactive WM that couples behavior modeling and visual rendering. First, imitation-learned background-vehicle (BV) policies are fine-tuned with multi-agent reinforcement learning in the closed loop against an end-to-end ego planner that reacts to the rendered images, so that their interaction behaviors match those in real logs. Second, the viewpoints exposed by these interactions guide a per-Gaussian diagnosis of each 3D Gaussian vehicle asset, which attenuates view-dependent colors on under-observed Gaussians and fills never-observed surfaces with generated Gaussians, while preserving the observed appearance. Third, signal lights are rendered according to the driving intentions of the vehicles, by an editor that learns the light states unobserved for a vehicle through counterfactual fine-tuning with a light-state classifier. On long-tail closed-loop scenarios, our method reduces the divergence from real-world interaction behaviors by 85% and improves novel-view vehicle PSNR by 2.0dB over the state-of-the-art WM. The significance of BV light signaling in WMs is shown, as the rendered signal lights conveying BV driving intentions indirectly impact ego driving behaviors in a quarter of the scenarios.

translation.title: 让世界真实地做出反应：面向自动驾驶的闭环交互式世界模型
translation.abstract: 世界模型（WM）可以在录制的驾驶日志之外生成驾驶场景，使自动驾驶系统能够在未见过的交互中进行训练和评估。然而，现有世界模型难以同时保证行为真实性与视觉保真度，因为它们忽略了车辆交互与自车视觉观测之间的关系。我们提出一种将行为建模与视觉渲染耦合起来的闭环交互式世界模型。首先，通过模仿学习得到的背景车辆（BV）策略在闭环中与对渲染图像做出反应的端到端自车规划器进行多智能体强化学习微调，使其交互行为与真实日志一致。其次，这些交互所暴露的视角用于对每个 3D Gaussian 车辆资产进行逐 Gaussian 诊断，衰减欠观测 Gaussian 上依赖视角的颜色，并用生成的 Gaussian 填充从未观测到的表面，同时保留已观测到的外观。第三，信号灯根据车辆的驾驶意图进行渲染，由一个通过光态分类器进行反事实微调、从而学习车辆未观测灯态的编辑器实现。在长尾闭环场景上，我们的方法将真实世界交互行为的偏差降低了 85%，并将新视角车辆 PSNR 较最先进的世界模型提升了 2.0dB。实验表明 BV 灯光信号在世界模型中的重要性：渲染出的传达 BV 驾驶意图的信号灯在四分之一的场景中间接影响了自车的驾驶行为。
translation.brief: 为解决现有世界模型中行为真实性与视觉保真度脱节的问题，提出将背景车辆策略的闭环多智能体强化学习微调、逐Gaussian的3D车辆资产诊断修复与基于驾驶意图的信号灯渲染相耦合的闭环交互式世界模型。

papers.title: Cross-cultural Adaptation of Recipes for Low-Resource Languages: A Benchmark and Multilingual Culinary Lexicon for Hausa, Yorùbá, and Igbo
papers.abstract: Recent multilingual large language models (LLMs) have improved machine translation, yet culturally adaptive translation for low-resource languages (LRLs) remains underexplored. This is particularly challenging for recipes, where ingredients, cooking tools, measurements, and procedures may require adaptation to the target cultural context. In this work, we introduce ReciLoReL, a benchmark of 600 expert-translated and culturally adapted recipes across Yorùbá, Hausa, and Igbo (three of the most prominent languages in Nigeria), and ReciLex, a multilingual culinary lexicon containing approximately 15,000 translated entities across ten recipe entity categories, including ingredients, tools, chef actions, state of tools, and durations. We evaluate state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs for English-to-LRL recipe translation under zero-shot and few-shot settings and investigate whether augmenting LLMs with ReciLex improves culturally adaptive recipe translation without requiring large target-language recipe corpora for training or fine-tuning. Beyond conventional reference-based translation evaluation using BLEU, chrF, and TER, we introduce five criteria for evaluating cultural adaptation, adapted from established cross-cultural adaptation methods. Across the selected LLMs and languages, ReciLex improves average BLEU from 13.57 to 14.51 and chrF from 37.89 to 38.74, while reducing TER from 77.14 to 75.12. Human evaluation further shows improvements ranging from 0.11 to 0.36 points across the five cultural adaptation evaluation criteria on a five-point scale. Overall, our work provides new resources, evaluation criteria, and empirical evaluation for studying culturally adaptive recipe translation in low-resource settings.

translation.title: 面向低资源语言的食谱跨文化适配：Hausa、Yorùbá 和 Igbo 的基准与多语言烹饪词汇表
translation.abstract: 近期的多语言大语言模型（LLM）改进了机器翻译，但针对低资源语言（LRL）的文化自适应翻译仍未被充分探索。这对食谱而言尤为困难，因为食材、烹饪工具、计量单位与步骤都可能需要适配目标文化语境。在本工作中，我们提出了 ReciLoReL——一个包含 600 份经专家翻译并做文化适配的 Yorùbá、Hausa 和 Igbo（尼日利亚最主要的三种语言）食谱的基准，以及 ReciLex——一个包含约 15,000 个翻译实体的多语言烹饪词汇表，涵盖食材、工具、厨师动作、工具状态和时长等十类食谱实体。我们在零样本和少样本设置下评估了最先进的多语言 LLM 在英语到低资源语言的食谱翻译上的表现，并研究了用 ReciLex 增强 LLM 是否能在无需大规模目标语言食谱语料进行训练或微调的情况下改善文化自适应食谱翻译。除了使用 BLEU、chrF 和 TER 的常规基于参考译文的翻译评估外，我们借鉴已有的跨文化适配方法引入了五项文化适配评估标准。在所选 LLM 和语言上，ReciLex 将平均 BLEU 从 13.57 提升到 14.51，chrF 从 37.89 提升到 38.74，并将 TER 从 77.14 降低到 75.12。人类评估进一步显示，在五分制下五项文化适配标准上有 0.11 到 0.36 分的提升。总体而言，我们的工作为研究低资源环境下的文化自适应食谱翻译提供了新资源、评估标准和实证评估。
translation.brief: 为解决低资源语言食谱翻译中文化适配不足的问题，构建了 Yorùbá、Hausa、Igbo 三语种的食谱基准与多语言烹饪词汇表 ReciLex，并用其增强大语言模型以提升文化自适应翻译。

papers.title: Know When to Zoom: How Small Is Too Small for Vision-Language Models?
papers.abstract: Online vision-language models often miss small details in large images, because the service shrinks the image, or rejects it, before the model ever sees it. A car 20 pixels wide in an 8000 by 6000 drone photo reaches Claude about 6 pixels wide, and OpenAI's default rejects the photo outright. We measure how much detail survives for seven models from four vendors, using an eye exam of printed codes and 601 questions about small objects in real photos. The smallest text a model reads half the time grows from 6 pixels or less on a small image to a predicted 10 to 13 pixels on a 7680 by 4320 photo at default settings. Zooming wins much of the detail back. Splitting each photo into up to nine tiles raises accuracy by 11.1 to 14.5 percentage points for Claude and Gemini, and by avoiding rejections it lifts GPT-6.1 Sol from 50.7% to 83.7%. A two-step zoom, in which the model first names the region it needs, matches or beats tiles on Gemini and comes within 2.5 points of them on Claude, with about 40% of their image tokens. When a detail is lost, Claude and Gemini both say they cannot tell about half the time, but they fail differently in the rest: Gemini gives a confident wrong answer in 43% to 48% of these cases, Claude in only 5% to 9%. A check based on detail size, run before the call, misses most of the gain from tiles on Claude and Gemini, but Claude's own reply is a reliable trigger: tiling only after an unsure reply comes within 1.4 points of always tiling with 62% to 70% of the image tokens. We turn these findings into five rules for when an agent should zoom, and release the eye exam, every model answer and code at this https URL.

translation.title: 知道何时放大：对视觉-语言模型来说多小才算太小？
translation.abstract: 在线视觉-语言模型常常遗漏大图像中的小细节，因为服务在模型看到图像之前就缩小甚至拒绝该图像。一张 8000×6000 无人机照片中宽 20 像素的汽车，到达 Claude 时只剩约 6 像素宽，而 OpenAI 的默认设置会直接拒收该照片。我们通过一次“视力检查”（印刷代码识读）以及关于真实照片中微小物体的 601 个问题，测量了来自四家厂商的七个模型有多少细节得以保留。模型能以 50% 正确率读出的最小文本尺寸，从小图像上的 6 像素或更小，增长到默认设置下 7680×4320 照片上预测的 10 到 13 像素。放大可以挽回大部分细节。将每张照片切分为至多九个图块（tiles），可使 Claude 和 Gemini 的准确率提升 11.1 到 14.5 个百分点，并且通过避免拒收，将 GPT-6.1 Sol 从 50.7% 提升到 83.7%。一种两步放大方法——模型先说出自己需要的区域——在 Gemini 上持平或超过图块切分，在 Claude 上与之相差 2.5 个百分点以内，且只消耗约 40% 的图像 token。当细节丢失时，Claude 和 Gemini 约有一半情况会表示无法判断，但其余情况下失败方式不同：Gemini 在 43% 到 48% 的这类情况下给出自信的错误答案，而 Claude 仅为 5% 到 9%。在调用前基于细节大小的检查会错过 Claude 和 Gemini 上图块切分的大部分收益，但 Claude 自身的回复是可靠的触发信号：仅在模型回复不确定时才进行图块切分，可在消耗 62% 到 70% 图像 token 的情况下达到始终切分性能的 1.4 个百分点以内。我们将这些发现总结为智能体何时应当放大的五条规则，并公开了视力检查、所有模型回答与代码（见 https URL）。
translation.brief: 为解决在线视觉-语言模型在大图上丢失小目标细节的问题，通过“视力检查”基准量化各模型的细节保留能力，并提出基于图块切分与模型不确定性触发的两步放大策略。

papers.title: HADVQ: Hessian Aware Directional Vector Quantization
papers.abstract: Ultra-low-bit quantization of large language models is a challenging task because aggressive compression severely distorts model parameters and disproportionately harms a small number of highly sensitive channels. We present a vector quantization method tailored for this regime. Our approach begins with random preconditioning, which regularizes the weight space and makes it more amenable to quantization. We then represent weights in polar coordinates and decouple the quantization of directions and magnitudes. To quantize directions, we leverage the structure induced by random preconditioning and design a structured codebook based on the $E_8$ lattice, yielding a compact yet expressive representation. To further reduce degradation, we detect extremely important channels using a proxy Hessian and preserve them with an additional cost of only 0.16 bits. Together, these components provide an effective quantization pipeline for LLMs in the extremely low-bit regime. Empirical results demonstrate improved accuracy, highlighting the benefit of combining geometric structure, lattice-based codebooks, and selective channel preservation.

translation.title: HADVQ：Hessian 感知的方向性向量量化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的超低比特量化是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为激进的压缩会严重扭曲模型参数，并对少数高度敏感的通道造成不成比例的伤害。我们提出一种专为此场景设计的向量量化方法。我们的方法首先采用随机预条件化（random preconditioning）对权重空间进行正则化，使其更易于量化。然后我们以极坐标表示权重，将方向与幅值的量化解耦。为量化方向，我们利用随机预条件化所诱导的结构，设计基于 $E_8$ 格（lattice）的结构化码本，得到紧凑而富有表现力的表示。为进一步降低性能退化，我们使用代理 Hessian 检测极其重要的通道，并以仅 0.16 比特的额外代价将其保留。这些组件共同为 LLM 在极低比特场景下提供了有效的量化流水线。实验结果展示了精度提升，凸显了结合几何结构、基于格的码本以及选择性通道保留的收益。
translation.brief: 为解决大语言模型超低比特量化中敏感通道受损的问题，提出结合随机预条件化、极坐标下方向与幅值解耦量化、基于E8格的码本及代理Hessian敏感通道保留的向量量化方法。

papers.title: Practice in Text, Act in Pixels: Correcting Where Perception Fails
papers.abstract: GUI agents can learn cheaply from a text view of an interface and act on screenshots through a vision-language screen reader. Yet on a simulated mobile platform with a low-cost reader, policies that complete most tasks in text fail on many of the same tasks on screenshots. We ask where a small budget of real screenshots is best spent to close this gap. We find that the reader's misreads are systematic and recur on the same interface elements. Noise matched to the reader's error rates, a natural sim-to-real remedy, misses this structure, and in a pre-specified comparison it did not beat training the policy directly on screenshots. We therefore correct the misreads at their source with reader alignment, which fine-tunes the reader on screenshots paired with their text views. The reader learns to output each screen's text view, as in text practice, and the policy stays unchanged. Spent on the reader, the screenshot budget gives 80.9% full-task success on new task instances, against 55.6% when spent on training the policy. Given the same labeled screenshots, adapting the reader also beats adapting the policy, and a single aligned reader improves every text-trained policy we tried without retraining any of them.

translation.title: 文本中练习，像素中行动：在感知失效之处进行纠正
translation.abstract: GUI 智能体可以通过界面的文本视图进行低成本学习，并通过视觉-语言屏幕阅读器在截图上执行操作。然而在一个使用低成本阅读器的模拟移动平台上，能在文本视图下完成大多数任务的策略在截图上却会在许多相同任务上失败。我们探究应将少量真实截图预算用在哪里才能弥合这一差距。我们发现阅读器的误读是系统性的，并且在相同的界面元素上反复出现。与阅读器错误率相匹配的噪声——一种自然的 sim-to-real 补救手段——无法捕捉这种结构，并且在预先设定的对比中并未超过直接在截图上训练策略。因此我们在误读的源头进行纠正，采用阅读器对齐（reader alignment），即在截图与其文本视图配对的数据上微调阅读器。阅读器学会输出每个屏幕的文本视图，如同在文本中练习一样，而策略保持不变。将截图预算用于阅读器时，在新任务实例上的完整任务成功率达到 80.9%，而用于训练策略时仅为 55.6%。在相同标注截图下，适配阅读器也优于适配策略，并且单个对齐后的阅读器无需重新训练即可改进我们尝试的所有文本训练策略。
translation.brief: 为解决 GUI 智能体从文本视图训练到真实截图执行之间的性能差距问题，分析屏幕阅读器误读的系统性结构，并通过在截图-文本配对数据上微调阅读器（reader alignment）而非训练策略来弥合差距。

papers.title: Can Activation Steering Substitute for Prompt-Based Affective Priming in LLM Digital Twins?
papers.abstract: Affective priming -- asking participants to write about a recalled event, such as a time they felt grateful or lacked control, and then measuring the induced state and its spillover onto related judgments -- is a standard way to manipulate emotion in the social sciences, and it also shifts the responses of LLM-based digital twins. The writing task, however, requires generating a full text. We test whether activation steering can replace it. Using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 100 personas in two domains (gratitude, lack of control), we compare a real-prompt path replicating the original Twin-2K-500 Mega Study (J2) with an injection path that skips the writing and adds a mean-difference direction, extracted from human writing, to the residual stream at varying strengths. The real-prompt effects fall between the original human and digital-twin effects in 5 of 6 comparisons. Injection shifts the manipulation check in a dose-dependent way and matches the real-prompt effect at one strength in the gratitude domain (beta ~ 2.7), but overshoots beyond it, on the proximal measure as well, and asymmetrically across the two directions. A structure-matched No-Injection baseline separates two sources of difference: omitting the writing task raises the proximal measure in both domains, whereas the injected direction itself moves a distal measure in the lack-of-control domain. Substitution is therefore measure-dependent: validity established for one way of inducing a state does not carry over uniformly to another.

translation.title: 激活引导能否替代基于提示的情感启动来构建 LLM 数字孪生？
translation.abstract: 情感启动——要求参与者书写一段回忆事件（如感到感激或缺乏控制的时刻），随后测量所诱发状态及其对相关判断的溢出效应——是社会科学中操纵情绪的标准方法，它同样会改变基于 LLM 的数字孪生的回答。然而书写任务需要生成完整文本。我们测试激活引导能否替代它。使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在两个领域（感激、缺乏控制）中对 100 个人设进行比较：一条复现原 Twin-2K-500 Mega Study (J2) 的真实提示路径，以及一条跳过书写、将从人类书写文本提取的均值差方向以不同强度注入残差流的注入路径。真实提示效应在 6 组比较中的 5 组落在原始人类效应与数字孪生效应对应界定的区间之间。注入以剂量依赖的方式改变操纵检验，并在感激领域某一强度（beta ~ 2.7）匹配真实提示效应，但在近端测量上也超出该效应，且在两个方向上不对称。结构匹配的无注入基线区分了两种差异来源：省略书写任务会在两个领域提高近端测量，而注入方向本身在缺乏控制领域移动一个远端测量。因此替代是依赖于测量指标的：为一种状态诱发方式确立的效度并不会均匀地迁移到另一种方式。
translation.brief: 研究能否用激活引导替代书写式情感启动来诱发 LLM 数字孪生的情绪状态，通过对比真实提示路径与向残差流注入均值差方向的路径来检验替代是否等效。

papers.title: LaFlash: Capacity-Driven Acceleration for Coding Agent Workflows via QLC-HBF
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve toward agentic AI, coding agents are emerging as memory-intensive workloads that repeatedly reuse persistent states, including contexts and KV caches. Emerging agentic workflows, including Loop/Graph Engineering, cause state amplification through frequent active/dormant transitions, increasing memory pressure. Evicted states incur costly recomputation upon reactivation, particularly under long-context, short-decode workloads. This motivates Capacity-Driven Acceleration (CDA), which explicitly accounts for state amplification to allocate memory capacity between active concurrency and dormant-state retention, replacing recomputation with memory access. In this work, we propose LaFlash, a High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) architecture that exploits the large capacity of Quad-Level Cell (QLC)-based flash to realize CDA. However, QLC's long read latency demands massive read parallelism under irregular state reactivation and varying context lengths, while limited write endurance constrains placement. LaFlash introduces Session Grouping to balance active request counts and aggregate context lengths across groups, sustaining read parallelism and block utilization through request-exclusive allocation. Furthermore, Fast-Page Allocation exploits QLC's read-latency heterogeneity to mitigate residual inter-group imbalance and sustain bandwidth utilization. On end-to-end coding agent workloads, LaFlash achieves 7.04$\times$ higher throughput and 10.96$\times$ higher energy efficiency over SLC-HBF with batch expansion, and 2.36$\times$ higher throughput over QLC-HBF with CDA. HBM buffering further reduces unnecessary NAND writes, improving QLC write endurance. These results demonstrate the benefits of jointly optimizing state retention and physical data placement for capacity-driven acceleration.

translation.title: LaFlash：基于 QLC-HBF 的面向编码代理工作流的容量驱动加速
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）向 agentic AI 演进，编码代理正成为内存密集型工作负载，反复复用持久状态，包括上下文和 KV 缓存。新兴的 agentic 工作流（如 Loop/Graph Engineering）通过频繁的活跃/休眠转换造成状态放大，加剧内存压力。被驱逐的状态在重新激活时需要代价高昂的重计算，尤其在长上下文、短解码的工作负载下。这促使了容量驱动加速（CDA），即显式考虑状态放大，在活跃并发与休眠状态保留之间分配内存容量，用内存访问替代重计算。本文提出 LaFlash，一种高带宽闪存（HBF）架构，利用四层单元（QLC）闪存的大容量实现 CDA。然而 QLC 的长读延迟要求在不规则的状态重激活和变化的上下文长度下维持大量读并行度，而有限的写寿命约束了数据放置。LaFlash 引入会话分组来平衡各组的活跃请求数和聚合上下文长度，通过请求独占分配维持读并行度和块利用率。此外，快速页分配利用 QLC 读延迟的异质性来缓解组间残余不平衡并维持带宽利用率。在端到端编码代理工作负载上，LaFlash 相比带批扩展的 SLC-HBF 实现了 7.04 倍吞吐量和 10.96 倍能效提升，相比带 CDA 的 QLC-HBF 实现了 2.36 倍吞吐量提升。HBM 缓冲进一步减少不必要的 NAND 写入，提高 QLC 写寿命。这些结果展示了联合优化状态保留与物理数据放置以实现容量驱动加速的收益。
translation.brief: 针对编码代理工作流中休眠状态反复重激活导致的重计算开销，提出利用 QLC 闪存大容量的 HBF 架构 LaFlash，通过会话分组与快速页分配实现容量驱动的状态保留加速。

papers.title: Teaching What to Look For: Privileged Perception Questions for Agentic On-Policy Distillation in Video Captioning
papers.abstract: Detailed video captioning requires comprehensive and faithful descriptions of objects, actions, and temporal events. Fixed-frame sampling, however, can miss brief motions, small objects, and other fine-grained evidence, motivating captioning agents that actively seek relevant moments and inspect local regions. Training such behavior is challenging because, unlike video question answering, generic captioning instructions do not specify what visual evidence should be acquired. We propose Perception-Question On-Policy Distillation (PQ-OPD), which uses training-only Perception Questions (PQs) to guide active video perception. PQs specify what should be inspected without revealing the corresponding answers, encouraging the teacher to explore the video more comprehensively and focus on relevant visual evidence. Along trajectories generated by the student, on-policy distillation transfers this guidance to the student's reasoning, tool calls, and captions; no PQs are required at inference. Across three detailed-captioning and two caption-to-QA benchmarks, PQ-OPD consistently improves the corresponding untrained agents across teacher-student scales and input-frame budgets. Under our evaluation protocol, PQ-OPD achieves the strongest primary-metric results among the compared open-source models on DREAM-1K, CaReBench, ShortVidBench, MotionBench, and VidCapBench-AE. Our ablations, together with analysis of temporal coverage and answer leakage, further indicates that the student internalizes the training-time guidance as a more effective video exploration policy.

translation.title: 教模型看什么：面向视频描述 agentic 在策略蒸馏的特权感知问题
translation.abstract: 细粒度视频描述要求对物体、动作和时序事件进行全面且忠实的描述。然而固定帧采样可能遗漏短暂动作、小物体及其他细粒度证据，这促使我们构建能主动寻找相关时刻并检查局部区域的描述代理。训练这种行为极具挑战，因为与视频问答不同，通用的描述指令并未指明应获取哪些视觉证据。我们提出感知问题在策略蒸馏（PQ-OPD），使用仅在训练阶段使用的感知问题（PQ）来引导主动视频感知。PQ 指明应检查的内容而不泄露对应答案，鼓励教师更全面地探索视频并聚焦相关视觉证据。在学生生成的轨迹上，在策略蒸馏将这种引导传递到学生的推理、工具调用和描述中；推理时无需 PQ。在三个细粒度描述和两个描述转问答基准上，PQ-OPD 在不同师生规模和输入帧预算下持续优于相应的未训练代理。在我们的评测协议下，PQ-OPD 在 DREAM-1K、CaReBench、ShortVidBench、MotionBench 和 VidCapBench-AE 上取得了开源模型中最强的主指标结果。消融实验及对时序覆盖与答案泄露的分析进一步表明，学生将训练时的引导内化为更有效的视频探索策略。
translation.brief: 针对视频描述代理不知应获取哪些视觉证据的问题，提出仅在训练时使用感知问题（PQ）引导教师在策略蒸馏，使学生学会主动探索视频而推理时无需 PQ。

papers.title: Exploiting Aggregate Feedback for Decentralized Equilibrium Learning in Markov Games: A Smart Grid Application
papers.abstract: In many multi-agent systems, an agent's payoff depends on its own action and an aggregate of other agents' actions, rather than their individual decisions. This paper investigates decentralized equilibrium learning in Markov games (MGs) with such aggregative reward structures. However, existing decentralized learning algorithms for general MGs typically rely on bandit feedback, without exploiting the additional information available from aggregate observations. To exploit this information, we develop an aggregation-predictive stage-based V-learning algorithm with hybrid-feedback Exp3-IX. Using known local reward functions and observed aggregate quantities, each agent evaluates the immediate rewards of all candidate actions and predicts their immediate losses from historical aggregate feedback, while continuation values are learned from selected-action state transitions. The algorithm requires neither opponents' individual information nor knowledge of the transition kernel. We establish a high-probability regret bound that explicitly depends on aggregate prediction errors and retains the standard worst-case order. Under a regularity condition on adaptive stage lengths, the algorithm learns an $\epsilon$-approximate coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) within $\widetilde O(SA_{\max}T^5/\epsilon^2)$ episodes and extends to correlated equilibrium (CE) learning. We further apply the algorithm to a renewable-rich microgrid with strategic prosumers and shared energy storage. Numerical results show smaller deviation gaps and lower gap-AUC than three learning baselines. Compared with representative demand-response rules, the learned policies exhibit weaker incentives for unilateral deviations while maintaining favorable user rewards, high renewable utilization, and relatively stable electricity prices.

translation.title: 利用聚合反馈进行马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化均衡学习：智能电网应用
translation.abstract: 在许多多智能体系统中，智能体的收益取决于自身动作与其他智能体动作的聚合量，而非它们的个体决策。本文研究具有此类聚合奖励结构的马尔可夫博弈（MG）中的去中心化均衡学习。然而，现有的面向一般 MG 的去中心化学习算法通常依赖 bandit 反馈，未利用聚合观测所提供的额外信息。为利用这些信息，我们开发了基于聚合预测的分阶段 V-learning 算法，结合混合反馈的 Exp3-IX。利用已知的本地奖励函数和观测到的聚合量，每个智能体评估所有候选动作的即时奖励，并从历史聚合反馈预测其即时损失，同时延续值从所选动作的状态转移中学习。该算法既不需要对手的个体信息，也不需要转移核的知识。我们建立了显式依赖聚合预测误差的高概率遗憾界，并保持标准的最坏情形阶。在自适应阶段长度的正则性条件下，该算法在 $\widetilde O(SA_{\max}T^5/\epsilon^2)$ 个 episode 内学习一个 $\epsilon$-近似粗关联均衡（CCE），并可扩展到关联均衡（CE）学习。我们进一步将该算法应用于含策略性产消者与共享储能的可再生能源丰富的微电网。数值结果表明其偏差间隙与 gap-AUC 均小于三个学习基线。与代表性需求响应规则相比，学到的策略展现出更弱的单边偏离激励，同时保持良好的用户收益、高可再生能源利用率和相对稳定的电价。
translation.brief: 针对具有聚合奖励结构的马尔可夫博弈中现有去中心化算法未利用聚合观测信息的问题，提出结合聚合预测与混合反馈 Exp3-IX 的分阶段 V-learning 算法，并应用于含共享储能的微电网。

papers.title: StitchRAG: Constructing Compact and Evidence-Preserving Contexts for RAG with Diffusion-Based Stitching
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external evidence. However, long retrieved contexts incur computational overhead and can even hurt performance due to noisy or irrelevant content. We propose \textsc{StitchRAG}, a framework for constructing compact context in RAG. \textsc{StitchRAG} builds a faithful, information-dense context while dynamically compressing the retrieved passages. We adapt the size reduction ratio to each passage by formulating a utility maximization trading-off the retained information and computation costs. We then extract answer candidates and query-related keywords from passages as anchors and collect passage sentences containing anchors under the derived size constraint. Finally, we connect or stitch the collected sentences together using text diffusion to form a coherent and natural context. Experiments on five open-domain QA benchmarks show that \textsc{StitchRAG} consistently outperforms diverse multi-step and compression baselines. Extensive ablations show the effectiveness of dynamic size allocation, anchor preservation, and diffusion-based stitching.

translation.title: StitchRAG：基于扩散拼接为 RAG 构建紧凑且保留证据的上下文
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大语言模型（LLM）锚定于外部证据来提升事实性。然而，冗长的检索上下文带来计算开销，甚至可能因噪声或无关内容而损害性能。我们提出 StitchRAG，一个在 RAG 中构建紧凑上下文的框架。StitchRAG 在动态压缩检索段落的同时构建忠实且信息密集的上下文。我们通过形式化一个在保留信息与计算成本之间权衡的效用最大化问题，为每个段落自适应地确定压缩比例。随后从段落中抽取答案候选和与查询相关的关键词作为锚点，并在所得大小约束下收集包含锚点的段落句子。最后，我们使用文本扩散将收集到的句子连接或拼接起来，形成连贯自然的上下文。在五个开放域 QA 基准上的实验表明，StitchRAG 持续优于多样的多步与压缩基线。大量消融实验验证了动态大小分配、锚点保留和基于扩散的拼接的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对 RAG 长上下文的计算开销与噪声问题，提出 StitchRAG，通过效用最大化动态分配各段落压缩比例，以关键词锚点选取句子并用文本扩散拼接成紧凑连贯的上下文。

papers.title: CrossEnv: Synthesizing Verifiable Cross-Environment Tasks for Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.abstract: Executable synthetic environments provide scalable training tasks and verifiable feedback for long-horizon agents. Existing environment synthesis methods primarily generate tasks within individual environments. However, these tasks do not adequately capture real-world interactions across services, where actions in one service depend on information obtained from another. Synthesizing such tasks is challenging because data generated across environments must remain consistent to support executable and verifiable interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce CrossEnv, a framework that uses an entity-tool graph to identify connections between environments and aligns task-specific data to synthesize executable, verifiable cross-environment tasks. We further propose CrossEnv-Curriculum, which progresses from single-environment tool use to coordination across more environments and business domains, before introducing user interaction. Across four external benchmarks, combining cross-environment training data with this curriculum achieves competitive performance with fewer training examples. Further analyses support the benefits of cross-environment data and curriculum training, and provide evidence of transfer to new environment combinations, external tasks less similar to the training data, and longer workflows.

translation.title: CrossEnv：为长程智能体训练合成可验证的跨环境任务
translation.abstract: 可执行的合成环境为长程智能体提供了可扩展的训练任务和可验证的反馈。现有的环境合成方法主要在单个环境内生成任务，但这些任务无法充分刻画现实中跨服务的交互——其中一个服务的动作依赖于从另一个服务获取的信息。合成此类任务具有挑战性，因为跨环境生成的数据必须保持一致，才能支持可执行且可验证的交互。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 CrossEnv，一个利用实体-工具图识别环境间连接并对齐任务相关数据的框架，从而合成可执行、可验证的跨环境任务。我们进一步提出 CrossEnv-Curriculum，训练进程从单环境工具使用逐步过渡到跨更多环境和业务领域的协调，最后引入用户交互。在四个外部基准上，将跨环境训练数据与该课程相结合，以更少的训练样本取得了具有竞争力的性能。进一步分析支持了跨环境数据和课程训练的收益，并提供了向新环境组合、与训练数据相似度较低的外部任务以及更长工作流迁移的证据。
translation.brief: 针对现有环境合成只能生成单环境任务、无法刻画跨服务依赖的问题，提出用实体-工具图对齐跨环境数据来合成可验证的跨环境任务，并配合课程式训练。

papers.title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

translation.title: NexSight：面向细粒度智能体长视频理解的可验证任务
translation.abstract: 关于长视频的细粒度问题会询问某个动作发生了多少次、事件以何种顺序展开、或某个状态究竟在何时发生变化。回答这些问题可能需要在长达数小时的视频中寻找零散的短暂片段。能够决定何时何地观看的智能体模型有望找到这些片段，但这一能力既难以度量也难以学习。稀疏的支持证据或许能证明某动作发生过，却无法证明其总次数；验证覆盖整条时间线的主张需要检查是否有遗漏或重复计数；而仅依据答案的监督又无法显式监督证据搜索过程。我们提出 NexSight，构建可验证任务来同时评估和训练智能体式的长视频理解。其智能体流水线 SightForge 只接受满足以下条件的任务：一个对草拟答案不可见的验证器能够依据从原始视频重新密集获取的证据重建该答案，且反例检查无法将其推翻。由此得到 SightLine——从 108 个长视频中提取的 310 个证据可追溯任务，并通过 SightLoop 进行评估，这是一个共享的多尺度测试框架，支持时间探索、局部查看、证据整合与回看，同时记录返回的观察结果。在不相交的视频上，经验证任务上的求解轨迹成为观察决策的步级监督。最强模型在 SightLine 上仅达到 54.52%，但在给定标注证据时达到 79.35%。仅用不到 6K 的样本，Sight-35B 将其基础模型的交互式准确率近乎翻倍（21.29% 提升至 42.26%），超越了同系列 397B 模型，在后训练后开始使用其基础模型从未使用过的显式空间查看，并在两个外部长视频基准上提升超过 8 个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对长视频细粒度理解难以度量与学习的问题，提出通过验证器盲重建与反例检查构建证据可追溯的可验证任务，并用其进行评估与训练智能体式视频理解模型。

papers.title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
papers.abstract: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.

translation.title: 视觉工具框架使通用 VLM 扩展至医学图像
translation.abstract: 我们证明，合适的视觉工具框架可以显著提升通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在多种医学影像任务上的性能。我们引入 \ours，一个医学视觉工具框架，为通用 VLM 配备交互式视觉工具和系统化的诊断证据管理。借助 \ours，通用 VLM 可以交互式地探索医学图像并逐步获取诊断证据，这些证据被无损地保存在记忆中以便后续检索和使用。在提交初始答案后，VLM 会收到关于潜在遗漏和已发现结果可靠性的评估。该评估指导进一步的图像检查与测量，随后在迭代式智能体循环中修订答案，直到获得足够的证据。在 11 个任务和 4 种影像模态上，\ours 使 Qwen3.8-27B 在所有任务上均有提升，其中脾脏测量（63.3% 提升至 98.3%）、肾脏搜索（57.5% 提升至 71.2%）和肺结节检测（0.0% 提升至 28.2%）的提升尤为显著。高性能的 API 型 VLM 借助 \ours 取得了更高的性能。例如，GPT-6.1 Sol 在 \ours 的帮助下将肺结节检测从 10.8% 提升至 69.2%，展现了更强模型能力与有效医学视觉工具框架的互补优势。我们的结果凸显了视觉工具框架作为将通用 VLM 扩展至医学影像任务的新范式的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对通用VLM在医学影像上表现不佳的问题，提出配备交互式视觉工具与诊断证据管理的医学视觉框架，使模型迭代探索图像并修订答案。

papers.title: TabDAG: Structured Evolutionary Search for Tabular Feature Engineering
papers.abstract: Feature engineering can improve tabular prediction, but useful transformations are compositional, data-dependent, and subject to leakage constraints. We present TabDAG, a framework that combines evolutionary search with a graph representation of feature-engineering programs. Nodes implement row-wise or data-fitted transformations; edges encode dependencies among raw variables, intermediate values, and final features. The representation supports interactions, statistical encodings, clustering- and neighborhood-based features, and multi-stage compositions in a single executable program. Mutations are structured edits constrained by a parent-specific schema and checked before evaluation. In our experiments, no structurally invalid program reached evaluation, although proposals could be rejected and valid graphs could still fail at runtime.
