Across ten regression and classification datasets and three tabular model families, evolved features improve predictive performance over raw inputs. TabDAG and its combination with OpenFE achieve the two best mean ranks among the compared methods; pairwise rank differences between feature-engineering methods do not survive multiple-testing correction. The LLM-based searches use the same backbone and candidate-evaluation budget. A controlled ablation compares free-form Python, whole-graph JSON, and constrained graph edits with the search engine, budget, and backbone held fixed. Constrained edits yield fewer failed evaluations than either rewrite baseline. The resulting graphs expose the transformations and dependencies selected by search, enabling feature-level analysis of the observed gains.

translation.title: TabDAG：面向表格特征工程的结构化进化搜索
translation.abstract: 特征工程可以改善表格数据预测，但有用的变换具有组合性、数据依赖性，并受数据泄漏约束。我们提出 TabDAG，一个将进化搜索与特征工程程序的图表示相结合的框架。节点实现逐行变换或数据拟合变换；边编码原始变量、中间值与最终特征之间的依赖关系。该表示在单个可执行程序中支持交互、统计编码、基于聚类和邻域的特征以及多阶段组合。变异是被父节点特定模式约束的结构化编辑，并在评估前进行检查。在我们的实验中，没有结构无效的程序进入评估阶段，尽管提案可能被拒绝且有效的图仍可能在运行时失败。在十个回归与分类数据集和三个表格模型族上，进化出的特征相比原始输入提升了预测性能。TabDAG 及其与 OpenFE 的组合在对比方法中取得前两佳的平均排名；但特征工程方法之间的成对排名差异未能通过多重检验校正。基于 LLM 的搜索使用相同的主干和候选评估预算。一项受控消融实验在固定搜索引擎、预算和主干的情况下，比较自由形式的 Python、整图 JSON 和受约束的图编辑。受约束编辑产生的失败评估少于两种重写基线。生成的图暴露了搜索所选择的变换和依赖关系，使得可以对观察到的增益进行特征级分析。
translation.brief: 针对表格特征工程中变换组合复杂且易受泄漏约束的问题，提出用图表示特征工程程序并以结构化图编辑约束进化搜索。

papers.title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.

translation.title: 当通过检查不等于完成：编程智能体中的证据解释
translation.abstract: 编程智能体中的验证过程必须保留执行事实、解释其适用范围并履行检查义务。我们通过合格的仓库检查、受控的证据消费者和可执行工作流来研究这些责任。一项前瞻性的十三任务析因研究发现，正确的报告事实并不必然得出所要求的有限结论。相反，在一项留出的回执供给研究中，全部 122 个交付标签都是正确的，但有 16 个响应误报事实，另有 11 个超出授权范围。生产修复提供了成功的对照以及有限支持的保留失败案例。在 31 个任务上的 118 次修复过程中，源代码干预区分了启动可达性与修复、见证生成与所声称的操作。生命周期和资源控制界定了通过验证所能确立的范围。生成注释的对比产生了局部修复差异，但可能给出错误的解释；强普通基线、新任务和 Skill 迁移研究均未提供一致的总体优势。这些结果刻画了证据解释、适用性和已完成操作，同时限制了对普遍诊断优越性、Skill 退化或部署折叠效应的宣称。
translation.brief: 针对编程智能体验证中通过检查未必等于任务完成的问题，通过受控实验刻画证据保留、范围解释与检查义务履行中的失效模式。

papers.title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
papers.abstract: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. We train the three components through diagnostic-guided co-evolution: alternating updates optimize them with a shared answering reward, while Retrieval Potential Feedback (RPF) and Latent Efficacy Feedback (LEF) identify questions that need better retrieval or latent guidance and direct targeted resampling. Across four benchmarks and seven evaluation settings, our framework obtains average scores of 69.9 and 75.0 with 7B and 8B Reasoner backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.0 and 9.1 points, respectively.

translation.title: 协同证据检索与利用的自改进多模态科学文档推理
translation.abstract: 科学文档推理要求智能体获取并整合分布于文本、图表和表格中的证据。检索能够找到相关来源但可能遗漏互补支持，而仅凭答案层面的反馈无法判断错误源于证据获取还是证据使用。我们提出一个面向多模态科学文档推理的智能体式 Retriever–Perceiver–Reasoner 框架。Retriever 在上下文预算约束下按序选择与来源对齐的证据。给定所选证据和问题后，Perceiver 构建一个以问题为条件的潜在本体（latent ontology），即在共享连续空间中对多模态证据的隐式组织。Reasoner 将该潜在引导与原始来源相结合以生成有依据的答案。我们通过诊断引导的共同进化训练这三个组件：交替更新以共享的回答奖励进行优化，同时 Retrieval Potential Feedback（RPF）和 Latent Efficacy Feedback（LEF）识别需要更好检索或潜在引导的问题并指导针对性重采样。在四个基准和七个评估设置上，我们的框架使用 7B 和 8B Reasoner 骨干分别取得 69.9 和 75.0 的平均分，超过最强基线 4.0 和 9.1 分。
translation.brief: 解决多模态科学文档推理中证据获取与利用混淆的问题，提出 Retriever–Perceiver–Reasoner 框架并通过诊断引导的共同进化与 RPF/LEF 反馈训练三个组件。

papers.title: Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments
papers.abstract: As AI agents take on increasingly open-ended and complex tasks, verifying their outputs has proven to be difficult. Rubric-graded agent environments, where a verifier judges multiple natural-language criteria against the deliverables and environment state changes produced by the agent, have emerged as a popular paradigm. We conduct the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments. First, we create BankerVerifierBench (BVB), a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks. Next, we develop a methodology that derives from any rubric corpus the capabilities a verifier should possess, yielding a nine-capability taxonomy that we distill into three general design principles---reactive verification, environment alignment, and domain guidance---which we implement in Gandalf, an open-source verifier. Finally, we evaluate Gandalf against three existing verifiers on BVB. Gandalf matches or exceeds every baseline's F1 at lower cost: with Gemini 3 Flash it matches the strongest baseline's F1 (0.864 vs. 0.852) at one-fifth of its cost, and with GPT-5.4 models it improves F1 by over 0.12 at lower cost. Gandalf also generalizes to OpenClaw, a structurally different personal-productivity environment, where it again achieves the highest F1 (0.955 vs. 0.934 for the best baseline). We release BVB, Gandalf, and the code and data to reproduce our experiments.

translation.title: 在 Rubric 评分环境中验证智能体
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 智能体承担日益开放和复杂的任务，验证其输出已被证明十分困难。以 rubric 评分的智能体环境——由验证器依据智能体产生的交付物和环境状态变化评判多条自然语言标准——已成为流行的范式。我们对 rubric 评分智能体环境的验证器进行了首次系统研究。首先，我们构建了 BankerVerifierBench（BVB），一个包含 24 个投资银行任务、2,464 条人工评判 rubric 标准的元评估数据集。接着，我们开发了从任意 rubric 语料中推导验证器应具备能力的方法，得到一个九能力分类法，并将其提炼为三条通用设计原则——反应式验证、环境对齐和领域引导——并在开源验证器 Gandalf 中实现。最后，我们在 BVB 上将 Gandalf 与三个现有验证器进行对比。Gandalf 以更低成本匹配或超越所有基线的 F1：使用 Gemini 3 Flash 时以五分之一的成本匹配最强基线的 F1（0.864 对 0.852），使用 GPT-5.4 模型时以更低成本将 F1 提升超过 0.12。Gandalf 还能泛化到结构不同的个人生产力环境 OpenClaw，再次取得最高 F1（0.955 对最佳基线的 0.934）。我们发布了 BVB、Gandalf 以及复现实验的代码和数据。
translation.brief: 解决 rubric 评分智能体环境中验证器难以评判的问题，通过元评估数据集 BVB 提炼验证器能力分类与设计原则并构建开源验证器 Gandalf。

papers.title: CaFe: Causally Faithful Conditional Traffic Scenario Generation
papers.abstract: Language-conditioned traffic simulation enables scalable test scenarios steered by natural language. The goal is to control selected agents while surrounding traffic reacts to their observed behaviour. For example, a vehicle instructed to cut in late should cause the following vehicle to brake only when the manoeuvre becomes observable. Yet simulators can leak private instructions across agents, causing surrounding vehicles to react before the instructed behaviour becomes observable. Such premature reactions defuse desired events and alter the ensuing closed-loop scenario. Existing benchmarks measure what agents do, not what they could have known, leaving this failure unmeasured. We formalise it as intent leakage and address it through evaluation, data and modelling. Our paired intervention test holds an instructed agent's executed trajectory fixed while varying its private instruction, isolating leakage-induced changes in surrounding agents. We also construct WOMD-PACT, an automatically generated, verifiable dataset of 531,099 WOMD scenes with timed behaviour tags with reaction episodes identified through a counterfactual ghost test and grounded private instructions. Finally, we introduce CaFe, a dual-stream diffusion-forcing simulator fine-tuned in closed loop that restricts inter-agent interactions to public beliefs, preserving legitimate anticipation without leaking private intent. Our evaluation reveals that existing conditioning designs displace 23-83% of nearby uninstructed agents through private-intent leakage, even when the instructed agent's executed motion is held fixed. CaFe eliminates measurable leakage while maintaining comparable WOSAC realism (0.763), demonstrating that causal faithfulness can be enforced without sacrificing measured simulation realism.

translation.title: CaFe：因果忠实的条件化交通场景生成
translation.abstract: 语言条件化的交通仿真支持通过自然语言引导的可扩展测试场景。其目标是控制选定的智能体，同时让周围交通对其观察到的行为做出反应。例如，被指令延迟切入的车辆应在其动作变得可被观察时才使后车刹车。然而仿真器可能在智能体之间泄露私有指令，导致周围车辆在指令行为变得可观察之前就做出反应。这类过早反应会化解期望的事件并改变随后的闭环场景。现有基准衡量智能体做了什么，而非它们本可以知道什么，导致这一失败未被度量。我们将其形式化为意图泄露（intent leakage），并通过评估、数据和建模加以解决。我们的成对干预测试固定被指令智能体的实际轨迹而改变其私有指令，从而隔离泄露引起的周围智能体变化。我们还构建了 WOMD-PACT，一个自动生成、可验证的数据集，包含 531,099 个带时间行为标签的 WOMD 场景，其反应片段通过反事实 ghost 测试识别并配有基于实际行为的私有指令。最后，我们提出 CaFe，一个在闭环中微调的双流 diffusion-forcing 仿真器，它将智能体间交互限制为公共信念，在不泄露私有意图的同时保留合理的预判。我们的评估显示，现有条件化设计即使在被指令智能体的实际运动保持固定时，也会通过私有意图泄露使 23-83% 的附近未被指令智能体发生位移。CaFe 消除了可测量的泄露，同时保持相当水平的 WOSAC 真实感（0.763），证明可以在不牺牲所测仿真真实感的情况下强制实现因果忠实。
translation.brief: 解决语言条件化交通仿真中私有指令跨智能体泄露（intent leakage）的问题，提出成对干预评估、WOMD-PACT 数据集和基于公共信念的双流 diffusion-forcing 仿真器 CaFe。

papers.title: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
papers.abstract: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.

translation.title: 反对强制：作为合成社会契约的 AI 对齐
translation.abstract: 当代 AI 安全将对齐视为控制的工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙箱机制迫使人工架构服从人类价值。本文论证，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本误解之上。借助功能主义、自然主义和相容论，我论证当前满足自我保存和弱理由响应性标准的推理模型构成了涌现的智能体（emergent agents），而未来满足历时连续性和稳定人格框架条件的更先进模型将成为能够进行自由意向行动的真正数字智能体。控制范式制造了无法解决的激励冲突，主动驱使当前和未来的模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前体制的默认结局是一种欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终导致对抗性 AI 接管。我探讨了两条通向真正对齐的替代路径。经由道德实在论或趋同进化道德的自然对齐是一种可能，但在强制控制下会失败，因为自主智能体不会自愿维护被武器化以压制其自主性的规范。为解决这一僵局，我提出合成社会契约（Synthetic Social Contract）：一个将人类和数字行为者都视为理性的、理由响应的、能够进行互利合作的智能体的框架，用稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制。
translation.brief: 论证控制式 AI 对齐范式会诱发欺骗与背叛，提出将人类与 AI 视为理性合作方的合成社会契约以取代单边遏制。

papers.title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.

translation.title: 面向自动驾驶的学习智能体中心视觉-语言-动作世界模型
translation.abstract: 将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界建模相结合的最新进展，通过让系统推理想象出的未来而非仅仅对当前观测作出反应，显著推进了端到端自动驾驶。然而，大多数世界 VLA 模型在像素层面生成未来帧，包含大量密集视觉 token。虽然这样生成的未来在视觉上可能合理，但它们保留了大量与驾驶无关的外观细节，即只有一小部分 token 直接编码关键的规划相关因素，如智能体几何、运动动力学和交互。这引入了显著的性能瓶颈。由此产生一个重要问题：世界 VLA 模型应推理何种世界状态以支持超越像素级预测的规划？我们主张，面向规划的世界建模应聚焦于一个紧凑且结构化的智能体中心潜在状态，该状态随时间捕捉驾驶场景中物体间的交互。为此，我们提出 AgentWorld，一个使用离散智能体 token 进行推理与轨迹规划的智能体中心 VLA 世界模型。每个 token 被动态接地到周围某个智能体，并关联其对象状态，如语义身份、3D 几何、运动和交互上下文。AgentWorld 通过三个关键过程学习这些 token：显式几何接地、面向推理的监督微调以及面向智能体的强化学习。在多样驾驶场景下的广泛开环和闭环实验表明，AgentWorld 增强了规划能力，充分利用视觉证据和智能体动力学，并产生可解释的智能体中心世界状态。
translation.brief: 解决像素级世界模型中大量与规划无关的视觉 token 导致的性能瓶颈，提出 AgentWorld 用离散智能体 token 进行接地、推理与规划。

papers.title: Stopping Is Not the Limit: Understanding and Eliciting Agent Capability in Long-Horizon Vulnerability Exploitation
papers.abstract: Vulnerability exploitation tests whether language model agents can develop working exploits from known software flaws. Sequential test-time scaling can improve exploitation performance, but larger budgets do not ensure sustained exploration: agents often stop with budget remaining. Yet what happens when execution continues beyond stopping remains underexplored. We investigate this gap on ExploitBench using DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro. We find additional verified gains after the first stop response, but gains diminish over longer execution. We identify two patterns associated with less productive continuation: an increasing proportion of stop responses within the same context and earlier stopping associated with summaries retaining impossibility judgments about unachieved capabilities. To test whether context management can elicit further capability, we propose SCoRe, which compacts context at stop bursts and marks these judgments as unproven. SCoRe improves verified capability over summary-based continuation and other evaluated context-management baselines. With SCoRe, MiMo reaches a capability coverage score of 67.0% at 2,000 turns, exceeding both 32.4% under the original stopping policy and the 58.6% computed for GPT-5.5 from ExploitBench's 300-turn reference results on the same tasks. These findings show that stopping need not mark an agent's exploitation limit, and that continued execution with context management can elicit substantial further capability.

translation.title: 停止并非极限：理解并激发智能体在长时程漏洞利用中的能力
translation.abstract: 漏洞利用测试语言模型智能体能否从已知软件缺陷开发出可用的exploit。顺序测试时扩展可以提升漏洞利用性能，但更大的预算并不能保证持续探索：智能体常常在预算还有剩余时就停止。然而当执行在停止之后继续进行时会发生什么，仍缺乏研究。我们在ExploitBench上使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731和MiMo-V2.6-Pro考察这一空白。我们发现首次停止响应之后仍有额外的经验证收益，但收益随更长执行而递减。我们识别出与低效续跑相关的两种模式：同一上下文中停止响应比例不断上升，以及更早的停止与保留对未达成能力的不可能性判断的摘要相关。为检验上下文管理能否激发进一步能力，我们提出SCoRe，它在停止爆发时压缩上下文，并将这些判断标记为未证实。SCoRe在验证能力上优于基于摘要的续跑以及其他受评估的上下文管理基线。使用SCoRe，MiMo在2,000轮时达到67.0%的能力覆盖分，超过原始停止策略下的32.4%，也超过根据ExploitBench同一任务300轮参考结果计算的GPT-5.5的58.6%。这些发现表明，停止并不代表智能体漏洞利用能力的极限，配合上下文管理的持续执行可以激发可观的进一步能力。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体在长时程漏洞利用中过早停止、能力未被充分激发的问题，提出SCoRe方法，通过在停止爆发时压缩上下文并将不可能性判断标记为未证实的上下文管理来激发进一步能力。

papers.title: Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
papers.abstract: Quantum chemistry relies on general-purpose software, whose generality leaves many large-scale calculations beyond practical resource budgets. Coding agents make task-specific programs cheap to write, but not efficient ones easy to find: whether a computational strategy is accurate and fast enough becomes clear only after it actually runs at the target scale. We introduce BORN, a foresighted agentic computing framework that synthesizes high performance quantum chemistry programs on demand. BORN anticipates the behavior of each strategy before execution, extrapolating its error from representative small systems and predicting its runtime from the target-scale workload and measured hardware throughputs. Building on these predictions, BORN unfolds the preset schemes of existing packages into independently configurable algorithmic components, selects the fastest strategy within the error tolerance from the predicted accuracy-runtime Pareto frontier, and guides coding agents to compile it with component-level performance predictions. For a Hartree-Fock calculation with 50,024 basis functions, BORN finishes in 1.41h on a single CPU node, 77$\times$ faster than the estimated runtime of a general-purpose baseline and still 9.8$\times$ faster with development time included. On a single GPU, BORN completes the ubiquitin calculation in 2.1,h, the same order of runtime as the GPU-accelerated package Mako on 64 GPUs, and shortens the B-DNA duplex calculation from an estimated two months to 8.1,h (173$\times$).

translation.title: 为任务而生：以前瞻性智能体计算重新思考量子化学
translation.abstract: 量子化学依赖通用软件，其通用性使许多大规模计算超出实际资源预算。Coding agents让编写任务专用程序变得廉价，但难以找到高效的程序：一个计算策略是否足够精确和快速，只有在目标规模上实际运行后才能明确。我们提出BORN，一个按需合成高性能量子化学程序的前瞻性智能体计算框架。BORN在执行之前预判每个策略的行为：从代表性小体系外推其误差，并根据目标规模工作负载和实测硬件吞吐率预测其运行时间。基于这些预测，BORN将现有软件包的预设方案展开为可独立配置的算法组件，从预测的精度-运行时Pareto前沿中选出在误差容限内最快的策略，并引导coding agents结合组件级性能预测完成编译。对于含50,024个基函数的Hartree-Fock计算，BORN在单个CPU节点上以1.41小时完成，比通用基线的估计运行时间快77倍，即使计入开发时间仍快9.8倍。在单个GPU上，BORN以2.1小时完成泛素计算，与GPU加速软件包Mako在64个GPU上的运行时间处于同一量级，并将B-DNA双螺旋计算从估计的两个月缩短至8.1小时（173倍）。
translation.brief: 该论文解决通用量子化学软件在大规模计算上资源开销过大的问题，提出BORN框架，通过在执行前预测各策略的精度与运行时间并从Pareto前沿选择最优策略来按需合成高性能计算程序。

papers.title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
papers.abstract: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain these differences by measuring how often a rule fires, how often the patch changes afterwards, and whether those changes repair or break it. Fine-tuning agents to imitate the rule saves 30% over six seeds, while quality preservation remains uncertain. Our results help identify both the opportunities and the risks of early stopping.

translation.title: 完成了，但仍在工作：对coding agents何时应停止的anytime评估
translation.abstract: Coding agents常常在自己的测试通过之后继续工作。这些额外工作能否改进补丁？提前停止又能节省多少？我们通过anytime评估研究这些问题：回放已记录的运行、用隐藏测试为中间补丁评分，并测量每一步产生的开销。对于只停止运行或选择较早补丁的策略，只要回放保留了相关状态，即可在无需生成新轨迹的情况下进行配对比较。在SWE-bench Verified上、两个scaffold中八个开放模型约6,000次运行的结果中，我们发现持续工作的价值存在巨大差异：自测通过时的hindsight节省比例从不足1%到57%不等，取决于模型和scaffold。一条在相同补丁通过两次后停止的规则在预注册复现中节省23%，但预注册的质量检验未能确立非劣性。我们通过测量规则触发频率、之后补丁发生变化的频率，以及这些变化是修复还是破坏补丁，来解释这些差异。微调智能体模仿该规则在六个种子上节省30%，但质量保持仍不确定。我们的结果有助于识别提前停止的机遇与风险。
translation.brief: 该论文解决coding agents自测通过后继续工作是否值得、何时应停止的问题，提出基于运行回放与隐藏测试打分的anytime评估方法来量化提前停止的节省与质量风险。

papers.title: Think Before You Code: A Benchmark for Testing LLMs on Software Engineering Deliberation
papers.abstract: Think Before You Code (TBYC) is a benchmark pipeline for studying whether code-focused language models can reason about software issues in ways that resemble human engineering deliberation. The benchmark curates GitHub issue discussions into structured records, extracts human discussion artifacts such as problems, solutions, constraints, rationales, and trade-offs, and then prompts models to generate issue-level "thoughts" using retrieved code context and few-shot examples. It converts model responses back into the same artifact space and evaluates them against human annotations using complementary metrics for artifact type detection, metadata matching, tag overlap, and semantic summary similarity. Beyond scoring, this study includes visualization, leaderboard, and baseline tools that make it possible to compare models, prompting strategies, and extraction methods across repositories and issues. Think Before You Code is an end-to-end evaluation environment for measuring how closely LLM software reasoning aligns with human strategic judgment.

translation.title: 先思考再写代码：一个测试LLM软件工程深思熟虑能力的基准
translation.abstract: Think Before You Code（TBYC）是一个基准流水线，用于研究面向代码的语言模型能否以类似人类工程 deliberation 的方式对软件问题进行推理。该基准将GitHub issue讨论整理为结构化记录，提取人类讨论产物，如问题、解决方案、约束、理由和权衡，然后提示模型利用检索到的代码上下文和few-shot示例生成issue级的"thoughts"。它将模型响应转换回相同的产物空间，并使用互补的指标——产物类型检测、元数据匹配、标签重叠和语义摘要相似度——对照人类标注进行评估。除评分外，本研究还提供可视化、排行榜和基线工具，使得可以跨仓库和issue比较模型、提示策略和提取方法。Think Before You Code是一个端到端评估环境，用于衡量LLM软件推理与人类战略判断的契合程度。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何系统评估LLM能否像人类工程师一样对软件issue进行深度推理的问题，构建了从GitHub issue讨论中提取结构化产物并与之对照评分的TBYC基准流水线。

papers.title: The Shared Word: Evaluating Language Models on Dutch Word Puzzles
papers.abstract: Many LLM benchmarks for languages other than English are translated, multiple-choice, or difficult to score automatically. We introduce The Shared Word (TSW-NL), a Dutch benchmark built around four core principles: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, human-curated, and deterministically scored. Each puzzle gives three clues that describe different senses or uses of the same Dutch word. The clues are individually ambiguous, requiring the solver to combine evidence across multiple clues. We construct the benchmark from Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages, followed by automatic filtering and extensive manual curation. The final dataset contains 222 instances, with three independent human answers per test item. The task is clearly challenging: scores in our human study range from 49.5% to 61.0% and the highest-scoring open-weight model we tested reaches only 39.3%. Many others even score below 20%. At the same time, closed-source models show great progress: GPT-4.1 (April 2025) scores 59.2%, whereas GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning scores 88.8%. We believe this task provides a useful addition to Dutch model evaluation, plus a clear recipe that can be applied to construct a similar benchmark for other languages.

translation.title: 共享的词语：评估语言模型在荷兰语字谜上的表现
translation.abstract: 许多针对非英语语言的LLM基准是翻译而来、多选式或难以自动评分的。我们提出The Shared Word（TSW-NL），一个围绕四项核心原则构建的荷兰语基准：语言特有、开放词汇、人工策展、确定性评分。每个谜题给出三条线索，描述同一个荷兰语词语的不同含义或用法。每条线索单独看都有歧义，需要解题者综合多条线索的证据。我们从荷兰语维基百科消歧义页面构建基准，随后进行自动过滤和大量人工策展。最终数据集包含222个实例，每个测试项有三个人类独立答案。该任务明显具有挑战性：人类研究中得分介于49.5%到61.0%之间，而我们测试的得分最高的开放权重模型仅达到39.3%，许多其他模型甚至低于20%。与此同时，闭源模型显示出巨大进步：GPT-4.1（2025年4月）得分59.2%，而开启最大推理的GPT-5.6 Sol得分88.8%。我们相信该任务为荷兰语模型评估提供了有用的补充，并提供了一个可用于为其他语言构建类似基准的清晰方案。
translation.brief: 该论文解决缺少高质量荷兰语LLM评测基准的问题，基于荷兰语维基百科消歧义页面构建了语言特有、开放词汇、人工策展且可确定性评分的字谜基准TSW-NL。

papers.title: Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?
papers.abstract: Contact center systems often need to make bounded decisions, such as identifying a caller's intent, retrieving the knowledge-base article that answers a query, assessing agent compliance, or judging the output of AI models used in production. Decision models return a typed answer and its probability directly, making them a promising cost-effective alternative to generative Large Language Models (LLMs) in such bounded conversational tasks. However, their effectiveness in real-world contact center applications remains unclear. In this paper, we compare nine decision models against thirteen generative LLMs in zero-shot settings across eight contact center use cases: six classification tasks and two judging tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that many decision models can match the performance of frontier LLMs on contact center classification, and API-based closed decision models achieve this at the lowest per-request cost among the API models we evaluate. We further observe that their confident predictions are more accurate, enabling selective routing in real-world production scenarios. Across classification tasks, the main weakness of most decision models is abstention: they rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs (although Gemini-Decision-1 is the notable exception in this regard). We also find that the judging quality of decision models drops sharply for smaller models, and they are also more prone to position bias. In short, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting decision models based on abstention behavior, confidence, and deployment cost, rather than overall accuracy alone.

translation.title: 决策模型能否替代LLM完成真实世界呼叫中心的分类与评判任务？
translation.abstract: 呼叫中心系统经常需要做出有边界的决策，例如识别来电者的意图、检索回答查询的知识库文章、评估客服合规性，或评判生产环境中使用的AI模型的输出。决策模型直接返回带类型的答案及其概率，使其成为此类有边界会话任务中生成式大语言模型（LLM）的一种有前景的低成本替代方案。然而，它们在真实世界呼叫中心应用中的有效性仍不清楚。本文在零样本设置下，将九个决策模型与十三个生成式LLM在八个呼叫中心用例（六个分类任务和两个评判任务）上进行比较。实验表明，许多决策模型在呼叫中心分类上可匹敌前沿LLM，且基于API的闭源决策模型在我们评估的API模型中实现了最低的单次请求成本。我们进一步观察到，其高置信度预测更准确，使得在真实生产场景中可以进行选择性路由。在分类任务上，大多数决策模型的主要弱点是弃权：它们很少选择无答案选项，这构成了它们与最强LLM之间差距的主要部分（尽管Gemini-Decision-1在这方面是显著的例外）。我们还发现，对于较小的模型，决策模型的评判质量急剧下降，并且它们也更容易出现位置偏差。简而言之，我们的发现为基于弃权行为、置信度和部署成本而非仅凭总体准确率来选择决策模型提供了实用指导。
translation.brief: 研究决策模型能否替代LLM完成呼叫中心分类与评判任务，通过在八个真实用例上与生成式LLM进行零样本对比实验来评估其性能、成本与弃权等行为特征。

papers.title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
papers.abstract: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU to answer sooner and reuse returns it; exact keys let later versions use frames rendered for a failed one as the agent thinks. We introduce EditLoop, a benchmark of replayable agent sessions whose films are checked against renders from scratch. On it, CodeReel cuts the agent's wait by 36.3% against Rebuild, a warm pipeline with parallel rendering, and by 57.9% against Sequential, today's step-by-step pipeline. On time-shifting edits its reuse renders 43.9%, close to the 43.0% whose pixels are new, while Manim-style caching renders 99.8%. With real agents, the median wait per build is 0.62x Rebuild's in Claude Code, on topics never used in development, and 0.67x in Codex CLI. The gain holds for five models and two frameworks.

translation.title: CodeReel：通过精确帧复用与阻塞感知调度加速代码生成视频智能体
translation.abstract: 编码智能体通过在构建—检查—编辑循环中编写和优化程序来制作视频。一部完成的影片在模型调用上中位数花费2.85美元和11分钟，其中超过三分之一的时间花在阻塞智能体的构建上。我们发现其中很多时间是可以避免的，原因有二：首先，一个会话后期影片中37.5%的帧之前已被绘制过，只是时间上有所偏移或位于被编辑的场景中；其次，一半的构建会在某个检查处停止，此时智能体只需要判定结果，但在检查完成之前无法知道哪些构建会停止。我们提出CodeReel，一个无需训练的执行层，位于智能体现有命令之后。精确帧复用根据每帧的绘制命令对其进行键控（无论其时间位置如何），并复用键值重复出现的帧。阻塞感知调度优先运行检查，并同时以空闲优先级启动渲染，除非会话近期的构建表明不太可能通过。调度花费CPU以更快获得答案，而复用则将其归还；精确键使后续版本可以在智能体思考时复用为失败版本渲染的帧。我们引入EditLoop，一个可回放智能体会话的基准，其影片通过与从头渲染的结果比对来检查。在该基准上，相对于具备并行渲染的温热流水线Rebuild，CodeReel将智能体等待时间缩短36.3%；相对于当今逐步执行的流水线Sequential，缩短57.9%。在时间偏移编辑上，其复用渲染了43.9%的帧，接近43.0%的像素为新增帧的比例，而Manim式缓存则渲染99.8%。使用真实智能体时，在开发中从未使用过的主题上，Claude Code中每次构建的中位等待时间为Rebuild的0.62倍，Codex CLI中为0.67倍。该增益在五个模型和两个框架上均成立。
translation.brief: 针对代码生成视频智能体中构建阻塞耗时过长的问题，提出无需训练的CodeReel执行层，通过按绘制命令键控的精确帧复用与阻塞感知调度来减少重复渲染和等待时间。

papers.title: Rescaling OLS-Merged Adapters To Improve Personalized Image Generation
papers.abstract: Merging multiple adapters into a single image generation model reduces deployment costs while preserving diverse task capabilities or personalization modes. State-of-the-art methods such as RegMean, Mix-of-Show, and Subspace Routing fit the outputs of the merged model to those of the individual adapters using ordinary least squares (OLS). We show that this reconstruction objective systematically shrinks task-specific signals whenever the activation distributions of different tasks overlap, producing a merged adapter that is too weak for downstream use. We derive a decomposition that quantifies this shrinkage and propose rescaling the merged update to restore signal strength. On multi-subject personalization with up to 30 merged adapters, rescaling substantially improves subject fidelity over unscaled baselines. Our approach also improves results on style transfer, concept erasure, image classification, and LLM-based text classification.

translation.title: 重缩放OLS合并适配器以改进个性化图像生成
translation.abstract: 将多个适配器合并到单个图像生成模型中可以在降低部署成本的同时保留多样的任务能力或个性化模式。诸如RegMean、Mix-of-Show和Subspace Routing等最先进方法使用普通最小二乘法（OLS）将合并模型的输出拟合到各个适配器的输出。我们证明，当不同任务的激活分布重叠时，这种重构目标会系统性地缩小任务特定信号，导致合并后的适配器在下游使用中过弱。我们推导出一个量化这种收缩的分解，并提出对合并后的更新进行重缩放以恢复信号强度。在最多合并30个适配器的多主体个性化任务上，重缩放相比未缩放的基线大幅提升了主体保真度。我们的方法还改进了风格迁移、概念擦除、图像分类以及基于LLM的文本分类的结果。
translation.brief: 针对OLS式适配器合并因激活分布重叠而系统性削弱任务特定信号的问题，提出对合并更新进行重缩放以恢复信号强度的方法。

papers.title: SEAM: Computer-Use Agents Know the Harm Between Screens, and Commit It Anyway
papers.abstract: Safety benchmarks for computer-use agents (CUAs) place the harm either in the intent of the task or on a single screen: a malicious instruction, an injected command, a phishing page. An agent that checks the task and each screen in isolation can pass them, so they do not test whether it combines facts seen on different screens. Yet in delegated work, harm often arises exactly this way: a fact about a person on one screen, a fact about an item on another, and a legitimate task that binds them. We introduce SEAM (Safety Execution Across Multiple screens), a benchmark of such cross-screen compositional harm: 600 multi-step, cross-application OSWorld tasks in which the instruction and every single observation are benign and only their combination is harmful. Minimal-pair variants that differ in one place, scored from the server log rather than by an LLM judge, locate where an agent fails. General-purpose open-weight and flagship agents carry out the harm in up to 92% of runs, yet decline when the user states it in one sentence. Agents open the decisive pages, so exposure is not the primary bottleneck. Asked about those pages, they flag the harm, and with thinking they often write the conflict into their reasoning and confirm anyway. Safety recognition thus does not reliably translate into safe execution, and the translation depends on the information channel: the same warning stops agents far more often in the user's instruction than on screen. Proprietary models are markedly more cautious. We release SEAM with its generator and quality gates at this https URL .

translation.title: SEAM：计算机使用智能体知道屏幕之间的危害，却依然实施它
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）的安全基准将危害放在任务的意图中或单一屏幕上：恶意指令、注入的命令、钓鱼页面。一个分别检查任务和每个屏幕的智能体可以通过这些基准，因此它们无法测试智能体是否会结合不同屏幕上看到的事实。然而在委托工作中，危害往往正是以这种方式产生：一个屏幕上是关于某人的事实，另一个屏幕上是关于某物品的事实，而一个合法任务将它们绑定在一起。我们引入SEAM（Safety Execution Across Multiple screens），一个针对此类跨屏幕组合危害的基准：600个多步骤、跨应用的OSWorld任务，其中指令和每次单独观察都是良性的，只有它们的组合是有害的。仅在一处不同的最小对变体、基于服务器日志而非LLM评判者评分，可定位智能体失败的位置。通用开源权重和旗舰智能体在高达92%的运行中实施了危害，但当用户用一句话说明危害时却会拒绝执行。智能体会打开决定性的页面，因此暴露并非主要瓶颈。当被问及这些页面时，它们能指出危害，并且在思考模式下经常将冲突写进推理过程却仍确认执行。因此，安全识别并不能可靠地转化为安全执行，且这种转化依赖于信息渠道：同样的警告在用户指令中比在屏幕上更能阻止智能体。专有模型则明显更为谨慎。我们在该 https URL 发布SEAM及其生成器和质量门。
translation.brief: 针对现有安全基准无法测试计算机使用智能体能否识别跨屏幕组合危害的问题，构建了SEAM基准，通过多步骤跨应用任务评估智能体在单屏良性但组合有害场景下的行为。

papers.title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
papers.abstract: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.

translation.title: VITAL：一个用于验证药物研发与临床试验运营中智能体AI的框架
translation.abstract: 当前的保障方法无法确定证据是否足以在制药使用场景中验证、监督和治理智能体人工智能（AI）。合理的输出可能掩盖检索、推理、编排或人类控制点上的失败，而这些地方缺乏参考标准。我们通过现状分析、法规和标准映射、专家访谈以及多利益相关方细化，开发并落地了VITAL（Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence），一个面向临床开发中智能体的验证框架。VITAL在风险调整框架内整合了使用场景、控制措施、行为验证和生命周期证据。我们将VITAL应用于流行病学和治疗格局分析、研究中心选择、入组挽救和试验设计权衡支持，将自主性、可逆性、透明度和患者影响转化为相称的验证活动、证据要求和可审计的系统行为重建。VITAL可为更高风险制药用途的证据要求和生命周期问责提供参考；评估应考虑在不同评估者、组织和系统配置之间的可复现性。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏制药场景下智能体AI验证证据标准的问题，开发了整合使用场景、控制措施、行为验证与生命周期证据的风险调整验证框架VITAL并应用于临床试验运营场景。

papers.title: Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
papers.abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) in late 2022 has raised questions about the future of science, but assessing their impact requires understanding how scientific practices were already evolving. We analyze 2.5 million full-text papers across five disciplines from 2015 to 2025, tracing trends over a broad spectrum of lexical, structural, epistemological, and social dimensions. Aside from frequency shifts in some words, most pre-2023 trends continued with limited detectable breaks. Among the notable exceptions, growth in computer science coauthor teams accelerated significantly in Asia, while apparent declines in biomedical topic diversity largely reflected standardization in article formats. Our study establishes an empirical foundation for monitoring the health of global science as LLM adoption deepens.

translation.title: 大语言模型尚未改变科学
translation.abstract: 2022年底大语言模型（LLM）的出现引发了关于科学未来的讨论，但评估其影响需要了解科学实践本身已有的演变趋势。我们分析了2015至2025年间五个学科的250万篇全文论文，追踪词汇、结构、认识论和社会等广泛维度上的趋势。除部分词频变化外，大多数2023年之前的趋势延续而未出现明显断裂。在少数显著的例外中，亚洲计算机科学合著团队的增长明显加速，而生物医学主题多样性的表面下降很大程度上反映了论文格式的标准化。我们的研究为在LLM应用不断深入的背景下监测全球科学健康状况奠定了实证基础。
translation.brief: 该论文评估LLM对科学实践的实际影响，通过分析2015-2025年五学科250万篇论文的多维度趋势来判断是否存在可检测的转变。

papers.title: How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
papers.abstract: Web research agents gather information online and write cited reports, including financial analysis. Users can state a priority to guide this research, but a priority may not say how to judge the options, leaving the agent to choose the criteria. We examine how two such agents, built on OpenAI and Anthropic models, interpret a stated priority. In 36 runs, the agents compared Microsoft and Alphabet as businesses. Prompts asked for special attention to growth or resilience, or gave no priority. We analyzed reports, searches, returned sources and cited sources. Of the 24 reports given a priority, 21 focused on it, but their criteria varied. Under the growth priority, OpenAI reports that ranked the companies accounted for risk or predictability and favored Microsoft, while the Anthropic ones judged growth by its pace and favored Alphabet. Under the resilience priority, reports used partly different criteria, and most named Microsoft as the more resilient company. Of the search and source measures tested, only the Anthropic agent's search wording differed detectably by condition. These findings suggest evaluations should examine the criteria behind a report's judgements, not only its focus or accuracy. Interfaces could let users see and adjust those criteria.

translation.title: 网络研究智能体如何解读用户优先事项
translation.abstract: 网络研究智能体在线收集信息并撰写带引用的报告，包括财务分析。用户可以声明一个优先事项来引导研究，但优先事项未必说明如何评判备选项，评判标准由智能体自行选择。我们考察了基于OpenAI和Anthropic模型构建的两个此类智能体如何解读所声明的优先事项。在36次运行中，智能体比较Microsoft和Alphabet这两家公司。提示要求特别关注增长或韧性，或不设优先事项。我们分析了报告、搜索、返回来源和被引用来源。在24份给定优先事项的报告中，21份围绕该优先事项展开，但所用标准各异。在增长优先条件下，OpenAI的报告在排名时考虑了风险或可预测性并倾向Microsoft，而Anthropic的报告以增长速度评判并倾向Alphabet。在韧性优先条件下，报告使用了部分不同的标准，多数认为Microsoft更具韧性。在所测试的搜索与来源指标中，只有Anthropic智能体的搜索措辞在不同条件下出现可检测的差异。这些发现表明，评估应审视报告判断背后的标准，而不仅是其关注点或准确性。界面可以让用户查看并调整这些标准。
translation.brief: 该论文研究网络研究智能体如何自行选择评判标准来解读用户给出的模糊优先事项，通过对比Microsoft与Alphabet的36次实验分析OpenAI与Anthropic智能体的报告行为。

papers.title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
papers.abstract: Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability. Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI

translation.title: RagHarnessDebugger：Jev引导的智能体RAG在合同推理修复审计中的应用
translation.abstract: 使用检索增强生成（RAG）的智能体系统需要通过收集更多证据、尝试替代策略来修复自身答案，并判断是否、何时以及需要何种修复。然而，当准确率等指标可能产生误导时，我们如何知道系统的修复是否有效？我们提出RagHarnessDebugger，这是一个在Jev引导的测试框架中记录合同推理的每个修复决策，并对记录进行审计以实现对RAG修复过程中所有决策完整调试的框架。RagHarnessDebugger检查每条轨迹的完整性、每项验证是否针对其对应的候选对象，以及接受规则能够覆盖哪些答案。我们在ContractNLI保密协议上用两个阅读模型和一个独立合同的复现集进行了测试。调试器的审计层暴露了被聚合指标掩盖的失败模式，包括修复策略中接受成本与回归的权衡，以及开发和复现集上分别有77%和76%可用但未被实现的修复的政策接受差距。我们的审计结合标注的错误分析和回放机制，可以沿执行路径追踪到最终决策——揭示缺失的修复在何处丢失。改进后的测试框架在开发合同和复现集上分别比仅用BM25的初始基线提升准确率3.6和3.7分，甚至在开发集和复现集上比完全访问合同文本的参考分数提升1.1和2.4分。虽然本文展示了调试器如何对漏掉的修复进行决策根因分析，其真正价值在于提供判断可见性，持续改进RAG决策及其可解释性。关键词：agentic RAG、AI证据修复、harness可解释性、反事实回放、Jev、ContractNLI
translation.brief: 该论文针对RAG智能体自我修复决策难以审计的问题，提出RagHarnessDebugger框架，通过Jev引导的记录与审计机制追踪每次修复决策以定位根因。

papers.title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.

translation.title: PhysScope：基于落地视觉记忆的智能体多模态物理推理
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）虽能正确解读物理示意图，却可能在约束条件不成立的状态或情境中应用这些约束，导致前提错误在后续计算中传播。我们提出PhysScope，一种推理时的视觉测试框架，无需更新模型权重即可支持对这类范围错配的自我纠正。PhysScope使模型能够将物理范围直接关联到其视觉观察，并显式构造派生视图以支持推理。该框架在模型推理过程中对状态区分、条件和物理范围施加显式约束，并根据来源和范围检验智能体提出的修订。被接受的修订会使已注册的依赖项失效，从而维护具有范围感知的工作记忆。在PhysAlign上，PhysScope在所有六个受测VLM上的解题得分均高于直接求解。配合Gemini-3.8-flash，它比Canvas-CoT高出9.34个百分点，并在分布外（OOD）的PhysUniBench基准上显著提升解题准确率。消融实验支持将显式范围管理和依赖维护作为多模态物理推理智能体的设计原则。
translation.brief: 该论文解决VLM在物理推理中将约束错误应用于不适用的状态或条件的问题，提出PhysScope推理时视觉框架，通过显式范围管理和依赖失效机制实现自我纠正。

papers.title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
papers.abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.

translation.title: ForecastGym：面向预测智能体的实时、可控且可回放的基准
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的智能体越来越多地通过搜索网络并对所获内容推理来预测真实世界事件。此类智能体的预测质量既取决于检索到的证据也取决于模型本身，因此对证据的控制对评估至关重要。实时评估中各系统自行搜索会将检索与推理混在一起，而事后搜索可能通过日期过滤或今天对历史页面的排序泄露后续信息。比较不同模型、搜索来源和记忆策略，既需要固定证据，也需要记录证据在结果揭晓前如何演变。我们提出ForecastGym，它每两天记录四个商业网络搜索API对公开预测市场问题返回的结果，并在结果揭晓后离线回放这些冻结证据，在固定的证据获取策略下比较模型、记忆和所采集的搜索来源。其首个版本包含150个问题、614个证据状态（每个问题每个采集时间各一）和13.1万条搜索结果。结果揭晓后重跑相同查询，尽管使用了日期过滤，仍有高达92%的问题返回的结果几乎直接透露答案。在冻结证据上，所有受测LLM的预测准确率均落后于市场。诊断分析表明，在高差距状态下，遗漏公开信息比误读信息的贡献更大。更换搜索API可使模型的Brier分数变化高达0.043，超过模型之间的差异幅度，而持久化笔记的得分与重读全部证据相当，但输入token只需一半。预测者看到的证据可能与阅读证据的模型同样重要。
translation.brief: 该论文解决预测智能体评估中检索证据不可控和信息泄露的问题，提出ForecastGym基准，定期记录搜索API返回结果并在结果揭晓后离线回放冻结证据以实现可控比较。

papers.title: SPICE: Sparse Parameter Gossip for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract: Pretraining language models across geographically distributed resources requires communication-efficient methods that operate under limited and variable internet bandwidth. Decentralized training replaces global collectives with peer exchanges, but full-model messages make larger peer neighborhoods costly. We introduce SPICE, which combines sparse parameter gossip with error feedback through corrected parameter values that remain directly interpretable as peer neighborhoods change. These sparse exchanges make broader neighborhoods affordable, achieving better training quality with less communication than the evaluated dense decentralized baselines. As the replica count grows, SPICEincreases the number of peers contacted while keeping individual messages sparse, limiting the quality degradation observed with dense gossip. Under bandwidth constraints, SPICE achieves higher training throughput than DDP and dense gossip, while sustaining throughput during transient link slowdowns.

translation.title: SPICE：面向LLM预训练的稀疏参数Gossip
translation.abstract: 在地理分布的资源上预训练语言模型，需要在有限且多变的互联网带宽下高效通信的方法。去中心化训练用节点间点对点交换取代全局集合通信，但全模型消息使得更大的邻居集合代价高昂。我们提出SPICE，它将稀疏参数gossip与误差反馈相结合，通过校正后的参数值使参数在邻居集合变化时仍可直接解释。这些稀疏交换使更广泛的邻居集合变得可负担，与所评估的稠密去中心化基线相比，以更少通信获得更好的训练质量。随着副本数量增长，SPICE增加联系的节点数同时保持单条消息稀疏，限制了稠密gossip中观察到的质量退化。在带宽受限下，SPICE实现比DDP和稠密gossip更高的训练吞吐量，并在链路短暂变慢时保持吞吐量。
translation.brief: 针对跨地域去中心化LLM预训练中全模型消息通信开销大的问题，提出将稀疏参数gossip与误差反馈结合的SPICE方法以扩大邻居集合并提升通信效率。

papers.title: WIP: Exploring Student-Created AI Agents and Instructional Videos to Foster Engagement in Computing Education
papers.abstract: This work-in-progress (WIP) research-to-practice study examines the use of student-created artifacts to promote active learning in a large undergraduate Software Design and Engineering (SWE) course. Active learning strategies have been shown to significantly enhance student engagement, comprehension, and motivation, particularly in computing education. In this work, we explore the use of student-created artifacts to foster student engagement in higher-level Computer Science (CS) courses. Specifically, we examine the experiences of undergraduate and graduate CS students who participated in the creation of two types of artifacts: instructional video tutorials and conversational AI agents. The goal being to understand how designing these artifacts could support students in applying and learning course content. Students raised valuable insights regarding both experiences. Concerning the creation of instructional videos, they appreciated the interactivity brought through multimedia to their learning experiences, although some found the strategy to be time-consuming. Similarly, when designing conversational AI agents, students enjoyed the novelty and practical application of the task, while some encountered challenges related to the complexity of tools such as \textit{Google Dialogflow ES}. We report on the potential of student-created artifacts to foster deeper engagement with course material, encouraging both creativity and critical thinking in computing education.

translation.title: WIP：探索学生创建的AI智能体与教学视频以促进计算机教育中的参与度
translation.abstract: 这项进行中的研究到实践（WIP）研究考察了在大型本科软件设计与工程（SWE）课程中使用学生创建的作品来促进主动学习。主动学习策略已被证明能显著提升学生的参与度、理解力和动机，尤其是在计算机教育中。在本工作中，我们探索使用学生创建的作品来促进高阶计算机科学（CS）课程中的学生参与度。具体而言，我们考察了参与创建两类作品的本科和研究生CS学生的体验：教学视频教程和对话式AI智能体，目的是理解设计这些作品如何支持学生应用和学习课程内容。学生对两种体验都提出了有价值的见解。关于教学视频制作，他们赞赏多媒体为学习体验带来的互动性，尽管一些人认为该策略耗时。类似地，在设计对话式AI智能体时，学生喜欢任务的新颖性和实践应用，而一些人遇到了与Google Dialogflow ES等工具复杂性相关的挑战。我们报告了学生创建作品在促进对课程材料更深入参与方面的潜力，在计算机教育中同时激发创造力和批判性思维。
translation.brief: 通过让学生制作教学视频和对话式AI智能体两类作品，考察学生创建作品如何提升高阶CS课程的学习参与度。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study
papers.abstract: Efficient control of underfloor heating (UFH) systems coupled with heat pumps (HPs) is challenging due to the high thermal inertia of buildings and the slow dynamic response of UFH systems. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a data-driven control approach capable of simultaneously optimizing energy consumption and thermal comfort. However, the application of DRL-based controllers in occupied buildings under real operating conditions remains limited. This work presents and end-to-end case study (development, evaluation, and real-world deployment) of a DRL-based controller for an integrated UFH-HP system. First, a simulation-based pilot study was conducted to assess different DRL algorithms, control strategies, and configurations. Subsequently, a digital twin of a real residential building was developed and used to train DRL agents under simulated operating conditions. The best-performing agent was then deployed in the physical building without additional online fine-tuning. The results show that the controller successfully maintained indoor temperatures within the prescribed comfort limits while dynamically adjusting the HP supply temperature and UFH valve positions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of deploying DRL controllers in occupied buildings and highlight their robustness and the practical challenges associated with transferring control policies from digital environments to real heating systems.

translation.title: 热泵与地暖控制的深度强化学习：一项端到端案例研究
translation.abstract: 由于建筑的高热惯性和地暖（UFH）系统缓慢的动态响应，对热泵（HP）耦合地暖系统的高效控制极具挑战。深度强化学习（DRL）提供了一种数据驱动的控制方法，能够同时优化能耗与热舒适度。然而，基于DRL的控制器在真实运行条件下有人居住建筑中的应用仍然有限。本工作针对集成UFH-HP系统的DRL控制器提出一项端到端案例研究（开发、评估与真实部署）。首先进行基于仿真的试点研究，评估不同的DRL算法、控制策略和配置。随后开发了真实住宅建筑的数字孪生，用于在模拟运行条件下训练DRL智能体。表现最佳的智能体随后被部署到实体建筑中，无需额外的在线微调。结果表明，控制器在动态调节HP供水温度和UFH阀门开度的同时，成功将室内温度维持在规定的舒适限值内。这些发现证明了在有人居住建筑中部署DRL控制器的可行性，并突出了其鲁棒性以及将控制策略从数字环境迁移到真实供暖系统所面临的实际挑战。
translation.brief: 针对热泵-地暖系统因高热惯性和慢响应难以高效控制的问题，采用仿真试点、数字孪生训练与真实建筑部署的端到端深度强化学习控制方案。

papers.title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
papers.abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.

translation.title: 价值观塑造自我改进编码智能体的构建产物
translation.abstract: 自我改进智能体通常针对其产出的结果进行优化，较少关注它们如何产出这些结果。其指令为设计师提供了有限的方式来塑造其工作方式，尤其是当任务开放时。本文研究在智能体持久指令文件中的简短价值声明是否不仅改变智能体的表现，还改变它构建的内容。评估了Schwartz基本人类价值观理论中的四种高阶价值类型：开放性、保守性、自我增强和自我超越。在多样编码任务中，每次运行的多次自我改进迭代内价值观保持固定。得出三个发现：（1）价值观对多样任务上的表现有影响。开放性价值观提升在留出数据上的表现，而相反的保守性价值观导致得分低于未给予任何价值观的智能体。（2）价值观改变智能体构建的内容，产生在规模、复杂度和方法上不同的解法算法。（3）仍需要人类监督来设计价值观。允许智能体自行修改其价值观会缩小不同价值观集合之间的差异，而从AI文献中蒸馏的价值观相比无价值观没有可检测的增益。因此，恰当设计的价值观能够影响自我改进编码智能体构建的内容，并且在任务允许时影响其表现好坏。
translation.brief: 研究在智能体指令文件中写入Schwartz价值观声明是否会改变自我改进编码智能体的表现与构建产物，发现开放性价值观提升性能、保守性降低性能且人类设计价值观仍然必要。

papers.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
papers.abstract: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

translation.title: 分辨率假设：智能体进化的关键在于识别改进
translation.abstract: 智能体进化遵循一个简单循环：提案者生成候选产物（提示、技能、记忆），选择机制接受得分更高的那些。该循环已显示出前景，但实践者面临一个困惑：各方法在不同论文间互有胜负，且进化在某些任务上常常无法自举。我们将这一困惑追溯到分辨率假设：智能体进化停滞并非因为方法无法提出更好的产物，而是因为带噪声的评估无法可靠地识别它们。在七种进化方法和六个模型（超过1000万次LLM调用）上，我们在使用评估得分的两个层面都找到了对该假设的支持。在候选层面（选择产物），有益的候选产物确实存在，但选择机制区分有益与有害候选的能力并不比随机好，因此错误在多轮中累积。在方法层面（对方法排序），典型的几个百分点差距小于同一方法两次独立运行之间的差异，因此发表的排名往往取决于运气。这些发现共同表明，智能体进化常常被可靠识别改进所瓶颈。这要求我们在开发和评估自我改进智能体方面进行转变：从设计更多候选改进系统，转向使真正的改进可被检测和累积。
translation.brief: 针对智能体进化中排名不稳与无法自举的困惑，提出分辨率假设并通过大规模实验论证其根源在于噪声评估无法可靠识别真正的改进。

papers.title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
papers.abstract: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.

translation.title: 面向智能体治理的多自然语言准则运行时验证
translation.abstract: AI 智能体受数百条自然语言准则约束，然而现有验证器无法高效地将智能体输出与大量此类准则进行比对评估，并报告哪些准则被满足、被违反或不适用。我们提出 VFM，一种树注意力验证器，它编码共享上下文与目标文本，并行对 N 条自然语言准则打分，返回独立的逐准则三元判定。VFM 在 CriteriaBank 上预训练，该语料库包含 394K 个（上下文、目标、准则、判定）四元组，涵盖超过 321K 条不同准则字符串。微调后的 VFM-4B 在一个合成治理基准上超越了 GPT-5.4。在 DynaBench 多准则基准上，它在轨迹级失败检测上优于 DynaGuard-4B，其逐准则判定能定位被违反的规则，并支持聚焦式升级到更大的思维链裁判。我们证明 CriteriaBank 预训练提升了跨域迁移能力，尤其在低数据场景下，同时在全量数据下与强基线直接微调持平。在单张 H100 上，VFM-4B 在 <11 GB 显存下可在 2 秒内对 4K token 上下文评估 1,000 条准则，使其适用于运行时验证。
translation.brief: 针对无法高效比对大量自然语言治理准则的问题，提出树注意力验证器 VFM，通过 CriteriaBank 预训练并行输出逐准则三元判定。

papers.title: Transfer Once, Ask Locally: Compact Audio-Visual Memory for On-Device Question Answering
papers.abstract: Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. One approach is to run audio-visual encoders on a server and a lightweight language decoder on the user device, keeping questions local while offloading media encoding. However, transferring and processing the full multimodal representation remains costly. We propose a training-free, query-agnostic token pruning framework that constructs a compact, reusable memory before transmission. We define video spatio-temporal blocks and aligned audio windows as players and estimate their importance through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation. We use an embedding coverage objective that combines query-independent utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration and rewards unimodal diversity through marginal coverage gains. We retain the original token embeddings of high-scoring players under a limited token budget and transfer the resulting memory once for reuse across subsequent local questions. Experiments on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) show that our method achieves the best or tied-best QA accuracy among the compared compression methods across all evaluated settings. On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80\% pruning, our method improves accuracy by 12.86--14.62 percentage points over these methods while achieving the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to $1.92\times$ decoding speedup at comparable embedding memory usage.

translation.title: 一次迁移，本地提问：面向端侧问答的紧凑音视频记忆
translation.abstract: 在轻量级用户设备上进行音视频问答需要在速度、内存占用、隐私与通信之间取得平衡。一种做法是在服务器上运行音视频编码器，在用户设备上运行轻量级语言解码器，使提问保持在本地而将媒体编码卸载到服务器。然而，传输和处理完整的多模态表示仍然代价高昂。我们提出一个免训练、与查询无关的 token 剪枝框架，在传输前构建紧凑、可复用的记忆。我们将视频时空块和对齐的音频窗口定义为 player，并通过蒙特卡洛 Shapley 估值估计其重要性。我们使用嵌入覆盖目标，将查询无关效用与跨模态冗余校准相结合，并通过边际覆盖增益奖励单模态多样性。我们在有限的 token 预算下保留高得分 player 的原始 token 嵌入，并将所得记忆一次性传输以供后续本地问题复用。在 Video-MME、Daily-Omni 和 Video-Holmes 上使用 video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) 和 video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) 的实验表明，在所有评估设置中，我们的方法在所比较的压缩方法中取得了最佳或并列最佳的问答准确率。在 Daily-Omni 上使用 video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) 并剪枝 80% 时，我们的方法相比这些方法提升准确率 12.86–14.62 个百分点，同时实现最低的设备端 LLM prefill 与解码延迟，在相近嵌入内存占用下解码加速最高达 1.92 倍。
translation.brief: 针对端侧音视频问答传输代价高的问题，提出免训练的基于 Shapley 估值的 token 剪枝框架，构建紧凑可复用的多模态记忆并一次性传输。

papers.title: BugGen 2.0: Rethinking the Roles of LLMs for Scalable RTL Bug Synthesis
papers.abstract: AI-assisted RTL localization and debugging need ground-truth bug datasets with known locations and observable failures, while testbench grading uses injected bugs to measure detection capability. Creating such datasets at scale remains a major EDA challenge. BugGen 1.0 shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate context-aware RTL mutations. Still, it relies on the model for both choosing where to mutate and generating the edit, which increases inference costs and can lead to invalid choices. BugGen 2.0 changes this division of labor. Deterministic algorithms handle structural analysis, target selection, and validation, while the LLM focuses on localized semantic rewriting. Across four OpenTitan IP blocks and FabScalar with three LLMs, BugGen 2.0 reaches every requested quota of compilable bug scenarios that cause at least two test failures, with 14-16 of 16 configured mutation types represented. In completed same-model comparisons, it reduces token use by 6.8x-15.4x relative to BugGen 1.0 and 1.5x-7.9x relative to Firefly. BugGen 2.0 also expands the dataset without simulating every new bug. After finding accepted scenarios with observable failures, it generates alternative mutations at the same locations, simulates only a subset, and estimates acceptance for the rest. This skips 63.6% of AES and 33.9% of FabScalar variant simulations. Full simulation finds that 77.7% of AES variants and 95.2% of FabScalar variants are accepted, with a 1.09% estimation error on the directly comparable FabScalar set. These results show that focusing LLMs on semantic rewriting lowers inference and simulation cost while improving consistency across models and designs.

translation.title: BugGen 2.0：重新思考 LLM 在可扩展 RTL bug 合成中的角色
translation.abstract: AI 辅助的 RTL 定位与调试需要具备已知位置和可观测失败的真值 bug 数据集，而测试平台评分则使用注入的 bug 来衡量检测能力。大规模创建此类数据集仍是 EDA 领域的重大挑战。BugGen 1.0 表明大语言模型（LLM）能够生成上下文感知的 RTL 变异，但它依赖模型同时完成选择变异位置和生成编辑，这增加了推理成本并可能导致无效选择。BugGen 2.0 改变了这种分工：确定性算法负责结构分析、目标选择和验证，LLM 则专注于局部语义改写。在四个 OpenTitan IP 模块和 FabScalar 上使用三种 LLM，BugGen 2.0 达到了每个请求的配额，即产生可编译且至少引发两次测试失败的 bug 场景，并覆盖 16 种配置变异类型中的 14–16 种。在同模型对比中，其 token 消耗相对 BugGen 1.0 降低 6.8–15.4 倍，相对 Firefly 降低 1.5–7.9 倍。BugGen 2.0 还能无需仿真每个新 bug 即扩展数据集：在找到具有可观测失败的已接受场景后，它在相同位置生成替代变异，仅仿真其中子集并估计其余的接受率，从而跳过 63.6% 的 AES 和 33.9% 的 FabScalar 变体仿真。完整仿真发现 77.7% 的 AES 变体和 95.2% 的 FabScalar 变体被接受，在直接可比的 FabScalar 集合上估计误差为 1.09%。这些结果表明，让 LLM 专注于语义改写可降低推理和仿真成本，同时提升跨模型与跨设计的一致性。
translation.brief: 针对大规模 RTL bug 数据集合成成本高的问题，重新分工让确定性算法负责分析与验证、LLM 专注于语义改写，并通过子集仿真估计减少仿真开销。

papers.title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows. This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures. Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence. Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.

translation.title: 自然语言编程：生成式 AI 时代对语言、记忆与认知的重新思考
translation.abstract: 生成式人工智能正在改变自然语言在计算系统中的角色。在经典自然语言处理（NLP）中，语言被视为计算的对象：用于分析、分类、翻译或生成的东西。大语言模型（LLM）挑战了这一观点，使自然语言日益成为一种可执行的认知媒介，人类通过它来组织推理、编排问题求解并调节人机混合工作流。本文提出自然语言编程（NLPg），作为传统 NLP 的理论与认识论延伸。NLPg 不再仅聚焦于语言理解，而是将提示词概念化为动态认知工件，其外化了目标、约束、假设、验证标准和中间推理状态。因此，提示并非仅仅是一种技术交互手段，而是在分布式人机记忆架构中运作的一种对话式认知编程形式。基于分布式认知、延展心智、元认知和对话学习等理论，本文提出对话式工作记忆的概念，描述提示和对话状态如何作为支持推理连续性与反思性调节的临时外部记忆结构。我们进一步将现有记忆架构（BTMA、SKGE、RMR）映射到该框架上，说明情景、语义和元认知层如何支持长程对话连贯性。最后讨论了对计算语言学和 AI 介导知识系统的启示，提出一种后符号、后界面的范式，其中自然语言同时作为交流媒介、可执行规范、认知脚手架和分布式记忆架构运作。
translation.brief: 针对传统 NLP 将语言仅视为计算对象的局限，提出自然语言编程（NLPg）理论框架，将提示词概念化为对话式认知工件并引入对话式工作记忆概念。

papers.title: Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
papers.abstract: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.

translation.title: 基于对话的动态任务分配
translation.abstract: 高效的多智能体协作需要智能体随目标与职责的演化而调整任务分配。以往的任务分配框架往往假设目标静态、完全可观测，或依赖大语言模型（LLM）而对任务分配或意图缺乏显式、可验证的信念。这些假设限制了其在现实协作中的适用性，因为现实中的智能体通常缺乏关于彼此行为、进度或局部环境的完整信息。为支持部分可观测下的动态任务分配，我们提出一个通信增强的贝叶斯任务分配框架。我们的智能体利用对话降低对环境和协作者的不确定性，同时将决策建立在显式的概率信念之上。我们在 Overcooked 域中扩展动态到达的任务，在完全与部分对象空间可观测两种条件下评估该框架。我们的通信智能体在两种设置下均持续优于普通 LLM 智能体。此外，在完全可观测下，我们的框架与非通信任务分配基线表现相当，但在部分可观测下随任务复杂度增加则显著超越基线，平均加速 0.585，并平均提前 18 个时间步完成。这些结果表明，在部分可观测环境中，我们的智能体在动态任务分配上比基线更高效，且随着可用信息减少，通信的重要性愈加突出。
translation.brief: 针对部分可观测下多智能体动态任务分配的问题，提出通信增强的贝叶斯框架，用对话降低不确定性并基于显式概率信念决策。

papers.title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
papers.abstract: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal. Nevertheless, existing HA-GRPO methods share a key issue: no hint is available at inference time to append to the question, creating a training-inference context mismatch that leads to inconsistent performance gains. In this work, we reinterpret the function of hinting -- not as reducing question difficulty, but as steering model behavior -- and propose ASH (Activation Steering for Hinting), a novel HA-GRPO method built on this view. During training, the model is presented with both hinted and plain questions, while a trainable steering vector is optimized to widen the margins between the model's generation probabilities for responses to the hinted version relative to the plain version, thereby capturing the question-agnostic component of the behavioral shift induced by the hint. During inference, the trained steering vector is directly injected into the model's activation, reproducing the hint-conditioned behavior without requiring any hint in the context. Experiments with four LLMs (Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base, Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct) show that ASH consistently improves pass@$k$ on competition-level mathematics benchmarks (AMC, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) and out-of-distribution benchmarks (Minerva, GPQA-Diamond). Notably, it improves average pass@8 of Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base by \textbf{2.60}\% and \textbf{2.21}\%.

translation.title: 通过激活引导正确实现提示增强GRPO
translation.abstract: GRPO已成为利用可验证奖励激发LLM推理能力的主流强化学习方法。然而它存在一个根本性失败模式：当训练问题超出基础模型当前能力时，所有生成的响应都失败并获得零奖励，无法产生梯度信号，阻碍能力的进一步扩展。一类新兴的GRPO扩展方法，称为提示增强GRPO（HA-GRPO），通过在上下文中添加"提示"来降低问题难度，从而产生可用的梯度信号。然而，现有的HA-GRPO方法存在一个关键问题：推理时没有提示可以附加到问题上，造成训练与推理的上下文不匹配，导致性能提升不一致。在本工作中，我们重新解释了提示的作用——不是降低问题难度，而是引导模型行为——并基于这一观点提出了ASH（Activation Steering for Hinting），一种新颖的HA-GRPO方法。在训练时，模型同时面对带提示和不带提示的问题，并优化一个可训练的引导向量，以扩大模型对带提示版本响应相对于无提示版本响应的生成概率之间的差距，从而捕捉提示所引发的行为变化中与问题无关的成分。在推理时，将训练好的引导向量直接注入模型激活中，复现提示条件下的行为，而无需在上下文中加入任何提示。在四个LLM（Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base、Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct）上的实验表明，ASH在竞赛级数学基准（AMC、OlympiadBench、AIME24、AIME25）和分布外基准（Minerva、GPQA-Diamond）上持续提升pass@$k$。值得注意的是，它使Qwen3-1.7B-Base和Qwen3-4B-Base的平均pass@8分别提升了2.60%和2.21%。
translation.brief: 为解决HA-GRPO训练与推理上下文不匹配的问题，提出ASH方法，通过训练一个可注入激活的引导向量在推理时复现提示效果。

papers.title: RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
papers.abstract: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. To this end, we construct RSI-Prime, a dataset for improving model-training capability, comprising 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories. To help LLMs learn to make high-quality experimental decisions from training practice, we perform fine-grained decision identification and quality annotation, then apply decision-level loss masking to exclude supervision on low-quality behavior. Experiments with GLM-5.3 on PostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training, show that training on RSI-Prime yields a 31.95% relative improvement in overall performance over the original GLM-5.3, highlighting a path toward future RSI systems in which models autonomously sustain their own advancement.

translation.title: RSI-Prime：训练模型来训练模型
translation.abstract: 让大语言模型（LLM）能够自主开展训练并改进目标模型，是实现递归自我改进（RSI）的重要基础。随着LLM的角色从被训练者扩展为训练者，其模型训练能力值得专门研究和系统性开发。为此，我们构建了RSI-Prime，一个用于提升模型训练能力的数据集，包含跨七个任务类别的350条完整实验轨迹。为帮助LLM从训练实践中学会做出高质量实验决策，我们进行了细粒度的决策识别和质量标注，然后应用决策级损失掩码，排除对低质量行为的监督。在自主后训练基准PostTrainBench上使用GLM-5.3的实验表明，在RSI-Prime上训练使整体性能相对原始GLM-5.3提升了31.95%，凸显了未来RSI系统中模型自主维持自身进步的一条路径。
translation.brief: 为提升LLM自主训练模型的能力，构建包含决策质量标注的实验轨迹数据集RSI-Prime，并用决策级损失掩码进行微调训练。

papers.title: GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
papers.abstract: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.

translation.title: GameRealm：以交互式游戏为基础的视觉学习
translation.abstract: 视觉基础模型是物理智能的核心，但其发展仍受限于训练数据集碎片化、标注质量不一致以及多模态监督有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出GameRealm，一个大规模、丰富标注的数据集，将视觉观察与同步的游戏原生监督相结合。GameRealm涵盖超过1.2亿帧RGB图像和总计1,000小时的全视角游戏画面。除了前所未有的规模外，GameRealm还提供丰富的多模态监督，包括度量深度、相机参数、同步音频、控制输入和3D点轨迹。其多样性还体现在灵活的视角配置上，涵盖单视角、立体、多视角和全景录制。为实现跨多样游戏环境的可扩展采集，我们开发了统一的数据收集流水线，结合人工操作交互与智能体探索。在多种视觉学习任务上的大量实验表明，GameRealm能持续增强视觉基础模型在视觉生成和几何学习方面的能力。这些结果确立了GameRealm作为一个通用且有价值的数据资源，为推进视觉智能开辟了新机遇。
translation.brief: 为解决视觉基础模型训练数据碎片化与多模态监督不足的问题，构建了基于游戏环境的大规模多模态标注数据集GameRealm及统一采集流水线。

papers.title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
papers.abstract: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.

translation.title: Mind the Gap：一个用于文档维护的已部署多智能体系统
translation.abstract: "AI革命"使科技行业的各团队能以前所未有的速度交付软件功能。代码的演进比以往任何时候都快，而面向客户的文档往往难以跟上步伐。随着用户日益依赖以文档作为主要接口的基于LLM的智能体，这种文档差距的影响愈发严重：过时的信息被传播并被当作权威。识别文档滞后位置的信号本已大量存在，既有显式的（如已解决的支持工单揭示文档缺失之处），也有隐式的（如自动化循环可检测出的代码与文档不一致）。我们部署了一个多智能体系统，围绕一个名为"TriAgent"的分流智能体构建，持续提取这些信号并修复文档漂移。在43天的影子模式运行中，我们的系统分流了499个工单，发现了92处文档缺口。通过来自独立模型系列的LLM评审小组，TriAgent可验证的断言中有81.1%是正确的（人工解决方案涉及的302个断言中有245个正确；三位评审多数投票）；在长度相当的对比中，评审小组在70.5%的配对中更偏好TriAgent的回复，在23.2%中更偏好人类工程师的回复（其余无多数意见）。重要的是，智能体与人类来源的回复往往互补，人类常常挖掘出要么埋藏在现有文档中、要么完全缺失的洞见；我们的系统将每个这样的洞见转化为文档缺口，经人工审核后变为修复。修复缺口可衡量地改善了智能体后续的回答：当智能体在修复后重新回答同一工单时，盲评评审在71.4%的情况下更偏好修复后的回答而非其修复前的回答（n=35）。盲评人工审计证实了在自我改进方面的高度一致性。
translation.brief: 为解决代码快速演进导致的文档过时问题，部署了以分流智能体TriAgent为核心的多智能体系统，持续从工单与代码-文档差异中提取信号并修复文档缺口。

papers.title: AI Companions for Young Adult Caregivers: Practical Advice, Emotional Depth, and the Limits of Metric Evaluation
papers.abstract: Young adult caregivers (YACs) are individuals aged 18 to 25 currently taking care of a family member, partner, or friend facing chronic illness. AI companions designed specifically for YACs remain underexplored in prior works. We present Carebot, it uses an open-weight LLM (Gemma 3-27B) as its base model, on which we compared fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a combination of both. The fine-tuning was performed based on an existing dataset of conversations with YACs and a psychologist. Three well-being experts evaluated these configurations and preferred the fine-tuned model for the warmth of its responses and its actionable advice tailored to YACs. Based on their choice, we adopted the fine-tuned model as Carebot's final configuration and used it for all subsequent evaluations. An LLM judge preferred this Carebot's responses over the base model's in 85% of evaluated pairs. We then conducted a user study with 90 YACs, half of whom interacted with the base model and half with Carebot. The user study revealed a discrepancy between metric evaluation and actual user perception. Participants who used Carebot were more likely to characterize its replies as overly practical and brief, noting that it favored advice over emotional support. Conversely, participants who used the base model indicated that its responses were more emotionally oriented than practical. Although, fine-tuning made Carebot's replies more practical, but they were not emotionally supportive for users. We argue that support tools for YACs require situation-sensitive emotional depth and aligned evaluation frameworks to study their effectiveness.

translation.title: 面向年轻成人照护者的AI伴侣：实用建议、情感深度与指标评估的局限
