translation.abstract: 年轻成人照护者（YAC）是指18至25岁、正在照护患有慢性疾病的家庭成员、伴侣或朋友的个体。专为YAC设计的AI伴侣在既往研究中仍探索不足。我们提出Carebot，它以开放权重LLM（Gemma 3-27B）为基础模型，并在此基础上比较了微调、检索增强生成（RAG）以及两者结合的方式。微调基于现有的YAC与心理学家对话数据集进行。三位福祉专家评估了这些配置，并更偏好微调后模型回复的温暖度及其针对YAC的可行建议。基于他们的选择，我们采用微调模型作为Carebot的最终配置，并将其用于后续所有评估。LLM评审在85%的评估配对中更偏好此Carebot的回复而非基础模型的回复。随后我们对90名YAC开展了用户研究，其中一半与基础模型交互，一半与Carebot交互。用户研究揭示了指标评估与用户实际感知之间的差异：使用Carebot的参与者更倾向于认为其回复过于实用和简短，指出它偏重建议而非情感支持；相反，使用基础模型的参与者则认为其回复更偏情感而非实用。尽管微调使Carebot的回复更实用，但对用户而言缺乏情感支持。我们认为，面向YAC的支持工具需要情境敏感的情感深度以及与之对齐的评估框架来研究其有效性。
translation.brief: 为给年轻成人照护者提供AI陪伴支持，构建了基于微调Gemma 3-27B的Carebot，并通过用户研究揭示了自动化指标评估与真实用户情感感知之间的差异。

papers.title: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.

translation.title: 面向多语言适配的 MoE-LoRA 方法：系统性实证研究
translation.abstract: 路由式低秩适配器为提升大语言模型（LLM）跨任务性能提供了一种参数高效手段。因此人们假设它们也可用于提升 LLM 对低资源语言的支持——目前 LLM 对英语的服务远好于全球数千种其他语言。然而这一假设从未在统一的多语言评估协议下得到实证验证。我们正是针对这一空白，在冻结的基础模型上，使用 200 种独特语言、超过 9,000 个评估设置，比较了八种低秩适配（LoRA）方法。结果表明，缩小规模的搜索可以找到可行的 LoRA 配置，但无法可靠预测其相对性能，因为排名最高的配置在大规模评估中从来不是最优的。LoRA 能可靠提升模型在翻译数据上的拟合，却始终降低阅读理解能力，且对低资源语言帮助最大。这些发现表明，LoRA 方法应被视为有针对性的工具，而非提升 LLM 多语言能力的通用手段。
translation.brief: 研究 MoE-LoRA 在多语言场景下能否提升低资源语言能力，通过在冻结基础模型上用 200 种语言的大规模评估系统比较八种 LoRA 方法。

papers.title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
papers.abstract: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.

translation.title: 降低观测频率下学习式与运动学轨迹预测的对比
translation.abstract: 自动驾驶的轨迹预测模型通常以固定采样频率的数据训练，而通过车联网（V2X）通信接收的位置数据到达频率为 1-10 Hz。我们研究当历史观测频率下降时，仅使用观测历史的学习式预测器是否仍能保持对匀速（CV）和匀加速（CA）运动学模型的优势。在 Argoverse 2 运动预测数据集上，将焦点智能体的 5 秒历史从 10 Hz 降采样至 5、2 和 1 Hz，在不使用地图和邻近智能体的情况下预测 6 秒未来。针对每个频率训练的 LSTM 循环神经网络（RNN）与在 10 Hz 训练后经线性插值应用于稀疏历史的同一网络进行比较。假设和阈值在训练前固定，各主 RNN 用十个随机种子训练，24,984 个测试场景的结果具有基于场景和种子的 bootstrap 置信区间。频率专用 RNN 的平均位移误差在 5 Hz 时增长 3.1%，2 Hz 时增长 10.1%，1 Hz 时增长 20.3%。与我们的假设相反，其相对更优运动学模型的优势在直线运动中并未消失，在所有频率下于直线运动和转弯上均保持 24-30% 的优势；而对行人而言 CV 更准确。带插值的 10 Hz 模型在降至 2 Hz 时最多比频率专用模型低 1.3% 的精度，但在 1 Hz 时低 11.5%。各假设均只得到部分支持。
translation.brief: 研究观测频率降低时学习式轨迹预测器相对 CV/CA 运动学模型的优势是否保持，通过在 Argoverse 2 上降采样对比 LSTM RNN 与运动学模型。

papers.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.

translation.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure（ATI）：面向跨组织自主 AI 智能体的联邦身份、信任、证明与问责架构
translation.abstract: AI 智能体日益跨越组织边界协作，调用工具并与由独立实体运营的智能体交互。尽管现有智能体框架支持规划与协调，但缺乏验证跨组织智能体身份、执行完整性和授权的统一机制。我们提出 Agent Trust Infrastructure（ATI），一种构建于公钥基础设施（PKI）、零信任架构（ZTA）和远程证明之上的框架无关安全架构。ATI 通过对等的组织级证书颁发机构（AgentCA）建立联邦信任，无需共享根权威。在执行请求之前，ATI 验证智能体证书、核实已批准的模型、工具和系统提示配置，并通过三项策略检查实施授权。我们将 ATI 实现为外部安全执行层，与现有智能体框架集成而无需修改其底层模型。我们在由八个组织组成的模拟联邦中评估 ATI，使用六个智能体框架，每个部署五智能体团队。安全实验涉及两个组织，在五种智能体模型上评估 14 种攻击场景和六个良性任务，每种攻击使用五个变体、每变体三次重复。由裁判模型组成的评审团评估实验结果。启用全部执行机制后，攻击遏制率从 43% 提升至 84%（在所有配置下统一评估的 11 种攻击场景中从 40% 提升至 80%），同时执行机制每个请求仅引入约 174 微秒的开销。ATI 以开源、框架无关的包发布，使用 IETF WIMSE 工作负载令牌格式进行身份与请求验证，使用实体证明令牌验证模型、工具和系统提示的完整性。
translation.brief: 针对跨组织 AI 智能体缺乏统一身份、完整性与授权验证机制的问题，提出基于 PKI、零信任架构和远程证明的框架无关安全架构 ATI。

papers.title: Identifying and Repairing Energy Smells with Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Energy smells are inefficient implementations that waste energy. Once code reaches production, these smells become costlier and riskier to fix, so energy efficiency checks should shift left, i.e., move earlier in the development lifecycle, to where code is written. Existing energy smell tools rely on fixed static rules and do not measure energy savings, whereas LLM-based optimizers mostly target execution time and rarely ground their changes in concrete smell definitions. To address both limitations, we present DR. GREENS, an agent skill that detects and repairs energy smells in Python code within the developer's coding environment. The skill grounds the coding agent in our taxonomy of 12 energy smells and 65 root causes, augmented with repair guidance drawn from 230 measured cases. The skill also encapsulates a static analyzer and an independent verifier to confirm behavior preservation and energy saving for each attempted repair. We evaluated DR. GREENS in 18 sessions on three open-source repositories, with two models and three skill configurations. Of the 258 measured repairs, 68.6% saved energy, with a median saving of 24.9%. Compared with a baseline skill that lacks the taxonomy, the full skill found more energy smells with verified savings in all three repositories with both models. DR. GREENS helps developers detect energy hotspots and fix them reliably without altering program behavior, which makes energy-efficient development more feasible.

translation.title: 利用智能体技能识别与修复能源坏味道
translation.abstract: 能源坏味道是指浪费能源的低效代码实现。代码进入生产环境后，修复这些坏味道的成本和风险都会增加，因此能效检查应当左移，即前移到开发周期中编写代码的阶段。现有的能源坏味道工具依赖固定的静态规则且不度量节能效果，而基于 LLM 的优化器大多只关注执行时间，很少将修改建立在具体的坏味道定义之上。为同时解决这两个局限，我们提出 DR. GREENS，一种在开发者编码环境中检测并修复 Python 代码能源坏味道的智能体技能。该技能以我们提出的包含 12 种能源坏味道和 65 个根因的分类体系为编码智能体提供依据，并辅以来自 230 个实测案例的修复指南。该技能还封装了一个静态分析器和一个独立验证器，以确认每次修复尝试都保持了程序行为并实现了节能。我们在三个开源仓库上进行了 18 个会话的评估，使用两种模型和三种技能配置。在 258 次实测修复中，68.6% 实现了节能，中位节能为 24.9%。与缺少分类体系的基线技能相比，完整技能在两种模型下均在全部三个仓库中发现了更多经验证节能的能源坏味道。DR. GREENS 帮助开发者检测能源热点并可靠地修复而不改变程序行为，使高能效开发更加可行。
translation.brief: 针对现有能源坏味道工具规则固定且不度量节能效果的问题，提出结合坏味道分类体系、静态分析与独立验证器的智能体技能 DR. GREENS 来检测并修复 Python 代码中的能源坏味道。

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

translation.title: LLM 智能体还需要被告知如何自我改进吗？
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体日益驱动自身的学习。自我改进方法将模型优化的 various 组件委托给模型本身。随着模型能力增强，这引发一个基本问题：这些日益强大的模型是否还需要我们指定它们应如何自我改进？本文研究一种自主范式：在给定基本原语、资源和一般性自我改进目标的情况下，智能体自行构建用于基于上下文优化的自学习算法。以游戏玩法作为测试平台，一个冻结的 LLM 智能体获得计算预算以及收集经验和更新文本文档的工具，并在没有外部施加循环或真实世界数据访问的情况下自由实验。我们发现足够强大的模型在这些条件下确实能自我改进，其策略与经典的自我调节学习认知框架以及机器学习文献中关于自生成课程的概念相契合。此外，我们研究了所学文本产物向外部基准的迁移程度，观察到在不同游戏视野、机制和 3D 导航上的提升。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体在仅获得基本原语和资源、无外部指定流程时能否自主构建自我改进算法，通过让冻结 LLM 在游戏环境中自由实验并观测跨基准迁移来验证。

papers.title: Equilibrium Statistics and Stability in Random Two-Population and Three-Population Evolutionary Games
papers.abstract: Multi-population matrix evolutionary games provide a framework for studying adaptation and strategic interactions among heterogeneous agents. When payoffs are uncertain, however, analysing a specified game does not reveal how frequently different evolutionary outcomes occur or how their probabilities depend on modelling assumptions. We study two- and three-population games with two strategies per population and both within- and between-population pairwise interactions, with payoffs fixed during each evolutionary trajectory. For two populations, we derive equilibrium-existence probabilities and analytical stability results for generic games and three structured classes: diversity, exclusive, and avoidance games. For generic two-population games, independent Gaussian sampling of payoff entries and of replicator coefficients produces different equilibrium statistics. Interaction structure further distinguishes coexistence from attraction: diversity and exclusive games share the same interior-existence probability, but only exclusive games admit asymptotically stable interior equilibria. Avoidance games admit transversely attracting equilibrium families without locally asymptotically stable individual points. For generic three-population games under independent payoff sampling, we obtain existence probabilities for all equilibrium types and joint existence-and-stability probabilities for boundary equilibria. Monte Carlo simulations support the analytical predictions and quantify multistability, while phase portraits illustrate initial-condition dependence. Under the same Gaussian payoff-sampling protocol, simulations show a lower frequency of fully mixed equilibria but a higher frequency of multistability for three populations than for two.

translation.title: 随机两种群与三种群演化博弈中的均衡统计与稳定性
translation.abstract: 多种群矩阵演化博弈为研究异质智能体之间的适应与策略互动提供了框架。然而，当收益不确定时，分析一个特定的博弈并不能揭示不同演化结果出现的频率，以及这些概率如何依赖于建模假设。我们研究每个种群有两种策略、包含种群内与种群间两两交互的两种群和三种群博弈，收益在每个演化轨迹期间保持固定。对于两种群情形，我们推导了一般博弈以及三类结构化博弈（多样性博弈、排他博弈和回避博弈）的均衡存在概率和解析稳定性结果。对于一般两种群博弈，对收益元素和对复制子系数的独立高斯采样会产生不同的均衡统计量。交互结构进一步区分了共存与吸引：多样性博弈与排他博弈具有相同的内部均衡存在概率，但只有排他博弈容许渐近稳定的内部均衡。回避博弈容许横向吸引的均衡族，但没有局部渐近稳定的个体均衡点。对于独立收益采样下的一般三种群博弈，我们得到了所有均衡类型的存在概率以及边界均衡的存在与稳定的联合概率。蒙特卡洛模拟支持解析预测并量化了多稳态，相图则说明了对初始条件的依赖性。在相同的高斯收益采样协议下，模拟显示三种群相比两种群完全混合均衡的频率更低，但多稳态的频率更高。
translation.brief: 该论文研究收益不确定下两种群与三种群演化博弈中各类均衡的存在概率与稳定性，通过解析推导结合蒙特卡洛模拟刻画均衡统计规律。

papers.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
papers.abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.

translation.title: Ambient LLMs：基于温度匹配的数据高效监督微调
translation.abstract: 为自回归语言模型收集大规模、多样且高质量的后训练数据集十分困难。因此，监督微调（SFT）通常应用于远小于预训练数据规模的数据集，这会导致过拟合以及对数据分布尾部知识的灾难性遗忘。为防止这种坍塌，我们提出了 Ambient SFT，一个利用不完美预测来扩充微调数据集的原则性框架。在我们的方法中，预训练模型的一个"冻结"版本充当噪声教师，微调后的模型只需在粗粒度上与其匹配。具体而言，我们要求后训练模型产生的条件分布的高温版本应与预训练模型的高温版本相匹配。温度超参数控制对预训练模型的信任程度：当 $T\to \infty$ 时退回常规 SFT，而 $T=1$ 时则等价于知识蒸馏。我们证明该方法在领域适应、指令微调和推理任务上均优于标准 SFT，相比标准 SFT 平均相对提升最高达 $21\%$。
translation.brief: 该论文解决小规模SFT数据的过拟合与灾难性遗忘问题，核心方法是让微调模型在高温分布层面匹配冻结预训练模型（温度匹配），并引入温度超参数作为信任度控制。
